body.text: bhikṣuṇī-vinaya
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-vinaya</s> (Disciplinary Code for Nuns)

body.text: STORY OF MAHĀPRAJĀPATĪ GAUTAMĪ
body.translated_text: Story of <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>

body.text:
1. oṃ namo buddhāya | āryamahāsāṃghikānāṃ lokottaravādināṃ madhy'-udeśikānāṃ pāṭhena bhikṣuṇīvinaya
syādiḥ |
body.translated_text: 1. Oṃ, homage to the <s>Buddha</s>. The <s>Bhikṣuṇīvinaya</s> (Disciplinary Code for Nuns) according to the recension of the <s>Āryamahāsāṃghikas</s>, the <s>Lokottaravādins</s>, of the middle region. Thus it begins.

body.text: bhagavān samyaksambuddho yadarthaṃ samudāgato tadartham abhisambhāvayitvā śākyeṣu viharati śākyānāṃ kapilavastusmin nyagrodhārāme śāstā devānāñ ca manuṣyānāñ ca buddho bhagavān satkṛtogurukṛto mānitaḥ pūjito arcito apacāyito lābhāgrayaśo-'graprāpto lābhī cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārānān | tatra cānupalipto padmam iva jalena puṇyabhāgīyān satvān puṇyehi niveśayamāno phalabhāgīyān satvān phalehi pratiṣṭhāpayamāno vāsanābhāgīyān satvān vāsanāyām avasthāpayamāno amṛtam analpakena devamanuṣyān samvibhajanto prāṇikoṭiniyutaśatasahasrāṇy amṛtaṃ anuprāpayanto anavarāgrajātijarāmaraṇasaṃsārakāntāranarakavidurgān mahāprapātād abhyuddharitvā kṣeme śive same sthale abhaye nirvāṇe pratiṣṭhāpayamāno āvarjayitvā aṅgamagadhavṛjimallikāśikośalakurupañcālacedivatsamatsyaśūrasenaśividaśārṇa cāsvakiavanti |
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> (Blessed One), the Perfectly Awakened One, having accomplished the purpose for which he had arisen, dwelt among the <s>Śākyas</s> in the <s>Nyagrodhārāma</s> (Banyan Grove) at <s>Kapilavastu</s> of the <s>Śākyas</s>—the Teacher of gods and humans, the <s>Buddha</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s>, honored, revered, esteemed, worshipped, venerated, and respected, foremost in gains and fame, a recipient of robes, almsfood, lodging, and medicinal requisites for the sick. And therein, untainted like a lotus by water, establishing beings of the merit-portion in merit, establishing beings of the fruition-portion in fruition, establishing beings of the disposition-portion in [proper] disposition, sharing the deathless nectar generously with gods and humans, leading hundreds of thousands of millions of billions of living beings to the deathless, having rescued them from the wilderness of <s>saṃsāra</s> with its low and high births, old age, death, hells, and perilous places—from the great precipice—establishing them in the safe, auspicious, even, firm, fearless [state of] <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, having won over [the people of] <s>Aṅga</s>, <s>Magadha</s>, <s>Vṛji</s>, <s>Malla</s>, <s>Kāśi</s>, <s>Kośala</s>, <s>Kuru</s>, <s>Pañcāla</s>, <s>Cedi</s>, <s>Vatsa</s>, <s>Matsya</s>, <s>Śūrasena</s>, <s>Śivi</s>, <s>Daśārṇa</s>, <s>Aśvaka</s>, and <s>Avanti</s>.

body.text: jñāne dṛṣṭaparākramo svayāṃbhūḥ divyehi vihārehi viharanto brāhmehi vihārehi āryehi vihārehi aniñjehi vihārehi viharanto brāhmehi vihārehi āryehi vihārehi aniñjehi vihārehi sātatye hi vihārehi buddho buddhavihārehi jino jinavihārehi jānako jānakavihārehi sarvajño sarvajñavihārehi cetovasiparamapāramipraptāś ca punar buddhā bhagavanto yehi yehi vihārehi ākāṅkṣanti tehi tehi vihārehi viharanti vihārakuśalāś ca punar buddhā bhagavantaḥ |
body.translated_text: He of proven valor in knowledge, the Self-born One, dwelling in divine abodes, dwelling in <s>Brahma</s>-abodes, noble abodes, imperturbable abodes, constant abodes—a <s>Buddha</s> in <s>Buddha</s>-abodes, a conqueror in conqueror-abodes, a knower in knower-abodes, an omniscient one in omniscient abodes. And furthermore, the <s>Buddhas</s>, the <s>Bhagavāns</s>, having attained the supreme perfection of mastery over the mind, dwell in whatever abodes they wish—and furthermore, the <s>Buddhas</s>, the <s>Bhagavāns</s>, are skilled in [all] abodes.

body.text: 2. atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī cchandāya cchandakapālāya dāsacchandāye cchandakamātare ca pañcahi ca śākiyānīśatehi sārdhaṃ yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte asthāsi ekāntasthitā mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavantam etad avocat | durlabho bhagavan buddhotpādo durlabhā saddharmadeśanā | bhagavāṃs caitarhi loke utpanno tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho dharmo ca deśayati aupasamiko pārinivāṇiko sugatapravedito amṛtasya prāptaye nirvāṇasya sākṣātkriyāya samvartati | sādhu bhagavan mātṛgrāmo pi labheya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasampadaṃ bhikṣuṇibhāvaṃ | bhagavān āha | mā te gautami rocatu tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvo |
body.translated_text: 2. Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>, together with <s>Chandā</s>, <s>Chandakapālā</s>, <s>Dāsacchandā</s>, <s>Chandakamātā</s>, and five hundred <s>Śākya</s> women, approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed her head at the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet, and stood to one side. Standing to one side, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Rare, <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the arising of a <s>Buddha</s>; rare is the teaching of the true <s>Dharma</s>. And now the <s>Bhagavān</s> has arisen in the world—the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One—and teaches the <s>Dharma</s> that is calming, leading to final <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, proclaimed by the <s>Sugata</s>, conducive to the attainment of the deathless and the direct realization of <s>Nirvāṇa</s>. It would be good, <s>Bhagavān</s>, if women too could obtain the going-forth (<s>pravrajyā</s>), full ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>), and the status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> (nun) in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Do not wish for this, <s>Gautamī</s>—the going-forth, full ordination, and status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> for women in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī | na khalu bhagavān mātṛgrāmasya avakāśaṃ karoti tathāgata pravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadāya bhikṣuṇībhāvāyeti | sā bhagavato pādau śirasā vanditvā sārdhaṃ cchandāya cchandakapālāye dāsacchandāye cchandakamātare ca yena tāni pañca śākiyānīśatāni tenopasaṃkramitvā śākiyānīyo etad avocat | na khalu āryamiśrikāyo bhagavān avakāśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāupasaṃpadāya bhikṣuṇībhāvāya | kim puna vayam āryamiśrikāyo sāmam eva keśān otārayitvā kāṣāyāni vastrāṇi ācchādayitvā kośakābaddhehi yānehi bhagavantaṃ kośalehi janapadehi cārikāṃ caramāṇaṃ pṛṣṭhimena pṛṣṭhim ābandhema | sace mo bhagavān anujāniṣyati pravrajiṣyāmo no ca anujāniṣyati evam tu tāyi bhagavato santike brahmacaryañ cariṣyāmaḥ sādhu āryeti tāyo śākiyānīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye pratyāśrauṣi |
body.translated_text: Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> [thought]: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, receive full ordination, and attain the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' She bowed her head at the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet and, together with <s>Chandā</s>, <s>Chandakapālā</s>, <s>Dāsacchandā</s>, and <s>Chandakamātā</s>, approached those five hundred <s>Śākya</s> women and said to them: 'Noble ladies, the <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, receive full ordination, and attain the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. What if we, noble ladies, were to shave our own hair, put on saffron robes, and in covered carriages follow the <s>Bhagavān</s> on his wandering through the <s>Kośala</s> regions, stage by stage? If the <s>Bhagavān</s> grants us permission, we shall go forth; and if he does not grant permission, even so we shall practice the holy life in the <s>Bhagavān's</s> presence.' 'Very well, noble one'—those <s>Śākya</s> women assented to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>.

body.text: 3. atha khalu bhagavān kapilavastusmin nagare yathābhiramyaṃ viharitvā kośaleṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ prakrāmi | atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī sārdhaṃ cchandāye cchandakapalāye dāsacchandāya cchandakamātare ca pañcahi ca śākiyānīśatehi sātmaneva keśān otārayitvā kāṣāyāṇi vastrāṇi ācchādayitvā kośakabaddhehi yānehi bhagavantaṃ kośaleṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ caramāṇaṃ pṛṣṭhimena pṛṣṭham anubandheṃsuḥ |
body.translated_text: 3. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, having dwelt in <s>Kapilavastu</s> as long as he wished, set out on a wandering tour through the <s>Kośala</s> regions. Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>, together with <s>Chandā</s>, <s>Chandakapālā</s>, <s>Dāsacchandā</s>, <s>Chandakamātā</s>, and five hundred <s>Śākya</s> women, having shaved their own hair, put on saffron robes, and in covered carriages, followed the <s>Bhagavān</s> stage by stage on his wandering through the <s>Kośala</s> regions.

body.text: 4. atha khalu bhagavān kośaleṣu janapadeṣu cārikāṃ caramāno mahatā bhikṣusaṃghena sārdhaṃ pañcahi bhikṣuśatehi yena kośalānāṃ śrāvastīnagaraṃ tad avasāri | tad anuprāptas tatraiva viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍadasyārāme |
body.translated_text: 4. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, wandering through the <s>Kośala</s> regions with a great <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s> of five hundred monks, arrived at the city of <s>Śrāvastī</s> of the <s>Kośalas</s>. Having arrived there, he dwelt in the <s>Jetavana</s>, the park of <s>Anāthapiṇḍada</s>.

body.text: atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte asthāsi | ekāntasthitā mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavantam etad avocat | durlabho bhagavan buddhotpādo durlabhā saddharmadeśanā | bhagavāṃś caitarhi loke utpanno tathāgato rhaṃ samyaksambuddho dharmo ca deśate aupasamiko ca pārinirvāṇiko sugatapravedito amṛtasya prāptaye nirvāṇasya sākṣātkriyāya samvartati | sādhu bhagavan mātṛgrāmo pi labheya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | evam ukte bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm etad avocat | mā te gautamī rocatu mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāupasampadābhikṣuṇibhāvo |
body.translated_text: Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed her head at the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet, and stood to one side. Standing to one side, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Rare, <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the arising of a <s>Buddha</s>; rare is the teaching of the true <s>Dharma</s>. And now the <s>Bhagavān</s> has arisen in the world—the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One—and teaches the <s>Dharma</s> that is calming, leading to final <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, proclaimed by the <s>Sugata</s>, conducive to the attainment of the deathless and the direct realization of <s>Nirvāṇa</s>. It would be good, <s>Bhagavān</s>, if women too could obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' Thus addressed, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said this to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Do not wish for this, <s>Gautamī</s>—the going-forth, full ordination, and status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> for women in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: 5. atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī | na khalu bhagavān avakāśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāya upasampadāya bhikṣuṇibhāvasyeti | sā bhagavato pādāṃ śirasā vanditvā jetavanasya ārāmadvārakoṣṭhakasamīpe rodamānī asthāsi pādāṇguṣṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhantī | addaśāśi khu anyataro bhikṣur mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīṃ jetavanasya ārāmadvārakoṣṭhasamīpe rudamānīn tiṣṭhantīṃ pādāṅguṣṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhentīṃ dṛṣṭvā ca punar yenāyuṣmān ānando tenopasaṃkramitvā āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | eṣā āyuṣman ānanda mahāprajāpatī gautamī jetavanasya ārāmakoṣṭhakasamīpe rudamānī tiṣṭhati pādāṅguṣṭhena bhūmiṃ vilikhantī | gacchāvusānanda jānehi kiṃ mahāprapatī gautamī rodīti |
body.translated_text: 5. Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> [thought]: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, receive full ordination, and attain the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' She bowed her head at the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet and stood near the gateway of the <s>Jetavana</s> park, weeping, scratching the ground with her big toe. A certain <s>bhikṣu</s> saw <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> standing near the gateway of the <s>Jetavana</s> park, weeping, scratching the ground with her big toe. Having seen her, he approached the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s> and said this to the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> stands near the gateway of the <s>Jetavana</s> park, weeping, scratching the ground with her big toe. Go, friend <s>Ānanda</s>, find out why <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> is weeping.'

body.text: 6. atha khalu āyuṣmān ānando yena mahāprajāpatī gautamī tenopasaṃkramitvā mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm etad avocat | kiṃ gautami rudasi | evam ukte mahāprajāpatī gautamī āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | alam me āryānanda ruṇṇena yatra hi nāma evaṃ durlabho buddhotpādo evaṃ durlabhā saddharmadeśanā | bhagavāṃś caitarhi loke utpanno tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho dharmo deśīyati aupasamiko pārinirvāṇiko sugatapravedito amṛtasya prāptaye nirvāṇasya sākṣātkriyāyai samvartati | na ca bhagavān avakāśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāyopasampadāya bhikṣuṇībhāvasya ścai sādhu tāvāryānanda bhagavantaṃ yāca yathā labheya mātṛgrāmo pi tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasampadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ |
body.translated_text: 6. Then the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s> approached <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> and said this to her: 'Why do you weep, <s>Gautamī</s>?' Thus addressed, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> said this to the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'I have good reason for my weeping, Noble <s>Ānanda</s>, for the arising of a <s>Buddha</s> is so rare, and the teaching of the true <s>Dharma</s> is so rare. And now the <s>Bhagavān</s> has arisen in the world—the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One—and teaches the <s>Dharma</s> that is calming, leading to final <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, proclaimed by the <s>Sugata</s>, conducive to the attainment of the deathless and the direct realization of <s>Nirvāṇa</s>. Yet the <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, receive full ordination, and attain the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. It would be good if the Noble <s>Ānanda</s> would request the <s>Bhagavān</s> so that women too might obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: 7. sādhu gautamīti āyuṣmān ānando mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye pratiśrutvā yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādauśirasā vanditvā ekānte asthāsi | ekāntasthito āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat durlabho bhagavan buddhotpādo durlabhā saddharmadeśanā bhagavān cetarhi loke utpanno tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho dharmo ca deśyate aupasamiko pārinirvāṇiko sugatapravedito amṛtasya prāptaye nirvāṇasya sākṣātkriyāyai samvartati | sādhu bhagavan mātṛgrāmo pi labheya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upadampadāṃ bhikṣuṇibhāvaṃ | evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | mā te gautamīmātā rocatu mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasampadā bhikṣuṇībhāvo |
body.translated_text: 7. 'Very well, <s>Gautamī</s>'—the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, having agreed to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī's</s> [request], approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed his head at the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet, and stood to one side. Standing to one side, the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Rare, <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the arising of a <s>Buddha</s>; rare is the teaching of the true <s>Dharma</s>. And now the <s>Bhagavān</s> has arisen in the world—the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One—and teaches the <s>Dharma</s> that is calming, leading to final <s>Nirvāṇa</s>, proclaimed by the <s>Sugata</s>, conducive to the attainment of the deathless and the direct realization of <s>Nirvāṇa</s>. It would be good, <s>Bhagavān</s>, if women too could obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' Thus addressed, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said this to the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Do not wish for this for <s>Gautamī's</s> mother—the going-forth, full ordination, and status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> for women in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: 8. atha khalv āyuṣmān ānando | bhagavān nāvakaśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgata pravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāupasaṃpadāye bhikṣuṇībhāvasyeti | bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā yena mahāprajāpati gautamī tenopasaṃkramitvā mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm etad avocat | na khalu gautamī bhagavān avakāśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāyopasaṃpadāya bhikṣuṇībhāvāya | evam ukte mahāprajāpatī gautamī āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | sādhu tāvāryānanda dvitīyaṃ pi bhagavantaṃ yāca yathā mātṛgrāmo pi labheya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāṃ upasaṃpadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sādhu gautamīti āyuṣmān ānando dvitīyaṃ pi mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye pratiśrutvā yena bhagavān tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte asthāsi | ekānte sthito āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat | durlabho bhagavan buddhotpādo ti tad evaṃ sarvaṃ yāva bhikṣuṇībhāvo ti evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | māte gautamī mātā rocatu mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyā upasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvo | saṃyathāpi nāmānanda sampanne yavakaraṇe ca kāraṇḍavaṃ nāma rogarājā ti upanipateya evan taṃ sampannaṃ yavakaraṇaṃ mahatā upakleśena upakliṣṭaṃ bhavati evam eva gautamī mātā yasmin prāvacane mātṛgrāmo pi labhati pravrajyām upasaṃpadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ evan taṃ prāvacanaṃ mahatāmupakleśena upakliṣṭaṃ bhavati | sayyathāpi nāma gautamī mātā sampanne ikṣukaraṇe mañjiṣṭhā nāma rogarājā ti evan taṃ sampannaṃ ikṣukaraṇam mahatā upakleśena upakliṣṭam bhavati | evam eva gautamī mātā yasmin prāvacane mātṛgrāmo pi labhati pravrajyām upasaṃpadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ evan taṃ prāvacanam mahatā upakleśena upakliṣṭam bhavati | sayyathāpi nāma mā te gautamī mātā rocatu mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāmupasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvo |
body.translated_text: 8. Then the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> [thought]: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women (<s>mātṛgrāma</s>) to go forth into homelessness (<s>pravrajyā</s>), to receive full ordination (<s>upasaṃpadā</s>), and to attain the status of a nun (<s>bhikṣuṇī</s>) in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' Having bowed his head at the feet of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, he approached <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> and said to her: 'Indeed, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, to receive full ordination, and to attain the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' When this was said, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Please, noble <s>Ānanda</s>, petition the <s>Bhagavān</s> a second time, so that women too may obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' 'Very well, <s>Gautamī</s>,' said the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, and having agreed to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>'s [request] a second time, he approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed his head at the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s feet, and stood to one side. Standing to one side, the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: '<s>Bhagavan</s>, the arising of a <s>Buddha</s> is rare.' And he said all that as before, up to 'the status of a nun.' When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Do not, <s>Ānanda</s>, let it please your mother <s>Gautamī</s> that women should go forth, receive full ordination, and attain the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. Just as, <s>Ānanda</s>, when a barley crop has flourished, a disease called <s>kāraṇḍava</s> would attack it — thus that flourishing barley crop would be afflicted by a great blight; even so, <s>Ānanda</s>, in whatever dispensation women obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun, that dispensation will be afflicted by a great blight. Just as, mother <s>Gautamī</s>, when a sugarcane crop has flourished, a disease called <s>mañjiṣṭhā</s> (red blight) would attack it — thus that flourishing sugarcane crop would be afflicted by a great blight; even so, mother <s>Gautamī</s>, in whatever dispensation women obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun, that dispensation will be afflicted by a great blight. Therefore, do not, mother <s>Gautamī</s>, let it please you that women should go forth, receive full ordination, and attain the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.'

body.text: 9. atha khalv āyuṣmān ānando | bhagavān nā vakāśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāyopasaṃpadāya bhikṣuṇībhāvasyeti | yena mahāprajāpatī gautamī tenopasaṃkramitvā mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīṃ etad avocat | na khalu gautamī bhagavān avakāśaṃ karoti mātṛgrāmasya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyāyopasaṃpadāya bhikṣuṇībhāvasyeti | evam ukte mahāprajāpatī gautamī āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | sādhu tāvāryānanda tṛtīyaṃ pi bhagavantaṃ yāca yathā mātṛgrāmo pi labheya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sādhu gautamītī āyuṣmān ānando tṛtīyaṃ pi mahāprajāpatīya gautamīya pratiśrutvā yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte niṣīdi ekāntaniṣaṇṇo āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat | purimakānāṃ bhagavan tathāgatānām arhatāṃ samyaksambuddhānāṃ kati parṣāyo abhuvan | evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | purimakānām ānanda tathāgatānām arhatāṃ samyaksambuddhānāṃ catvāri pariṣāyo abhuvan sayyathīdaṃ | bhikṣu bhikṣuṇī upāsakopāsikā |
body.translated_text: 9. Then the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> [thought]: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, to receive full ordination, and to attain the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' He approached <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> and said to her: 'Indeed, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s> does not grant permission for women to go forth, to receive full ordination, and to attain the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' When this was said, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Please, noble <s>Ānanda</s>, petition the <s>Bhagavān</s> a third time, so that women too may obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>.' 'Very well, <s>Gautamī</s>,' said the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, and having agreed to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>'s [request] a third time, he approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed his head at the <s>Bhagavān</s>'s feet, and sat down to one side. Seated to one side, the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: '<s>Bhagavan</s>, did the former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, perfectly and fully awakened ones (<s>samyaksambuddhas</s>), have assemblies?' When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'The former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, perfectly and fully awakened ones, had four assemblies, namely: <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (nuns), <s>upāsakas</s> (male lay followers), and <s>upāsikās</s> (female lay followers).'

body.text: evam ukte āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat | ye ime bhagavan catvāro śrāmaṇyaphalā sayyathīdaṃ śrotaāpattiphalaṃ sakṛdāgāmiphalam anāgāmiphalam agraphalam arhatvaṃ | bhavyo eteṣāṃ mātṛgrāmo pi eko 'pramatto ātāpi vyupakṛṣṭo viharanto sākṣīkartuṃ | evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | yānīmāni ānanda catvāri śrāmaṇyaphalāni sayyathīdaṃ śrotaāpattiphalaṃ yāvad agraphalam arhatvaṃ | bhavyo eteṣāṃ matṛgrāmo pi eko 'pramatto ātāpi vyupakṛṣṭo viharanto sākṣīkartuṃ |
body.translated_text: When this was said, the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: '<s>Bhagavan</s>, these four fruits of the <s>śramaṇa</s> life, namely the fruit of stream-entry (<s>śrotaāpattiphala</s>), the fruit of once-returning (<s>sakṛdāgāmiphala</s>), the fruit of non-returning (<s>anāgāmiphala</s>), and the highest fruit of <s>arhatship</s> (<s>arhatva</s>) — are women too capable, being diligent, ardent, and dwelling in seclusion, of realizing these?' When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'These four fruits of the <s>śramaṇa</s> life, namely the fruit of stream-entry up to the highest fruit of <s>arhatship</s> — women too are indeed capable, being diligent, ardent, and dwelling in seclusion, of realizing these.'

body.text: 10. evam ukte āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat | yato khalu bhagavan purimakānāṃ tathāgatānām arhatāṃ samyaksaṃbuddhānāṃ catvāro parṣāyo abhūṃsuḥ bhikṣubhikṣuṇī upāsakopāsikā | ime catvāri śrāmaṇyaphalāni sayyathīdaṃ | śrotaāpattiphalaṃ yāva agraphalam arhatvaṃ | bhavyo eteṣāṃ mātṛgrāmo pi eko apramatto ātāpi vyupakṛṣṭo viharanto sākṣīkartuṃ | sādhu bhagavan mātṛgrāmo pi labheya tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasaṃpadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | duṣkarakārikā ca bhagavato mahāprajāpatī gautamī āpāyikā poṣikā janetrīye kālagatāye stanyasya dāyikā bhagavāṃś ca kṛtajño kṛtavedī | evam ukte bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | evam etad ānanda duṣkarakārikā ānanda tathāgatasya mahāprajāpatī gautamī āpāyikā poṣikā janetriye kālagatāye stanyasya dāyikā tathāgato ca kṛtajño kṛtavedī ca | api cānanda tathāgato pi mahāprajāpatīya gautamīya duṣkarakārako | tathāgataṃ hy ānandāāgamya mahāprajāpatī gautamī buddhaśaraṇaṃ gatā | dharmaśaraṇaṃ gatā | saṃghaśaraṇaṃ gatā tathāgataṃ hy ānandāgamya mahāprajāpatī gautamī
body.translated_text: 10. When this was said, the venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Since, <s>Bhagavan</s>, the former <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, perfectly and fully awakened ones, had four assemblies — <s>bhikṣus</s>, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>upāsakas</s>, and <s>upāsikās</s> — and since these four fruits of the <s>śramaṇa</s> life, namely the fruit of stream-entry up to the highest fruit of <s>arhatship</s>, are such that women too are capable, being diligent, ardent, and dwelling in seclusion, of realizing them — it would be good, <s>Bhagavan</s>, if women too could obtain the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. And <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> has rendered difficult service to the <s>Bhagavān</s> — she was his nurse, foster-mother, and when his birth-mother passed away, she gave him her breast-milk; and the <s>Bhagavān</s> is grateful and recognizes kindness.' When this was said, the <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'It is so, <s>Ānanda</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> has rendered difficult service to the <s>Tathāgata</s> — she was his nurse, foster-mother, and when his birth-mother passed away, she gave him her breast-milk; and the <s>Tathāgata</s> is grateful and recognizes kindness. But also, <s>Ānanda</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> too has rendered difficult service to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. For it is through the <s>Tathāgata</s> that <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> has gone for refuge to the <s>Buddha</s>, has gone for refuge to the <s>Dharma</s>, has gone for refuge to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; it is through the <s>Tathāgata</s> that <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>

yāvajjīvaṃ adattādānāt prativiratā [2]

children.translated_text: has for life abstained from sexual misconduct, [3]
has for life abstained from false speech, [4]
has for life abstained from the drinking of fermented liquors, spirits, and intoxicants. [5]

body.translated_text: has for life abstained from the taking of life, [1] has for life abstained from taking what is not given, [2]

body.text: tathāgataṃ hy ānandāgamya mahāprajāpatī gautamī śraddhayā vardhati | śīlena vardhati śrutena vardhati tyāgena vardhati | prajñayā vardhati | tathāgataṃ hy ānandāgamya mahāprajāpatī gautamī duḥkhaṃ jānāti samudayaṃ jānāti | nirodhaṃ jānāti | mārgaṃ jānāti ||
body.translated_text: It is through the <s>Tathāgata</s> that <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> grows in faith (<s>śraddhā</s>), grows in moral conduct (<s>śīla</s>), grows in learning (<s>śruta</s>), grows in generosity (<s>tyāga</s>), and grows in wisdom (<s>prajñā</s>). It is through the <s>Tathāgata</s> that <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> knows suffering (<s>duḥkha</s>), knows its origin (<s>samudaya</s>), knows its cessation (<s>nirodha</s>), and knows the path (<s>mārga</s>).'

body.text: 11. yaṃ ānanda pudgalo pudgalam āgamya buddhaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchati | dharmaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchati | saṃghaṃ śaraṇaṃ gacchati | iminā ānanda pudgalena imasya pudgalasya na supratikaraṇaṃ bhavati yāvajjīvaṃ pi na upasthiheya yad uta cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārehi | evaṃ pi na supratikaraṃ bhavati | yaṃ ānanda pudgalo pudgalam āgamya yāvajjīvaṃ prāṇātipātāto prativiramati | yāvajjīvaṃ adattādānāto prativiramati | yāvajjīvaṃ kāmeṣu mithyācārāt prativiramati | yāvajjīvaṃ mṛṣāvādāto prativiramati | yāvajjīvaṃ surāmaireyamadyapānāto prativiramati | iminā pudgalena imasya pudgalasya na supratikaraṃ bhavati | yāvajjīvaṃ api na upasthiheyā | yad uta cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārehi | evaṃ pi na supratikaraṃ bhavati | yaṃ ānanda pudgalo pudgalam āgamya śraddhayā vardhati śīlena śrutena tyāgena prajñayā vardhati | iminānanda pudgalena imasya pudgalasya na supratikaraṃ bhavati | yāvajjīvaṃ pi na upasthiheya yad uta cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārehi | evaṃ pi se na supratikāram bhavati | yaṃ ānanda pudgalo pudgalam āgamya duḥkhaṃ jānāti samudayaṃ jānāti nirodhañ jānāti mārgañ ca jānāti | iminā ānanda pudgalena imasya pudgalasya na supratikāram bhavati | yāvajjīvaṃ pi na upasthiheya yad uta cīvarapiṇḍapātaśayanāsanaglānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārehi | evaṃ pi se na supratikaram bhavati ||
body.translated_text: 11. '<s>Ānanda</s>, when a person through another person goes for refuge to the <s>Buddha</s>, goes for refuge to the <s>Dharma</s>, goes for refuge to the <s>Saṃgha</s> — by that person, the debt to this person cannot be easily repaid, even if one were to attend upon them for one's entire life with robes, alms-food, lodging, and medicines for the sick and their requisites; even so, the debt cannot be easily repaid. When, <s>Ānanda</s>, a person through another person abstains for life from the taking of life, abstains for life from taking what is not given, abstains for life from sexual misconduct, abstains for life from false speech, abstains for life from the drinking of fermented liquors, spirits, and intoxicants — by that person, the debt to this person cannot be easily repaid, even if one were to attend upon them for one's entire life with robes, alms-food, lodging, and medicines for the sick and their requisites; even so, the debt cannot be easily repaid. When, <s>Ānanda</s>, a person through another person grows in faith, moral conduct, learning, generosity, and wisdom — by that person, the debt to this person cannot be easily repaid, even if one were to attend upon them for one's entire life with robes, alms-food, lodging, and medicines for the sick and their requisites; even so, the debt cannot be easily repaid. When, <s>Ānanda</s>, a person through another person knows suffering, knows the origin [of suffering], knows the cessation [of suffering], and knows the path — by that person, the debt to this person cannot be easily repaid, even if one were to attend upon them for one's entire life with robes, alms-food, lodging, and medicines for the sick and their requisites; even so, the debt cannot be easily repaid.'

body.text: 12. atha khalu bhagavato etad abhūṣi | sace khalu aham ānandasya gautamasya putrasya yāvattṛtīyakaṃ api prativahiṣyāmi bhaviṣyati ca se cittasyānyathātvaṃ | śrutā pi se dharmā sammohaṃ gamiṣyanti | kāmaṃ varṣasahasraṃ pi me saddharmo sthāsyati | mā haivānandasya gautamīputrasya bhavatu cittasyānyathātvaṃ mā pi se śrutā dharmā sammoṣaṅ gacchantu | kāmaṃ pañcāpi me varṣaśatāni saddharmo sthāsyati | atha khalu bhagavān āyuṣmantam ānandam āmantrayati sma | sayyathāpi nāmānanda iha puruṣo parvatasaṃkṣepe setuṃ bandheya yāvad eva vārisya anatikramaṇāya evam evānanda tathāgato bhikṣuṇīnām aṣṭa gurudharmān prajñāpeti ye bhikṣunīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyā gurukartavyā mānayitavyā pūjayitavyā anatikramaṇīyā velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa || katame aṣṭau |
body.translated_text: 12. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> thought to himself: 'If I refuse the son of <s>Gautamā</s>, <s>Ānanda</s>, even a third time, his mind will become disturbed, and the teachings he has heard will fall into confusion. Let the true <s>Dharma</s> endure for a thousand years. Let there be no disturbance of mind for <s>Ānanda</s>, the son of <s>Gautamī</s>, and let not the teachings he has heard fall into confusion. Let the true <s>Dharma</s> endure even for five hundred years.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Just as, <s>Ānanda</s>, a man might build a dyke at a mountain pass for the very purpose of preventing the water from overflowing, even so, <s>Ānanda</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> lays down eight weighty rules (<s>gurudharmāḥ</s>) for the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which are to be respected, revered, honored, venerated, and never transgressed by the nuns for their entire lives — like the shore by the great ocean. What are these eight?'

body.text: aṣṭau gurudharmā
body.translated_text: The Eight Weighty Rules (<s>aṣṭau gurudharmāḥ</s>)

body.text: gurudharma 1
body.translated_text: Weighty Rule 1 (<s>gurudharma</s> 1)

body.text: 13. varṣaśato pasampannāye ānanda bhikṣuṇīye tadahopasampannasya bhikṣusya śirasā pādā vanditavyā | ayam ānanda bhikṣuṇīnāṃ prathamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣūṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yāva anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa ||
body.translated_text: 13. '<s>Ānanda</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordained for a hundred years must bow her head at the feet of a <s>bhikṣu</s> ordained that very day. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the first weighty rule for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be respected by nuns for their entire lives, and never to be transgressed — like the shore by the great ocean.'

gurudharma 2
aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇī deśitāśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāye ubhayato saṃghe upasampadā pratyāśaṃsitavyā | ayam ānanda dvitīyo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo gurukartavyo yāva velā iva samudreṇa ||
body.translated_text: Weighty Rule 2 (<s>gurudharma</s> 2): 'A maiden who has reached eighteen years of age, having been a trainee (<s>śikṣamāṇā</s>) for two years, having completed the training, shall seek full ordination (<s>upasaṃpadā</s>) from both <s>Saṃghas</s> (the orders of monks and nuns). This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the second weighty rule, which is to be respected and revered by nuns for their entire lives — like the shore by the ocean.'

body.text:
gurudharma 3
āvaḍḍo ānanda bhikṣuṇīnāṃ bhikṣuṣu vacanapatho bhūtena vā abhūtena vā anāvaḍḍo bhikṣusya bhikṣuṇīṣu vacanapatho bhūtena no abhūtena | ayam ānanda bhikṣuṇīnāṃ tṛtīyo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo vistareṇa ||
body.translated_text: Weighty Rule 3 (<s>gurudharma</s> 3): '<s>Ānanda</s>, the path of accusation is open for nuns against monks, whether the charge is true or false; but the path of accusation for a monk against nuns is open only when the charge is true, not when false. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the third weighty rule for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be respected by nuns for their entire lives, in detail.'

body.text:
gurudharma 4
bhaktāgraṃ śayyāsanaṃ vihāro ca bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣuto sādayitavyo | ayam ānanda caturtho gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo gurukartavyo vistareṇa ||
body.translated_text: Weighty Rule 4 (<s>gurudharma</s> 4): 'The distribution of alms-food, bedding, lodging, and dwelling must be requested by the nuns from the monks. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the fourth weighty rule, which is to be respected and revered by nuns for their entire lives, in detail.'

body.text:
gurudharma 5
gurudharmāpannāye ānanda bhikṣuṇīye ardhamāsam bhikṣuṇīsaṃghe mānatvaṃ yācitavyaṃ ubhayato saṃghe ca āhvayanaṃ | ayam ānanda paṇcamo bhikṣuṇīnāṃ gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo vistareṇa ||
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> (weighty rule) 5: <s>Ānanda</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> (nun) who has committed a <s>gurudharma</s> offense must practice <s>mānatva</s> (penance) for half a month in the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> and seek rehabilitation before both <s>saṃghas</s>. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the fifth <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, in detail.

body.text:
gurudharma 6
anvārdhamāsaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣusaṃghāt uvādopasaṃkramaṇaṃ pratyāśaṃsitavyaṃ | ayam ānanda bhikṣuṇīnām ṣaṣṭho gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo vistareṇa |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> 6: Every half-month, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should seek instruction (<s>uvāda</s>) and guidance from the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the sixth <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, in detail.

body.text:
gurudharma 7
na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīhi abhikṣuke āvāse varṣām upagantuṃ | ayam ānanda bhikṣuṇīnāṃ saptamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo vistareṇa ||
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> 7: It is not permissible for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to enter the rains retreat (<s>varṣā</s>) in a dwelling without <s>bhikṣus</s>. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the seventh <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, in detail.

body.text:
gurudharma 8
varṣoṣitāhi ānanda bhikṣuṇīhi ubhayatosaṃghe pravāraṇā pratyāśaṃsitavyā | ayam ānanda bhikṣuṇīnāṃ aṣṭamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo gurukartavyo mānayitavyo pūjayitavyo anatikramaṇīyo velā iva samudreṇa |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> 8: <s>Ānanda</s>, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who have completed the rains retreat should seek the <s>pravāraṇā</s> (invitation ceremony) before both <s>saṃghas</s>. This, <s>Ānanda</s>, is the eighth <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, to be respected, revered, venerated, and never transgressed—like the shore by the ocean.

body.text: ime ānanda bhikṣuṇīnām aṣṭau gurudharmā ye bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyā gurukartavyā mānayitavyā pūjayitavyā anatikramaṇīyā velā iva samudreṇa ||
body.translated_text: These, <s>Ānanda</s>, are the eight <s>gurudharmās</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which are to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, to be respected, revered, venerated, and never transgressed—like the shore by the ocean.

body.text: 14. sace nāmānanda mahāprajāpatī gautamī imān aṣṭa gurudharmān pratīcchati catuhi ca patanīyehi dharmehi anadhyācārāya śikṣāṃ śikṣati | eṣā se adyadagreṇa pravrajyā | eṣā upasaṃpadā eṣa bhikṣuṇībhāvo | sādhu bhagavann iti āyuṣmān ānando bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā yena mahāprajāpatī gautamī tenopasaṃkramitvā mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīṃ etad avocat | śṛṇu gautamī bhagavato vacanaṃ | sayyathāpi nāma gautamī iha puruṣa parvatasaṃkṣepe setuṃ bandheya yāvad eva vāriṣya anatikramaṇāya evam eva gautamī bhagavān bhikṣuṇīnāṃ aṣṭagurudharmān prajñāpeti ye bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyā gurukartavyā mānayitavyā pūjayitavyā anatikramaṇīyā velāmiva samudreṇa |
body.translated_text: 14. If, <s>Ānanda</s>, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> accepts these eight <s>gurudharmās</s> and trains in the training for non-transgression regarding the four <s>pātanīya</s> (defeat) offenses—this shall be, from this day forth, her going forth (<s>pravrajyā</s>), this her full ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>), this her status as a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. 'Very well, Lord,' said the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, and having bowed his head at the feet of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, he approached <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> and said to her: 'Listen, <s>Gautamī</s>, to the word of the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Just as, <s>Gautamī</s>, a man might build a dam at the narrowing of a mountain [pass] precisely to prevent the overflow of water, even so, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>Bhagavān</s> has established eight <s>gurudharmās</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which are to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, to be respected, revered, venerated, and never transgressed—like the shore by the ocean.'

body.text: 15. katame 'ṣṭa | varṣaśatopasampannāya gautamī bhikṣuṇīya tadahopasampannasya bhikṣusya pādā śirasā vanditavyā | ayaṃ gautamī bhikṣuṇīnām prathamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yo anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva samudreṇa | evaṃ sarve aṣṭa gurudharmān | tad eva mahāprajāpatīya gautamīya pratyārociti | yāva sace khu tvaṃ gautamī imān aṣṭa gurudharmān pratīcchasi catuhi ca patanīyehi dharmehi anadhyācārāya śikṣāṃ śikṣasi | eṣā eva te adyadagreṇa pravrajyā eṣā upasampadā eṣa bhikṣuṇībhāvo ||
body.translated_text: 15. Which eight? <s>Gautamī</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordained for a hundred years must bow her head at the feet of a <s>bhikṣu</s> ordained that very day. This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the first <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, never to be transgressed—like the shore by the ocean. [Likewise for] all eight <s>gurudharmās</s>. He then announced to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'If indeed you, <s>Gautamī</s>, accept these eight <s>gurudharmās</s> and train in the training for non-transgression regarding the four <s>pātanīya</s> offenses—this itself shall be, from this day forth, your going forth, your full ordination, your status as a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>.'

body.text: 16. evam ukte mahāprajāpatī gautamī āyuṣmantam ānandam etad avocat | sayyathāpi nāmānanda iha syāt yuvā puruṣo maṇḍanajātīyo śīrṣasnāto āhatavastranivastro utpalamālām vā campakamālām vā kumudamālām vā tṛṇamolikamālām vā śirasā pratīccheya evam evāham āryānanda imān aṣṭagurudharmān śirasā pratīcchāmi catuhi ca patanīyehi dharmehi anadhyacārāya śikṣāṃ śikṣāṃ śikṣiṣyaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 16. When this was said, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> said to the venerable <s>Ānanda</s>: 'Just as, venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, a young person of the ornament-loving class, having bathed his head, dressed in fresh garments, would accept upon his head a garland of <s>utpala</s> lotuses, or a garland of <s>campaka</s> flowers, or a garland of <s>kumuda</s> water-lilies, or a garland of <s>tṛṇamolika</s> blossoms—even so, venerable <s>Ānanda</s>, I accept these eight <s>gurudharmās</s> upon my head, and I shall train in the training for non-transgression regarding the four <s>pātanīya</s> offenses.'

body.text: 17. atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī sārdhaṃ cchandāyi cchandakapālāye dāsacchandāye cchandakamātare ca pañcahi ca śākiyāniśatehi sārdhaṃ yena bhagavān tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte asthāsuḥ |
body.translated_text: 17. Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>, together with <s>Chandāyī</s>, <s>Chandakapālā</s>, <s>Dāsacchandā</s>, <s>Chandakamātā</s>, and five hundred <s>Śākya</s> women, approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed their heads at the feet of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, and stood to one side.

body.text: 18. ekāntasthitāyo bhikṣuṇīyo bhagavān etad avocat | tasmād iha bhave bhikṣuṇīyo adydagreṇa mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīṃ saṃghasthavirāṃ saṃghamahattarīṃ saṃghathaviriṇā vikandhāvetha | atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī yena bhagavān tenāñjaliṃ praṇāmayitvā bhagavantam etad avocat | ye ime bhagavan bhikṣuṇīnāṃ aṣṭagurudharmā bhagavatā saṃkṣiptena bhāṣitā vistareṇa vibhaktā labhyā te 'smābhir vistareṇa śrotuṃ ||
body.translated_text: 18. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> standing to one side: 'Therefore, in this [dispensation], <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, from this day forth, you should regard <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> as the elder of the <s>saṃgha</s>, the senior of the <s>saṃgha</s>, as the chief elder of the <s>saṃgha</s>.' Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>, raising her joined palms toward the <s>Bhagavān</s>, said to him: 'Lord, these eight <s>gurudharmās</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> spoken by the <s>Bhagavān</s> in brief and analyzed in detail—may we hear them in full detail?'

body.text: 19. bhagavān āha | labhyā | āha | kinti dānī gautamī varṣaśatopasampannāye bhikṣuṇīye tadahopasampannasya bhikṣusya abhivādanavandanapratyutthānāñjalīkarma samīcīkarma kartavyaṃ | na dāniṃ bhikṣuṇīye āgamitavyaṃ | yadāhaṃ varsaśatopasampannā bhaviṣyaṃ bhikṣu ca tad ahopasampanno bhaviṣyati tadāham abhivādanavandanapratyutthānamañjalīkarma sāmīcikarma kariṣyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 19. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You may.' He said: 'How is it then, <s>Gautamī</s>? A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordained for a hundred years must perform the acts of greeting, bowing, rising, <s>añjali</s> (respectful salutation), and proper conduct toward a <s>bhikṣu</s> ordained that very day. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should not think: "When I have been ordained for a hundred years and a <s>bhikṣu</s> has been ordained that very day, then I will perform the acts of greeting, bowing, rising, <s>añjali</s>, and proper conduct."'

body.text: 20. atha khalu sarvāhi bhikṣuṇīhi sthavirīhi vā navāhi vā madhyamāhi vā sarveṣāṃ bhikṣūṇām stherāṇāṃ navānāṃ madhyamānāṃ abhivādanavandanapratyutthānāñjalīkarma sāmīcikarma kartavyaṃ || ete dāni bhikṣū bhikṣūṇīupāśrayaṃ praviṣṭā bhavanti | sarvāhi bhikṣuṇīhi stherīhi vā navāhi vā madhyamāhi vā sarveṣāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ stherāṇāṃ navānāñ ca madhyamānām abhivādanavandanapratyutthānāñjalīkarma sāmīcīkarma kartavyaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 20. Now, all <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—whether senior, junior, or of middle standing—must perform the acts of greeting, bowing, rising, <s>añjali</s>, and proper conduct toward all <s>bhikṣus</s>—senior, junior, or of middle standing. When these <s>bhikṣus</s> have entered the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence, all <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—whether senior, junior, or of middle standing—must perform the acts of greeting, bowing, rising, <s>añjali</s>, and proper conduct toward all <s>bhikṣus</s>—senior, junior, and of middle standing.

body.text: 21. atha dāni bhikṣuṇī jarādurbalā vā bhavati vyādhidurbalā vā yattakānāṃ abhisaṃbhuṇoti tattakānāṃ pādā śirasā vanditavyā | śiṣṭhakānāṃ mūrdhni añjaliṃ kṛtvā vaktavyaṃ | sarveṣāṃ āryamiśrāṇāṃ pādāṃ vandāmi | etāyo bhikṣuṇīyo bhikṣuvihāraṃ nirdhāvanti sarvāhi bhikṣuṇīhi stherīhi vā navāhi vā madhyamāhi vā sarveṣāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ therāṇāṃ navānāṃ madhyamānāṃ pādā śirasā vanditavyā | atha dāni bhikṣuṇī jarādurbalā bhavati vyādhidurbalā vā yattakānām abhisaṃbhuṇoti tattakānāṃ pādā śirasā vanditavyā śiṣṭakānāṃ mūrdhni añjalīṃ kṛtvā vaktavyaṃ | sarveṣāṃ āryamiśrāṇāṃ pādā śirasā vandāmi |
body.translated_text: 21. Now, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is weakened by old age or weakened by illness, she should bow her head at the feet of as many as she is able to. For the rest, she should raise her joined palms to her head and say: 'I bow at the feet of all the noble ones.' These <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should go to the <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery, and all <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—whether senior, junior, or of middle standing—must bow their heads at the feet of all <s>bhikṣus</s>—senior, junior, and of middle standing. Now, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is weakened by old age or weakened by illness, she should bow her head at the feet of as many as she is able to. For the rest, she should raise her joined palms to her head and say: 'I bow at the feet of all the noble ones.'

body.text: 22. sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avajñāya paribhavanena koṇṭabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā ḍhossabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā vaidyabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā akhallamahalle ti vā akuśalo ti vā apratikṛtijño ti vā kṛtvā na śirasā pādān vandati gurudharmam atikrāmati | evaṃ gautamī varṣaśatopasampannāye bhikṣuṇīye tadahopasampannasya bhikṣusya śirasā vanditavyaṃ | ayaṃ gautamī bhikṣuṇīnāṃ prathamo gurudharmo yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo gurukartavyo mānayitavyo pūjayitavyo anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva samudreṇa ||
body.translated_text: 22. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, out of disrespect and contempt, calling [a <s>bhikṣu</s>] 'one-eyed monk,' or 'hunchback monk,' or 'physician monk,' or 'one who dwells in an unfit place,' or 'unskilled one,' or 'one who does not acknowledge favors'—does not bow her head at his feet, she transgresses the <s>gurudharma</s>. Thus, <s>Gautamī</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordained for a hundred years must bow her head [at the feet of] a <s>bhikṣu</s> ordained that very day. This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the first <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, to be honored for as long as they live, to be respected, revered, venerated, and never transgressed—like the shore by the ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 2
23. kinti dāni gautamī aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dvevarṣāṇi śikṣitaśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāye ubhayatosaṃghe upasampadā pratyāsaṃsitavyā |
yā dāni eṣā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā bhavati tāye bhikṣuṇīsaṃghe dvevarṣāṇī śikṣādeśanāsaṃmuti yācitavyā | karmakārikāya karma kartavyam | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho | iyam itthannāmā nāma aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasampadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ iyamnāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā saṃghaṃ dvevarṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ yāceyā | yāciṣyati āryamiśrikāyo saṃgho iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dvevarṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> 2. 23. How is it then, <s>Gautamī</s>? An eighteen-year-old maiden who has trained for two years, having completed her training, should seek full ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>) before both <s>saṃghas</s>. Now, for this eighteen-year-old maiden, the permission for two years of training instruction (<s>śikṣādeśanāsaṃmuti</s>) should be requested from the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>. The <s>karmakārikā</s> (procedure officiant) should perform the formal act: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desires the going forth, full ordination, and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, this one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, should request from the <s>saṃgha</s> two years of training instruction permission. She will request: Noble ones, the <s>saṃgha</s> [grants] this one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, two years of training instruction permission. If this is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, let it be silent. Thus I understand it.'

body.text: 24. tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmi āryasaṃghaṃ | aham itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣāmi tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasampadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sāhaṃ saṃghaṃ dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ yācāmi | sādhu vata me āryasaṃgho dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ detu | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: 24. Now she should make this request: 'I bow to the noble <s>saṃgha</s>. I, named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desire full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. I request from the <s>saṃgha</s> two years of training instruction permission. May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> grant me two years of training instruction permission.' A second and a third time likewise.

body.text: 25. karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ yācati | tasyā āryasaṃgho itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutin dadyāt | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 25. The <s>karmakārikā</s> should perform the formal act: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, requests two years of training instruction permission. May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> grant this one named so-and-so, the eighteen-year-old maiden, two years of training instruction permission. This is the motion (<s>jñapti</s>).'

body.text: śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasampadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | seyaṃ saṃghaṃ dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ yācati | tasyā saṃgho itthan nāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutin deti | yasyā āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇī śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiṃ dīyamānāṃ saṃghena sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣatu | evaṃ dvitīyaṃ pi tṛtīyaṃ pi dinnāmāryamiśrikāyo itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsaṃmutiḥ saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desires the going forth, full ordination, and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. She requests from the <s>saṃgha</s> two years of training instruction permission. The <s>saṃgha</s> grants this one named so-and-so, the eighteen-year-old maiden, two years of training instruction permission. If this is acceptable to the noble ones—the granting of two years of training instruction permission to this one named so-and-so, the eighteen-year-old maiden, by the <s>saṃgha</s>—let her be silent. If it is not acceptable, let her speak.' A second and a third time likewise. 'The noble ones have granted this one named so-and-so, the eighteen-year-old maiden, two years of training instruction permission by the <s>saṃgha</s>. It is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, since it is silent. Thus I understand it.'

body.text: 26. tasyā dāni kā vattā | sarvabhikṣuṇīnān navikā sarvaśrāmaṇerīṇāṃ vṛddhā āsanaparyanto tāye sādayitavyo [1] | bhaktaparyanto tāye sādayitavyo [2] yvāguparyanto tāye sādayitavyo [3] yat tasyā 'miṣam akalpikam taṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ āmiṣaṃ kalpikaṃ [4] yaṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ āmiṣaṃ kalpikaṃ tasyā taṃ āmiṣaṃ akalpikaṃ [5] bhikṣuṇīyihi tasyāḥ tena parivartaśeyyā kartavyā [6] tāya pi śrāmaṇerīṇāṃ tena parivartakaśeyyā kartavyā [7] | bhikṣuṇīyihi sā pratigrāhaṇikā kārāpayitavyā sthāpayitvā agnikalpañ ca [8] | jātarūparajatañ ca [9] tāye pi śrāmaṇerīyo pratigrāhaṇikā kārāpayitavyāyo [10] |
body.translated_text: 26. Now, what are her observances? She is junior to all <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> and senior to all <s>śrāmaṇerīs</s> (female novices). The seat allocation should be arranged for her [1]. The food allocation should be arranged for her [2]. The gruel allocation should be arranged for her [3]. What food is improper for her is proper for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> [4]. What food is proper for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is improper for her [5]. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> should arrange alternate sleeping quarters with her [6]. She too should arrange alternate sleeping quarters with the <s>śrāmaṇerīs</s> [7]. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> should have her receive [items], except fire and the like [8], and gold and silver [9]. She too should have the <s>śrāmaṇerīs</s> receive [items] [10].

body.text: 27. na kṣamati tāye poṣadho vā pravāraṇā vā abhisaṃbhuṇituṃ | atha khalu yadā poṣadho vā pravāraṇā vā bhavati | tadaho tāyi vṛddhāntam āruhya mūrdhni añjaliṃ kṛtvā vaktavyaṃ | vandāmi āryāyo viśuddhām me dhāretha | dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi | vandāmi āryāyo viśuddhāṃ dhārayetha trīṇi vārāṃ jalpīya gantavyaṃ [11] na kṣamati sā prātimokṣasūtraṃ śrāvayituṃ | atha khalu yattakaṃ pāriyati padaphalakāye grāhayituṃ tattakaṃ grāhayitavyā [12] | vaktavyam |
body.translated_text: 27. It is not permissible for her to attend the <s>poṣadha</s> (observance day) or the <s>pravāraṇā</s> (invitation ceremony). However, when there is a <s>poṣadha</s> or <s>pravāraṇā</s>, on that day she should approach the senior [nuns], raise her joined palms to her head, and say: 'I bow to the noble ones; please acknowledge my purity.' A second and a third time: 'I bow to the noble ones; please acknowledge my purity.' Having spoken three times, she should depart [11]. It is not permissible for her to recite the <s>Prātimokṣa Sūtra</s>. However, as much as she can learn from the instruction tablets, that much should be taught to her [12]. It should be said:

body.text: na kṣamati abrahmacaryaṃ pratisevituṃ [13] na kṣamati adinnam ādayitum [14] |
body.translated_text: It is not permissible to engage in unchastity [13]. It is not permissible to take what is not given [14].

body.text: na kṣamati svahastaṃ manuṣyavigrahaṃ jīvitād vyoparāyituṃ [15] na kṣamati abhūvanam uttarimanuṣyadharmam prajānituṃ [16] |
body.translated_text: [15] It is not permitted to deprive a human being of life with one's own hand. [16] It is not permitted to claim superhuman qualities that one does not possess.

body.text: evaṃ yattakaṃ pārīyati padaphalake grāhayituṃ tattakaṃ grāhayitavyā |
body.translated_text: Thus, as many [rules] as can be recited on the instruction-tablet, that many she should be made to learn.

body.text: pañcaśikṣābhañjanakāni | vikālabhojanaṃ | sannidhikārābhojanaṃ | jātarūparajatapratigrahaṇaṃ | gandhāmālāvilepanadhāraṇaṃ | surāmaireyamadyapānāñ ca | yattakāni divasāni adhyācarati tattakāni divasāni uktāni śikṣā śikṣitavyā [18] ||
body.translated_text: The five training-rule violations: [1] eating at an improper time; [2] eating stored food; [3] accepting gold and silver; [4] wearing garlands, perfumes, and ointments; [5] and drinking liquor, spirits, and intoxicants. For as many days as she transgresses, for that many days the stated training rules must be observed. [18]

body.text: 28. yaṃ kālaṃ dve varṣāṇi bhavanti tato tāya saṃgho upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācitavyo |
body.translated_text: 28. When two years [of training] have been completed, then the <s>saṃgha</s> (community) should be asked for the formal agreement for ordination (<s>upasthāpanā-saṃmuti</s>).

body.text: karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣā paripūraśikṣā ākāmkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye pravrajyām upasampadām bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dve vaṣrāṇi deśitaśikṣā paripūriśikṣā | sā saṃghaṃ upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yāceya | yāciṣyati āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmā aṣṭādaśāvarṣā kumārībhūtā deśitaśikṣā paripūriśikṣā dve varsāṇi upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇim etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: The motion-maker (<s>karmakārikā</s>) should perform the formal act: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete, desires the going-forth (<s>pravrajyā</s>), full ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>), and the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, this one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete—she should request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for the formal agreement for ordination. She shall request: Noble ladies, this one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, trained in the rules, with training complete, [requests] the formal agreement for ordination after two years. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let it be silent; thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 29. tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmi āryasaṃgham aham itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarśā kumārībhūtā dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣā paripūriśikṣā | sā ahaṃ saṃghaṃ upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācāmi | sādhu me āryā saṃgho upasthāpanāsaṃmutin detu | dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi | vandāmi āryāyo aham itthan nāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣā paripūriśikṣā | sāhaṃ saṃghaṃ upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācāmi | sādhu me āryasaṃgho upasthāpanāsaṃmutin detu | karmakārikāye karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho | iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣā paripūriśikṣā sā saṃghaṃ upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthan nāmāye aṣṭādeśavarṣāye kumārī bhūtāye dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāye upasthhāpanāsaṃmutin dadyāt | ovaśikāye eṣā jñaptiḥ ||
body.translated_text: 29. Then she should make the request: 'I bow to the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. I, named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete—I request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for the formal agreement for ordination. May the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> kindly grant me the formal agreement for ordination.' A second and third time [likewise]: 'I bow to the Noble Ones. I, named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete—I request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for the formal agreement for ordination. May the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> kindly grant me the formal agreement for ordination.' The motion-maker should perform the formal act: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete—she requests the <s>Saṃgha</s> for the formal agreement for ordination. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s> should grant the formal agreement for ordination to this one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete. As a resolution, this is the motion (<s>jñapti</s>).'

body.text: 30. śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho iyaṃ itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārī bhūtā dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣā paripūrṇaśikṣā | sā saṃgham upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācati | tāya saṃgho itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāye upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ deti | yāsāṃ āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśa varṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāye upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ dīyamānāṃ saṃghena | sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasya na kṣamati sā bhāṣitu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitiyā tṛtīyā karmavācaneti |
body.translated_text: 30. 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete—she requests the <s>Saṃgha</s> for the formal agreement for ordination. The <s>Saṃgha</s> grants the formal agreement for ordination to this one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete. Those Noble Ladies for whom it is acceptable that the formal agreement for ordination be granted by the <s>Saṃgha</s> to this one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete—let her be silent. She who does not accept, let her speak. This is the first proclamation (<s>karmavācanā</s>). Likewise the second and third proclamation.'

body.text: 31. dinnā āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśa varṣāye kumāribhūtāye dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāye upasthāpanāsaṃmuti saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 31. 'The formal agreement for ordination has been granted by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, Noble Ladies, to this one named so-and-so, eighteen years of age, having been a maiden, two years trained in the rules, with training complete. It is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 32. upasaṃpādyāya upādhyāyinī yācitavyā | vandāmy ārye aham itthannāmā āryām upādhyāyinīṃ yācāmi | āryā me upasaṃpādetu upādhyāyinīmiśrāhi | evaṃ dvitiyam pi tṛtīyam pi yācitavyaṃ | upādhyāyinīya pātracīvarāṇi paryeṣitavyāni | anuśrāvaṇācāryā paryeṣitavyā dve rahānuśāsanācāryā paryeṣitavyā yo gaṇo samudānayitavyo gaṇasya upanāmayitavyo |
body.translated_text: 32. For the one to be ordained, an <s>upādhyāyinī</s> (preceptress) should be requested: 'I bow to you, Noble One. I, named so-and-so, request the Noble One as <s>upādhyāyinī</s>. May the Noble One ordain me, with the preceptress as my guide.' Thus a second and third time the request should be made. Bowl and robes should be procured for the <s>upādhyāyinī</s>. A announcing-instructress (<s>anuśrāvaṇācāryā</s>) should be sought. Two private-instruction teachers (<s>rahānuśāsanācāryā</s>) should be sought. The assembly should be convened. She should be presented to the assembly.

body.text: 33. karma | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāya upasampādyā | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthaṃnāmā ca itthannāmā ca itthannāmāṃ raho 'nuśāseyyā | anuśāsiṣyati āryasaṃgho itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca itthannāmāṃ raho | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etan dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 33. The formal act: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so-and-so and so-and-so should instruct so-and-so in private. The Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> shall instruct—so-and-so and so-and-so [shall instruct] so-and-so in private. It is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 34. tāhi dāni sā anuśāsitavyā gaṇasya nātidūre nātyāsanne saṃkṣiptena vā vistareṇa vā |
body.translated_text: 34. Then they should instruct her—not too far from the assembly and not too near—either in brief or in detail.

body.text: kinti dāni saṃkṣiptena | vaktavyā | śṛṇu kuladhite yaṃ yad evātra saṃghamadhye pṛcchiyasi tat tad eva yaṃ asti tam astīti vaktavyaṃ | yan nāsti tan nāftiti vaktavyaṃ | evaṃ saṃkṣiptena |
body.translated_text: What then is the brief [instruction]? She should be told: 'Listen, daughter of good family. Whatever you are asked in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>—that which exists, you should say "it exists"; that which does not exist, you should say "it does not exist." Thus in brief.'

body.text: 35. kinti dāni vistareṇa | śṛṇu kuladhīte ayaṃ satyakālo ayaṃ bhūtakālo yāva sadevakaṃ lokaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ saśramaṇabrāhmaṇīṃ prajāṃ sadevamānuṣāsurāṃ visamvādeyyā yā ca tasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksambuddhasya śrāvikāsaṃghaṃ visamvādeyyā imaṃ tato mahāsāvadyataraṃ |
body.translated_text: 35. What then is the detailed [instruction]? 'Listen, daughter of good family. This is the time of truth, this is the time of reality. Even if one could deceive the world with its gods, <s>Māra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, the generation of ascetics and brahmins, gods, humans, and <s>asuras</s>—to deceive the community of female disciples of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, would be a far greater offense than that.'

body.text: yaṃ yad eva saṃghamadhye pṛcchiyasi taṃ tad eva yaṃ asti taṃ astīti vaktavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever you are asked in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>—that which exists, you should say "it exists"; that which does not exist, you should say "it does not exist."'

body.text: anujñātāsi anujñāpakehi | āmaṃ | yācitā te upādhyāyinī | āma | paripūrṇan te pātracivaraṃ | āma | deśitaśikṣāsi | āma | paripūrṇaśikṣāsi | āma | sammatāsi viśuddhāsi bhikṣuṇīhi | āma | mā mātṛghātini | nahi | mā pitṛghātini | nahi | mā arhantaghātinī | nahi | mā saṃghabhedikā | nahi | mā tathāgatasya duṣṭacittarudhirotpādikā | nahi | cirā parinivṛto kho puna so bhagavāṃs tathāgato rhan samyaksambuddho ||
body.translated_text: 'Have you been given permission by those who gave permission?' 'Yes.' 'Has your <s>upādhyāyinī</s> been requested?' 'Yes.' 'Is your bowl and robe complete?' 'Yes.' 'Have you been trained in the rules?' 'Yes.' 'Is your training complete?' 'Yes.' 'Have you been approved and declared pure by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?' 'Yes.' 'You are not a matricide?' 'No.' 'You are not a patricide?' 'No.' 'You are not a slayer of an <s>Arhat</s>?' 'No.' 'You are not a schismatic of the <s>Saṃgha</s>?' 'No.' 'You have not with malicious intent caused the blood of a <s>Tathāgata</s> to flow?' 'No.' For that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, has long since attained final <s>Parinirvāṇa</s>.

body.text: mā bhikṣudūṣikā | nahi | mā stainyasamvāsikā | nahi | mā tirthikāpakrāntikā | nahi | mā dāsi | nahi | mā avapitikā | nahi | mā ṛṇahārikā | nahi | mā rājabhaṭi | nahi | mā rājñaḥ kilbiṣakāriṇi | nahi | upasampannapūrvāsi | anyadāpi yady āha upasampannapūrvā ti | vaktavyā gaccha nasya cala prapalāhi | nāsti te upasampadā |
body.translated_text: 'You are not a corrupter of a <s>bhikṣu</s>?' 'No.' 'You are not one living in concealed offense (<s>stainyasaṃvāsikā</s>)?' 'No.' 'You are not one who has gone over to the heretics?' 'No.' 'You are not a female slave?' 'No.' 'You are not an absconder?' 'No.' 'You are not a debtor?' 'No.' 'You are not a royal soldier?' 'No.' 'You are not one who has committed an offense against the king?' 'No.' 'Have you been previously ordained?' If at any time she says 'I have been previously ordained,' she should be told: 'Go, depart, leave, be gone! You have no ordination.'

body.text: atha dān āha | nahīti | uttari samanugrāhitavyā mā vātilā | mā pittilā | mā pindilā | mā hallavāhinī | mā pūyavāhinī | mā cakravāhinī | mā ārdravraṇā | mā śuṣkavraṇā | mā śoṇitavraṇā | mā śikhiriṇī | mā dvipuruṣikā | mā stripaṇḍikā | mā puruṣadveṣiṇī
body.translated_text: But if she then says 'No,' she should be further questioned: 'You are not afflicted by wind-disease?' 'You are not afflicted by bile-disease?' 'You are not afflicted by swelling-disease?' 'You do not discharge pus?' 'You do not discharge matter?' 'You do not discharge blood cyclically?' 'You do not have open wounds?' 'You do not have dry wounds?' 'You do not have bleeding wounds?' 'You are not a hunchback?' 'You are not a hermaphrodite (<s>dvipuruṣikā</s>)?' 'You are not a <s>strīpaṇḍikā</s> (sexually deficient woman)?' 'You do not have aversion to men?'

body.text: 36. santi kho punar imasmin kāye vividhā anuśayikā ābādhā sayyathīdaṃ |
body.translated_text: 36. 'There are indeed in this body various chronic ailments, namely:'

body.text: dardru kaṇḍū kacchū rakacā | vicarcikā arśo bhagandalā | pāṇḍurogo ālasako | lohitapittaṃ jvaro | kāso śvāso soṣo apasmāro | vātodaraṃ dakodaraṃ | plīhodaraṃ kuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhaṃ madhumeho visūcikā |
body.translated_text: 'Skin eruptions, itching, scabies, boils, eczema, hemorrhoids, fistula, jaundice, torpor, bilious blood-disorder, fever, cough, asthma, consumption, epilepsy, wind-swelling of the abdomen, water-swelling of the abdomen, splenic swelling of the abdomen, leprosy, white leprosy, diabetes, and cholera.'

body.text: santi te ete vā anye vā vividhā anuśayikā ābādhāḥ kāye 'smin na vā |
body.translated_text: 'Do you have these or any other various chronic ailments in this body, or not?'

body.text: 37. yady āha nahīti | vaktavyā | yaṃ kālaṃ śabdāpiyesi taṃ kālam āgacchesi tāhi dānīṃ āgatvā sāmīciṃ kṛtvā vaktavyaṃ anuśāstā ti |
body.translated_text: 37. If she says 'No,' she should be told: 'When you are summoned, you should come at that time.' Then having come, she should pay respects and say: 'The instruction has been given.'

body.text: karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho iyam itthamnāmā itthannāmāye upasampādyā itthannāmāya ca itthannamāya ca raho'nuśāstā | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ iyam itthannāmā itthaṃnāmāya upādhyāyin īya saṃghamadhyam upasaṃkrāmeyyā | upasaṃkramiṣyati āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmā itthaṃnāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhyaṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya | yasmāt tūṣṇīṃ evam etaṃ dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: The motion-maker should perform the formal act: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so; she has been instructed in private by so-and-so and so-and-so. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, this one named so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, should approach the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. She shall approach—Noble Ladies, this one named so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, [shall approach] the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. It is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 38. sā dāni śabdāpitavyā | tāya dāni āgacchitvā vṛddhāntāto prabhṛti sarvāsāṃ pādā śirasā vanditavyāḥ yāvan navakāntaṃ |
body.translated_text: 38. Then she should be summoned. Having come, she should bow her head at the feet of all [nuns], beginning from the most senior down to the most junior.

body.text: karmakārikāye agrataḥ aṣṭohaṃ + + + + + + + + +takaṃ kṛtvā paryaṅkena niṣīditavyaṃ durbalavastiko mātṛgrāmaḥ mā aphāsu bhaveyā ti |
body.translated_text: Before the motion-maker, having made eight [...] she should sit cross-legged—for the female sex is of weak constitution, lest she become faint.

body.text: 39. karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye upasaṃpādyā itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ iyam itthannāmā itthamnāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yāceyyā | yāciṣyati āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam me dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 39. The motion-maker should perform the formal act: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so; she has been instructed in private by so-and-so and so-and-so. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, this one named so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, should request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for full ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>). She shall request—Noble Ladies, this one named so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, [shall request] the <s>Saṃgha</s> for full ordination. It is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 40. tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ | ahaṃ itthannāmā arthahetor nāma gṛhṇāmi itthannāmāye upādhyāyinīya upasampādyā itthaṃnāmāya ca itthaṃnāmāya ca āryā raho'nuśāstā | sāham itthannāmā arthahetor nāma gṛhṇāmi itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yācāmi | upasaṃpādetu me āryasaṃgho | ullumpatu me āryasaṃgho | anukampatu me āryasaṃgho | anukampako anukampām upādāya | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi yācayitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 40. Then she should make the request: 'I bow to the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. I, named so-and-so—I take the name for this purpose—to be ordained by the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, instructed in private by the Noble so-and-so and so-and-so. I, named so-and-so—I take the name for this purpose—with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for full ordination. May the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> ordain me! May the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> lift me up! May the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> show compassion to me—out of compassion, with compassion!' Thus a second and third time the request should be made.

body.text: 41. karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho | iyam itthannāmā itthaṃnāmāye upasaṃpādyā | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | aneyā itthannāmāya itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgho yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmāṃ itthaṃnāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye antarāyikān dharmān pṛcchemaḥ | pṛcchiṣyati āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye antarāyikān dharmān | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etan dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 41. The motion-maker should perform the formal act: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so; she has been instructed in private by so-and-so and so-and-so. This one named so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, has requested the <s>Saṃgha</s> for full ordination up to the third time. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, we should ask so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, about the obstructive conditions (<s>antarāyika dharmas</s>) in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. We shall ask—Noble Ladies, so-and-so, with the <s>upādhyāyinī</s> named so-and-so, about the obstructive conditions in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. It is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 42. sā dāni vaktavyā śṛṇu | kuladhīte saṃgha satyakālo ayaṃ bhūtakālo yāva sadevakaṃ lokaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmakaṃ saśramaṇabrāhmaṇīṃ prajāṃ sadevamānuṣāsurān visamvādeyyā yā ca tasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksambuddhasya śrāvikāsaṃghaṃ visamvādeyyā iman tato mahāsāvadyataraṃ |
body.translated_text: 42. Then she should be told: 'Listen, daughter of good family. This is the time of truth for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, this is the time of reality. Even if one could deceive the world with its gods, <s>Māra</s>, <s>Brahmā</s>, the generation of ascetics and brahmins, gods, humans, and <s>asuras</s>—to deceive the community of female disciples of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, would be a far greater offense than that.'

body.text: 43. yaṃ yad eva saṃghamadhye pṛcchiyesi taṃ tad eva yaṃ asti taṃ astīti vaktavyaṃ | yan nāsti tan nāstīti vaktavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 43. 'Whatever you are asked in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>—that which exists, you should say "it exists"; that which does not exist, you should say "it does not exist."'

body.text: anujñātāsi anujñāpakehi | āma | yācitā te upādhyāyinī | āma | paripūrṇan te pātracīvaraṃ | āma | deśitaśikṣāsi | āma | paripūrṇaśikṣāsi āma | sammatāsi | viśuddhāsi bhikṣuṇīhi | āma | mā mātṛghātini | nahi | mā pitṛghātini | nahi | mā arhadghātini | nahi | mā saṃghabhedikā | nahi | mā tathāgatasya duṣṭacittarudhirotpādikā | nahi |
body.translated_text: 'Have you been given permission by those who gave permission?' 'Yes.' 'Has your <s>upādhyāyinī</s> been requested?' 'Yes.' 'Is your bowl and robe complete?' 'Yes.' 'Have you been trained in the rules?' 'Yes.' 'Is your training complete?' 'Yes.' 'Have you been approved and declared pure by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?' 'Yes.' 'You are not a matricide?' 'No.' 'You are not a patricide?' 'No.' 'You are not a slayer of an <s>Arhat</s>?' 'No.' 'You are not a schismatic of the <s>Saṃgha</s>?' 'No.' 'You have not with malicious intent caused the blood of a <s>Tathāgata</s> to flow?' 'No.'

body.text: ciraparinivṛto kho puna so bhagavāṃs tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho |
body.translated_text: That <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, has long since passed into <s>Parinirvāṇa</s>.

body.text: 44. mā bhikṣudūṣikā | nahi | mā stainyasamvāsikā | nahi | mā tirthikāpakrāntikā | nahi | mā svayaṃ sannaddhikā | nahi | mā dāsi | nahi | mā avapitikā | nahi | mā ṛṇahārikā | nahi | mā rājabhaṭi | nahi | mā rājñaḥ kilbiṣakāriṇī | nahi | upasampannapūrvāsi anyadāpi | yady āha upasampannapūrvā ti | vaktavyā | gaccha nasya cala prapalāhi nāsti te upasaṃpadā |
body.translated_text: 44. Are you a defiler of <s>bhikṣus</s>? No. Are you one who cohabits by stealth? No. Are you one who has gone over to the heretics? No. Are you one who has armed herself?
