No. Are you a slave? No. Are you a runaway? No. Are you a debt-evader? No. Are you a king's soldier? No. Are you an offender against the king? No. Have you been previously ordained elsewhere? If she says 'I have been previously ordained,' she is to be told: 'Go away, leave, depart, flee—there is no ordination for you.'

body.text: 45. athāha | nahīti | vaktavyā | mā vātilā | nahi | mā pittilā | nahi | mā pindilā | nahi | mā hallavāhinī | nahi mā pūyavāhinī | nahi | mā cakravāhinī | nahi | mā ārdravraṇā | nahi | mā śuṣkavraṇā | nahi | mā śonitavraṇā | nahi | mā śikharinī | nahi | mā dvipuruṣikā | nahi | mā strīpaṇḍikā | nahi | mā puruṣadveṣiṇī | nahi |
body.translated_text: 45. If she says 'No,' she is to be asked: Are you afflicted by wind-disease? No. Are you afflicted by bile-disease? No. Are you afflicted by swelling? No. Are you one who discharges vomit? No. Are you one who discharges pus? No. Are you one who discharges blood cyclically? No. Are you one with moist wounds? No. Are you one with dry wounds? No. Are you one with bleeding wounds? No. Are you a <s>śikharinī</s> (hermaphrodite)? No. Are you a <s>dvipuruṣikā</s> (woman who consorts with two men)? No. Are you a <s>strīpaṇḍikā</s> (sexually dysfunctional woman)? No. Are you a man-hater? No.

body.text: 46. santi kho punar imasmiṃ kāye vividhā ānuśayikā ābādhā saṃyathīdaṃ | dardru kaṇḍū kacchū rakacā | vicarcikā arśo bhagandalā | pāṇḍuroga alasako | lohitapittaṃ | jvaro | kāso śvāso śoṣo apasmāro | vātodaraṃ dakodaraṃ plīhodaraṃ madhumeho | santi te ete vā anye vā vividhā ānuśayikā vā ābādhāḥ kāye 'smin na vā | yady āha nahīti vaktavyaṃ | tūṣṇīkā bhavāhīti |
body.translated_text: 46. There are indeed in this body various chronic ailments, namely: skin disease, itching, scabies, leprosy, eczema, hemorrhoids, fistula, jaundice, sluggish digestion, hemorrhagic bile, fever, cough, asthma, consumption, epilepsy, wind-belly, water-belly, spleen-belly, diabetes. Do you have any of these or other various chronic ailments in this body, or not? If she says 'No,' she is to be told: 'Be silent.'

body.text: 47. karmakārikāye karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me bhante āryā saṃgho iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye upasaṃpādyā itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | tāya itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgho yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi | yācitānayā upādhyāyinī | paripūrṇam asyāḥ pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣā paripūrṇaśikṣā | sammatā pariśuddhā antarāyikehi dharmehi | ātmānaṃ pratijānāti | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthaṃnāmāye upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye trayo niśrayā deśayāmaḥ | deśayiṣyanti āryasaṃgho itthannāmāye itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye trayo niśrayān | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 47. The <s>karmakārikā</s> (procedural officer) should perform the act: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so; so-and-so and so-and-so are her private instructors. The <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested for ordination up to the third time by so-and-so's preceptress. She has been authorized by the authorizers. Her preceptress has been requested. Her bowl and robes are complete. The training has been taught. The training is fulfilled. She has been approved. She is purified from obstructing conditions. She declares herself [ready]. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let us teach the three reliances in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s> to so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress. They will teach. The noble <s>Saṃgha</s> [will teach] the three reliances in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s> to so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let it be silent—thus I understand it.'

body.text: 48. sā dāni vaktavyā | śṛṇu kuladhīte ime tena bhagavatā tathāgatenārhatā samyaksambuddhena arthakāmena hitaiṣinā anukampakena anukampām upādāya śrāvikāṇāṃ trayo niśrayā abhijñāya deśitāḥ prajñaptāḥ samyag ākhyātāḥ | yatrotsahantīyo śrāddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpadīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādīyanti |
body.translated_text: 48. She is then to be told: 'Listen, daughter of good family. These three reliances (<s>niśraya</s>) were taught, established, and rightly proclaimed by that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One—who desires benefit, seeks welfare, and is compassionate—out of compassion for his female disciples. Those who are willing, faithful daughters of good family, receive ordination; those who are unwilling do not receive ordination.'

body.text: niśraya 1
body.translated_text: <s>Niśraya</s> (Reliance) 1

body.text: 49. pāṃsukūlaṃ cīvarāṇāṃ alpañ ca sulabhañ ca kalpikañ cānavadyañ ca śramaṇīsārūpyañ ca | taṇ ca niśrāya pravrajyā upasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvaḥ yatrotsahantīyo śraddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādīyanti | atraca te kuladhīte yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | utsahasi tvaṃ kuladhīte yāvajjīvaṃ pāṃsukūlaṃ cīvarāṇān dhārayituṃ | utsahantyā utsahāmīti vaktavyaṃ | atirekalābhaḥ kambalaṃ karpāsaṃ kṣaumaṃ śāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ kṣaumutikā cīvarāṇāṃ ||
body.translated_text: 49. Rag-robes are for robes—they are few, easily obtained, proper, blameless, and befitting an ascetic woman. Relying on that, the going-forth (<s>pravrajyā</s>), ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>), and status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> [are undertaken]; those who are willing, faithful daughters of good family, receive ordination; those who are unwilling do not receive ordination. And herein, daughter of good family, effort is to be made for your entire life. Are you willing, daughter of good family, to wear rag-robes for your entire life? She who is willing should say 'I am willing.' Extra gain: blankets, cotton cloth, linen, hemp, flax, and <s>kṣaumutikā</s> cloth for robes.

body.text: niśraya 2
body.translated_text: <s>Niśraya</s> (Reliance) 2

body.text: 50.ucchiṣṭapiṇḍaṃ bhojanānāṃ alpañ ca sulabhañ ca kalpikaṃ cānavadyañ a śramaṇīsārūpyañ ca | taṅ ca niśrāya pravrajyā upasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāva yatrotsahantīyo śraddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādīyanti |
body.translated_text: 50. Leftover food is for meals—it is little, easily obtained, proper, blameless, and befitting an ascetic woman. Relying on that, the going-forth, ordination, and status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> [are undertaken]; those who are willing, faithful daughters of good family, receive ordination; those who are unwilling do not receive ordination.

body.text: atra ca te kuladhīte yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | utsahasi tvaṃ kuladhīte yāvajjīvam ucchiṣṭapiṇḍaṃ bhojanānāṃ bhoktuṃ | utsahantīyo utsahāmīti vaktavyaṃ | atirakalābhaḥ pakṣikānimantraṇā cāturdaśikā pāñcadaśikā upoṣadhikā śalākābhaktaṃ |
body.translated_text: And herein, daughter of good family, effort is to be made for your entire life. Are you willing, daughter of good family, to eat leftover food for your entire life? She who is willing should say 'I am willing.' Extra gain: fortnightly invitation, fourteenth-day meals, fifteenth-day meals, observance-day meals, and ticket-food.

body.text:
niśraya 3
51. pūtimūtraṃ bhaiṣajyānām alpañ ca sulabhañ ca kalpikañ cānavadyañ ca śramaṇīsārūpyañ ca | tañ ca niśrāya pravrajyā upasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvaḥ | atra utsahantīyo śraddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasampādīyanti | atra ca te kuladhīte yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | utsahasi tvaṃ kuladhīte yāvajjīvaṃ pūtimūtraṃ bhaiṣajyānāṃ pratisevituṃ | utsahantyā utsāhāmīti vaktavyaṃ | atirekalābhaḥ sarpistailaṃ madhuphāṇitaṃ vasānavanītaṃ ime trayo niśrayā āryavaṃśā | anuśikṣitavyaṃ anuvartitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Niśraya</s> (Reliance) 3. 51. Putrid urine is for medicines—it is little, easily obtained, proper, blameless, and befitting an ascetic woman. Relying on that, the going-forth, ordination, and status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> [are undertaken]. Herein, those who are willing, faithful daughters of good family, receive ordination; those who are unwilling do not receive ordination. And herein, daughter of good family, effort is to be made for your entire life. Are you willing, daughter of good family, to use putrid urine as medicine for your entire life? She who is willing should say 'I am willing.' Extra gain: ghee, oil, honey, molasses, fat, and butter. These are the three reliances—they are the <s>āryavaṃśa</s> (noble lineage). They are to be trained in, to be followed.

body.text: 52. karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho iyam itthannāmā itthaṃnāmāye upasaṃpādyā itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | tāya itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgho yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi | yācitānayā upādhyāyinī | paripūrṇam asyāḥ pātracīvaran | deśitaśikṣā | paripūrṇaśikṣā | sammatā | pariśuddhā antarāyikehi dharmehi | ātmānaṃ pratijānāti | niśrayeṣu cotsahati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ | saṃgho itthaṃnāmāṃ itthaṃnāmāya upādhyāyanīya upasaṃpādeyya | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 52. The <s>karmakārikā</s> (procedural officer) should perform the act: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so; so-and-so and so-and-so are her private instructors. The <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested for ordination up to the third time by so-and-so's preceptress. She has been authorized by the authorizers. Her preceptress has been requested. Her bowl and robes are complete. The training has been taught. The training is fulfilled. She has been approved. She is purified from obstructing conditions. She declares herself [ready]. She is willing regarding the reliances. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s> would ordain so-and-so with so-and-so as preceptress. This is the motion (<s>jñapti</s>).'

body.text: 53. śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye upasaṃpādyā | itthaṃnāmāya ca itthaṃnāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | saṃgho 'nayā itthaṃnāmāya itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi | yācitānayā upādhyāyinī paripūrṇam asyāḥ pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣā | paripūrṇaśikṣā | sammatā | pariśuddhā antarāyikehi dharmehi ātmānaṃ prati jānāti | niśrayeṣu cotsahati |
body.translated_text: 53. 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so; so-and-so and so-and-so are her private instructors. The <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested for ordination up to the third time by so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress. She has been authorized by the authorizers. Her preceptress has been requested. Her bowl and robes are complete. The training has been taught. The training is fulfilled. She has been approved. She is purified from obstructing conditions. She declares herself [ready]. She is willing regarding the reliances.'

body.text: 54. tāṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya upasaṃpādeti | yāsām āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāṃ itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya upasaṃpādīyamānāṃ saṃghena | sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣatu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitīyā | tṛtīyā karmavācaneti | vaktavyaṃ | upasampanneyam āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmā itthannāmāye upādhyāyāyinīya saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 54. 'The <s>Saṃgha</s> ordains so-and-so with so-and-so as preceptress. Those of the noble assembly to whom it is acceptable that so-and-so be ordained by the <s>Saṃgha</s> with so-and-so as preceptress, let her be silent. She who does not accept, let her speak. This is the first <s>karmavācanā</s> (formal act). Likewise the second. The third <s>karmavācanā</s>.' It is to be said: 'So-and-so has been ordained by the noble assembly with so-and-so as preceptress by the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let it be silent—thus I understand it.'

body.text: 55. sā dāni vaktavyā | jānāmi tvam itthannāme upasaṃpannā sūpasaṃpannā traivācikena karmaṇā | jñapticaturthena anāghātapañcamena | samagreṇa saṃghena na vyagreṇa | daśabaddhena gaṇena | sātirekadaśa baddhena |
body.translated_text: 55. She is then to be told: 'Know, so-and-so, that you are ordained, well-ordained, by the act of three readings (<s>traivācika karman</s>), with the motion as the fourth (<s>jñapticaturtha</s>) and non-objection as the fifth, by a complete <s>Saṃgha</s>, not an incomplete one, by a group bound by ten, with more than ten bound.'

body.text: 56. tathā dāni karohi yathā |
body.translated_text: 56. Thus now do as follows:

body.text:
buddhaśobhanā ca bhosi | dharmaśobhanā ca bhosi | saṃghaśobhanā ca bhosi | buddha guru ca dharma guru ca saṃgha guru ca | upādhyāyinī guru ca | ācāryāyiṇī guru ca | śikṣā guru ca | tathā dāni karohi | yathā | ārāgayitvā na virāgayasi |
durlabhā kṣaṇasaṃpadā |
body.translated_text: You are an ornament to the <s>Buddha</s>, an ornament to the <s>Dharma</s>, an ornament to the <s>Saṃgha</s>. The <s>Buddha</s> is your teacher, the <s>Dharma</s> is your teacher, the <s>Saṃgha</s> is your teacher. Your preceptress is your teacher. Your instructress is your teacher. The training is your teacher. Thus now act so that, having attained [the goal], you do not fall away. Rare is the attainment of the right moment.

children.translated_text: For whichever purpose there is the going-forth, for whichever purpose there is the ordination,
Guard that virtue as a <s>camarī</s> (yak-cow) guards the tip of her tail. [1]
That which is dear and intended by the <s>Buddha</s>, kinsman of the sun,
And by the wise female disciples, the discerning ones who see the meaning,

children.text: so te artho anuprāpto labdhā te upasaṃpadā || [2]
children.translated_text: That goal has been attained by you; the ordination has been gained by you. [2]

children.text: aśokaṃ virajaṃ kṣemaṃ dvīpaṃ lenaṃ parāyaṇaṃ |
children.translated_text: Sorrowless, stainless, secure—a refuge, a shelter, the final resort,

children.text: taṃ prāpuṇāhi nirvāṇaṃ eṣā te sarvasampadā || [3]
children.translated_text: Attain that <s>Nirvāṇa</s>—this is your complete attainment. [3]

body.text: 57. tām evam bhikṣuṇīgaṇenopasaṃpādiya bhikṣuvihāraṃ gatvā upādhyāyinīya ubhayato saṃgho samudānayitavyo | āsanaprajñapti kartavyā nīcatamā ekadeśe bhikṣuṇīsamghasya | yadā bhikṣū sāmīciṃ kṛtvā niṣaṇṇā bhavanti tadā bhikṣuṇīhi sāmīciṃ kṛtvā niṣīditavyam | tato upādhyāyinīya upasaṃpādyā gaṇasyopanāmayitavyā | karmakārakeṇa pṛcchitavyā | pariśuddhāsi bhikṣuṇīhīti | na pṛcchati vinayātikramam āsādayati |
body.translated_text: 57. Having thus ordained [the candidate] with the <s>bhikṣuṇī-gaṇa</s> (assembly of nuns), one should go to the <s>bhikṣu-vihāra</s> (monks' monastery), and the preceptress should convene the dual <s>Saṃgha</s> (<s>ubhayato saṃgha</s>). A seat arrangement should be prepared, with the lowest seat placed in one section for the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>. When the <s>bhikṣus</s> have performed the reverential salutation and are seated, then the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should perform the reverential salutation and sit down. Then the preceptress should present the candidate to the assembly. The procedural officer should ask: 'Has she been purified by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?' If he does not ask, he incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (transgression of the disciplinary code).

body.text: 58. karmakārakeṇa karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī | tāye itthannāmā antevāsinī upasaṃpādyā | viśuddhā bhikṣuṇīhi |
body.translated_text: 58. The procedural officer should perform the act: 'May the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so—her student named so-and-so is to be ordained. She has been purified by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.'

body.text: yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāye antevāsinīye saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yāceyyā | yāciṣyati bhante saṃgho itthannāmā itthannāmāye antevāsinīye saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 'If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so would request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for ordination on behalf of her student named so-and-so. She will request the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> for ordination of so-and-so on behalf of her student named so-and-so. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let it be silent—thus I understand it.'

body.text:
59. tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ aham itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā me iyam itthannāmā antevāsinī upasampādyā | sāham itthannāmāya antevāsinīye saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yācāmi | upasaṃpādetu taṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ mayā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya anukampām upādāya | dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi yācitavyaṃ |
karma | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye upasaṃpādyā | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | yadi samghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yāceyyā | yāciṣyati bhante saṃgho itthannāmā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 59. She should then make the request: 'I pay homage to the noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. I, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so—this one named so-and-so is my student who is to be ordained. I, on behalf of my student named so-and-so, request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for ordination. May the <s>Saṃgha</s> ordain so-and-so, with me named so-and-so as preceptress, out of compassion.' She should request a second and a third time. The formal act: 'May the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so; so-and-so and so-and-so are her private instructors. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so-and-so would request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for ordination with so-and-so as preceptress. She will request the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> for ordination of so-and-so with so-and-so as preceptress. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let it be silent—thus I understand it.'

body.text: 60. tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ | ahaṃ itthannāmā arthahetor nāma gṛhṇāmi itthannāmāye upādhyāyinīye upasaṃpādyā | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca ācāryāya raho'nuśāstā | sāham itthannāmā arhahetor nāma gṛhṇāmi itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yācāmi | upasaṃpādetu me āryo saṃgho | ullumpatu āryo saṃgho | anukampatu me āryo saṃgho | anukampako anukampām upādāya evam dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: 60. She should then make the request: 'I pay homage to the noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. I, named so-and-so, for the sake of the goal take the name, to be ordained by the preceptress named so-and-so; so-and-so and so-and-so are the instructresses and private instructors. I, named so-and-so, for the sake of the goal take the name, and request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for ordination with so-and-so as preceptress. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> ordain me. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> lift me up. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> have compassion on me—compassionate, out of compassion.' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: karma | śṛṇu me bhante saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye upasaṃpādyā | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | anayā itthannāmāya itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃgho yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye antarāyikān dharmān pṛcchemaḥ | pṛcchiṣyati bhante saṃgho itthannāmā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye antarāyikān dharmān | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: The formal act (<s>karma</s>): 'Let the <s>Saṃgha</s> hear me, venerable ones. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so. So-and-so and so-and-so have instructed her in private. By this one named so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress (<s>upādhyāyinī</s>), the <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested up to a third time for full ordination. If the time is suitable for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let us question so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress, about the obstructing conditions (<s>antarāyika dharmāḥ</s>) in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. The <s>Saṃgha</s> will question, venerable ones, so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress, about the obstructing conditions in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If this is agreeable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let it be silent — thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 61. sā dāni vaktavyā | śṛṇu kuladhite | ayaṃ satyakālo | ayaṃ bhūtakālo yāva sadevakaṃ lokaṃ samārakaṃ sabrahmaṇaṃ saśramaṇabrāhmaṇīṃ prajāṃ sadevamānuṣāsurāṃ visamvādeyyā ya ca tasya bhagavato tathāgatasyārhataḥ samyaksambuddhasya ubhayatosaṃghaṃ visamvādeyyā iman tato mahāsāvadyataraṃ | yaṃ yad eva te saṃghamadhye pṛccheyāma taṃ tad eva yam asti tam astīti vaktavyaṃ | yaṃ nāsti taṃ nāstīti vaktavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 61. She is then to be addressed: 'Listen, daughter of good family. This is the time of truth. This is the time of reality. [Even if] you were to deceive the world with its gods, with <s>Māra</s>, with <s>Brahmā</s>, the people with <s>śramaṇas</s> and <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, with gods, humans, and <s>asuras</s> — and even if you were to deceive the dual <s>Saṃgha</s> of that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened one — this [deceiving the <s>Saṃgha</s>] is a far greater offense than that. Whatever we ask you in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, if it is so, you must say "it is so"; if it is not, you must say "it is not."'

body.text: 62. anujñātāsi anujñāpakehi | āma | yācitā te upādhyāyinī | āma | paripūrṇan te pātracīvaraṃ | āma | deśitaśikṣāsi | āma | paripūrṇaśikṣāsi | āma | sammatāsi | āma | viśuddhāsi bhikṣuṇīhi | āma | mā mātṛghātinī | nahi | mā arhadghātinī | nahi mā saṃghabhedikā | nahi | mā tathāgatasya duṣṭacittarudhirotpādikā | nahi | ciraparinivṛtto kho puna so bhagavāṃs tathāgato 'rhan samyaksambuddho |
body.translated_text: 62. 'Have you been given permission by those who give permission?' 'Yes.' 'Has your preceptress (<s>upādhyāyinī</s>) been requested?' 'Yes.' 'Is your bowl and robe complete?' 'Yes.' 'Have you completed the training instruction?' 'Yes.' 'Is your training fulfilled?' 'Yes.' 'Have you been approved?' 'Yes.' 'Have you been declared pure by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?' 'Yes.' 'You have not killed your mother?' 'No.' 'You have not killed an <s>Arhat</s>?' 'No.' 'You have not caused a schism in the <s>Saṃgha</s>?' 'No.' 'You have not, with malicious intent, drawn blood from a <s>Tathāgata</s>?' 'No.' 'That <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened one, has long since passed into final <s>Parinirvāṇa</s>.'

body.text: mā bhikṣudūṣikā nahi mā stainyasamvāsikā | nahi | mā tīrthikāpakrāntikā | nahi | mā dāsī | nahi | mā avapitikā | nahi | mā ṛṇahārikā | nahi | mā rājabhaṭī | nahi | mā rājñaḥ kilbiṣakāriṇī | nahi | upasampannapūrvāsi anyadāpi | yady āha | āman ti | vaktavyā | gaccha nasya cala prapalāya nāsti te upasaṃpadā | athāha nahīti | vaktavyaṃ | santi kho punar imasmiṃ kāye vividhā anuśāyikā ābādhāḥ | saṃyathīdaṃ dadru kaṇḍū kacchū rakacā | vicarcikā kuṣṭhaṃ kiṭibhaṃ | arśā bhagandalā | pāṇḍurogo ālaso | lohitapittaṃ jvaro | kāso śvāso soṣo apasmāro | vātodaram dakodaraṃ | plīhodaraṃ madhumeho visūcikā | santi te ete vā anye vā vividhā anusāyikā ābādhā kāye 'smin na vā | yady āha nahīti | vaktavyā | tūṣṇikā bhavāhi |
body.translated_text: 'You have not corrupted a <s>bhikṣu</s>?' 'No.' 'You have not lived in association through theft [of ordination]?' 'No.' 'You have not gone over to a non-Buddhist sect (<s>tīrthika</s>)?' 'No.' 'You are not a slave?' 'No.' 'You are not a debtor fleeing [creditors]?' 'No.' 'You are not one who carries off debts?' 'No.' 'You are not a royal soldier?' 'No.' 'You have not committed an offense against the king?' 'No.' 'Have you been previously ordained elsewhere?' If she says 'Yes,' she is to be told: 'Go, leave, depart — there is no ordination for you.' But if she says 'No,' she is to be told: 'There are in this body various chronic diseases, such as: scabies, itching, leprosy, roughness of skin, eczema, white leprosy, black leprosy, hemorrhoids, fistula, jaundice, and lethargy...'

body.text: 63. karma | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye upasaṃpādyā | itthannāmāya ca itthananāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā | anayā itthannāmāya itthannāmāya upādhyāyinyā saṃgho yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi | yācitānayā upādhyāyinī | paripūrṇaṃ se pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣā | paripūrṇaśikṣā | sammatā viśuddhā bhikṣuṇīhi | pariśuddhā anatarāyikairdharmair ātmānaṃ pratijānāti | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmāye itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye trayo niśrayā deśayāmaḥ | deśiṣyanti bhante saṃgho itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya saṃghamadhye trayo niśrayān | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 63. The formal act (<s>karma</s>): 'Let the <s>Saṃgha</s> hear me, venerable ones. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. So-and-so and so-and-so have instructed her in private. By this one named so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress, the <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested up to a third time for full ordination. She has been permitted by those who give permission. She has requested a preceptress. Her bowl and robe are complete. She has completed the training instruction. Her training is fulfilled. She has been approved and declared pure by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. She declares herself pure of the obstructing conditions. If the time is suitable for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, [let the <s>Saṃgha</s> ordain] so-and-so with so-and-so as preceptress in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>...'

body.text:
niśraya 1
64. sā vaktavyā | śṛṇu kuladhīte ime tena bhagavatā tathāgatenārhatā samyaksambudḍhenārthakāmena hitaiṣinā anukampakenānukampām upādāya śrāvikāṇān trayo niśrayā abhijñāya deśitā prajñaptāḥ samyag ākhyātāḥ | yatrotsahantīyo śrāddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādīyanti | atra ca kuladhite yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | pāṃsukūlaṃ cīvarāṇām alpañ ca sulabhañ ca kalpikañ cānavadyañ ca śramaṇīsārūpyañ ca | tañ ca niśrāya pravrajyopasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvaḥ | yatrotsahantīyo śrāddhāyo kulakuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādiyanti | atra ca te kuladhīte yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | utsahasi tvaṃ kuladhīte yāvajjīvaṃ pāṃsukūlaṃ cīvarāṇān dhārayituṃ | utsahantīya utsahāmīti vaktavyaṃ | atirekalābhaḥ kambalaṃ karpāsaṃ kṣaumaṃ śāṇaṃ bhaṅgaṃ kṣomutikā cīvarāṇāṃ |
body.translated_text: Reliance 1 (<s>niśraya</s> 1): 64. She is to be told: 'Listen, daughter of good family. These three reliances (<s>niśrayāḥ</s>) have been taught, established, and properly declared by that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened one, who desires what is beneficial, wishes for welfare, and acts out of compassion — having understood them for the sake of his female disciples. Those faithful daughters of good family who can endure them are ordained; those who cannot endure them are not ordained. And in this, daughter of good family, effort must be made for one's entire life. Rag-robes (<s>pāṃsukūla</s>) are the [standard] robes — they are few, easily obtained, permissible, blameless, and suitable for a female renunciant. Relying on this, there is the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun...'

body.text:
niśraya 2
ucchiṣṭapiṇḍaṃ bhojanānāṃ alpañ ca sulabhañ ca kalpikañ cānavadyañ ca śramaṇīsārūpyañ ca | tañ ca niśrāya pravrajyopasaṃpadā bhikṣuṇībhāvaḥ | yatrotsahantīyo śraddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādīyanti | atra ca te kuladhite yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | utsahasi tvaṃ kuladhite yāvajjīvam ucchiṣṭapiṇdaṃ bhojanānāṃ bhoktuṃ | utsahantīya utsāhāmīti vaktavyam | atirekalābhaḥ | pakṣikānimantraṇā cāturdaśikā pāñcadaśikāyāṃ upoṣadhikā śalākābhaktaṃ |
body.translated_text: Reliance 2 (<s>niśraya</s> 2): Leftover alms-food (<s>ucchiṣṭapiṇḍa</s>) is the [standard] food — it is little, easily obtained, permissible, blameless, and suitable for a female renunciant. Relying on this, there is the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun. Those faithful daughters of good family who can endure are ordained; those who cannot endure are not ordained. And in this, daughter of good family, effort must be made for one's entire life. 'Can you, daughter of good family, eat leftover alms-food as your food for your entire life?' If she can endure, she should say 'I can endure.' The extra allowance: fortnightly invitations, on the fourteenth and fifteenth days, on <s>upoṣadha</s> days, and food distributed by ticket.

body.text:
niśraya 3
pūtimūtraṃ bhaiṣajyānām alpañ ca sulabhañ ca kalpikañ cānavadyañ ca śramaṇīsārūpyañ ca | tañ ca niśrāya pravrajyopasaṃpad bhikṣuṇībhāvaḥ | yatrotsahantīyo śrāddhāyo kuladhītāyo upasaṃpādīyanti | anutsahantīyo nopasaṃpādīyanti | atra ca kuladhīte yāvajjīvam utsāho karaṇīyo | utsahasi tvaṃ kuladhīte yāvajjīvaṃ pūtimūtraṃ bhaiṣajyānāṃ pratisevituṃ | utsahantīya utsāhāmīti vaktavyaṃ | atirekalābhaḥ | sarpistailaṃ madhuphāṇitaṃ vasānavanītaṃ | ime trayo niśrayā āryavaṃśā | anuśikṣitavyaṃ anupravartitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: Reliance 3 (<s>niśraya</s> 3): Putrid urine (<s>pūtimūtra</s>) is the [standard] medicine — it is little, easily obtained, permissible, blameless, and suitable for a female renunciant. Relying on this, there is the going-forth, full ordination, and the status of a nun. Those faithful daughters of good family who can endure are ordained; those who cannot endure are not ordained. And in this, daughter of good family, effort must be made for one's entire life. 'Can you, daughter of good family, use putrid urine as your medicine for your entire life?' If she can endure, she should say 'I can endure.' The extra allowance: clarified butter, oil, honey, molasses, fat, and fresh butter. These are the three reliances, the noble lineages (<s>āryavaṃśāḥ</s>). One should train in them...

body.text: 65. karmakārakeṇa karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyaṃ itthannāmā itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye upasaṃpādyā itthannāmā ya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā saṃgho 'nayā itthannāmāya itthan nāmāya upādhyāyinīya yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi | yācitānayā upādhyāyinī | paripūrṇam asyāḥ pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣā | paripūrṇāśikṣā sammatā viśuddhā bhikṣuṇīhi pariśuddhā antarāyikehi dharmehi ātmānaṃ pratijānāti | niśrayeṣu cotsahati yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya upasaṃpādeyyā | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 65. The one performing the formal act should perform it [as follows]: 'Let the <s>Saṃgha</s> hear me, venerable ones. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. So-and-so and so-and-so have instructed her in private. By this one named so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress, the <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested up to a third time for full ordination. She has been permitted by those who give permission. She has requested a preceptress. Her bowl and robe are complete. Her training instruction is complete. Her training is fulfilled. She has been approved and declared pure by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. She declares herself pure of the obstructing conditions. And she can endure the reliances. If the time is suitable for the <s>Saṃgha</s>...'

body.text: 66. śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye upasaṃpādyā | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstā saṃgho 'nayā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya yāvat tṛtīyakam upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi yācitānayā upādhyāyanīyinī | paripūrṇam asyāḥ pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣā | paripūrṇaśikṣā sammatā | viśuddhā bhikṣuṇīhi | pariśuddhā antarāyikair dharmair ātmānaṃ pratfiānāti | niśrayeṣu cotsahati | tāṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ itthannāmāye upādhyāyinīye upasaṃpādeti | yeṣām āyuṣmantānāṃ kṣamati itthannāmām itthannāmāye upādhyāyinīye upasaṃpādīyamānāṃ saṃghena | so tūṣṇīm asya | yasya na kṣamati so bhāṣatu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evam dvitīyā | tṛtīyā karmavācaneti vaktavyaṃ | upasaṃpanneyaṃ bhante saṃgho itthannāmāṃ itthannāmāye upādhyāyinīya saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 66. 'Let the <s>Saṃgha</s> hear me, venerable ones. This one named so-and-so is to be ordained by so-and-so the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. So-and-so and so-and-so have instructed her in private. By this one named so-and-so, with so-and-so as preceptress, the <s>Saṃgha</s> has been requested up to a third time for full ordination. She has been permitted by those who give permission. She has requested a preceptress. Her bowl and robe are complete. Her training instruction is complete. Her training is fulfilled. She has been approved and declared pure by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. She declares herself pure of the obstructing conditions. And she can endure the reliances. The <s>Saṃgha</s> ordains so-and-so with so-and-so as preceptress. Those venerable ones who approve...'

body.text: 67. atrāntare cchāyā māpayitavyā | nakṣatrāṇi vā gaṇayitavyāni
body.translated_text: 67. In the interval, the shadow should be measured, or the stars should be counted [to determine the exact time of ordination].

body.text: sā dāni vaktavyā | eṣāsi tvaṃ kuladhīte upasaṃpannā sūpasaṃpannā traivācikena karmaṇā | jñapticaturthena | anāghātapañcamena ubhayataḥ saṃghena samagreṇa na vyagreṇa daśabaddhena gaṇena sātirekadaśabaddhena vā |
body.translated_text: She is then to be told: 'You, daughter of good family, are ordained, well-ordained, by a threefold declaration (<s>traivācika karma</s>), a motion with three announcements (<s>jñapticaturtha</s>), with a fifth [factor] of non-objection, by both <s>Saṃghas</s> united, not divided, with a quorum of ten or more than ten.'

body.text: tathā dāni karohi yathā | buddhaśobhanā ca bhosi dharmaśobhanā ca saṃghaśobhanā ca | buddha guru ca dharma guru ca saṃgha guru ca | upādhyāyinī guru ca ācāryā guru ca tathā dāni karohi yathā |
body.translated_text: 'Now conduct yourself in such a way that you are an ornament to the <s>Buddha</s>, an ornament to the <s>Dharma</s>, and an ornament to the <s>Saṃgha</s>. The <s>Buddha</s> is your teacher, the <s>Dharma</s> is your teacher, the <s>Saṃgha</s> is your teacher, your preceptress (<s>upādhyāyinī</s>) is your teacher, and your instructress (<s>ācāryā</s>) is your teacher. Now conduct yourself accordingly.'

body.text:
ārāgayitvā na virāgayasi
durlabhā kṣaṇasampadā |
body.translated_text: 'Having gained [the religious life], do not become dispassionate [toward it]; the conjunction of [favorable] conditions is hard to obtain.'

body.text: yasārthāya pravrajyā yasyārthāya upasaṃpadā |

children.translated_text: 'Guard that moral conduct, as the yak-cow [guards] the tip of her tail.' [1]

body.translated_text: 'That for the sake of which there is the going-forth, that for the sake of which there is the full ordination —'

children.translated_text: 'That which is desired and intended by the <s>Buddha</s>, kinsman of the sun (<s>ādityabandhu</s>),'
'and by the wise female disciples, the discerning ones who see the meaning,'

children.text: so te artho anuprāpto labdhā te upasaṃpadā || [2]
children.translated_text: 'that goal has been attained by you; you have obtained full ordination.' [2]

children.text: aśokaṃ virajaṃ kṣemaṃ dvīpaṃ lenaṃ parāyaṇaṃ |
children.translated_text: 'Sorrowless, stainless, secure — an island, a shelter, a final refuge —'

children.text: taṃ prāpuṇāhi nirvāṇaṃ eṣā te sarvasampadā || [3]
children.translated_text: 'attain that <s>Nirvāṇa</s>; this is your complete fulfillment.' [3]

body.text: 68. pāriveṇikā | aṣṭau pārājikā dharmāḥ | ekūnaviṃśati saṃghātiśeṣā dharmāḥ | triṃśan niḥsargikapācattikā dharmāḥ | aṣṭa prātideśikā dharmāḥ | catuṣaṣṭi śekhiyā dharmāḥ | sapta adhikaraṇaśamathā dharmāḥ | dvau dharmau dharmo 'nudharmaś ca | eṣa te kuladhīte saṃkṣiptena ovādo | vistareṇa te upādhyāyinīācāryāyo ovadiśyanti |
body.translated_text: 68. The summary (<s>pāriveṇikā</s>): Eight <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) rules; nineteen <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s> (formal meeting) rules; thirty <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s> (forfeiture-and-expiation) rules; eight <s>prātideśika</s> (confession) rules; sixty-four <s>śekhiya</s> (rules of training) rules; seven <s>adhikaraṇaśamatha</s> (settlement of disputes) rules; two [categories]: the <s>Dharma</s> and the subsidiary <s>Dharma</s>. This, daughter of good family, is the instruction in brief. Your preceptress and instructresses will instruct you in detail.

body.text: 69. śṛṇu tvam itthannāme | ime tena bhagavatā tathāgatenārhatā samyaksambuddhena evaṃ pravrajitopasampannāye bhikṣuṇīye catvāraḥ śrāmaṇīkā rakā dharmā ākhyātā |
body.translated_text: 69. 'Listen, so-and-so. By that <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened one, four rules that make one a [true] female renunciant (<s>śrāmaṇīkāraka dharmāḥ</s>) have been declared for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who has gone forth and been ordained.'

children.text: ākruṣṭāya na pratyākroṣitavyaṃ roṣitāya na pratiroṣitavyaṃ |
children.translated_text: 'When abused, one should not abuse in return; when angered, one should not respond with anger;'

children.text: bhaṇḍitāya na pratibhaṇḍitavyaṃ tāḍitāya na pratitāḍitavyaṃ || [1]
children.translated_text: 'when quarreled with, one should not quarrel in return; when struck, one should not strike back.' [1]
'Going forth is for one of faith; full ordination is for one who is pure;'
'declared by its true name by the fully awakened one who knows.' [2]
'The non-doing of all evil, the undertaking of what is wholesome,'
'the complete taming of one's own mind — this is the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.' [3]

body.text: 70. ekam idaṅ gautami samayaṃ tathāgato vaiśālīyaṃ viharati | mahāvane kūṭāgāraśālāyān dharmadinnāye dāni bhikṣuṇīye dve antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | apraśarkeṇa dāni licchavikumāreṇa śrutaṃ | dharmadinnāye bhikṣuṇīye dve antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | tā pañcāhaṃ pūrve evañ caivañ ca khalīkṛto gacchāmy ahan tāyo upasampādyāyo brahmacaryāto yācayāmīti dharmadinnāye śrutaṃ |
body.translated_text: 70. At one time, the <s>Tathāgata</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>, in the Great Forest (<s>Mahāvana</s>), in the Gabled Hall (<s>Kūṭāgāraśālā</s>). The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> had two female pupils to be ordained. A <s>Licchavi</s> youth named <s>Apraśarka</s> heard: 'The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> has two female pupils to be ordained.' [He thought:] 'Let me go five days beforehand and harass them in this way and that; I shall ask those [women] to be ordained to abandon the holy life.' <s>Dharmadinnā</s> heard [of this].

body.text: 71. sā dāni yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavantam etad avocat | mama bhagavan dve antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyaḥ | labhyā bhagavan tāyo tatrasthitāyo ihasthitena saṃghena upasaṃpādayituṃ | bhagavān āha | labhyā | gaccha prathamaṃ bhikṣuṇīgaṇenopasaṃpādiya paścād bhikṣuvihāraṃ gatvā dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān yāca dvau vā trīṇi vā gaṇa na kṣamati | dadātu ca te saṃgho dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān | sādhū ti vaditvā dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī bhagavato 'ntikāt prakrāntā | yāvat |
body.translated_text: 71. She then approached the <s>Bhagavān</s> and said to him: 'Lord, I have two students to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. Is it possible, Lord, for them to be ordained by the <s>saṃgha</s> present here while they remain there?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'It is possible. Go, first ordain them through the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> assembly, then go to the <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery and request ordination-by-messenger acceptors—two or three, not an assembly. Let the <s>saṃgha</s> give you ordination-by-messenger acceptors.' Having said 'Very well,' the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> departed from the presence of the <s>Bhagavān</s>. And so forth.

body.text: 72. karmakārakeṇa karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho iyan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca antevāsinīnāṃ tatrasthitānām ihasthitaṃ saṃghaṃ dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān yāceya | yāciṣyati bhante saṃgho dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāye ca itthannāmāye ca antevāsinīnām upasaṃpādyānāṃ tatrasthitānāṃ ihasthitaṃ saṃghaṃ dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 72. The <s>karmakāraka</s> (procedure officiant) should perform the formal act: 'May the venerable <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This is the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>. She has two students named so-and-so to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> should request the <s>saṃgha</s> present here for ordination-by-messenger acceptors for the students named so-and-so who remain there. She will request: Venerable <s>saṃgha</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> [requests] ordination-by-messenger acceptors for the students named so-and-so to be ordained who remain there, from the <s>saṃgha</s> present here. If this is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, let it be silent. Thus I understand it.'

body.text: 73. tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ ahan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā me itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo | sāhaṃ dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāye ca itthannāmāye ca antevāsinīnāṃ upasaṃpādyānān tatrasthitānām ihasthitaṃ saṃghaṃ dūtopasaṃpādāpratigrāhakān yācāmi | sādhu bhava me āryo saṃgho itthannāmāye ca itthannāmāye ca antevāsinīnāṃ upasaṃpādyānāṃ tatrasthitānām ihasthito saṃgho dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān detu | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi yācitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 73. Now she should make this request: 'I bow to the noble <s>saṃgha</s>. I am the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>. I have two students named so-and-so to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. I, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>, request the <s>saṃgha</s> present here for ordination-by-messenger acceptors for the students named so-and-so to be ordained who remain there. May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> please grant the <s>saṃgha</s> present here as ordination-by-messenger acceptors for the students named so-and-so to be ordained who remain there.' A second and a third time the request should be made.

body.text: 74. karma | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantināṃ syād brahmacaryantarāyaḥ | seyan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāye ca itthannāmāye ca upasaṃpādyānāṃ tatrasthitānām ihasthitaṃ saṃghaṃ dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakā yācayati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ ca itthannāmaṃ ca dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān sammanyeyā | ivayikā eṣā prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 74. The formal act: 'May the venerable <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This is the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>. She has students named so-and-so to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> requests the <s>saṃgha</s> present here for ordination-by-messenger acceptors for the students named so-and-so to be ordained who remain there. The <s>saṃgha</s> appoints so-and-so and so-and-so as ordination-by-messenger acceptors. If acceptable to the noble ones, let them be silent; if not acceptable, let them speak. A second and a third time.'

body.text: 75. śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyaṃ dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinī upasaṃpādyā tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo | seyaṃ dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāye ca itthannāmāye ca antevāsinīnāṃ upasaṃpādyānāṃ tatrasthitānāṃ ihasthitaṃ saṃghaṃ dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān yācate | tān saṃgho dharmadinnāye bhikṣuṇīye itthannāmaṃ ca itthannāmaṃ ca dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān sammanyati | yeṣām āyuṣmantānāṃ kṣamati dharmadinnāye bhikṣuṇīye itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakān sammanyiyamānān saṃghena | so tūṣṇīm asya | yasya na kṣamati so bhāṣatu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitīya tṛtīyā karmavācanā iti kartavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 75. 'May the venerable <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> has students named so-and-so to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> requests the <s>saṃgha</s> present here for ordination-by-messenger acceptors for the students named so-and-so who remain there. If this is acceptable to the noble ones—the appointment of so-and-so and so-and-so as ordination-by-messenger acceptors by the <s>saṃgha</s>—let them be silent. If not acceptable, let them speak. A second and a third time.'

body.text: 76. sammatā | bhante saṃgho | dharmadinnāye bhikṣuniye itthannāmāye ca itthannāmāye ca antevāsinīnāṃ tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāya iti kṛtvā tatrasthitānām ihasthitena saṃghena itthannāmo ca itthannāmo ca bhikṣū dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakāḥ kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 76. 'Approved. Venerable <s>saṃgha</s>, for the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>'s students named so-and-so, since there might be an obstacle to their chaste life if they were to come here, so-and-so and so-and-so have been appointed by the <s>saṃgha</s> present here as ordination-by-messenger acceptors for those who remain there. It is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, since it is silent. Thus I understand it.'

body.text: 77. tehi dani sammatehi samānehi dharmadinnāye bhikṣuṇīye upāśrayaṃ gantavyaṃ | tāhi dāni dharmadinnāya antevāsinīhi te yācitavyāḥ | vandāmy āryaṃ ihasthitāyo itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca āryāye dharmadinnāye upādhyāyinīye upasaṃpādyāyo | viśuddhā bhikṣuṇīhi | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca āryāya raho'nuśāstāyo tāsām asmākaṃ tatragacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo | tā vayaṃ itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca āryāya dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatrasthitaṃ saṃgham upasaṃpadaṃ yācāmaḥ | upasaṃpādetu me ārya saṃgho | ullumpatu me āryo saṃgho | anukampatu me āryo saṃgho anukampako anukampām upādāya | evaṃ dvitīyaṃ pi tṛtīyaṃpi yācitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 77. Now, those who have been appointed should go to the residence of the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>. Then <s>Dharmadinnā</s>'s students should make this request to them: 'I bow to the noble ones. We, named so-and-so, who are here, are students of the noble <s>Dharmadinnā</s>, to be ordained. We request the noble ordination-by-messenger acceptors: may you accept us for ordination.' A second and a third time.

body.text: 78. tato bhikṣuvihāraṅ gantavyaṃ | yaṃ kālaṃ ubhayato saṃgho upaviṣṭo bhavati tato dharmadinnāya yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ | ahan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | viśuddhā bhikṣuṇīhi | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo | sāhan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca antevāsinīnām upasaṃpādyānāṃ tatrasthitānām ihasthitaṃ saṃghaṃ upasaṃpadaṃ yācāmi | upasaṃpādetu tāyo saṃgho mayā itthannāmāya upādhyāyinīya | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyaṃ pi yācitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 78. Then they should go to the <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery. When both <s>saṃghas</s> are seated, <s>Dharmadinnā</s> should make this request: 'I bow to the noble <s>saṃgha</s>. I am the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s>. I have students named so-and-so to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. The ordination-by-messenger acceptors have been appointed by the <s>saṃgha</s>. May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> grant the ordination for those remaining there through the <s>saṃgha</s> present here.'

body.text: 79. yaṃ kālaṃ dharmadinnāya yācitaṃ bhavati | tato dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakehi yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ | iyan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinyo upasaṃpādyāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syāt brahmacaryāntarāyo | tāhi itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatrasthitāhi ihasthitaḥ saṃgha upasaṃpadaṃ yācitaḥ | upasaṃpādetu tāyo āryo saṃgho | ullumpatu tāyo āryo saṃgho | anukampatu tāyo āryo saṃgho | anukampako anukampām upādāya | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi yācitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 79. When <s>Dharmadinnā</s> has made the request, the ordination-by-messenger acceptors should make this request: 'I bow to the noble <s>saṃgha</s>. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> has students named so-and-so to be ordained. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. We have been appointed as ordination-by-messenger acceptors. We have gone to their place, examined them, instructed them in private, and they are fit for ordination. May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> ordain them.'

body.text: 80. karmakārakena karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho iyaṃ dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca raho'nuśāstāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo tāhi itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatra sthitāhi ihasthitaḥ saṃgho upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātā anujñāpakehi | yācitā tāhi upādhyāyinī | paripūrṇaṃ tāsāṃ pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣāyo paripūrṇaśikṣāyo sammatāyo viśuddhāyo bhikṣuṇīhi | pariśuddhāyo antarāyikehi dharmehi ātmānaṃ pratijānanti | niśrayeṣu cotsahanti | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ itthannāmāṃ ca itthannāmāṃ ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatrasthitāyo ihasthito saṃgho upāsaṃpādeyyā | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 80. The <s>karmakāraka</s> should perform the formal act: 'May the venerable <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> has students named so-and-so to be ordained, and so-and-so are their private instructors. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. The ordination-by-messenger acceptors have been appointed. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, the <s>saṃgha</s> should ordain them—those remaining there—through the <s>saṃgha</s> present here. This is the motion.'

body.text: 81. śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho | iyan dharmadinnā bhikṣuṇī | tasyā itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca antevāsinīyo upasaṃpādyāyo | itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca raho'nuśāstāyo | tāsām ihāgacchantīnāṃ syād brahmacaryāntarāyo | tāhi itthannāmāya ca itthannāmāya ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatrasthitāhi ihasthito saṃgho upasaṃpadaṃ yācito | anujñātāyo anujñāpakehi | yācitā tāhi upādhyāyinī | paripūrṇaṃ tāsāṃ pātracīvaraṃ | deśitaśikṣāyo | paripurṇaśikṣāyo | sammatāyo viśuddhāyo bhikṣuṇīhi | pariśuddhāyo antarāyikehi dharmehi ātmānaṃ pratijānanti | tāyo saṃgho itthannāmāṃ ca itthannāmāṃ ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya ihasthito saṃgho upasaṃpādeti | yeṣām āyuṣmatāṃ kṣamati itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatrasthitāyo ihasthitena saṃghena upasaṃpādīyamānāyo | so tūṣṇīm asya | yasya na kṣamati so bhāṣatu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācanā |
body.translated_text: 81. 'May the venerable <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> has students named so-and-so to be ordained. So-and-so are their private instructors. If they were to come here, there might be an obstacle to their chaste life. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Dharmadinnā</s> requests ordination-by-messenger for the students named so-and-so who remain there, from the <s>saṃgha</s> present here. If this is acceptable to the noble ones, let them be silent; if not, let them speak. A second and a third time.'

body.text: 82. karma kartavyam | upasampannā bhante saṃgho itthannāmā ca itthannāmā ca dharmadinnāya upādhyāyinīya tatrasthitāyo ihasthitena saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etan dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 82. The formal act should be performed: 'Ordained, venerable <s>saṃgha</s>, are so-and-so, students of the preceptress <s>Dharmadinnā</s>, who remained there, by the <s>saṃgha</s> present here. It is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, since it is silent. Thus I understand it.'

body.text: evam upasaṃpadāya tehi dūtopasaṃpadāpratigrāhakehi bhikṣuṇyupāśrayaṅ gatvā tāyo upasaṃpannāyo vaktavyāyo | etā itthannāmāyopasaṃpannāyo sūpasaṃpannāyo traivācikena karmaṇā jñapticaturthena | anāghātapañcamena | samagreṇa ubhayataḥ saṃghena daśabaddhena gaṇena | sātirekadaśabaddhena vā |
body.translated_text: Thus for ordination [by messenger], the ordination-by-messenger acceptors, having gone to the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence, should tell them they are ordained: 'These ones named so-and-so are ordained, well-ordained, by a three-statement formal act, a resolution with motion as the fourth. Without harm, without danger, you should conduct yourselves well.'

body.text:
tathā dāni karotha yathā |
buddhaśobhanā ca bhotha | dharmaśobhanā ca saṃghaśobhanā ca |
body.translated_text: So you should act accordingly: be ornaments of the <s>Buddha</s>, ornaments of the <s>Dharma</s>, and ornaments of the <s>Saṃgha</s>.

body.text:
buddha guru ca | dharma guru ca saṃgha guru ca | upādhyāyinī guru ca | ācārya guru ca | tathā dāni karotha yathā |
ārāgayitvā na virāgayatha |
durlabhā kṣaṇasampadā |
body.translated_text: The <s>Buddha</s> is your teacher, the <s>Dharma</s> is your teacher, the <s>Saṃgha</s> is your teacher, the preceptress is your teacher, the instructor is your teacher. So you should act accordingly: having gained [the teaching], do not become dispassionate. The attainment of the opportune moment is rare.

body.text: yasyārthāya pravrajyā yasyārthāya upasaṃpadā

children.translated_text: guard that moral conduct, as the yak guards her tail-hair. [1]

body.translated_text: For the purpose of which there is going forth, for the purpose of which there is full ordination—

children.translated_text: That which is desired and intended by the <s>Buddha</s>, kinsman of the sun,
and by the wise female disciples, the skillful ones who see the meaning,

children.text: so vo 'rtho anuprāpto labdhā vo upasaṃpadā || [2]
children.translated_text: that purpose has been attained by you; you have obtained the full ordination. [2]

body.text: aśokaṃ virajaṃ kṣemaṃ dvīpaṃ lenaṃ parāyaṇaṃ

children.text: taṃ prāpuṇatha nirvāṇaṃ eṣā vo sarvasaṃpadā || [3]
children.translated_text: may you attain <s>Nirvāṇa</s>; this is your complete attainment. [3]
The remainder should be supplied as before.

body.translated_text: Sorrowless, stainless, secure, an island, a refuge, the final goal—

body.text: evaṃ gautami aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārī bhūtāye ubhayataḥsaṃghe upasaṃpadā pratyāśaṃsitavyā | ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnāṃ dvitīyo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yāvad velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: Thus, <s>Gautamī</s>, an eighteen-year-old maiden should seek full ordination before both <s>saṃghas</s>. This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the second <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, even as the shore by the great ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 3
83. kin ti dāni gautami āvaḍo bhikṣuṇīnāṃ bhikṣūhi vacanapatho bhūtena vā abhūtena vā anāvaḍo bhikṣūṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīhi vacanapatho bhūtena abhūtena | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣuṃ dharṣiya vaktuṃ koṇṭabhikṣū ti vā vaidyabhikṣū ti vā cūḍabhikṣū ti vā akhallā mahallaapratijñaakuśalo ti vā vaktuṃ | athaiva jalpati gurudharmam atikramati |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> (Weighty Rule) 3. 83. What then, <s>Gautamī</s>? It is permitted for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (nuns) to be admonished by <s>bhikṣus</s> (monks), whether truthfully or untruthfully. It is not permitted for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to be admonished by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, whether truthfully or untruthfully. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to dare to speak to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, calling him 'stupid monk' or 'quack monk' or 'tonsured monk' or 'incapable, old, ignorant, unskilled.' If she does speak thus, she transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>.

body.text: 84. atha dāni bhikṣuṇīye kaścit pravrajito bhavati jñātiko vā bhrātā vā | so ca bhavati uddhato unnaḍo | na kṣamati adhyupekṣituṃ nāmapi kṣamati dharṣiya vaktuṃ | atha khalu prajñayā samjñāpayitavyo yadi tāvat taruṇako bhoti vaktavyo | sālohita idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi | kin dāni yadā jīrṇo vṛddho mahallako adhvagatavayan anuprāpto bhaviṣyasi | etat tava sādhu etat pratirūpaṃ yac ca uddiśeśi svādhyāyesi bhadrako guṇavān śikṣākāmo bhavesi buddhānām śāsane yogam āpadyesi |
body.translated_text: 84. Now, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has a male relative or brother who has gone forth, and he is restless and arrogant—she may not disregard it, but it is permissible to dare to speak to him. However, he should be made to understand with wisdom. If he is young, he should be told: 'Dear kinsman, you do not train now—when will you train? Will it be when you are old, aged, decrepit, with the journey of life nearly spent? This would be good for you, this would be proper: that you recite and study, be virtuous and endowed with good qualities, desirous of training, applying yourself to the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.'

body.text: 85. atha dāni so vṛddho bhoti | vaktavyo | idanīṃ imīdṛśo punas tvaṃ taruaṇakāle idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi | kin dāni yadā maṇḍaladvāram anuprāpto bhaviṣyasi tadā śikṣiṣyasi yā py eṣā tava parṣā sāpi tava dṛṣṭā anukṛtim āpadyamānā anayavyasanam āpadyiṣyatīti etat tava sādhu etat pratirūpaṃ yat tvam uddiśasi svādhyāyesi bhadrako guṇavān | śikṣākāmo bhavesi buddhānāṃ śāsane yogam āpadyesi sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avajñāya vā paribhavena vā koṇṭabhikṣū ti vā vaidyabhikṣū ti vā cūḍabhikṣū ti vā akhallamahallaaprakṛtijñaakuśalo ti vā dharṣiya jalpati gurudharmam atikramati |
body.translated_text: 85. Now if he is old, he should be told: 'Now you are like this—what were you like in your youth? You do not train now—when will you train? Will it be when you have reached the door of the funeral ground? This assembly of yours, following your example, will fall into misfortune and ruin. This would be good for you, this would be proper: that you recite and study, be virtuous and endowed with good qualities, desirous of training, applying yourself to the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.' But that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who, out of contempt or disrespect, dares to speak calling [a monk] 'stupid monk' or 'quack monk' or 'tonsured monk' or 'incapable, old, ignorant of nature, unskilled'—she transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>.

body.text: 86. anāvaḍo bhikṣūṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīhi vacanapatho bhūtena vā abhūtena iti na kṣamati bhikṣuṇā bhikṣuṇīṃ dharṣiya vaktuṃ muṇḍastrī chinnakavaḍeti jalpati vinayātikramam āsādayati |
body.translated_text: 86. It is not permitted for <s>bhikṣus</s> to be admonished by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, whether truthfully or untruthfully. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣu</s> to dare to speak to a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, calling her 'shaven-headed woman' or 'cut-ear.' If he speaks thus, he incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression.

body.text: 87. atha dāni bhikṣor mātā vā bhaginī vā pravrajitikā bhavati sā ca uddhatā vā unnaḍā vā bhavati | na kṣamati adhyupekṣituṃ yadi tāvat taruṇikā bhoti | vaktavyā | sālohite idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣiṣyasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi | kiṃ dāni yaṃ kālaṃ jīrṇavṛddhā mahallikā bhaviṣyasi etat tava sādhu etat pratirūpaṃ yat tvaṃ uddiśesi svādhyāyesi bhadrikā guṇavatī śikṣākāmā bhavesi buddhanāṃ śāsane yogam āpadyesi |
body.translated_text: 87. Now if a <s>bhikṣu</s> has a mother or sister who has gone forth, and she is restless or arrogant—he may not disregard it. If she is young, she should be told: 'Dear kinswoman, you do not train now—when will you train? Will it be when you are old, aged, and decrepit? This would be good for you, this would be proper: that you recite and study, be virtuous and endowed with good qualities, desirous of training, applying yourself to the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.'

body.text: 88. atha dāni sā vṛddhā bhoti | vaktavyā | sālohite idānīṃ tvam īdṛśī kīdṛśī punas taruṇīkāle idānīṃ tvan na śikṣasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi kin dāni yaṃ kālaṃ maṇḍaladvāram anuprāptā bhavisyasi tadā śikṣiṣyasi yā py eṣā tava parṣā sāpi tava dṛṣṭā anukṛtim āpadyamānā anayena vyasanam āpadyiṣyatīti | etat tava sādhu etat pratirūpaṃ yat tvaṃ uddiśesi svādhyāyasi bhadrikā guṇavatī śikṣākāmā bhavesi buddhānāṃ śāsane yogam āpadyesīti |
body.translated_text: 88. Now if she is old, she should be told: 'Dear kinswoman, now you are like this—what were you like in your youth? You do not train now—when will you train? Will it be when you have reached the door of the funeral ground? This assembly of yours, following your example, will fall into misfortune and ruin. This would be good for you, this would be proper: that you recite and study, be virtuous and endowed with good qualities, desirous of training, applying yourself to the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.'

body.text: eṣa gautami āvaṭo bhikṣuṇīnāṃ bhikṣūhi vacanapatho bhūtena vā | abhūtena vā |
body.translated_text: This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the permitted admonition-path of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> by <s>bhikṣus</s>, whether truthful or untruthful.

body.text: anāvaṭo bhikṣūṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīhi vacanapatho bhūtena no abhūtena |
body.translated_text: The unpermitted admonition-path of <s>bhikṣus</s> by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is truthful but not untruthful.

body.text: ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnām tṛtiyo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yāvad anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the third <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for life, never to be transgressed—like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 4
89. kin ti dāni gautami bhaktāgraṃ śayanāsanāgraṃ vihārāgrañ ca bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣusaṃghāto sā dayitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> (Weighty Rule) 4. 89. What then, <s>Gautamī</s>? The priority in food (<s>bhaktāgra</s>), priority in lodging (<s>śayanāsanāgra</s>), and priority in dwelling (<s>vihārāgra</s>) should be offered by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>.

body.text: eṣo dāni koci bhikṣuṇīsaṃghasya bhaktaṃ karoti vaktavyo | jyeṣṭhaparyāyatā karohīti | atha dāni so āha nāsti mama taṃhi śraddhā nāsti prasādo ti vaktavyaḥ | vayaṃ pi na praticchāmo ti | atha dān āha | dattapūrvaṃ teṣāṃ mama mātrā vā pitrā vā goṣṭhīsambandhena vā śreṇīsaṃbandhena vā samayasambhandhena vā āryamiśrikāṇāṃ na kadācin mayā bhaktaṃ kṛtapūrvaṃ | pratigṛhṇantu āryamiśrikā ti antamasato ekapiṇḍapātaṃ pi dāpayitvā bhikṣusaṃghasya bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho śatarasaṃ pi bhojanaṃ praticchati anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now if someone prepares food for the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, he should be told: 'Make it in order of seniority [i.e., give to the monks first].' If he then says, 'I have no faith there, no devotion,' he should be told: 'Then we also do not accept it.' If he then says, 'Previously my mother, or father, or by guild-connection, or trade-connection, or agreement-connection, has given to them; but I have never before prepared food for the Noble Ladies—let the Noble Ladies accept it,' then, having given at least one alms-meal to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> may accept even a hundred flavors of food—there is no offense.

body.text: 90. kin ti dāni śayanāsanāgraṃ | eṣo dāni kocid bhikṣuṇīsaṃghasya śayanāsanaṃ dadāti | vaktavyaṃ | jyeṣṭhaparyāyatāvad dehīti | atha dāni so āha nāsti mama tahiṃ śraddhā nāsti prasādo | vaktavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 90. What then about the priority in lodging? Now if someone gives lodging to the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, he should be told: 'Give in order of seniority [i.e., to the monks first].' If he then says, 'I have no faith there, no devotion,' he should be told:

body.text: vayaṃ pi na praticchāmo ti | atha dān āha | dattapūrvaṃ mama ārye bhikṣusaṃghasya śayanāsanaṃ mātrā vā yāvat samayasambandhena vā | pratīcchantvāryamiśrikā ti antamasato khayu[?]kā mañcaṃ pi bhikṣusaṃghasya dāpayitvā mahārhaṃ śayanāsanaṃ bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaḥ pratīcchaty anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Then we also do not accept it.' If he then says, 'Noble Ones, my mother, or by agreement-connection, has previously given lodging to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>—let the Noble Ladies accept it,' then, having given even a small bed to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> may accept even a valuable lodging—there is no offense.

body.text: 91. kin ti dāni vihārāgraṃ | eṣo dāni kocit bhikṣuṇīsaṃghasya vihāraṃ pratiṣṭhāpayati | vaktavyaṃ | jyeṣṭhaparyāyatāvat pratiṣṭhāpayehīti |
body.translated_text: 91. What then about the priority in dwelling? Now if someone establishes a dwelling for the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, he should be told: 'Establish it in order of seniority [i.e., for the monks first].'

body.text: atha dān āha | ārye nāsti mama tahiṃ śraddhā | nāsti prasādo ti | vaktavyaṃ vayaṃ pi na pratīcchāmo ti | atha dān āha | ārye kārāpitan teṣāṃ vihārāḥ mātrā vā yāvat samayasambandhena vā pratīcchantv āryamiśrikā vihāran ti antamasato gomayagṛhaṃ pi piṣṭhagṛhaṃ pi bhikṣusaṃghasya dāpayitvā bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho saptabhūmakaṃ pi vihāraṃ pratīcchaty anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: If he then says, 'Noble Ones, I have no faith there, no devotion,' he should be told: 'Then we also do not accept it.' If he then says, 'Noble Ones, dwellings were built for them by my mother, or by agreement-connection—let the Noble Ladies accept the dwelling,' then, having given even a cow-dung hut or a flour-store to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> may accept even a seven-storied dwelling—there is no offense.

body.text: 92. tā etā bhikṣuṇīyo avajñāya paribhavena vā koṇṭabhikṣū ti vā | vaidyabhikṣū ti vā | akhallamahallāprakṛtijño tī vā kṛtvā bhaktāgraṃ śayanāsanāgraṃ vihārāgraṃ bhikṣusaṃghāto na śātiyati gurudharmam atikrāmati | evaṃ gautamī bhaktāgraṃ śayanāsanagraṃ vihārāgraṃ bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣusaṃghāto sātayitavyo |
body.translated_text: 92. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who, out of contempt or disrespect, calling [monks] 'stupid monk' or 'quack monk' or 'incapable, old, ignorant of nature,' do not offer the priority in food, priority in lodging, and priority in dwelling to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>—they transgress a <s>gurudharma</s>. Thus, <s>Gautamī</s>, the priority in food, priority in lodging, and priority in dwelling should be offered by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>.

body.text: ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnāṃ caturtho gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yāvad anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the fourth <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for life, never to be transgressed—like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 5
93. kin ti dāni gurudharmāpannāya bhikṣuṇīya ardhamāsaṃ mānatvañ caritavyaṃ ubhayataḥ saṃghe āhvayanaṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> (Weighty Rule) 5. 93. What then? A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who has committed a <s>gurudharma</s> offense must practice <s>mānatta</s> (penance) for a half-month, with a formal summoning before both <s>Saṃghas</s>.

body.text: sā dāni eṣā bhikṣuṇī gurudharmān apannā bhavati tāya ardhamāsaṃ bhikṣuṇīsaṃghe mānatvaṃ caritavyaṃ ubhayataḥ saṃghe ca āhvayanaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avajñāya vā paribhavena vā yāvad akuśalo ti vā kṛtvā gurudharmāpannā samānā nārdhamāsaṃ bhikṣuṇīsaṃghe mānatvaṃ carati ubhayataḥ saṃghe ca āhvayanaṃ | gurudharmam atikramati | ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnāṃ pañcamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yāvad velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: Now this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who has committed a <s>gurudharma</s> offense must practice <s>mānatta</s> for a half-month in the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, with a formal summoning before both <s>Saṃghas</s>. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who, out of contempt or disrespect, or saying 'unskilled,' etc., having committed a <s>gurudharma</s> offense, does not practice <s>mānatta</s> for a half-month in the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> with a summoning before both <s>Saṃghas</s>—she transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>. This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the fifth <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be honored by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for life—like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 6
94. kin ti dāni anvārdhamāsaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣusaṃghāto ovādopasaṃkramaṇaṃ pratyāśaṃsitavyaṃ yadaho dāni poṣadho bhavati tadaho bhikṣuṇīsaṃghena bhikṣuvihāraṃ gantavyaṃ | atha dāni sarvasaṃgho na gacchati ardhasaṃghena gantavyaṃ | ardhasaṃgho na gacchati aṣṭāhi vṛddhatarikāhi gantavyaṃ | aṣṭa vṛddhatarikā na gacchanti antamasato māsacārikiṇīhi pakṣacārikiṇīhi vā cchandārhaṇāṃ chandaṃ gṛhṇīya gantavyaṃ | yadi tāvad anukālyaṃ bhavati stūpo tāvad vanditavyo | stūpaṃ vanditvā yo tahiṃ bhikṣur abhilakṣito bhavati parijñāto vā tasya chando dātavyo | vaktavyaṃ vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ | āryasamagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho samagrasya bhikṣusaṃghasya pādān śirasā vandati | ovādopasaṃkramaṇañ ca dharmaṃ yācati | poṣadhañ ca pratīcchati | dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi vaktavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> (Weighty Rule) 6. 94. What then? Every half-month, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should seek instruction (<s>ovāda</s>) from the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>. On the day of the <s>poṣadha</s> (observance), the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> should go to the <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery. If the whole <s>Saṃgha</s> does not go, half the <s>Saṃgha</s> should go. If half the <s>Saṃgha</s> does not go, eight senior nuns should go. If the eight senior nuns do not go, then at least from those going on monthly or fortnightly rounds, consent should be taken from those worthy of consent, and [a representative] should go. If there is a convenient opportunity, a <s>stūpa</s> should first be venerated. Having venerated the <s>stūpa</s>, the consent should be given to whichever <s>bhikṣu</s> there is noted or recognized. It should be said: 'I bow to the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. The complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> bows its head at the feet of the complete <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, and requests the <s>Dharma</s> of instruction, and accepts the <s>poṣadha</s>.' A second and third time it should be said.

body.text: 95. atha dān āha | ahaṃ saṃghasthaviro ahaṃ tatradeśako ahaṃ bhikṣuṇīovādako ti tābhir api ete trayo varjaṃ kṛtvā śiṣṭakānāṃ chando dātavyo chandaṃ datvā bhikṣuṇīupāśrayaṃ gantavyaṃ | yaṃ kālaṃ bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho upaviṣṭo bhavati poṣasdhakarmāya sūtroddeśikāya sūtraṃ pragṛhītaṃ bhavati | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho adya saṃghasya cāturdaśiko vā pāñcadaśiko vā sandhipoṣadho vā viśuddhinakṣatraṃ ettakaṃ ṛtusya nirgataṃ ettakam avaśiṣṭaṃ |
body.translated_text: 95. If [a monk] then says, 'I am the <s>saṃgha-sthavira</s> (elder of the community), I am the preacher there, I am the instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>'—even so, having set aside those three, the consent should be given to the remaining [monks], and having given consent, [the nuns] should go to the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence. When the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> is seated for the <s>poṣadha</s> ceremony, the <s>sūtra</s> reciter should take up the <s>sūtra</s>: 'Let the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. Today is the <s>Saṃgha's</s> fourteenth or fifteenth or junction-<s>poṣadha</s>, the purification-asterism. So much of the season has passed, so much remains.'

body.text: kiṃ saṃghasya pūrvakṛtyaṃ | alpārtho 'lpakṛtyo bhagavataḥ śrāvikāsaṃgho śobhati anāgatānām āryamiśrikāṇāṃ chandapariśuddhiṃ ārocetha | nīto chandahārikāhi chando ti tāhi vṛddhāntam āruhitvā sāmīciṃ kṛtvā vaktavyaṃ | nīto 'smābhiḥ chandahārikābhiś chando itthan nāmenāryeṇa pratīcchito |
body.translated_text: 'What is the <s>Saṃgha's</s> preliminary duty? The community of the <s>Bhagavān's</s> female disciples is adorned by being of few needs and few tasks. Announce the purity of consent of the Noble Ladies who have not come.' 'The consent has been brought by the consent-bearers'—having ascended to the senior end and made obeisance, they should say: 'We have brought the consent; it has been accepted by the consent-bearers on behalf of the Noble One named so-and-so.'

body.text: 96. yaṃ kālaṃ bhikṣusaṃgho upaviṣṭo bhavati sūtroddeśakena sūtraṃ pratigṛhītaṃ bhavati | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho adya saṃghasya cāturdaśiko vā pāñcadaśiko vā sandhipoṣadho vā viśuddhinakṣatraṃ | ettakaṃ ṛtusya nirgataṃ ettakaṃ avaśiṣṭaṃ | kiṃ saṃghasya pūrvakṛtvā alpārtho alpakṛtyo bhagavataḥ śrāvakasaṃgho śobhati | anāgatānām āyuṣmanto bhikṣūṇāṃ chandapāriśuddhim ārocetha | ārocitañ ca prativedetha | ko bhikṣu bhikṣuṇīnāṃ chandahārako tenotthāya vṛddhāntaṃ āruhya vaktavyaṃ | vandāmy āryasaṃghaṃ samagro hi bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho samagrasya pādāṃ śirasā vandati | avavādañ ca yācati | poṣadhañ ca praticchati | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi vaktavyaṃ | yadi tahiṃ bhikṣuṇītovādako sammatako bhavati vaktavyo | ovādāhīti |
body.translated_text: 96. When the <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s> is seated, the <s>sūtra</s> reciter should take up the <s>sūtra</s>: 'Let the Venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. Today is the <s>Saṃgha's</s> fourteenth or fifteenth or junction-<s>poṣadha</s>, the purification-asterism. So much of the season has passed, so much remains. What is the <s>Saṃgha's</s> preliminary duty? The community of the <s>Bhagavān's</s> male disciples is adorned by being of few needs and few tasks. Announce the purity of consent of the Venerable <s>bhikṣus</s> who have not come, and report it. Which <s>bhikṣu</s> is the consent-bearer for the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>? Let him rise, ascend to the senior end, and say: "I bow to the Noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. The complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> bows its head at the feet of the complete [<s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>], and requests instruction, and accepts the <s>poṣadha</s>." Thus a second and third time it should be said. If there is an appointed instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> there, he should be told: 'Give instruction.'

body.text: 97. atha dāni na kocid bhikṣuṇīyovādako bhavati tatra yo dvādaśehi aṅgehi samanvāgato bhavati so sammanyitavyo | katamehi dvādaśehi | tadyathā | prātimokṣasamvarasamvṛto viharati ācāragocarasampannaḥ | anumātreṣv avadyeṣu bhayadarśī samādāya śikṣitaśikṣāpadeṣu kāyakarmavākkarmaṇā sammanvāgataḥ | pariśuddhena pariśuddājīvaḥ | bahuśrutaś ca abhidharme bahusrutaś ca bhavaty abhivinaye partibalo ca bhavaty adhiśīlaśikṣāyām vinayituṃ | ṇka |
body.translated_text: 97. Now if there is no instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, then one who is endowed with twelve qualities should be appointed. Which twelve? Namely: he dwells restrained by the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> (monastic code) discipline, is accomplished in conduct and resort, seeing danger in the slightest faults, undertaking and training in the training rules, endowed with pure bodily and verbal action, of purified livelihood; and he is learned in the <s>Abhidharma</s>, learned in the <s>Abhivinaya</s>, and capable of training in the higher morality. [text breaks off]

body.text: pratibalo bhavaty adhicittaṃ śikṣāyāṃ vinayituṃ | tṛ | pratibalo bhavaty adhiprajñāṃ śikṣāyāṃ vinayituṃ | phu | ananudhvastabrahmacaryaś ca bhavati | grā | yo bhūyakṣāntijātiko bhavati | hrā | na ca bhikṣuṇīnāṃ gurudharmaṃ āpadyitā bhavati | to kalyāṇavacanaś ca bhavati kalyāṇavākkaraṇopetaś ca bhavati | pauryavācā samanvāgato vispaṣṭāya anelāya arthasya vijñāpanīya | viṃśativarṣo ca bhavati sātirekaviṃśativarṣo vā |
body.translated_text: [He] is capable of training [<s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>] in the higher training of the mind. [He] is capable of training [<s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>] in the higher training of wisdom. He has not violated his celibacy. He is one endowed with great patience. He has not committed an offense against the <s>gurudharmas</s> (weighty rules) of the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. He is of pleasant speech and endowed with beautiful vocal expression. He possesses urbane speech, clear, fluent, and capable of communicating the meaning. And he is twenty years [of ordination age] or more than twenty.

body.text: imehi dvādaśehi aṅgehi samanvāgato bhikṣuṇīovādaka sammutīya saṃmanyitavyo |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> endowed with these twelve qualities should be appointed and approved as an instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.

body.text: 98. karmakārakeṇa karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho ayam itthannāmo ti bhikṣur aṅgopeto | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikṣuṃ bhikṣuṇītovādakaṃ saṃmutīya saṃmanyeya ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ | śṛṇotu me bhante saṃgho ayam itthannāmo bhikṣur taṃ saṃgho itthannāmaṃ bhikṣuṃ bhikṣuṇīovādakaṃ saṃmutīya sammanyati | yeṣām āyuṣmantānāṃ kṣamati itthannāmaṃ bhikṣuṃ bhikṣuṇīovādakaṃ saṃmutīya sammanyiyamānaṃ saṃghena | so tūṣṇīm asya | yasya na kṣamati so bhāṣatu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā evaṃ dvitīya tṛtīyā karmavācaneti | sammato bhante saṃgho itthannāmo bhikṣuḥ bhikṣuṇīovādaka saṃmutīya saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 98. The procedural officer should perform the formal act: 'Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so is endowed with the requisite qualities. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s> would appoint and approve so-and-so as instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. This is the motion. Let the venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so — the <s>Saṃgha</s> appoints and approves so-and-so as instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. Those of the venerable assembly to whom it is acceptable that so-and-so be appointed and approved by the <s>Saṃgha</s> as instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, let him be silent. He who does not accept, let him speak. This is the first <s>karmavācanā</s> (formal act). Likewise the second and third <s>karmavācanā</s>.' 'The venerable <s>Saṃgha</s> has appointed the <s>bhikṣu</s> named so-and-so as instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. It is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>; therefore it is silent. Thus do I hold it.'

body.text: 99. tena dāni sammatena samānena tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo ovāditavyāyo nākāle [1] | nādeśe [2] | nānāgate kāle [3] | nātikrānte kāle [4] | na chandaśo [5] | na vyagraśo [6] | na pārṣado [7] | na dīrghovādena [8] | āgantukāmasya preṣitavyā [9] |
body.translated_text: 99. By that one who has been appointed, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are to be instructed: [1] not at an improper time; [2] not at an improper place; [3] not at a time that has not yet arrived; [4] not at a time that has passed; [5] not selectively; [6] not when [the assembly is] incomplete; [7] not by factions; [8] not with a lengthy discourse; [9] one should be sent to fetch [the instructor] when he wishes to come.

body.text: kin ti dāni nākālo | akālo nāma astamito sūryo | antarhito ca aruṇo [1] |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not at an improper time'? An improper time means after the sun has set and before the dawn has appeared [1].

body.text: kin ti dāni nādeśe | adeśo nāma veśikāsāmante vā dyūtakaraśālāsāmante vā | pānāgāraśālāsāmante vā | vadhabandhanāgāraśālāsāmante vā atibhūṇḍe vā atiprākaṭe vā pradeśe [2] |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not at an improper place'? An improper place means near a brothel, or near a gambling hall, or near a tavern, or near a prison, or at a place that is too secluded or too public [2].

body.text: kin ti dāni nānāgate kāle anāgato nāma kālo pratipade dvitīyāyām vā [3] |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not at a time that has not yet arrived'? A time that has not yet arrived means on the first or second [day of the fortnight] [3].

body.text: kin ti dāni nātikrānte kāle | atikrānto nāma kālo caturdaśīyām vā pañcadaśīyām vā | atha khu tṛtīyāprabhṛti tāvad ovaditavyā yāvat trayodaśīti [4] |
