body.translated_text: What then is 'not at a time that has passed'? A time that has passed means on the fourteenth or fifteenth [day]. Rather, instruction should be given from the third day up until the thirteenth [4].

body.text: kin ti dāni na chandaśo | ovādakasya bhikṣuṇīya chando dātavyo | atha khu sarvāhi āgantavyaṃ [5] |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not selectively'? The instructor should not grant consent [to instruct only certain] <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. Rather, all should come [5].

body.text: kin ti dāni na vyagraśo | na bhikṣuṇā vyagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho ovaditavyo | atha khu sarvāḥ samagrā t-ovaditavyāḥ [6] |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not when [the assembly is] incomplete'? A <s>bhikṣu</s> should not instruct the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> when it is incomplete. Rather, all should be instructed when the assembly is complete [6].

body.text: kin ti dāni na pārṣado | na tāvat tava parṣā ovaditavyā tavādya parṣāye ovādakavāro tavādya parṣāye ovādakavāro ti | atha khu sarvāḥ samagrā t-ovaditavyāḥ [7] |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not by factions'? [One should not say] 'Your faction is to be instructed; it is your faction's turn for instruction; it is your faction's turn for instruction.' Rather, all should be instructed when the assembly is complete [7].

body.text: kin ti dāni na dīrghovādena ovaditāḥ | atha khu saṃkṣiptena ovaditavyāḥ |
body.translated_text: What then is 'not with a lengthy discourse'? Rather, they should be instructed briefly [8]:

children.translated_text: 'The non-doing of all evil, the undertaking of good,'
'The purification of one's own mind — this is the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.'

body.text: eṣa bhaginīyo ovādo śiṣṭakaṃ parikathā bhaviṣyati | yāgantu kāmā sāgacchatu | yā śrotukāmā sā śṛṇotu |
body.translated_text: 'This, Sisters, is the instruction. What remains will be conversation. She who wishes to come, let her come. She who wishes to listen, let her listen.'

body.text: 100. kin ti dānīṃ āgantukāmasya preṣayitavyaṃ | yadi so bhikṣuṇīovādako deśāntaraṅ gato bhavati tato ye tasya sārdhevihārikāvā antevāsikā bhavanti te bhikṣunīsaṃghena utsāhayitavyāḥ | gacchatha āryasya pātracīvaraṃ ānetha | teṣān dāni gacchantānām āgacchantānāñ ca pathy adanenāvaikalyaṃ kartavyaṃ | āgacchantasya bhikṣuṇīsaṃghena chatradhvajapatākehi yojanaṃ panthasya pratyudgantavyaṃ | yaṃhi vihāre avatarāya taṃhi ubhayasaṃghasya saptāhaṃ bhaktaṃ kartavyaṃ | atha dāni daridro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho bhavati bhikṣusaṃghasyaiva saptāhaṃ bhaktaṃ kartavyaṃ | antamasato ekapiṇḍapātenāpi pratimānayitavyo tena dāni bhikṣuṇīovādakena bhikṣuṇīhi dhītāsaṃjñā upasthāpayitavyā | tāhi bhikṣuṇīhi tasmin bhikṣuṇīovādakehi pitṛsaṃjñā upasthāpayitavyā |
body.translated_text: 100. What then is meant by 'one should be sent to fetch [the instructor] when he wishes to come'? If that instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> has gone to another region, then his co-residents or pupils should be encouraged by the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Saṃgha</s>: 'Go and bring the noble one's bowl and robes.' For those going and coming, provisions should be provided for the journey so there is no want. When he is approaching, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> should go out to meet him on the road for one <s>yojana</s> with umbrellas, banners, and flags. At whatever monastery he descends, both <s>Saṃghas</s> should provide meals for seven days. If the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> is poor, the <s>bhikṣu</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> alone should provide meals for seven days. At the very least, he should be honored with even a single alms-portion. The instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should cultivate the perception of [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> as] daughters toward the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should cultivate the perception of a father toward the instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.

body.text: 101. na kṣamati tena bhikṣuṇīovādakena ghoṭena yathā prasārya grīvāṃ tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo ovādituṃ | atha khalu yugamātraṃ nirīkṣante na tāyo ovāditavyāyo | yadi kadācit tahiṃ bhavet keśāvartena vā kṛtena | akṣīhi vā añcitena ākoṭitamaṣṭehi vā cīvarehi | śvetena vā kāya bandhanena | citrakuṭāhi vā upānahāhi | na kṣamati adhyupekṣituṃ | yadi tāva taruṇikā bhavati dharṣayitavyā | he avyakte akuśale idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi yaṃ kālaṃ jīrṇavṛddhā mahallikā adhvagatavayam anuprāptā bhaviṣyasi yā pi tavaiṣā parṣā sā pi tava dṛṣṭvā anukṛtim āpadyamānā anayena vyasanam āpadyiṣyati | etaṃ tava sādhu etat pratirūpaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhadrikā guṇavatī śikṣākāmā bhavesi buddhānāṃ śāsane yogam āpadyesi | atha dāni sā vṛddhā bhavati vaktavyaṃ | sālohite idānīṃ īdṛśī kīdṛśī tvam āsi taruṇe kāle idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi | yaṃ kālaṃ maṇḍaladvāram anuprāptā bhaviṣyasi yāpi tava eṣa parṣā sāpi tava dṛṣṭvā nukṛtim āpadyamānā anayā vyasanam āpatsyati etat tava sādhu etaṃ pratirūpaṃ yaṃ tvaṃ bhadrikā guṇavatī śikṣākāmā bhavesi buddhānāṃ śāsane yogam āpadyesi |
body.translated_text: 101. It is not proper for that instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to instruct those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> like a stallion, stretching out his neck. Rather, looking only a yoke-length ahead, he should instruct them. If at any time he should see among them [a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>] with curled hair, or with lined eyes, or with rumpled robes, or with a white body-band, or with colorful sandals — he must not overlook it. If she is young, she should be admonished: 'O foolish, unskilled one! If you do not train now, when will you train — when you have become old, aged, elderly, advanced in years? Whatever followers you have, they too, imitating you, will fall into misfortune and calamity. It would be good and proper for you, good lady, to be virtuous, desirous of training, and to apply yourself in the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.' If she is old, she should be told: 'Dear one! What were you like when young — now you are like this. If you do not train now, when will you train — when you have arrived at death's door? Whatever followers you have, they too, imitating you, will fall into misfortune and calamity. It would be good and proper for you, good lady, to be virtuous, desirous of training, and to apply yourself in the teaching of the <s>Buddhas</s>.'

body.text: 102. atha dāni so bhikṣuṇīyovādako gocaraprasṛto rathyāyaṃ bhikṣuṇīn paśyati keśāvartena vā kṛtena | akṣīhi vā añcitehi | ākoṭitamaṣṭehi vā cīvarehi | śvetena vā kāyabandhanena | citrakūṭāhi vā upānahāhi na dāni kṣamati nahi kīñcij jalpituṃ | mā jano ojjhāpeya paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇako bhāryām iva śravaṇikām ovadati | atha khu pṛcchitavyā | katamahiṃ eṣā vihārake prativasati | kā se upādhyāyī | kā se ācāryā paścād uktaṃ tahiṃ gatvā ovaditayvā | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avajñāya vā paribhavena vā koṇṭabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā | vaidyabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā cūḍabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā | akhallamahallaakuśalaaprakṛtijño ti vā kṛtvā anvārdhamāsaṃ bhikṣusaṃghāto ovādopasaṃkramaṇaṃ na pratyāśaṃsati gurudharmam atikramati | evaṃ gautami anvardhamāsaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi bhikṣusaṃghāto ovādopasaṃkramaṇaṃ pratyāśaṃsitavyaṃ | na pratyāśaṃsati gurudharmam atikrāmati |
body.translated_text: 102. If that instructor of <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, while going on his alms-round, sees <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> on the street with curled hair, or with lined eyes, or with rumpled robes, or with a white body-band, or with colorful sandals — he must not say anything [there], lest people find fault: 'Look! That mendicant instructs a renunciant woman as if she were his wife!' Rather, he should inquire: 'At which monastery does she reside? Who is her preceptress? Who is her teacher?' Afterwards, having gone there, he should instruct [her]. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, out of disrespect or contempt — thinking 'he is a bald monk,' or 'he is a quack monk,' or 'he is a crested monk,' or 'he is ignorant, unskilled, and does not know proper conduct' — does not approach the <s>bhikṣu</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> every half-month for instruction, she transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>. Thus, <s>Gautamī</s>, every half-month the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should approach the <s>bhikṣu</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> for instruction. One who does not approach transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>.

body.text: ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnāṃ ṣaṣṭo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo yāvad anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the sixth <s>gurudharma</s> (weighty rule) of the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be respected by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, never to be transgressed, like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 7
103. kin ti dāni na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīhi abhikṣuke avāse varṣām upagantuṃ |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> 7. 103. What then — it is not proper for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to undertake the rains retreat (<s>varṣāvāsa</s>) in a place without <s>bhikṣus</s>.

body.text: na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīhi abhikṣukehi grāmanagarehi varṣām upagantuṃ |
body.translated_text: It is not proper for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to undertake the rains retreat in towns or cities without <s>bhikṣus</s>.

body.text: atha dāni bhikṣuṇī jñātikehi grāmavāsakehi nimantrīyati | ihāryā varṣāvasāna ti na ca tahiṃ keci bhikṣū bhavanti bhikṣuṇī ca jñātikāmanukaṃpitukāmā bhavanti vaktavyaṃ | jyeṣṭhaparṣāṃ tāva nimantretha | atha dān āhaṃsuḥ | nāsti asmākaṃ tahiṃ śraddhā | nāsti prasādo | vaktavyam | ahaṃ pi na icchāmi | atha dāni bhikṣuṇī savibhavā bhavati | jñātikāñ ca anukampitukāmā bhavati | ātmanā bhikṣū nimantrayitavyā | teṣām āgatānāṃ samānānāṃ āhāreṇa avaikalyaṃ kartavyaṃ | tehi tahiṃ varṣām upagantavyaṃ | tāya bhikṣuṇīya tahiṃ varṣām tāya bhikṣuṇīya teṣām bhikṣūṇāṃ mūle anvardhamāsaṃ ovādopasaṃkramaṇaṃ pratyāśaṃsitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: If a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is invited by relatives who are villagers — 'Noble Lady, [please stay here] for the rains retreat' — and there are no <s>bhikṣus</s> there, and the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> wishes to show compassion to her relatives, she should say: 'First invite the senior assembly.' If then they say: 'We have no faith there, no devotion' — she should say: 'Then I too do not wish [to go].' If the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has means and wishes to show compassion to her relatives, she should personally invite <s>bhikṣus</s>. For those who have come, provisions should be provided without want. They should undertake the rains retreat there. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should approach those <s>bhikṣus</s> every half-month for instruction during that rains retreat.

body.text: 104. atha teṣām bhikṣūṇāṃ varṣām upagatānāṃ antaravarṣā-r-astu | koci ādīnavo utpadyati utthāya palāyanti | na dāni kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya kahiñci gantuṃ yāvat pravāraṇākālaṃ | yadi tāvat kṣemam bhavati tato te śabdāpayitavyāḥ | na dāni āgantikāyo | atha khalu uktena nimantrayitavyāḥ |
body.translated_text: 104. If those <s>bhikṣus</s> who have undertaken the rains retreat — during the rains retreat some danger arises and they get up and flee — the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> must not go anywhere until the time of <s>pravāraṇā</s> (invitation ceremony). If there is safety, then those [<s>bhikṣus</s>] should be sent for. But [not just] anyone who comes — rather, [only] those invited by [proper] invitation.

body.text: āgatānāṃ samānānāṃ bhaktena pratimānīya ācchādīya yathā samvibhāgan dātavyaṃ | pravārite kiñcāpi yaṃhi chando tahiṃ gacchati anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: For those who have come, having served them with food and having clothed them, a share should be given as is proper. When the <s>pravāraṇā</s> has been performed, [the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>] may go wherever she wishes — there is no offense.

body.text: 105. sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avajñāya vā paribhavena vā koṇṭa bhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā | vaidyabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā kṛtvā cūḍabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā khallamahallaakuśalaaprakṛtijño ti vā kṛtvā abhikṣuke āvāse varṣām upagacchati gurudharmam atikramati | evaṃ gautami na kṣamati bhikṣunīya abhikṣuke āvāse varṣām upagantuṃ | ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnāṃ saptamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvaj jīvaṃ satkartavyo yāvad anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: 105. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, out of disrespect or contempt — thinking 'he is a bald monk,' or 'he is a quack monk,' or 'he is a crested monk,' or 'he is ignorant, unskilled, and does not know proper conduct' — undertakes the rains retreat in a place without <s>bhikṣus</s>, she transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>. Thus, <s>Gautamī</s>, it is not proper for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to undertake the rains retreat in a place without <s>bhikṣus</s>. This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the seventh <s>gurudharma</s> of the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which is to be respected by <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> for as long as they live, never to be transgressed, like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text:
gurudharma 8
106. kin ti dāni varṣoṣitāhi bhikṣuṇīhi ubhayato saṃghe pravāraṇā pratyāśaṃsitavyā | yadaho dāni saṃghasya pravāraṇā bhavati tadaho bhikṣuṇīhi pravārayitavyaṃ | aparejjukāto pratipade kalyato ye ca nirdhāviya bhikṣuvihāraṃ gantavyaṃ | yadi tāva samagro bhikṣusaṃgho bhavati na kṣamati sarvāhi bhikṣuṇīhi apūrvācarimaṃ prāvarayituṃ | atha khu ekā pravārāyikā saṃmanyitavyā | bhikṣuṇī pratibalā pravārāyikā |
body.translated_text: <s>Gurudharma</s> 8. 106. What then — <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who have completed the rains retreat should seek <s>pravāraṇā</s> (the invitation ceremony) from both <s>Saṃghas</s>. On the day when the <s>Saṃgha</s>'s <s>pravāraṇā</s> takes place, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should perform their own <s>pravāraṇā</s>. On the next day, on the first day [of the new fortnight], in the morning, they should hasten and go to the <s>bhikṣu</s> monastery. If the <s>bhikṣu</s> <s>Saṃgha</s> is complete, it is not proper for all the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to perform the <s>pravāraṇā</s> one after another. Rather, one capable <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be appointed as the <s>pravāraṇā</s>-performer.

body.text: 107. tato karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho | iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī pratibalā pravārāyikā | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ bhikṣuṇīm saṃghasya pravārāyikāṃ saṃmanyeya | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 107. The procedural officer should perform the formal act: 'Let the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so is capable of performing the <s>pravāraṇā</s>. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s> would appoint so-and-so as the <s>Saṃgha</s>'s <s>pravāraṇā</s>-performer. This is the motion.'

body.text: śṛṇotu me āryasaṃgho | iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī pratibalā pravārāyikā | tāṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ saṃghasya pravārāyikāṃ saṃmanyati | yāsām āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ saṃghasya pravārāyikāṃ saṃmanyiyamānāṃ saṃghena | sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣatu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācaneti | vaktavyaṃ | sammatā āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmā saṃghasya pravārāyikā saṃghena kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evaṃ dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so is capable and fit to perform the <s>pravāraṇā</s> (invitation). The <s>Saṃgha</s> approves so-and-so as the <s>Saṃgha's</s> <s>pravāraṇā</s> agent. Those of the noble assembly to whom it is acceptable that so-and-so be approved by the <s>Saṃgha</s> as the <s>Saṃgha's</s> <s>pravāraṇā</s> agent, let her be silent. She who does not accept, let her speak. This is the first <s>karmavācanā</s>. Likewise the second and third <s>karmavācanā</s>.' It is to be said: 'So-and-so has been approved by the noble assembly as the <s>Saṃgha's</s> <s>pravāraṇā</s> agent by the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, since it is silent, thus I understand it.'

body.text: 108. tato sarvāhi vṛddhānte sthātavyaṃ | tato tāya pravārāyikāya vaktavyaṃ | samagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho samagraṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ pravāreti dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā | ovadantu mo āryo saṃgho arthakāmo hitaiṣī anukampako anukampām upādāya jānantyo paśyantyo smarantyo yathā dharmavinayaṃ pratikariṣyāmaḥ | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: 108. Then all should stand in order of seniority. Then the <s>pravāraṇā</s> agent should say: 'The complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> invites the complete <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s> by what has been seen, heard, or suspected. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> admonish us, desiring benefit, seeking welfare, compassionate, out of compassion. Knowing, seeing, and remembering, we shall act in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>.' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni samagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho bhavati saṃbahulā bhikṣū bhavanti | vaktavyaṃ | samagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho saṃbahulān bhikṣūn pravāreti dṛṣṭena śrutena yāvat pratikariṣyāmaḥ | dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there is a complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> and several <s>bhikṣus</s>, it is to be said: 'The complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> invites the several <s>bhikṣus</s> by what has been seen, heard... up to: we shall act in accordance [with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>].' A second and a third time.

body.text: 109. atha dāni samagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho bhavati eka bhikṣu ca bhavati | vaktavyaṃ | samagro bhikṣuṇīsaṃgho āryaṃ pravāretīti dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā yāvat pratikariṣyāmaḥ evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: 109. Now if there is a complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> and one <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is to be said: 'The complete <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> invites the noble one by what has been seen, heard, or suspected... up to: we shall act in accordance [with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>].' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni saṃbahulāyo bhikṣuṇīyo bhavanti | samagro ca bhikṣusaṃgho bhavati | vaktyavyaṃ saṃbahulāḥ āryamiśrikāḥ samagraṃ bhikṣusaṃghaṃ pravārenti dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā yāvat pratikariṣyāmaḥ | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there are several <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> and a complete <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s>, it is to be said: 'The several noble ones invite the complete <s>bhikṣu-saṃgha</s> by what has been seen, heard, or suspected... up to: we shall act in accordance [with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>].' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni saṃbahulā ca bhikṣuṇīyo bhavanti saṃbahulā ca bhikṣu bhavanti | vaktavyaṃ | saṃbahulā āryamiśrikāḥ saṃbahulān āryamiśrān pravārenti dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā yāvad | yathā dharmaṃ yathā vinayaṃ tathā pratikariṣyāmaḥ | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there are several <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> and several <s>bhikṣus</s>, it is to be said: 'The several noble ones invite the several noble ones by what has been seen, heard, or suspected... up to: we shall act in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>.' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni saṃbahulā bhikṣuṇīyo bhavanti | eka bhikṣu ca bhavati | vaktavyaṃ | saṃbahulā āryamiśrikāḥ āryaṃ pravārenti dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā yāvad yathā dharmaṃ yathā vinayaṃ tathā pratikariṣyāmāḥ | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there are several <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> and one <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is to be said: 'The several noble ones invite the noble one by what has been seen, heard, or suspected... up to: we shall act in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>.' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni ekā bhikṣuṇī bhavati | samagro ca saṃgho bhavati | vaktavyaṃ | aham itthannāmā saṃghaṃ pravāremi dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā | ovadatu mo āryo saṃgho yāvat pratikariṣyāmi evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there is one <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> and a complete <s>Saṃgha</s>, it is to be said: 'I, named so-and-so, invite the <s>Saṃgha</s> by what has been seen, heard, or suspected. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> admonish me... up to: I shall act in accordance [with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>].' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni ekā bhikṣuṇī bhavati | saṃbahulā ca bhikṣū bhavanti | vaktavyaṃ | aham ithannāmā saṃbahulān āryamiśrān pravāremi dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā | ovadantu me āryamiśrā yāvad yathādharmaṃ pratikariṣyāmi | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there is one <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> and several <s>bhikṣus</s>, it is to be said: 'I, named so-and-so, invite the several noble ones by what has been seen, heard, or suspected. May the noble ones admonish me... up to: I shall act in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s>.' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: atha dāni ekā bhikṣuṇī bhavati | eka bhikṣu bhavati | vaktavyaṃ | aham itthannāmā āryaṃ pravāremi dṛṣṭena śrutena pariśaṅkayā | ovadatu me āryo artha kāmo hitaiṣī anukampako anukampām upādāya jānantī paśyanti smarantī yathā dharmaṃ yathā vinayaṃ tathā pratikariṣyāmi | evaṃ dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi |
body.translated_text: Now if there is one <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> and one <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is to be said: 'I, named so-and-so, invite the noble one by what has been seen, heard, or suspected. May the noble one admonish me, desiring benefit, seeking welfare, compassionate, out of compassion. Knowing, seeing, and remembering, I shall act in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>.' Likewise a second and a third time.

body.text: 110. sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avajñāya vā paribhavena vā koṇṭabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā | vaidyabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā | cūḍabhikṣū ti vā kṛtvā akhallamahallaakuśalaaprakṛtijño ti vā kṛtvā | varṣoṣitā ubhayato saṃghapravāraṇān na pratyāśaṃsayati gurudharmam atikrāmati | evaṃ gautami varṣoṣitāhi bhikṣuṇīhi ubhayato saṃghe pravāraṇā pratyāśaṃsitavyā | ayaṃ gautami bhikṣuṇīnām aṣṭamo gurudharmo yo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyo gurukartavyo mānayitavyo pūjayitavyo anatikramaṇīyo velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: 110. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who, out of contempt or disrespect, or regarding [a monk] as a 'mere corner-<s>bhikṣu</s>,' or as a 'doctor-<s>bhikṣu</s>,' or as a 'crest-<s>bhikṣu</s>,' or considering [him] 'not healthy, not great, not skilled, not one who knows what is proper,' having completed the rains-retreat, does not observe the <s>pravāraṇā</s> (invitation) before both <s>Saṃghas</s>—she transgresses a <s>gurudharma</s>. Thus, <s>Gautamī</s>, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who have completed the rains should observe the <s>pravāraṇā</s> before both <s>Saṃghas</s>. This, <s>Gautamī</s>, is the eighth <s>gurudharma</s> for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should honor, respect, revere, and worship for their entire lives, not to be transgressed, like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text: ime gautami bhikṣuṇīnām aṣṭau gurudharmāḥ ye bhikṣuṇīhi yāvajjīvaṃ satkartavyā gurukartavyā mānayitavyā pūjayitvyā anatikramaṇīyā velāmiva mahāsamudreṇa |
body.translated_text: These, <s>Gautamī</s>, are the eight <s>gurudharmas</s> (rules of respect) for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should honor, respect, revere, and worship for their entire lives, not to be transgressed, like the shore by the great ocean.

body.text: pārājikadharma |
body.translated_text: <s>Pārājika</s> (Defeat) rules.

body.text: maithunaṃ
body.translated_text: Sexual intercourse.

body.text: 111. atha khalu bhagavān bhikṣuṇīyo āmantrayate sma tasmāt tahiṃ bhikṣuṇīyo adyadagreṇa mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīṃ saṃghasthavirīṃ saṃghamahattarīṃ saṃghapariṇāyikāṃ dhārayatha |
body.translated_text: 111. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Therefore, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, from this day forward, regard <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> as the <s>saṃgha-sthavirī</s> (elder of the <s>Saṃgha</s>), the <s>saṃgha-mahattarī</s> (senior of the <s>Saṃgha</s>), and the <s>saṃgha-pariṇāyikā</s> (leader of the <s>Saṃgha</s>).'

body.text: ya ime bhagavan bhagavatā catvāro patanīyo dharmo abhijñāya deśitāḥ labhyā te bhagavann asmābhi vistareṇa śrotuṃ | bhagavān āha labhyā gautami |
body.translated_text: '<s>Bhagavān</s>, these four rules leading to defeat have been taught by the <s>Bhagavān</s> with full knowledge. May we hear them in detail, <s>Bhagavān</s>?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You may, <s>Gautamī</s>.'

body.text: 112. pañcārthavaśān saṃpaśyamānāya śraddhāya kuladhītāya alam vinayam uddiśituṃ | alaṃ vinayaṃ dhārayituṃ yathā bhikṣuvinaye |
body.translated_text: 112. Seeing five purposes, it is fitting for a faithful daughter of good family to recite the <s>Vinaya</s>, it is fitting to uphold the <s>Vinaya</s>—as in the <s>Bhikṣuvinaya</s>.

body.text: 113. ekam idaṃ gautami samayan tathāgato śrāvastīyam viharati | atha khalu śāriputrasya sthavirasya yāvat ko nu khalu bhagavan hetuḥ kaḥ pratyayo yena ihaikeṣān tathāgatānām, arhatāṃ samyaksambuddhānām atyayena cirasthitikaṃ prāvacanaṃ bhavati cirasthitikaḥ saddharma iti yathā bhikṣuvinaye |
body.translated_text: 113. At one time, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Then the elder <s>Śāriputra</s> [asked]: 'What indeed, <s>Bhagavān</s>, is the cause, what is the condition, by which for some <s>Tathāgatas</s>, <s>Arhats</s>, Perfectly Awakened Ones, after their passing, the teaching endures long and the true <s>Dharma</s> endures long?'—as in the <s>Bhikṣuvinaya</s>.

body.text: ekam idaṃ gautami samayan tathāgato vaiśālīyam viharati | vistareṇa yaśikasyārthotpattiḥ prathamā | tasmāt tarhi gautami bhikṣuṇyāpi atraiva śikṣitavyam |
body.translated_text: At one time, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. The detailed origin-story of <s>Yaśika</s> is the first. Therefore, <s>Gautamī</s>, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too should train in this very matter.

body.text:
dvinnāṃ licchavi kumārāṇām arthotpattiḥ | dvitīyā |
yāvan nāsti bhikṣuṇīye śikṣāpratyākhyānaṃ | tṛtīyā |
nāsti daurbalyāviṣkarakarma | caturthī |
nandikasyārthotpattiḥ | pañcamī |
markaṭīya arthotpattiḥ ṣaṣṭhī |
body.translated_text: The origin-story of the two <s>Licchavi</s> youths is the second. Up to: there is no renunciation of training for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>—the third. There is no act declaring weakness—the fourth. The origin-story of <s>Nandika</s>—the fifth. The origin-story of the female monkey—the sixth.

body.text: vistareṇa tasmād iha gautami bhikṣuṇīhi atraiva śikṣitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: In detail, therefore, <s>Gautamī</s>, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should train in this very matter.

body.text: 114. atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo | atha khalu bhagavān sannipatitaṃ bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ viditvā yāvac chikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ |
body.translated_text: 114. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, knowing that the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> had assembled, laid down the training rule:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī chandaso maithunaṃ grāmyaṃ dharmaṃ pratiṣeviya antamasato tiryagyonigatena pi sārdhaṃ iyaṃ bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asamvāsyā |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> willingly engages in the vulgar practice of sexual intercourse, even with an animal, this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is <s>pārājikā</s> (defeated) and <s>asaṃvāsyā</s> (expelled from the community).'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ti upasampannā sūpasampannā traivācikena karmaṇā jñapticaturthena anāghātapañcamena samagreṇa saṃghena ubhayataḥ saṃghena iyaṃ bhikṣuṇī | cchandaso ti raktacittā |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained, well-ordained, by the threefold act (<s>traivācika karman</s>), with the motion as the fourth (<s>jñapticaturtha</s>) and non-objection as the fifth, by a complete <s>Saṃgha</s>, by both <s>Saṃghas</s>—this is a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. 'Willingly' means with a mind affected by passion.

body.text: maithunan ti abrahmacaryaṃ grāmyadharman ti grāmasyāpy eṣo dharmo nagarasyāpy eṣo dharmo sarvāvantasyāpi lokasya eṣo dharmo | pratiṣeveyā ti adhyācāreya | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī maithunaṃ grāmyadharmaṃ pratiṣevati mānuṣeṇa puruṣeṇa mānuṣyakena paṇḍakena trayāṇāṃ vraṇamukhānāṃ dhanyamārge varcamārge prasrāvamārge anyatarānyatarasmiṃ vraṇamukhe aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṃ prakṣiptaṃ ārtīyati ārtayitvā svādayati | ādau svādayati | madhye svādayati | paryavasāne svādayati | sukhīyati | āsvādaṃ nigamayati pārājikā bhavati | ādau na svādayati | madhyena svādayati | paryavasāne svādayati | yāvat pārājikā bhavati | ādau na svādayati | madhye na svādayati | paryavasāne svādayati yā āsvādan nigamayati sā pārājikā bhavati | ādau na svādayati | madhye na svādayati | paryavasāne na svādayati anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Sexual intercourse' means non-celibacy; 'vulgar practice' means it is the practice of the village, the practice of the town, the practice of the entire world. 'Engages in' means commits the offense. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> engages in the vulgar practice of sexual intercourse—with a human male, with a human <s>paṇḍaka</s> (eunuch)—through any of the three orifices: the genital passage, the anal passage, or the urinary passage—when the sexual organ is inserted into the sexual organ and she experiences distress; having experienced distress, she savors it: she savors at the beginning, she savors in the middle, she savors at the end; she is gratified, she achieves delight—she is <s>pārājikā</s>. She does not savor at the beginning; she savors in the middle; she savors at the end—she is <s>pārājikā</s>... up to: she does not savor at the beginning, she does not savor in the middle, she savors at the end—whoever achieves delight, she is <s>pārājikā</s>. She does not savor at the beginning, she does not savor in the middle, she does not savor at the end—there is no offense.

body.text: evaṃ suptasya mṛtasya aṅgajāte aṅgajātaṃ prakṣipitvā artīyati | peyālaṃ evaṃ amānuṣasya paṇḍakasya tiryagyonigatasya puruṣasya paṇḍakasya trayāṇāṃ vraṇamukhānāṃ | peyālaṃ |
body.translated_text: Likewise with one who is asleep or dead, when the sexual organ is inserted into the sexual organ and she experiences distress—abbreviated. Likewise with a non-human male, a non-human <s>paṇḍaka</s>, an animal male, an animal <s>paṇḍaka</s>, through the three orifices—abbreviated.

body.text: 115. sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī raktacittā puruṣaṃ darśanāya uṭṭhāpeti samvaragāmivinayātikramam āsādayati darśanaśravaṇe deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | yathā bhikṣuvinaye |
body.translated_text: 115. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who, with a passionate mind, rouses a man for the purpose of seeing [his sexual organ] incurs a <s>saṃvaragāmi-vinayātikrama</s> (restraint-leading disciplinary transgression); regarding sight and hearing, she incurs a <s>deśanāgāmi-vinayātikrama</s> (confession-leading transgression)—as in the <s>Bhikṣuvinaya</s>.

body.text: 116. puruṣo trikhaṇḍīkṛto bhavati | dvidhāpāṭito bhavati | śuṣko bhavati | koṭarakajātaḥ | ādhmātajāto bhavati | vinīlako bhavati | vipūyako bhavati |
body.translated_text: 116. A man may be in three pieces, split in half, dried up, hollowed out, bloated, discolored, or decomposing.

body.text: 117. pañca bhikṣuṇīyo pañca bhikṣūn balāt prasahyamadhyomardanti pañca bhikṣuṇīyo pārājikāyo bhavanti | yo ca bhikṣuḥ sātiyati |
body.translated_text: 117. If five <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> forcibly assault five <s>bhikṣus</s> through sexual contact, the five <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are <s>pārājikā</s> (defeated). And whatever <s>bhikṣu</s> consents [is also defeated].

body.text: pañca bhikṣū pañca bhikṣuṇīyo balāt pragṛhyamadhyomardanti pañca bhikṣū pārājikā bhavanti | yā ca bhikṣuṇī sātiyati |
body.translated_text: If five <s>bhikṣus</s> forcibly assault five <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> through sexual contact, the five <s>bhikṣus</s> are <s>pārājikā</s> (defeated). And whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> consents [is also defeated].

body.text: bhikṣu bhikṣuṇīya sārdhaṃ anyonyaṃ vipratipadyati ubhaye pārājikā bhavanti | bhikṣuṇī śrāmaṇereṇa saha vipratipadyati bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati śrāmaṇero nāśayitavyo | atha dāni bhikṣuṇī ārāmikena saha vipratipadyate bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati | ārāmiko agṛhītasamvaratvāt kim vradyiṣyati | evaṃ tīrthikena | trihi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati | mānuṣeṇa amānuṣeṇa tiryagyonigatena aparehi trihi dhanyamārge varcamārge prasrāvamārge | aparehi trihi supte mṛte jāgrante | dvihi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati puruṣeṇa paṇḍakena ca | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī suptā vā bhavati mattā vā unmattā vā vistareṇa puruṣo upasaṃkramya abhiniṣīdati vā abhinipadyati vā | antostarati vā | sā tato utthāya ādau svādayati | madhye svādayati | paryavasāne svādayati pārājikā bhavati | kin ti dāni sādiyanā draṣṭavyā | kin ti dāni asādiyanā | yathā bhikṣuvinaye | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī chandaso maithunaṃ grāmyadharmaṃ pratiṣevatīti | peyālaṃ | sā eṣā āpadyati | apy ekatyā ajñānāt | apyekatyā smṛtisaṃmoṣāt | apy ekatyākalpiyasaṃjñayā | apy ekatyā alajjikena | apy ekatyā rāgābhibhūtā doṣābhibhūtā mohābhibhūtā anāpattiḥ | kṣiptacittāye akarantīye anadhyācarantīye anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> and a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> engage in sexual misconduct with each other—both are <s>pārājikā</s>. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> engages in misconduct with a <s>śrāmaṇera</s>—the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is <s>pārājikā</s>, the <s>śrāmaṇera</s> is to be expelled. Now if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> engages in misconduct with a monastery attendant—the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is <s>pārājikā</s>; the attendant, not having taken the precepts, what consequence will there be for him? Likewise with a heretic. By three [categories] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is <s>pārājikā</s>: with a human, a non-human, and an animal. By another three: through the genital passage, the anal passage, and the urinary passage. By another three: with one asleep, one dead, and one awake. By two a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is <s>pārājikā</s>: with a man and with a <s>paṇḍaka</s>. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, whether asleep, intoxicated, or mentally deranged—in detail—if a man approaches and sits upon or lies upon or penetrates [her]—if she then, upon waking, savors at the beginning, savors in the middle, savors at the end—she is <s>pārājikā</s>. How then is consenting to be understood? How then is not consenting?—as in the <s>Bhikṣuvinaya</s>. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> willingly engages in the vulgar practice of sexual intercourse—abbreviated. She commits this offense: some through ignorance, some through confusion of memory, some with the perception that it is permitted, some shamelessly, some overpowered by passion, hate, or delusion. There is no offense for one whose mind is deranged, for one who does not do [it], for one who does not commit the offense—there is no offense. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā punar bhikṣuṇī chandaśo maithunaṃ grāmyadharmaṃ pratiṣeveya antamasato tiryagyonigatenāpi sārdhaṃ iyaṃ bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asaṃvāsyā |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> willingly engages in the vulgar practice of sexual intercourse, even with an animal, this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is <s>pārājikā</s> (defeated) and <s>asaṃvāsyā</s> (expelled from the community).'

body.text: pārājikadharma 24
body.translated_text: <s>Pārājika</s> (Defeat) rules 2-4.

body.text: evaṃ dvitīyasya | tṛtīyasya | caturthasya | na kiñcin nānākaraṇaṃ yathā bhikṣuvinaye |
body.translated_text: Likewise for the second, the third, and the fourth. There is no difference—as in the <s>Bhikṣuvinaya</s>.

body.text: saṃsarga
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃsarga</s> (Association).

body.text: 118. bhagavān chākyeṣu viharati śākyānāṃ kapilavastusmiṃ nyagrodhārāme | tena dāni kālena tena samayena bhagavatā bhikṣuṇīnāṃ araṇyakāni śayanāsanāni pratikṣiptāni | grāmāntakāni ca akṛtāni | bhikṣuṇīyo gṛhiṇām upavasitehi vasanti | rāṣṭrā nāma bhikṣuṇī | sā dāni aparasya sākyasya uduvasite vasati | sā dāni rāṣṭrā tasya śākiyakumārasya uddiśati | sā dāni rāṣṭrā prāsādikā darśaniyā avigatarāga | so pi śākiyakumāro prāsādiko darśanīyo | so dāni tāye trikkhatto devaśikaṃ upalaṅkṛtaṃ kālyaṃ madhyāhne sāyaṃ | tāye dāni taṃ śākiya kumāraṃ dṛṣṭvā abhīkṣṇaṃ saṃsevāya ca rāgacittam anudhvaṃsayati | sā dāni mlāyati pāṇḍukṛśā durvarṇā bhontīmapi bhojanaṃ na chando bhavati |
body.translated_text: 118. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling among the <s>Śākyas</s>, at <s>Kapilavastu</s>, in the <s>Nyagrodha</s> garden. At that time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> had prohibited forest dwellings for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, and dwellings at the edge of a village had not been established. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were living in residences of householders. There was a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>. She was living in the upper dwelling of a certain <s>Śākya</s> [youth]. <s>Rāṣṭrā</s> attracted the attention of that <s>Śākya</s> youth. <s>Rāṣṭrā</s> was pleasing and beautiful, not free from passion. That <s>Śākya</s> youth too was pleasing and handsome. He would adorn himself three times daily—in the morning, at midday, and in the evening. Having seen that <s>Śākya</s> youth repeatedly, through frequent association, her mind became corrupted by lust. She became withered, pale, thin, and of bad complexion; she had no desire even for food.

body.text: 119. bhikṣū dānīṃ pṛcchanti | kena tvaṃ bhaginī rāṣṭrā pāṇḍukṛśā durvarṇā | kin te duḥkhati | kin te paryeṣāmaḥ | sarpis tailaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ | sā dān āha bhotu bhotu ārya evam eva vartā bhaviṣyāmi | bhikṣuṇīyo pṛcchanti | ārye rāṣṭre kena tvam evaṃ pāṇḍukṛśā durvarṇā | kin te duḥkhati | kin te paryeṣāmaḥ | sarpis tailaṃ madhu phāṇitaṃ | sā dān āha | bhotu bhotu āryamiśrikāyo evam eva vartā bhaviṣyāmīti | evaṃ eva upāsikā upāsikāyo | so pi śākiyakumāro āha | ārye kin te duḥkhati | kena si pāṇḍu kṛśā durvarṇā | ācikṣāhi kīdṛśehi atra bhaiṣajyehi vā upakaraṇehi vā artho bhaveya | saced asmākaṃ na bhaviṣyati prātiveśya kulāto uddhāradharmaṇā ānāpayiṣyāmi | antarāpaṇāto vā grāmāntarāto vā ānāpayiṣyāmi | sā dān āha bhotu dīrghāyuḥ evam eva vartā bhaviṣyāmi | dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyam api āha | ārye kin te duḥkhati | kenāsi pāṇḍukṛśā durvarṇā yāvad grāmāntarāto ānāpayiṣyāmi | sā dān āha bhotu dīrghāyu evam eva vartā bhaviṣyāmi | so dāni śākiyakumāro āha | na idaṃ āryāye kiñcit kāyikaṃ gailāyaṃ | caitasikaṃ āryāye gailānyaṃ | sā dān āha | bāḍhaṃ caitasikaṃ gailānyaṃ | so dān āha kathaṃ sahyaṃ bhaveya | sā dān āha | yadi evam icchasi evaṃ sahyaṃ bhaveya |
body.translated_text: 119. The <s>bhikṣus</s> asked: 'By what cause, sister <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>, are you pale, thin, and of bad complexion? What ails you? What shall we procure for you—ghee, oil, honey, or molasses?' She said: 'Let it be, let it be, noble one; I shall remain just as I am.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> asked: 'Noble <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>, why are you so pale, thin, and of bad complexion? What ails you? What shall we procure for you—ghee, oil, honey, or molasses?' She said: 'Let it be, let it be, noble sisters; I shall remain just as I am.' The lay-women asked likewise. That <s>Śākya</s> youth also said: 'Noble one, what ails you? Why are you pale, thin, and of bad complexion? Tell me, what kind of medicines or provisions might you need? If we do not have them, I will have them brought from the neighbors' households by way of borrowing, or from the market, or from another village.' She said: 'Let it be, long-lived one; I shall remain just as I am.' A second and a third time he asked the same. She said: 'Let it be, long-lived one; I shall remain just as I am.' Then the <s>Śākya</s> youth said: 'The noble one has no bodily illness; the noble one's illness is mental.' She said: 'Indeed, it is a mental illness.' He said: 'How can it be cured?' She said: 'If you are willing, it can be cured thus.'

body.text: 120. so dān āha | ārye kim artham ahaṃ necchāmi | yo dāni ahaṃ jalpāmi | ācikṣatu āryā kim ājñāpayasi | kiṃ karomi | kīdṛśehi atra bhaiṣajyehi vā upakaraṇehi vā artho bhaveya | saced asmākaṃ na bhaviṣyati prātiveśyakulāto uddhāradharmaṇā ānayiṣyāmi antarāpaṇāto vā grāmāntarāto vā ānāpayiṣyāmīti | ācikṣatu āryā | sā dān āha | sādhu te etam artham karohi | so dān āha | na ārye evaṃ vaktavyaṃ | anyāhi ahaṃ kāṣāyavasanāhi notsahāmy etaṃ arthaṃ kartuṃ prāg eva āryāya | āryā mama guru ca bhāvanīyā ca | nāham āryāya evaṃ vaktavyo | nahy aham utsahāmy etaṃ kāryaṃ kartuṃ | sā dān āha | sādhu tāva me āliṅgasva cumbasva stanodarañ ca me parimardasveti | labhyan mayā etan mātraṃ kartuṃ | sa mātrāliṅgati cumbati stanodarañ ca se parimṛśati | sā pi dāni tattakenaiva vinodayati | so pi dāni śākiyakumāro abhīkṣṇasaṃsargeṇa apamlāyati |
body.translated_text: 120. He said: 'Noble one, why would I not be willing? I am speaking [to help you]. Tell me, noble one, what do you command? What should I do? What kind of medicines or provisions might you need? If we do not have them, I will have them brought from the neighbors' households by way of borrowing, or from the market, or from another village. Tell me, noble one.' She said: 'Do that thing for me.' He said: 'Noble one, do not speak thus. With other wearers of the saffron robe I would not be able to do that thing, how much less with the noble one. The noble one is my teacher and is to be revered. I should not be spoken to thus by the noble one. I am not capable of doing that deed.' She said: 'Then at least embrace me, kiss me, and caress my breasts and belly.' 'Is it permissible for me to do that much?' He embraced her, kissed her, and caressed her breasts and belly. She too was satisfied with that much. But that <s>Śākya</s> youth, through frequent association, also became withered.

body.text: 121. yathā bhagavān āha | nāham bhikṣavo 'nyam ekaṃ spraṣṭavyaṃ samanupaśyāmi | evaṃ rañjanīyam evaṃ kamanīyam evaṃ vañcanīyam evaṃ mūrcchanīyam evam adhyohāri evam antarāyakaram anuttarasya yogakṣemasyādhigamāya yathā puruṣasya strī spraṣṭavyaṃ strīyā puruṣa iti dāni tena abhikṣṇasaṃsevāya apamlāyati | so dāni punaḥ punaḥ karoti |
body.translated_text: 121. As the <s>Bhagavān</s> has said: '<s>Bhikṣus</s>, I do not see any other single tangible object so captivating, so desirable, so deceiving, so intoxicating, so ensnaring, so obstructive to the attainment of the unsurpassed security from bondage, as the tangible object of a woman for a man and the tangible object of a man for a woman.' Thus, through frequent association, he too became withered. And he continued [the conduct] again and again.

body.text: 122. sā dāni bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati | mā ārye evaṃ karohi naivaṃ labhyā kartuṃ | sā dān āha | evaṃ mama kriyamāṇaṃ phāsu bhavati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsu | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayati | bhagavān āha śabdāpayatha rāṣṭrāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | bhagavān āha | satyaṃ rāṣṭre evaṃ nāma tvaṃ avaśrutā avaśrutasya | puruṣasya upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyāṃ āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyasi | āha | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te rāṣṭre | nanv ahaṃ rāṣṭre anekaparyāyeṇa sarveṣāṃ kāmānāṃ kāmanandīnāṃ kāmanimnānāṃ kāmamūrcchānāṃ kāmapipāsānāṃ kāmaparidāhyānāṃ kāmādhyavasānānāṃ antam vadāmi | prahāṇam vadāmi | samatikramaṇaṃ vadāmi | tatra nāma tvaṃ imaṃ evaṃ rūpatvaṃ pāpam akuśalaṃ dharmaṃ adhyācarasi | naiṣa rāṣṭre dharma | naiṣa vinayo | naivaṃ śāstuḥ śāsanaṃ | naivaṃ kartavyaṃ | naivaṃ karato vṛddhir bhavati kuśalehi dharmehi |
body.translated_text: 122. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> told her: 'Noble one, do not act thus; it is not permissible to act thus.' She said: 'When it is done thus, I feel well.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>.' She was summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Is it true, <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>, that you, being lustful, with a lustful man, consented to the touching and stroking [of your body] above the knees and below the armpits?' She said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>. Have I not, <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>, in many ways declared the end of all sensual desires, sensual delights, sensual inclinations, sensual infatuations, sensual thirsts, sensual fevers, and sensual attachments? I speak of their abandonment, I speak of their transcendence. Yet you have practiced this evil, unwholesome conduct. This, <s>Rāṣṭrā</s>, is not the <s>Dharma</s>; this is not the <s>Vinaya</s>; this is not the Teacher's instruction; this should not be done; acting thus does not lead to growth in wholesome qualities.'

body.text: 123. atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo | yāvatikā bhikṣuṇīyo kapilavastun nagaram upaniśritya viharanti | atha khalu bhagavān sannipatitaṃ bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ viditvā etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ vistareṇārocayati | peyālaṃ | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 123. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>—all the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> dwelling in the vicinity of the city of <s>Kapilavastu</s>.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s>, knowing that the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> had assembled, reported this matter to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> in detail. Abbreviation. [He said:] '...so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya adho kakṣābhyām upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyeya iyaṃ pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asamvāsyā |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, consents to the touching and stroking by a lustful man [of her body] below the armpits and above the knees—this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too is defeated (<s>pārājikā</s>) and is expelled from the community.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti | peyālaṃ | yāvad eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā ti raktacittā | avaśrutasyeti raktacittasya | adho kakṣābhyām iti stanodaraṃ | upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām iti ūru | āmoṣaṇaṃ ti cchuvaṇaṃ | parāmoṣaṇan ti vītihāro | sādiyeyā ti sātīyati sukhiyati ramīyati āsvāda nigamayati pārājikā bhavati |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—abbreviation—up to: 'this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>.' 'Lustful' means with a mind of passion. 'Of a lustful one' means of one with a mind of passion. 'Below the armpits' means the breasts and belly. 'Above the knees' means the thighs. 'Touching' means contact. 'Stroking' means repeated handling. 'Consents' means she finds it agreeable, feels pleasure, delights in it, and savors the enjoyment—she is defeated (<s>pārājikā</s>).

body.text: pārājiketi pāraṃ nāmocyate dharmajñānaṃ | tato jīnā ojīnā saṃjīnā parihīṇā | tenāha pārājiketi |
body.translated_text: <s>Pārājikā</s> (defeated): '<s>Pāra</s>' is said to mean knowledge of the <s>Dharma</s>. She is conquered, overcome, utterly defeated, fallen from that. Therefore she is called '<s>pārājikā</s>.'

body.text: 124. evaṃ vistareṇa | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādayati pārājikā bhavati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutasya paṇḍakasya upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādayati pārājikā bhavati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā anavaśrutena paṇḍakena upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyati thūlaccayam āsādyati | sā pi eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā anavaśrutena puruṣena upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyati thūlaccayam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā anavaśrutena paṇḍakena upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaṃ parāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyeya thūlaccayam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā anavaśrutāya striyāya upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiya deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā avaśrutena puruṣeṇa upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyati thūl'-accayam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā avaśrutenapaṇḍakena upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyati thūl'-accayaṃ āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā avaśrutāya striyāya upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādayati deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā avaśrutena puruṣeṇa upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādayati deśanāgāmi vinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutena paṇḍakena upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādayati deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutāya striyāya upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adho kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādayati samvaragāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutena puruṣeṇa adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyāṃ yāvat sthūlātyayam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutena paṇḍakena adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām yāva thūl'-accayam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutāya striyāya adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyāṃ yāvad deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutena puruṣeṇa adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām yāvat deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsāsdayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutena paṇḍakena adho jānumaṇḍalābhyāṃ upari kakṣābhyām yāvat deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutāya striyāya adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyāṃ yāvat samvaragāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutena puruṣeṇa adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām yāvat deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutena paṇḍakena adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām yāvat deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutāyastriyāya adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām yāvat samvaragāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutena puruṣeṇa adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām yāvat samvaragāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutena paṇḍakena adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyāṃ yāvat samvaragāmivinayā tikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā anavaśrutāya striyāya adho jānumaṇḍalābhyām upari kakṣābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādīyati anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: 124. Thus in detail. If a lustful (<s>avaśrutā</s>) <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful man to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she commits a <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) offense. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful <s>paṇḍaka</s> (eunuch) to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she commits a <s>pārājika</s> offense. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful <s>paṇḍaka</s> to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s> (grave offense). If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful man to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful <s>paṇḍaka</s> to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful woman to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>deśanāgāmi</s> (offense requiring confession) <s>vinaya</s> transgression. If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful man to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful <s>paṇḍaka</s> to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful woman to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>deśanāgāmi vinaya</s> transgression. If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful man to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>deśanāgāmi vinaya</s> transgression. If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful <s>paṇḍaka</s> to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>deśanāgāmi vinaya</s> transgression. If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful woman to touch and caress her above the kneecaps and below the armpits, she incurs a <s>saṃvaragāmi</s> (offense involving restraint) <s>vinaya</s> transgression. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful man to touch her below the kneecaps and above the armpits, she incurs up to a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful <s>paṇḍaka</s> to touch her below the kneecaps and above the armpits, up to a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If a lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a lustful woman to touch her below the kneecaps and above the armpits, up to a <s>deśanāgāmi vinaya</s> transgression. [And so forth for all combinations of lustful/non-lustful with man/paṇḍaka/woman, below kneecaps and above armpits, down to:] If a non-lustful <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> allows a non-lustful woman to touch and caress her below the kneecaps and above the armpits — there is no offense.

body.text: 125 | atha dāni bhikṣuṇī lalāṭasirāṃ vedhāpayati dvitīyāya bhikṣuṇīya mūrdhni ākramitavyā yathā strī spraṣṭavyaṃ saṃjānāti na puruṣa spraṣṭavyaṃ saṃjānāti | atha dāni bāhuśirāṃ vindhāpayati aparāya bhikṣuṇīya bāhā grahetavyā yathā strī spraṣṭavyaṃ saṃjānāti na puruṣa spraṣṭavyaṃ | evaṃ gulphaśirā | evaṃ jānumaṇḍalādhaḥ | atha dāni gaṇḍaṃ vā piṭakam vā kṣatam vā puruṣeṇa pāṭāpayati vā upanāhāpayati vā aparāya bhikṣuṇīya ālambayitavyaṃ | na kṣamati sambādhe pradeśe gaṇḍam vā piṭakam vā kṣatam vā upahatam vā puruṣeṇa vedhāpayitum vā pāṭāpayitum vā upanāhāpayitum vā | sambādho nāma pradeśo upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām adhaḥ kakṣābhyām | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 125. Now, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has a vein on her forehead opened [for bloodletting], another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should press on her head so that she perceives a woman's touch and not a man's touch. If she has a vein on her arm opened, another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should hold her arm so that she perceives a woman's touch and not a man's touch. Likewise for the ankle vein. Likewise for [areas] below the kneecap. Now, if she has a boil, abscess, wound, or injury that a man would lance, cut open, or bandage, another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should support her. It is not permissible for a man to lance, cut open, or bandage a boil, abscess, wound, or injury in a private area. The 'private area' means above the kneecaps and below the armpits. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya adho kakṣā bhyām upari jānumaṇḍalābhyām āmoṣaṇaparāmoṣaṇaṃ sādiyeya iyaṃ pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asamvāsyā |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, allows a lustful man to touch and caress her below the armpits and above the kneecaps, this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too commits a <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) offense and is expelled from the community (<s>asaṃvāsyā</s>).

body.text:
pārājikadharma 6
aṣṭavastukā
body.translated_text: <s>Pārājika</s> Rule 6: The eightfold case (<s>aṣṭavastuka</s>).

body.text: 126. bhagavān samyaksambuddho yadarthaṃ samudāgato tadartham abhisambhāvayitvā vaiśālīyām viharati | mahāvane kūṭāgāraśālāyāṃ | tena dāni kālena tena samayena bhagavatā bhikṣuṇīnām āraṇyakāni śayanāsanāni pratikṣiptāni | grāmāntikani ca akṛtāni | bhikṣuṇīyo abhyantaranagare praviśanti | atha rāṣṭrapālā nāma bhikṣuṇī | sā dāni aparasya licchavikumārasya uduvasite vasati | sā dāni tasya licchavikumārasya uddeśan dadāti | sā dāni rāṣṭrapālā tasya devasikam upasaṃkramati kālyaṃ madhyāhne sāyam | sā dāni prāsādikā darśanīyā avītarāgā | so pi licchavikumāro prāsādiko darśanīyo | tāye dāni rāṣṭrapālāya abhīkṣṇadarśanena abhikṣṇaṃ saṃsevāya ca rāgacittam anudhvaṃsayati | sā dāni mlāyati | peyālaṃ | yāvad guru ca bhāvanīyā ca yāvan notsahāmi |
body.translated_text: 126. The <s>Bhagavān</s>, the perfectly and fully awakened one, having accomplished the purpose for which he had come forth, was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>, in the Great Forest (<s>Mahāvana</s>), in the Gabled Hall (<s>Kūṭāgāraśālā</s>). At that time, the <s>Bhagavān</s> had prohibited forest-dwelling for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> and had not established [residences] near villages. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> entered within the inner city. Now there was a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Rāṣṭrapālā</s>. She was living in the dwelling assigned to a certain <s>Licchavi</s> youth. She would give him religious instruction. She would visit that <s>Licchavi</s> youth daily — in the morning, at midday, and in the evening. Now, she was attractive and beautiful but not free from desire. That <s>Licchavi</s> youth too was attractive and handsome. Through her frequent visits and constant association with <s>Rāṣṭrapālā</s>, his mind became overwhelmed by passion. She then began to waste away. [The account is abbreviated.] [She thought:] 'He is to be respected and revered...' up to 'I am not able.'

body.text: 127. sā dān āha | sādhu khalu tāvan me anto hastapāśasya tiṣṭhāhi saṃlapāhi | hastaṃ me gṛhṇāhi | prahastaṃ me gṛhṇāhi | aṅguliṃ me gṛhṇāhi | anguṣṭaṃ me gṛhṇāhi | cīvaraṃ me gṛhṇāhi | ahaṃ pi te āgatam abhinandiṣyaṃ | āsanena upanimantrayiṣyaṃ | kāyan te anuprayacchiṣyaṃ | pīṭhikām vā āpaṇam vā karmāntam vā gamiṣyan ti | so dān āha | ārye labhyā mayā etaṃ kartuṃ | so dāni tāye anto hastapāsasya tiṣṭhati | saṃlapati | hastena gṛhṇāti | prahaste gṛhṇāti | cīvare gṛhṇāti | sā pi taṃ āgatam abhinandati | āsanenopanimantrayati | kāyaṃ se nuprayacchati | saṃketaṃ vā gacchati | sāpi dāni tattakenaiva kāmacchandam vinodeti | so pi dāni licchavikumāro abhīkṣṇadarśanena abhīkṣṇasaṃsevāya apamlāyati |
body.translated_text: 127. She then said [to the <s>Licchavi</s> youth]: 'Very well then, stand within my arm's reach, converse with me, hold my hand, hold my wrist, hold my finger, hold my thumb, hold my robe. And I too will welcome your coming, will invite you with a seat, will offer you my person, and will go to a bench, a shop, or a workplace [where we can meet].' He said: 'Noble lady, it is possible for me to do this.' So he stood within her arm's reach, conversed with her, held her hand, held her wrist, held her robe. And she too welcomed his coming, invited him with a seat, offered him her person, and went to their agreed meeting place. She then in that very way dispelled her lustful desire. But that <s>Licchavi</s> youth, through frequent seeing and constant association, began to waste away.

body.text: 128. yat tad uktaṃ bhagavatā | nāham bhikṣavo 'nyad ekarūpam api samanupaśyāmīti vistareṇa sūtraṃ | sā dāni abhīkṣṇaṃ saṃsevāya apamlāyati | sā punaḥ punaḥ karoti | sā bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati | mā ārye rāṣṭrapāle evaṃ karohi | naivaṃ labhyā kartuṃ | sā dān āha | ken' arthan na labhyate | evam mama kriyamāṇe phāsu bhavati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayanti | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha rāṣṭrapālāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | bhagavān āha | satyaṃ rāṣṭrapāle evan nāma tvaṃ avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya anto hastapāśasya saṃtiṣṭhasi saṃlapasi | peyālaṃ | yāvat saṃketaṃ gacchasi | āha | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te rāṣṭrapāle | yāvan mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | yāvac chikṣāpadaṃ prajñapataṃ |
body.translated_text: 128. As it was said by the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'I do not see, <s>bhikṣus</s>, any other single form...' — the <s>sūtra</s> in full. She wasted away through constant association. She did this again and again. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> said to her: 'Do not, noble <s>Rāṣṭrapālā</s>, do this. It is not permissible to do this.' She said: 'For what reason is it not permissible? When I act in this way, I find comfort.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Rāṣṭrapālā</s>.' She was summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Is it true, <s>Rāṣṭrapālā</s>, that you, being lustful, stand within the arm's reach of a lustful man, converse with him...' [abbreviated] '...up to go to an agreed meeting place?' She said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Rāṣṭrapālā</s>.' [The account continues] up to where he addresses <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> and lays down the training rule.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya anto hastapāśasya saṃtiṣṭheta vā saṃlapeta vā | hastagrahaṇam vā | cīvaragrahaṇam vā sādīyeya | āgatam vā abhinandeya | āsanena vā upanimantreya | kāyam vā anuprayaccheya | saṃketakṛtam vā gaccheya | iyaṃ pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asaṃvāsyā |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, stands within the arm's reach of a lustful man, or converses with him, or allows the holding of her hand, or the holding of her robe, or welcomes his coming, or invites him with a seat, or offers him her person, or goes to an agreed meeting place — this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too commits a <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) offense and is expelled from the community (<s>asaṃvāsyā</s>).

body.text: 129. yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasaṃpannā | yāvat sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā ti raktacittā | avaśrutasya puruṣasyeti raktacittasya | anto hastapāśasyeti anto vyāyāmeti | saṃlapeyā ti upakarṇaṃ vā jalpeya | hastagrahaṇan ti haste gṛhṇiya yāvad aṅguṣṭake vā | cīvaragrahaṇan ti saṃghāṭīyaṃ vā uttarāsaṅge vā aṅtarevāse vā saṃkakṣikāyāṃ vā dakaśāṭikāyām vā | sādiyeyā ti āsvādaṃ nigamayet | āgataṃ vā abhinandeyā ti vā svāgatan te anurāgatan te punaḥ puna āgacchesi | prītāsmi tavāgamanena | prahlāditam me gātraṃ tava darśanena | āsanenopanimantreyā ti āsanam asya dadeya | kāyaṃ se anuprayaccheyā ti yenāsau tena kāyaṃ praṇāmeta | saṃketakṛtaṃ gacched iti yas tasya abhīkṣṇaṃ upacāro bhaved āpaṇo vā pīṭhikā vā kṣetravastraṃ vā udakasamīpaṃ vā karmāntaṃ vā udyāyaṃ vā mārge vā tahiṃ tiṣṭhed iyaṃ pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā asaṃvāsyeti yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 129. 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. Up to: 'This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful' means with a mind affected by passion. 'Of a lustful man' means of one with a mind affected by passion. 'Within arm's reach' means within [his] range of exertion. 'Should converse' means should whisper in his ear. 'Holding of the hand' means she should grasp his hand, up to even a thumb. 'Holding of the robe' means of the outer robe (<s>saṃghāṭī</s>), or the upper garment (<s>uttarāsaṅga</s>), or the inner garment (<s>antarevāsa</s>), or the shoulder cloth (<s>saṃkakṣikā</s>), or the bathing cloth (<s>dakśāṭikā</s>). 'Should allow' means she should relish it. 'Should welcome his coming' means [saying:] 'Welcome to you, well-come to you, come again and again. I am delighted by your coming. My limbs are gladdened by seeing you.' 'Should invite with a seat' means she should offer him a seat. 'Should offer her person' means she should incline her body toward wherever he is. 'Should go to an agreed meeting place' means wherever his regular resort would be — a shop, a bench, a field or cloth [market], a waterside, a workplace, or a garden, or on the road — if she stands there, this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too commits a <s>pārājika</s> and is expelled. Thus is the rule established.

body.text: 130. sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya anto hastapāśaṃ saṃtiṣṭhati yāvat saṃketaṃ kṛtaṃ gacchati pārājikā bhavati | evaṃ paṇḍakasya striyāḥ sthūlātyayaḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya anto hastapāśaṃ tiṣṭhati yāvat saṃketakṛtam vā gacchati thūl'-accayaṃ | evaṃ paṇḍake striyāyāṃ deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā avaśrutasya anto hastapāśasya saṃtiṣṭhati yāvat saṃketakṛtam vā gacchati sthūlātyayaṃ | evaṃ paṇḍakasya striyāyān deśanāgāmivinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutena puruṣeṇa santiṣṭhati thūl'-accayam | saṃlapati sthūl'-accayaṃ | hastagrahaṇaṃ thūl'-accayam | cīvaragrahaṇaṃ thūl'-accayaṃ | āgatam abhinandati thūl'-accayaṃ | āsanenopanimantreti thūl'-accayaṃ | kāyam anuprayacchati thūl'-accayaṃ | saṃketaṅ gacchati pārājikā bhavati | evam ekaikena padena thūl'-accayaṃ | yāvat saptame sapta thūl'-accayāḥ | aṣṭame pade pārājikā bhavati | atha dāni anukhajjakam āpajjati yadāṣṭau thūl'-accayā bhavanti tadā pārājikā bhavati | atha dāni eka samāpadyitvā pratikaritvā yāvat saptamam āpadyitvā pratikaritvā aṣṭamam āpadyati na sā pārājikā bhavati | atha dāni saptamam āpadyitvā apratikaritvā aṣṭamam āpadyati pārājikā bhavati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 130. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, stands within arm's reach of a lustful man, up to going to an appointed meeting—she commits a <s>pārājika</s> (defeat) offense. Similarly, with a <s>paṇḍaka</s> (eunuch) or a woman, it is a <s>sthūlātyaya</s> (grave offense). If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, stands within arm's reach of a lustful man, up to going to an appointed meeting—it is a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Similarly, with a <s>paṇḍaka</s> or a woman, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression requiring confession (<s>deśanāgāmi</s>). If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, not being lustful, stands within arm's reach of a lustful person, up to going to an appointed meeting—it is a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Similarly, with a <s>paṇḍaka</s> or a woman, she incurs a <s>deśanāgāmi Vinaya</s> transgression. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, stands with a lustful man—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Converses with him—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Accepts his hand—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Accepts his robe—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Welcomes his coming—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Invites him with a seat—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Offers her body—<s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Goes to a meeting—she commits <s>pārājika</s>. Thus, for each step, a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>; up to the seventh, seven <s>sthūlātyayas</s>; at the eighth step, she commits <s>pārājika</s>. Now if she commits them consecutively, when there are eight <s>sthūlātyayas</s>, then she commits <s>pārājika</s>. But if, having committed one and made amends, up to having committed the seventh and made amends, she commits the eighth—she does not commit <s>pārājika</s>. But if, having committed the seventh without making amends, she commits the eighth—she commits <s>pārājika</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya anto hastapāśasya santiṣṭhed vā | saṃlaped vā | hastagrahaṇam vā | cīvaragrahaṇam vā sādīyeya | āgatam vā abhinandeya | āsanena vā upanimantreyeta | kāyam vā anuprayaccheya | saṃketakṛtam vā gaccheya | iyam pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asamvāsya |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being lustful, should stand within arm's reach of a lustful man, or should converse [with him], or should accept a hand-clasp, or should accept a robe-grasp, or should welcome his coming, or should invite him with a seat, or should offer her body, or should go to an appointed meeting—this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too commits <s>pārājika</s> and is not to be lived with.

body.text:
pārājikadharma 7
avadyapratichādikā
body.translated_text: <s>Pārājika-dharma</s> (Defeat Rule) 7: The concealer of offenses.

body.text: 131. bhagavān vaiśālīyaṃ viharati | vistareṇa nidānaṃ kṛtvā | vaiśālīyaṃ dāni nagare aparasya licchavisya triyantarā dārikā jātā | amaṅgalyā apraśastā | teṣān dāni mātāpitṛṇām bhavati | ka imāṃ vivāhayiṣyati | gṛhe pi dhāryamāṇā amaṅgalyā kasyeyan dātavyā | apare āhaṃsuḥ | icchata yūyaṃ etāṃ dārikāṃ unnīyamānāṃ | te dān āhaṃsuḥ | icchāmaḥ | āhaṃsuḥ | eṣātra kālī nāma bhikṣuṇī | tasyā detha sā unneṣyati | tehi dāni sā uktā | ārye 'smākaṃ triyantarā dārikā jātā adhanyā vāmaṅgalyā vāpraśastā vā | tām vayam ānāpeyemaḥ | unnehi vardhehi antevāsinīya te bhaviṣyati | vayaṃ ca te grāsācchādan dāsyāmaḥ | tāya sā parigṛhītā | unneti vardheti | tato devasikaṃ pakvapraheṇakam ānīyati | anuśamaṃ anuśamaṃ ācchādaṃ labhati | hemante hemantikaṃ | varṣākāle varṣāvāsikaṃ | sā yadā mahantībhūtā tadā tāya pravrajitā | śikṣā deśitā | paripūraśikṣā | upasampāditā | tīvrarāgo mātṛgrāmaḥ | sā dāni kleśehi bādhyate | na sahati | sā dān āha | ārye na dāni pravrajyāyāṃ gamiṣyāmy ahaṃ | kleśena bādhyāmi | kālī āha | putri duḥkho gṛhāvāsaḥ | aṅgārakarṣūpamā kāmā uktā bhagavatā | kin te gṛhāvāsena | sā paśyati yadi tāvad iyaṃ pratyodhāvati tato me lābhasatkāro 'ntarahāyiṣyati | sā tāya nigṛhītā vicchinditā | sā dāni kleśān asahantī ārāmikaparivrājakehi sārdhaṃ miśribhūtā | tāya kukṣiḥ pratiladbhodaraṃ mahantībhūtaṃ | sā bhikṣuṇīhi niṣkāśīyati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo āhaṃsuḥ | ārye kāli jānāsi tvam etāṃ āgārakehi parivrājakehi saha miśrībhūtāṃ | āha | jānāmi | evaṃ viropādāya āhaṃsuḥ | kim arthaṃ tvaṃ nārocesi | na jalpasi | paśyāmi yady aham ārocayiṣyaṃ | eṣā gṛhaṃ gamiṣyati | mama eṣa lābhasatkāro antarāhāyiṣyatīti |
body.translated_text: 131. The <s>Bhagavān</s> dwelt in <s>Vaiśālī</s>. Having given the background story in detail: In the city of <s>Vaiśālī</s>, a daughter with three abnormal [physical features] was born to another <s>Licchavi</s> family. She was inauspicious and ill-omened. Her parents thought: 'Who will marry her? Even being kept at home, she is inauspicious—to whom should she be given?' Others said: 'Do you wish this girl to be brought up?' They said: 'We do.' They said: 'There is this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Kālī</s>. Give her to her; she will raise her.' They told her: 'Noble One, a daughter with three abnormal [features] has been born to us—she is unlucky, inauspicious, and ill-omened. We would like to entrust her to you. Raise and nurture her; she will be your pupil. We will provide you with food and clothing.' She accepted her, raised and nurtured her. Then daily, cooked provisions were brought. From time to time she received clothing: winter robes in winter, rain-season robes in the rains. When [the girl] was grown up, [<s>Kālī</s>] ordained her, taught her the training rules—the training was complete—and gave her full ordination. But women are of intense passion. She was overcome by the <s>kleśas</s> (afflictions) and could not endure. She said: 'Noble One, I shall not continue in the going-forth. I am overcome by affliction.' <s>Kālī</s> said: 'Child, household life is suffering. Sensual pleasures have been called like a pit of coals by the <s>Bhagavān</s>. What use is household life for you?' She saw: 'If this one runs back [to lay life], my gains and honors will be cut off.' So she restrained and cut her off. Unable to endure the afflictions, [the girl] became involved with park-attendants and wanderers. She became pregnant, and her belly grew large. She was expelled by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then said: 'Noble <s>Kālī</s>, did you know that this one was involved with laymen and wanderers?' She said: 'I knew.' Reproaching her thus, they said: 'Why did you not report it? Why did you not speak?' 'I saw that if I reported it, she would go back to the household. And my gains and honors would be cut off.'

body.text: 132. etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha kāliṃ | sā śabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | āha | āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te kāli | asti nāma tvaṃ kāli jānantī bhikṣuṇīṃ duṣṭhullāpattim āpanāṃ praticchādesi | yāvan naiṣa kāli dharmo naiṣa vinayo | yāvad bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvatikā bhikṣuṇīyo vaiśālīn nagarīm upaniśritya viharanti | yāvac chikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ |
body.translated_text: 132. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Kālī</s>.' She was summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned her about everything in detail. She said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Kālī</s>. That you, <s>Kālī</s>, knowing [her offense], concealed a <s>bhikṣuṇī's</s> grave offense—this is not the <s>Dharma</s>, this is not the <s>Vinaya</s>.' ... The <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Convene, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—as many <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> as dwell in dependence on the city of <s>Vaiśālī</s>.' ... A training rule was laid down:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī bhikṣuṇīṃ duṣṭhullām āpattiṃ kṛtām adhyācīrṇāṃ chādeya | sā na pareṣām ārocayati kuvege mahājane saṃghamadhye | yadā sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi cyutā bhavati mṛtā niṣaṇṇā avasaṇṇā avakrāntā imasmād dharmavinayād | atha sā bhikṣuṇīnām evam vadeya | ājñāsi vatāham ārye itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye duṣṭhullāmāpatti kṛtāmadhyācīrṇā | sāhaṃ na pareṣām ārocayeyaṃ | kin ti imāye māpare jānantū ti | iyaṃ bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing that a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has committed and performed a grave offense (<s>duṣṭhullā āpatti</s>), should conceal it—she does not report it to others, whether to one person, to a group, or in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. When that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has fallen away from the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, or has died, or has lapsed, or has declined, or has gone over from this <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>—then that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'I knew, Noble Ones, that the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so had committed and performed a grave offense. I did not report it to others, thinking: let no others know about this one.' This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> commits a <s>pārājika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | peyālaṃ | jānantīti svayam vā jāneya parato vā śruṇeya ākāravantena darśanena śravaṇena | duṣṭhullām āpattiṃ ti duṣṭhullānāma aṣṭānām anyatarānyatarā kṛtā adhyācīrṇā | sā na pareṣām āroceya iti na kathayet | kuve ege ti ekāye | mahājane ti dvinnām trayāṇāṃ | saṃghamadhyti paripūrṇasaṃghasya |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>': one who has received full ordination. [Abbreviation.] 'Knowing': she knows either by herself or hears from another, with evidence of seeing or hearing. 'A grave offense': any one of the eight [<s>pārājika</s> offenses], committed and performed. 'She does not report to others': she does not speak of it. 'To one person' (<s>kuvege</s>): to one. 'To a group' (<s>mahājane</s>): to two or three. 'In the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>': of the complete <s>Saṃgha</s>.

body.text: cyutā ti cyutā bhoti brahmacaryāto | mṛtā ti kālagatā | niṣaṇṇā avasaṇṇā ti gṛhiṇībhāvaṅ gatā | avakrāntā imasmād dharmavinayād iti anyatīrthikāyatanaṃ saṃkrāntā | atha sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīnāṃ evaṃ vadeyā | ājñāsi vatāhaṃ ārye itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye duṣṭhullā-m-āpattiḥ kṛtāmadhyācīrṇā | chāye | sāhaṃ na pareṣām ārocaye | kin ti imāye māpare jānantū ti | iyam pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati | pāran nāma vuccati dharmajñānaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Fallen away': fallen from the holy life. 'Died': passed away. 'Lapsed, declined': gone to the state of a householder. 'Gone over from this <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>': transferred to another heretical school. 'Then that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>': 'I knew, Noble Ones, that the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so had committed and performed a grave offense. I concealed it. I did not report it to others, thinking: let no others know about this one.' This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too commits a <s>pārājika</s>. 'Defeat' (<s>pāra</s>) means knowledge of the <s>Dharma</s>. [Abbreviation.] Up to the promulgation.

body.text: 133. sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī paśyati bhikṣuṇīṃ aruṇodgate duṣṭhullām āpattim āpadyantīṃ | no tu cchādanācittaṃ pratilabhate | sūryasyodgamanakālasamaye chādanācittaṃ pratilabhitvā aruṇamudghāte ti iyaṃ bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavati | evaṃ do kālikā aṣṭa parivartā kartavyāḥ | yathā bhikṣuvinaye chādanāyāṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīṃ paśyati duṣṭhullām āpattim adhyācarantīṃ | tāya dāni aparāya ārocayitavyaṃ | atha sā bhoti antevāsiṇī vā sārdhavihāriṇī vā paśyati | yadi ārocayiṣyāmi idānīṃ bhikṣuṇīhi niskāsiṣyatīti anunayasambandhena chādeti pārājikā bhoti | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī paśyati aparāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ āpattim āpadyantīṃ | sā dāni aparāya āroceti dṛṣṭā mayā itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī duṣṭhullām āpattim adhyācarantī | ahaṃ paśyāmi yadi ārocayiṣyatīti dānī bhikṣuṇīhi nirdhāvayiṣyatīti mayā pi cchāditaṃ | sā pi paśyati yadi aham ārocayiṣyaṃ ubhaye nirdhāvayiṣyantīti cchādeti | sā pi pārajikā bhavati | evaṃ yattikāyo cchādenti sarvāyo pārājikā bhonti | eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīṃ paśyati duṣṭhullām āpattim āpadyantīṃ | sā aparān āroceti | itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī duṣṭhullām āpattim āpannā | sā dān āha | pāpaṃ kṛtan tvayā mama ārocayantīya | mā aparāye pi ārocayiṣyasīti thūl'-accyam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī paśyati bhikṣuṇīṃ duṣthullām āpattim adhyācarantīṃ | tāya aparāye ārocayitavyaṃ | atha dāni sā bhoti raudrā vā sāhasakārā paśyati | mā se jīvitāntarāyaṃ vā brahmacaryāntarāyam vā kariṣyatīti upekṣā partilabhati anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 133. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sees a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> committing a grave offense at dawn, but does not conceive the intention to conceal it—[then] at the time of sunrise, having conceived the intention to conceal it at dawn—this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> commits <s>pārājika</s>. Thus, for two time-periods, eight permutations should be made, as in the concealment [section] of the <s>bhikṣu-vinaya</s>. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sees a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> committing a grave offense, she should report it to another. But if that one is her pupil or co-resident, and she sees: 'If I report it, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> will now expel her'—and out of affection conceals it, she commits <s>pārājika</s>. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sees another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> committing an offense, and she reports it to another: 'I saw the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so committing a grave offense. I see that if I report it, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> will now expel her—so I too have concealed it.' If she too sees: 'If I report it, both will be expelled'—and conceals it, she too commits <s>pārājika</s>. Thus, however many conceal it, all commit <s>pārājika</s>. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sees a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> committing a grave offense and reports it to another—'The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so has committed a grave offense'—and [the offender] says: 'You have done wrong by reporting to me! Don't report it to anyone else!'—she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sees a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> committing a grave offense, she should report it to another. But if that one is violent or reckless, and she sees: 'She may endanger my life or endanger my holy life'—and remains indifferent, there is no offense. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī bhikṣuṇīye duṣṭhullām āpattiṃ kṛtām adhyācīrṇāṃ chādeya | sā na pareṣām ārocayet kuvege mahājane saṃghamadhye | yadā sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi cyutā bhavati mṛtā niṣaṇṇā avasaṇṇā avakrāntā imasmād dharmavinayād | atha bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīnām evam vadeya ājñāsi vatāhaṃ ārye itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye duṣṭhullā-m-āpatti kṛtāmadhyācīrṇā | sāhaṃ na pareṣām ārocayeyaṃ | kin ti imāye māpare jānantū ti | iyaṃ pi bhikṣuṇī pārājikā bhavaty asamvāsyā |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing that a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has committed and performed a grave offense, should conceal it—she does not report it to others, whether to one person, to a group, or in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. When that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has fallen away from the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, or has died, or has lapsed, or has declined, or has gone over from this <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>—then that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'I knew, Noble Ones, that the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so had committed and performed a grave offense. I did not report it to others, thinking: let no others know about this one.' This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> too commits <s>pārājika</s> and is not to be lived with.

body.text: pārājikadharma 8
body.translated_text: <s>Pārājika-dharma</s> (Defeat Rule) 8

body.text: utkṣiptānuvartikā
body.translated_text: The follower of one who has been suspended (<s>utkṣiptānuvartikā</s>).
