body.text: atha khalv āyuṣmān ānando bhagavantam etad avocat | kiṃ bhagavann imāhi śākiyāyinīhi purā pāpaṃ karma kṛtam yena etāyo evaṃ duḥkhām vedanām vedayanti | bhagavān āha | bhūtapūrvam ānanda etāyo śākiyāyinīyo ihaiva śrāvastyāṃ ṣaḍ gaṇikāyo abhūvan | ihaiva śrāvastīyaṃ kālo nāma pratyekabhuddho abhūṣi | so dāni piṇḍāya caranto tāhi gaṇikāhi ukto | ayaṃ dāni śramaṇo svayaṃ kāmān paribhuñjati | kāmānāṃ cāvarṇaṃ bhāṣati | tāhi hāsyābhiprāyāhi viheṭhanābhiprāyāhi anyehi duruktehi vacanapathehi obhartsito aṅgāramallakehi cāvakīrṇaḥ | so dāni ānanda pratyekabuddho duḥkhāya vedanāya spṛṣṭaḥ kharāṃ kaṭukāṃ vedanāṃ vedayanto kāyena ca jīvitena ca ardiyanto tatraiva vihāya samabhyudgamya anupādāya parinivṛtaḥ | pūrvādhiṣṭhitena ca svakena tejodhātunā tasya śarīraṃ vyāpinaṃ | tāyo dāni gaṇikāyo bhītayo pāpakam asmābhiḥ karmopacitaṃ | bahu apuṇyaṃ prasūtaṃ | īdṛśo mahābhāgo ṛṣir viheṭhitaḥ | tad asmākaṃ duḥkhaṃ vedanīyaṃ bhaviṣyati | tāhi dāni vipratisāraṃ jānāhi | tasya śarīraṃ parigṛhya stūpam akareṃsuḥ | chatradhvajapatākāhi ca pūjayeṃsuḥ | puṣpadhūpagandhehi ca pūjayeṃsuḥ | evaṃ ca praṇidheṃsuḥ | anāgatam adhvānam vayam etādṛśaṃ śāstāram ārāgayemaḥ | yeṣāṃ pāñcadharmāṇām ayaṃ lābhī | tān vayam api lapsyāma iti | tāyo etāyo tena pāpena karmeṇa kṛtena yāvan narakeṣūpapannāyo etāyo tahiṃ bahūni varṣasahasrāṇi duḥkham anubhaveṃsuḥ | etāhi ānanda bālapṛthagjanāhi hasantīhi pāpakarma kṛtaṃ | yasya aśrumukhā pi pāpakam pratisamvedayanti | yam etāhi sā pūjā kṛtā vipratisāraś cotpāditaḥ | yaṃ ca praṇidhānaṃ anāgatam adhvānaṃ etādṛśaṃ śastāram ārāgayemaḥ | yeṣān dharmāṇām ayaṃ lābhī | tān vayam api lapsyāma iti | yāvat pañcānām avarabhāgīyānāṃ saṃyojanānāṃ yāvat tatra parinirvāyinyaḥ | ko nāmāyaṃ bhagavan dharmaparyāyaḥ | kathaṃ caināṃ dhārayāmi | bhagavān āha | tasmāt tvam ānanda imaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ kāraṇavaipulyan nāma dhāraya idam avocat |
body.translated_text: Then the Venerable <s>Ānanda</s> said this to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'What evil <s>karma</s> was done previously by these <s>Śākya</s> women, <s>Bhagavān</s>, that they experience such painful sensations?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Formerly, <s>Ānanda</s>, these <s>Śākya</s> women were six courtesans here in this very <s>Śrāvastī</s>. And here in <s>Śrāvastī</s> there was a <s>Pratyekabuddha</s> named <s>Kāla</s>.'

body.text: 157. bhikṣuṇīyo dāni kapilavastunagare ruddhe virūḍhakena | kāścid anto nagare nilīnāḥ kāścid bahir nirgatāḥ | bhikṣuṇīyo bhikṣuṇīhi vipravustāyo | tāsāṃ kaurkṛtyaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi anāpattiḥ akāmikāye nagararuddhāye |
body.translated_text: 157. Now when the city of <s>Kapilavastu</s> was besieged by <s>Virūḍhaka</s>, some <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were trapped inside the city and some had gone outside. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> were separated from <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. They had remorse [about violating the rule of not staying apart]. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, there is no offense for one who is unwilling [to be separated] when trapped in a besieged city.'

body.text: bhagavāṃ śrāvastīyaṃ viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo adhvānaṃ gacchanti | tatra dāni bhikṣuṇī jarādurbalā | vyādhidurbalā | sārthāto parihīṇā ti | bhikṣuṇīyo atikrāntāyo | tāyo dāni kaukṛtyaṃ | kaukṛtyena mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahaprajāpatī gautamī bhagavantam ārocayati | bhagavān āha | tena hi anāpattiḥ | akāmikāya | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> were traveling on a road. There a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, weak from old age and weak from illness, fell behind the caravan. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> had gone ahead. They had remorse. Out of remorse they informed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> informed the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore [there is no offense in such a case].'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīya vinā ekarātram pi vipravaseya anyatrasamayena | tatrāyaṃ samayo glānā bhikṣuṇī bhavati | nagaroparodhe vā ruddhā bhavati | ayam atra samayo |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> spends even one night apart from another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, except on a [permissible] occasion—the occasion here is: the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is ill, or she is trapped in a city under siege. This is the occasion here.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasaṃpannā | bhikṣuṇībhir vinā ti advitīyaṃ | ekaṃ rātram pi vipravaseyā ti aruṇamudagame ca anyatrasamaye | tatrāyaṃ samayo akāmikā bhikṣuṇī bhavati | jarāburbalā vā vyādhidurbalā vā nagaroparodho vā | etaṃ tāva nagaraṃ paracakreṇovaruddham bhavati | kiñcāpi bhikṣuṇī anto nagarato bahirdhā nirdhāvati bahirdhāto vā anto nagaraṃ praviśati | kiñcāpi praviśati anāpattiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī sasūrye vinā bhūtā bhikṣuṇīhi vipravustā aruṇamudghāteti saṃghātiśeṣo | astamite sūrye vinā bhūtā aruṇamudghātayati thūl'-accayaṃ | bhikṣuṇīvihāre anyatra vā sarvāhi anto hastapāśasya pratikramitavyaṃ | trikkhatto rātrīya anyamanyasamavadhānaṃ dātavyaṃ | hastena parāmṛṣitavyaṃ | na khalu sakṛd eva |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'Apart from <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>'—means without a companion. 'Should dwell apart even for one night'—means until the rising of dawn, except in the proper circumstances. The proper circumstances are these: the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is unwilling [to be apart]; or she is weakened by old age or weakened by illness; or there is a siege of the city. When the city is besieged by a foreign army, even if the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> runs outside from within the city, or enters the city from outside—even if she enters, there is no offense. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is apart from <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> while the sun is still [up] and dawn rises, it is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. If she is apart after the sun has set and dawn rises, it is a grave transgression (<s>sthūlātyaya</s>). Whether in the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> monastery or elsewhere, all must sleep within arm's reach. Three times during the night, mutual check-in must be given. [Each one] must be touched by hand—not just once.

body.text: atha khalu yāme yāme purime yāme samavadhānaṃ na deti vinayātikramam āsādayati | madhyame yāme na deti vinayātikramam āsādayati | paścime yāme na deti vinayātikramam āsādayati | sarvatra dadāti anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: Now, watch by watch: if she does not give the check-in during the first watch, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. If she does not give it during the middle watch, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. If she does not give it during the last watch, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. If she gives it in all [watches], there is no offense.

body.text: atha dāni dvibhūmakaṃ bhavati ekā heṣṭhime pratikramati aparā uparime | trikkhatto rātrau avataritavyaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now, if there is a two-storied [building], one sleeps on the lower floor and another on the upper. Three times during the night she must come down. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā punabhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhi vinā ekarātram pi vipravasiya anyatrasamaye | tatrāyaṃ samayo glānā bhikṣuṇī bhavati | nagaro parodhe vā ruddhā bhavati ayam atra samayo | ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko saṃghātiśeṣo |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> dwells apart from <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> even for one night, except in the proper circumstances—the proper circumstances being these: the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is ill, or she is confined during a siege of the city—these are the proper circumstances. This too is an offense of the first category, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma 7 ananujñātā
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rule 7: [Ordaining] without permission

body.text: 158. bhagavān śrāvastyāṃ viharati | rājagṛhe dāni aparasya abhaṭagaṇasya sudinnikā nāma bhāryā taruṇī | prāsādikā darśanīyā | so dāni kālagato | sā strī puruṣeṇārthikā | sa devaro saṃkaletukāmo | sā strī striṇām āha | āryamiśrikā ahaṃ puruṣeṇa anarthikā | ayaṃ ca devaro mama saṃkaletukāmo | aparā strī āha | icchasi muccituṃ | sā dān āha | icchāmi | sā āha | gaccha śrāvastīṃ | taṃhi dāni kālī nāma bhikṣuṇī prativasati | sā te pravrājayiṣyati | sā dāni nirdhāvitā | śrāvastīṃ gatā | sā bhikṣuṇīvihāraṃ gatvā pṛcchati | katamaṃ āryāye kālīye pariveṇaṃ | aparāhi darṣitaḥ darśitaḥ eṣo ti | sā tām upasaṃkramitvā āha | icchāmi ārye pravrajituṃ | sā tāya pravrajitā upasaṃpāditā | so dāni manuṣyo mārgati saṃkaleṣyāmīti | na labhati | so dāni śṛṇoti | śrāvastīyaṃ kālī nāma śrāmaṇikā | tāye pravrājiteti | so dāni puruṣo anupūrveṇa śrāvastīṃ gatvā pṛcchati | katamo 'tra bhikṣuṇīvihāraḥ | aparāhi darśita eṣo ti | so tahiṃ praviśetivā | pṛcchati yāvād āha katamā āryā kālīti sā dān āha | ahaṃ | so dān āha | prāptakālan nāma āryāye mama bhāryām anotsṛṣṭāṃ pravrājayituṃ | sā dān āha | kutaḥ punas tvaṃ dīrghāyuḥ | so dān āha | rājagṛhāto | sā dān āha | caṇḍāyuṣo nas tvaṃ nagaraṃ praviṣṭaḥ | sāntevāsinī nām āha | ānetha saṃghāṭiṃ yāvad imaṃ caṇḍāyuṃ dhare cāṭikaṃ bandhāpayāmi | so dāni puruṣo bhītaḥ paśyati | yāvad iyaṃ śramaṇikā dhṛṣṭā ca mukharā ca bandhāpayeya iti | so manuṣyo ojjhāyati ca osakkati ca yāvad bahir gatvā bhikṣuṇīnāṃ mahājanakāyasyārocayati | paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇikā bhāryām ca me anotsṛṣṭāṃ pravrājayati mama ca bhandhanena santarjeti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayanti | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha kāliṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | etad eva sarvaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te kāli | evan nāma tvaṃ anujñāpakehi ananujñātām upasthāpayasi | tena hi na kṣamati anujñāpakehi ananujñātām upasthāpayituṃ |
body.translated_text: 158. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. In <s>Rājagṛha</s>, there was a young wife named <s>Sudinnikā</s> of another family group. She was pleasing and beautiful. Her [husband] died. That woman desired a man. Her brother-in-law wished to marry her. That woman said to [other] women: 'Noble ladies, I have no need of a man.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīyo āhaṃsuḥ | paśya bhagavan katham iyaṃ kālīya pratyutpannapratibhānatāya mocitā | sa ca puruṣo bhītaḥ prapalānaḥ | bhagavān āha | na ceṣā bhikṣuṇīyo kālīya etarhy eva pratyutpannapratibhānatāya mocitā | eṣa ca puruṣo bhītaḥ prapalānaḥ | anyadāpy eṣā etāya pratyutpannapratibhānatāya mocitā | eṣa ca puruṣo bhītaḥ prapalānaḥ |
body.translated_text: The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> said: 'Look, Lord, how she was rescued by <s>Kālī</s>'s presence of mind. And that man fled in fear.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'It is not only now that this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> was rescued by <s>Kālī</s>'s presence of mind and that man fled in fear. There is another [occasion as well].'

body.text: bhūtapūrvaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo iyam eva nagarī vārāṇasī | iyaṃ strī rātrau dārikāṃ skandhenādāya gacchati | siṃho ca purataḥ pratyupasthito | sā dāni dārikā dṛṣṭvā ruditā | tāya striyāya sā dārikā capeṭāya āhatā | eko te siṃho khādito etam pi khāditukāmāsi | siṃhaḥ paśyati | yādṛśī eṣā strī dhvāṅkṣā ca mukharā ca khādaty | eṣā mamāyīti | bhītaḥ prapalāyati | purato markaṭaḥ āgatvā siṃhaṃ pṛcchati | mṛgarājaputra kahiṃ gamiṣyasi | siṃho jalpati | bhayaṃ me upatannaṃ | vānaraḥ pṛcchati | kīdṛśaṃ bhayaṃ | siṃho vistareṇācikṣati | so jalpati | naivaṃ vaktavyaṃ | siṃhas tvaṃ mṛgarāja | kas tvāṃ prahariṣyati | āgacchāhi nivartāhi | sa necchati | siṃho vānareṇa keśehi gṛhītaḥ | āgacchāhīti | sā dārikā dṛṣṭvā praruditā | sā strī jalpati mā rodāhi dārike | eṣo tava mātuḥ kenānīto keśehi gṛhītvā | idāniṃ yan naṃ icchasi taṃ se khādāhīti | siṃhaḥ paśyati | mā haivaṃ saṃketakṛtaṃ bhaviṣyati | evam evānīyānīya deti | eṣāpi khādati | yat tāvad ahaṃ ekaṃ vāraṃ prapalānaḥ kiṃ bhūyo nivartitaḥ | so dāni tasya markaṭasya avadhunitvā prapalānaḥ | devatā gāthāṃ bhāṣate |
body.translated_text: In the past, this very city was <s>Vārāṇasī</s>. This woman was walking at night, carrying a girl on her shoulders. A lion appeared before them. The girl, seeing it, began to cry. That woman struck the girl with a slap, [saying]: 'One lion has already eaten [your share]; do you want to be eaten too?'

children.translated_text: This quick wit
did not arise after long deliberation;
see how the fear of the lion,
once arisen, was turned back by her presence of mind.

body.text: bhagavān āha | syād bhikṣuṇīyo yuṣmākam evam asyād anyā sā strī abhūṣi | naitad evaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | iyam eva sā kālī strī abhūṣi | syād bhikṣuṇīyo yuṣmākam evam asyād anyā sā dārikā ti | naitad evaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | iyam eva sā sudinnikā dārikā abhūṣi | syād bhikṣuṇīyo yuṣmākam evam asyād anyo so siṃho abhūṣīti | naitad evaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | eṣo so manuṣyo siṃho abhūṣi | tadāpy eṣā etāya pratyutpannapratibhānatāya mocitā | eṣa ca puruṣo bhītaḥ prapalānaḥ |
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: '<s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s>, you might think that was a different woman. It should not be seen thus. That was this very <s>Kālī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s>, you might think that was a different girl. It should not be seen thus. That was this very <s>Sudinnikā</s> [as a girl]. You might think [the lion was different—it should not be seen thus].'

body.text: 159. atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 159. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>—up to: so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anujñāpakehi ananujñātām upasthāpayed ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko saṃghātiśeṣo |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains [a woman] who has not been given permission by those who should give permission—this too is an offense of the first category, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasaṃpannā | anujñāpakehi ananujñātām iti avūḍhāya dārikāya mātāpitarau anujñāpakā | vūḍhāya śvaśruśvaśurau patidevarau | upasthāpayed iti upasaṃpādayet | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anujñāpakehi ananujñātām pravrājayati vinayātikramam āsādyati | śikṣāṃ deti thūl'-accayam āsādayati | upasaṃpādeti saṃghātiśeṣo eṣā kācit pravrajyāpekṣā āgacchati praṣṭavyā | anujñātāsi anujñāpakehi | yadi tāvad āha nahīti | avūḍhā vaktavyā | mātāpitarau anujānāpayitvā āgacchāhīti | vūḍhā vaktavyā patidevarau śvaśruśvaśurāv anujānāpayitvā āgacchāhīti | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣu���ī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'Without permission from those who give permission'—for an unmarried girl, the parents are those who give permission; for a married woman, the parents-in-law and the husband's brothers [are those who give permission]. 'Should ordain'—means should give full ordination (<s>upasampadā</s>). If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> gives the going forth to one without permission from those who give permission, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. [If she gives full ordination, it is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>].

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anujñāpakehi ananujñātām upasthāpayed ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko saṃghātiśeṣo |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains [a woman] who has not been given permission by those who should give permission—this too is an offense of the first category, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma 8
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rule 8

body.text:
vadhyā
160. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | mallā nāmā mallakalyo nāma nigamo | taṃhi dāni aparasya mallasya bhāryā parapuruṣeṇa sārdham abhicarati | so dān āha | asuke virama | ato doṣo | 'to mā te aham evañ ca evañ ca asat kariṣyaṃ | sā dāni duṣṭā na viramati | mariṣyāmy ahaṃ | na punar aham ato doṣato viramiṣyaṃ | tena sā sahoḍhaṃ gṛhītvā āsane upanāmitā | iccheyam ahaṃ bhavanto imāṃ svadharmeṇa lambhiyamānāṃ | kaḥ punas teṣāṃ svadharmaḥ mallānāṃ | yā strī anyena puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ abhicarati | sā saptadivasāni dānavisargaṃ kārapetvā ubhayato jñātisaṃghasya purato gopāṭikāya pāṭīyati | āsanikā āhaṃsuḥ | dinnā bhavatu svadharme labhehi | tena dāni puruṣeṇa gṛhaṃ nayitvā uktā | itikitikāya dhīte dada yat te asti ca nāsti ca | sapta divasāni ahaṃ te ubhayato jñātisaṃghasya purato gopāṭikāya pāṭayiṣyaṃ | sā dāni ubhayato jñātisaṃghaṃ sannipātetvā annaṃ pānaṃ khādyaṃ bhojyaṃ samudānīya rodati | striyo āhaṃsuḥ | kiṃ ruditena tvayaiva tathā ceṣṭitaṃ yena tvam evaṃ duḥkham anubhaviṣyasi | sā dān āha | nāhaṃ karomi | mariṣyan ti | api tu ubhayato jñātisaṃghasya purato gopāṭikāya pāṭayiṣyan ti | evaṃ rodāmi | aparā āha | icchasi tvaṃ muccituṃ | sā dān āha | icchāmi | āha | gaccha śrāvastīṃ | tahiṃ kālī nāma bhikṣuṇī | sā te pravrājayiṣyati | sā tasyā vacanaṃ śrutvā janasya khādyantasya pibantasya pramattasya yathā vā tathā vā nirdhāvitvā anupūrveṇa pṛcchapṛcchikāya śrāvastīm āgatā | pṛcchati | katamo 'tra bhikṣuṇīvihāro | aparāhi darśitaḥ | sā dāni praviśitvā pṛcchati | katamā āryakālī | aparāhi ākhyātā | eṣā ti | sā tām upasaṃkramya āha | icchāmy āryāya pravrājīyamānāṃ | sā dān āha | anujñātāsi anujñāpakehi | sā dān āha | ke puna ārye anujñāpakāḥ | āha | avūḍhāye dārikāye mātāpitarau | vūḍhāya śvaśruśvaśurau patidevarāḥ | āha | tadā eṣāham anujñātā | yadāhaṃ gopāṭikāya nisṛṣṭā sunisṛṣṭā | āha | putriṇi yā tvaṃ nisṛṣṭā sunisṛṣṭā yā tvaṃ gopāṭikāyāṃ nisṛṣṭā | sā tāya pravrājitā upasaṃpāditā | so manuṣyo mārgayati | gopāṭikāya pāṭiṣyāmīti na labhasi | so dāni śṛṇoti | śrāvastīyaṃ kālī nāma bhikṣuṇī | tāya pravrājitā | śrāvastīm āgatvā pṛcchati | katamo 'tra bhikṣuṇīvihāro | aparehi ākhyāto eṣo ti yāvat | sa tahiṃ praviśitvā | āryā kālī nāma | āha | kim kartavyaṃ | prāptan nāmāryāya mama bhāryām anotsṛṣṭām pravrājayituṃ | sā dān āha | kutas tvaṃ | āha | āmalakakalyato | āha | caṇḍāyu coras tvam ocorakas tvam ocaritukāmo tvaṃ śrāvastīyaṃ praviṣṭaḥ | na tvaṃ jānāsi nityaviruddhāḥ śrāvasteyāḥ āmalakakalyāś ca | sā dāni antevāsinīṃ śabdāpayati | ānehi tāva samaghāṭim yāvad imaṃ caṇḍāyuṃ dhare cāṭikaṃ rājakule bhandhāpemi | so manuṣyo paśyati | yādṛśī iyaṃ śramaṇikā dhṛṣṭā ca mukharā ca pragalbhā ca | bhandhāpeyaṃsi | eṣa so dāni puruṣo ojjhāyati ca osakkati ca | so dāni puruṣo bhikṣuṇī nāṃ mahājanakāyasya ca puro ojjhāyati | paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇikā bhāryāñ ca me anotsṛṣṭāṃ pravrājeti | mama ca bandhanena tarjayati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayanti | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: A Woman Condemned to Death (<s>vadhyā</s>). 160. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. There is a <s>Malla</s> town called <s>Mallakalya</s>. Now, the wife of a certain <s>Malla</s> was committing adultery with another man. He said: 'So-and-so, stop! This is a fault. Otherwise I shall do such-and-such unpleasant things to you.' But she, being wicked, did not stop: 'I shall die, but I will not cease from this fault.' He then took her together with [the evidence] and presented her before the assembly [of elders]: 'I wish, sirs, that this woman be dealt with according to our customary law.' What was the customary law of those <s>Mallas</s>? A woman who commits adultery with another man is made to provide provisions for seven days, and then, before the assembly of relatives from both sides, she is sawn in two with a saw (<s>gopāṭikā</s>). The donors said: 'Let it be granted; deal with her according to customary law.' That man then took her home and said: 'You daughter of a servant woman, give whatever you have and do not have! For seven days I shall saw you in two with a saw before the assembly of relatives from both sides.' She then, having assembled the relatives from both sides and having gathered food, drink, and provisions, wept. The women said: 'What use is weeping? You yourself acted in such a way that you will suffer this.' She said: 'It is not [the death] that I grieve for. I shall die. But that I shall be sawn in two with a saw before the assembly of relatives from both sides — for that I weep.' Another woman said: 'Do you wish to escape?' She said: 'I do.' [The other woman] said: 'Go to <s>Śrāvastī</s>. There is a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Kālī</s>. She will ordain you.' Hearing her words, while people were eating and drinking and inattentive, she fled one way or another and, asking along the way, arrived at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. She asked: 'Where is the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> monastery?' Others showed her. She entered and asked: 'Which one is the noble <s>Kālī</s>?' Others pointed her out: 'This one.' She approached her and said: 'I wish to be ordained by the noble one.' She said: 'Have you been given permission by those who give permission?' She said: 'Who are those who give permission, noble lady?' [<s>Kālī</s>] said: 'For an unmarried girl, the mother and father. For a married woman, the parents-in-law and brothers-in-law.' She said: 'Then I am indeed permitted — for I have been released, fully released, for the sawing [execution].'

body.text: duṣkṛtaṃ te kāli | evan nāma tvaṃ jānantī vadhyāṃ viditāṃ jñātidaṇḍaprāptām upasthāpayasi | tena hi na kṣamati jānantī vadhyāṃ viditāṃ jñātidaṇḍaprāptām upasthāpayituṃ |
body.translated_text: 'You have done wrong, <s>Kālī</s>! How could you knowingly ordain a condemned woman (<s>vadhyā</s>), one who is known [to be condemned], one who has received the penalty of her relatives? Therefore, it is not permissible to knowingly ordain a condemned woman who is known [to be condemned] and who has received the penalty of her relatives.'

body.text: 161. eṣaivārthotpattiḥ | śākyānāṃ śākyāvāno nāma nigamaḥ | evam eva vistareṇa kartavyaṃ | yāvad anyā tāva mayā īdṛśī yeva pravrājitā | tatra mayā daṇḍakarma ladbhaṃ | gaccha notsahāmi pravrājayituṃ | sā dāni aparāparāsāṃ bhikṣuṇīnām allīnā na kācit pravrājeti | yāvat tīrthikehi pravrājitā | so manuṣyo mārgati | gopāṭikāya pāṭiṣyan ti | na labhati | tena śrutaṃ śrāvastyāṃ tīrthikehi pravrājitā | so dān āha | idānīṃ sā itikitikāya dhītā sumahatā dṛṣṭadhārmikena ca vadhena | yaṃ upāsakadhītā tirthikehi pravrājitā | so punar na gaveṣati na pṛcchati | sā pi dāni tena tīrthikabhāvena tīrthikabhāvenārtīyati | te dāni tīrthikā durākhyātā adharmāṇāḥ | taṇḍulodakañ ca pibanti | sthālīdhovanañ ca pibanti | nagnā ahrīkā anotrāpiṇo istrikāmā pi dūṣenti | sā strī bhikṣuṇīnām āha | moha bhāginī asmākaṃ pravrajyā gartasmi patitā | nirayasmi patitā | prapātasmi patitā | uttarayātha māṃ | anukampayatha māṃ | uddharatha māṃ | anukampayatha māṃ | pravrājetha māṃ | tā dāni necchanti | sā dāni mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye allīnā | mahāprajāpatī gautamī ca bhagavato āroceti | bhagavān āha | labhyā | yas tatrāvarṇaḥ sa tīrthikeṣu gataḥ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami tāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 161. This is the same origin story [told differently]. The <s>Śākyas</s> have a town called <s>Śākyāvana</s>. [The account proceeds] in the same way in detail, up to: 'I have already ordained another such woman. In that case, I received a disciplinary penalty. Go — I am not willing to ordain you.' She then clung to one <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> after another, but none would ordain her. Finally she was ordained by <s>tīrthikas</s> (non-Buddhist ascetics). That man searched for her, intending to saw her with the saw. He could not find her. Then he heard: 'In <s>Śrāvastī</s>, she has been ordained by the <s>tīrthikas</s>.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī vadhyāṃ viditāṃ jñātidaṇḍaprāptām upasthāpayed anyatra samaye | tatrāyaṃ samayaḥ anyatīrthikapūrvā bhavati | ayam pi dharmo prathamāpattiko saṃghātiśeṣo |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should knowingly ordain a condemned woman (<s>vadhyā</s>), one who is known [to be condemned], one who has received the penalty of her relatives — except in a [permissible] circumstance. The permissible circumstance here is: she was previously a member of another [non-Buddhist] sect. This too is an offense at the first commission, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: 162. yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | jānantīti svayam vā jāneya parato vā śruṇeya | vadhyām iti ghātyāṃ | viditān ti ubhayato jñātisaṃghasya mātṛpakṣasya pitṛpakṣasya ca |
body.translated_text: 162. 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Knowingly' means she knows herself or has heard from another. 'Condemned to death' (<s>vadhyā</s>) means one who is to be killed. 'Known' (<s>viditā</s>) means by the assembly of relatives from both sides — the maternal and paternal sides.

body.text: jñāti daṇḍaprāptāṃ ti | jñātayo nāma kṣatriyāṅ brāhmaṇāḥ vaiśyāḥ śūdrāḥ ambaṣṭhavaidehāḥ bhaṭanāḥ kuṅkumālāḥ | yāvat keṣāñcit gopāṭikāya pāṭīyati | keṣāñcit kīṭena vā kāliñjena vā veṭhayitvā dahyati | keṣāñcit vālukāghaṭakaṃ kaṇṭhe badhvā udake praveśiyati | keṣāñcicchīrṣaṃ pradhamīyati | keṣāñcit karṇanāsā chidyanti | keṣāñcit taptaṃ phālaṃ vraṇamukhe anuśrotaṃ prakṣipīyati |
body.translated_text: 'One who has received the penalty of her relatives' — 'relatives' here means <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, <s>Vaiśyas</s>, <s>Śūdras</s>, <s>Ambaṣṭhas</s>, <s>Vaidehas</s>, <s>Bhaṭanas</s>, <s>Kuṅkumālas</s>. Among some, she is sawn in two with a saw (<s>gopāṭikā</s>). Among some, she is wrapped in thorns or <s>kāliñja</s> [reeds] and burned. Among some, a pot filled with sand is tied to her neck and she is thrown into the water. Among some, her head is crushed. Among some, the nose and ears are cut off. Among some, a heated ploughshare is placed in the wound-opening along the direction [of the body].

body.text: mallānāṃ śākyānāṃ ca gopāṭikāya pāṭīyati | kṣatriyāṇāṃ palālena śarehi ca veṭhayitvā dahyati | abhīrāṇām vālukāya ghaṭaṃ kaṇṭhe bhadhvā udake prakṣipati | śakayavanānāṃ śīrṣaṃ pradhamīyati | karṇanāsā vā chidyanti | taptam vā phālaṃ anuśrote vraṇamukhe prakṣipīyanti |
body.translated_text: Among the <s>Mallas</s> and <s>Śākyas</s>, she is sawn with the saw. Among <s>Kṣatriyas</s>, she is wrapped in straw and arrows and burned. Among the <s>Ābhīras</s>, a pot filled with sand is tied to her neck and thrown into the water. Among the <s>Śaka-Yavanas</s> (Indo-Scythians/Indo-Greeks), her head is crushed, or her nose and ears are cut off, or a heated ploughshare is placed in the wound-opening along the direction [of the body].

body.text: upasthāpayed iti pravrājayed upasampādayed | anyatra samaye ti pratyuddhṛtaṃ bhagavatā padaṃ anāpattiḥ | anyatra samaye tatrāyaṃ samayaḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Should ordain' means should grant the going-forth or grant the full ordination. 'Except in a [permissible] circumstance' — the <s>Bhagavān</s> has exempted the case: no offense. Except in a circumstance — the permissible circumstance here is:

body.text: anyatīrthikapūrvā bhavati | anyatīrthikā nāma | carakaparivrājakanirgranthājīvakatredaṇḍikāḥ mākandikāḥ gudugudukāḥ gautamadharmacintakāḥ vṛddhaśrāvakaḥ dakatṛtīyakāḥ yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'She was previously a member of another [non-Buddhist] sect.' 'Other sects' means: <s>Carakas</s>, <s>Parivrājakas</s>, <s>Nirgranthas</s>, <s>Ājīvakas</s>, <s>Tredaṇḍikas</s>, <s>Mākandikās</s>, <s>Gudugudukās</s>, <s>Gautama</s> followers, Dharma contemplators, Elder disciples, those who practice with water as the third [element]. Up to the rule establishment.

body.text: sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī jānantī vadhyāṃ viditāṃ jñāti daṇḍaprāptāṃ pravrajayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | śikṣāṃ deti thūl'-accayam āsādayati | upasampādeti saṃghātiśeṣā | tena bhagavān āha | yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī vadhyāṃ viditāṃ jñātidaṇḍaprāptām upasthāpayet | anyatra samaye | tatrāyaṃ samayaḥ | anyatīrthikapūrvā bhavati | ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko |
body.translated_text: If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> knowingly grants the going-forth to a condemned, known, clan-penalty-received woman, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression). If she gives her training, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s> (grave offense). If she grants full ordination, it is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should knowingly ordain a condemned woman, one who is known, one who has received the penalty of her relatives — except in a [permissible] circumstance. The permissible circumstance here is: she was previously a member of another sect. This too is an offense at the first commission.

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma 9
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> Rule 9

body.text: ekā nadin tareya
body.translated_text: Crossing a River Alone (<s>ekā nadīṃ tareya</s>)

body.text: 163 bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | atha saṃbahulā striyo nadīyam ajirāvatīyaṃ snāyanti | sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī tatraiva sthāya gatā | sā tāvad ekānte cīvarakāṇi nikṣipya bāhubhyāṃ pratīrṇā | tā dāni striyo āhaṃsuḥ | eṣā āryā sthūlanandā āgacchatīti | sā kayadhānake muhūrtam viśramitvā punar evāgatā | striyo āhaṃsuḥ | eṣā āryā sthūlanandā āgatā | aticāpalam āryāya kṛtaṃ | kathaṃ tvam bāhubhyāṃ tarasi | tā dāni striyo ojjhāyitāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocenti | mahāprajāpatī gautami bhagavato āroceti yāvad bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande | evaṃ ca nāma tvaṃ ekākinī nadīṃ tarasi | tena hi na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya vinā nadīn tarituṃ |
body.translated_text: 163. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, many women were bathing in the river <s>Ajirāvatī</s> (Aciravatī). The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s> also went to the same place. She, setting aside her robes in a secluded spot, swam across with her arms. The women said: 'Here comes the noble <s>Sthūlanandā</s>!' She, having rested for a moment at a landing spot, came back again. The women said: 'The noble <s>Sthūlanandā</s> has returned. The noble lady has acted very recklessly! How can you swim across with [just] your arms...'

body.text: atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>... until [the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīya vinā nadīn tare ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should cross a river without [another] <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, this too is an offense at the first commission.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | bhikṣuṇīya vinā ti advitīyā | nadīti yā bahiḥ sīmāto pravahantī bahiḥ sīmām upeti | tareyā ti aparāt pāraṃ gaccheya | ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko | yāvatā ca etāyo bhikṣuṇīyo nadīn taranti anto hastapāśe taritavyaṃ | paraṃ haste pāśe taranti thūl'-accayaṃ | dūreṇa dūraṃ bhavanti saṃghātiśeṣo | athavaikā madhye tiṣṭhati aparā taranti thūl'-accayaṃ | yāvad evam aparāparanti sarvāḥ thūl'-accayam āsādayanti | etāyo bhikṣuṇīyo nadyāṃ snāyanti ante hastapāśena snātavyaṃ | paraṃ hastapāśā snāyanti vinayātikramam āsādayanti | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Without a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means without a companion. 'River' means one that flows outside the boundary (<s>sīmā</s>) and reaches outside the boundary. 'Should cross' means she should go from the near to the far shore. This too is an offense at the first commission. As long as these <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> cross the river, they should cross within arm's reach [of each other]. If they cross more than arm's reach apart, it is a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. If they become far from each other, it is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. Or if one stands in the middle while the others cross, it is a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Up to: in the same way...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīya vinā nadīn tareya | ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko saṃghātiśeṣo ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should cross a river without [another] <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, this too is an offense at the first commission, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma 10
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> Rule 10

body.text: utkṣiptakā
body.translated_text: One Who Has Been Expelled (<s>utkṣiptakā</s>)

body.text: 164. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tahiṃ kālī nāma bhikṣuṇī grāmacārikāṃ gatā | tasyā gatāya antevāsinīye bhikṣuṇīsaṃghena utkṣepanīyakarma kṛtaṃ | sā grāmacārikāṃ caritvā āgatā | sā dān āha | ārye saṃghena utkṣepanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ | naivam eva dharmasaṃbhogena saṃbhuñjanti nāmiṣasaṃbhogena | sā dān āha | tūṣṇīkā bhava yāvat bhikṣuṇīyo sannipātayanti | sā dān āha | sannipātetha āryamiśrikāyo | sā dāni anyadā cānyadā ca yadā grāmacārikāṃ caritvā āgatā bhavati | tato bhikṣuṇīnāṃ vaibhaṅgikaṃ dadāti | tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo sannipatathety uktā śīghraṃ śīghraṃ sannipatitāḥ kiñcid vaibhaṅgikaṃ dāsyatīti | sā dān āha | śṛṇotu me āryamiśrikā saṃgho | iyaṃ itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī | tasyāḥ saṃghena utkeṣepanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ pratyosareya | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ | śṛṇotu me āryamiśrikā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī | tasyāḥ saṃghena utkṣepanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ | saṃgho tāṃ itthannāmāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ pratyosārayati | yasyā āryamiśrikānāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ pratyosāryamāṇāṃ saṃghena sā tūṣṇīm asya yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣetu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ traivācikaṃ pratyosāritā āryamiśrikā iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī | utkṣepanīyaṃ karma kṛtam saṃghena | kṣamati taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: 164. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. There a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Kālī</s> had gone on a village-tour. While she was away, the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s> had performed the <s>utkṣepanīya-karma</s> (act of suspension) against her pupil. Having completed her village-tour, she returned. [The pupil] said: 'Noble one, the <s>Saṃgha</s> has performed the act of suspension. They will not share in <s>Dharma</s>-communion with me, nor in material communion.' She said: 'Be silent. I shall convene the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.' She then said: 'Assemble, noble ones.' Now, at other times, whenever she returned from a village-tour, she would distribute shares to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, when told 'Assemble!', quickly gathered, [thinking] 'She will give us some distribution.' She then said: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so has had the act of suspension performed against her by the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s> would reinstate the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so. This is the motion. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so has had the act of suspension performed against her by the <s>Saṃgha</s>. The <s>Saṃgha</s> reinstates the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so. Those of the noble assembly to whom it is acceptable that the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so be reinstated by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, let her be silent. She who does not accept, let her speak. This is the first <s>karmavācanā</s>. Thus by the threefold declaration, so-and-so has been reinstated by the noble assembly. The act of suspension was performed by the <s>Saṃgha</s>. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, since it is silent, thus I understand it.'

body.text: atha sā dhṛṣṭā ca mukharā ca pragalbhā ceti na kācit pratikṣipati | atha tā bhikṣuṇyo pīḍitā āhuḥ | kin tāvad iman ti | aparā āhuḥ | vayam api na jānīmaḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇyo mahāprajāpatyā gautamyā ārocayeyuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavataḥ ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha kāliṃ | yāvad etam evārthaṃ pṛcchitā | āha | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te kāli evan nāma tvaṃ jānantī bhikṣuṇīṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmato vinayato utkṣiptām apratikṛtāṃ | akṛtvā pūrvakṛtyaṃ | anavalokayitvā bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ pratyosārayasi | tena hi na kṣamati | peyālaṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: Now she was bold, loquacious, and presumptuous, so no one opposed her. Then those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, being oppressed, said: 'What shall we do about this?' Others said: 'We too do not know.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Kālī</s>.' She was questioned about this very matter and said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Kālī</s>. How could you, knowing that a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> had been suspended by the complete <s>Saṃgha</s> in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, without her having made amends, without performing the preliminary duties, without consulting the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, reinstate her on your own? This is therefore not acceptable.' Abbreviated. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>]... up to: so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī bhikṣuṇīṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmato vinayato utkṣiptāṃ apratikṛtāṃ | akṛtvā pūrvakṛtyaṃ | anavalokayitvā bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ | svayam eva pratyosārayati | ayaṃ pi dharmo prathamāpattiko |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing that a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has been suspended by the complete <s>Saṃgha</s> in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, without her having made amends, without performing the preliminary duties, without consulting the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, reinstates her on her own—this too is an offense at the first commission.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā yāvad ubhayataḥ saṃghena | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī jānantīti | svayam vā jāne parato vā śrutvā | bhikṣuṇīṃ samagreṇa saṃgheneti avyagreṇa | dharmato vinayato ti | sati āpatyā adarśanena | apratidharmeṇa | trayāṇāṃ dṛṣṭīnāṃ apratinissargāya | utkṣiptam ti asaṃbhogakṛtaṃ | apratikṛtan ti apratyosāritaṃ | akṛtvā pūrvakṛtyaṃ ti prakṛtisthā bhikṣuṇīyo asaṃjñāpayitvā |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained... up to: by both <s>Saṃghas</s>. 'That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> knowing' means either knowing by herself or having heard from others. 'By the complete <s>Saṃgha</s>' means by an undivided [<s>Saṃgha</s>]. 'In accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>' means: when there is an offense, for non-acknowledgment, for non-making amends, or for non-renunciation of any of the three [wrong] views. 'Suspended' means the act of non-communion has been performed. 'Without having made amends' means not yet reinstated. 'Without performing the preliminary duties' means without informing the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who are in regular standing.

body.text: anavalokayitvā bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ ti | saṃghamadhye avalokanām akṛtvā svayam eva pratyosārayet | ayam api dharmaḥ yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Without consulting the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>' means without making a consultation in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, she reinstates [the suspended nun] on her own. This too is a rule, up to: it is a regulation.

body.text: sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī jānantī bhikṣuṇīṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmato vinayato utkṣiptāṃ | apratikṛtāṃ | akṛtvā pūrvakṛtyaṃ | anavalokayitvā bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ svayam eva pratyosārayati | saṃghātiśeṣam āsādayati |
body.translated_text: That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who, knowing that a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has been suspended by the complete <s>Saṃgha</s> in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, without her having made amends, without performing the preliminary duties, without consulting the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, reinstates her on her own—she incurs a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī samagreṇa saṃghena utkṣiptā bhavati | yā tasyā upādhyāyī vā ācāryāyiṇī vā ca yā prakṛtisthā bhikṣuṇyāḥ tā saṃjñāpayitavyāḥ |
body.translated_text: That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has been suspended by the complete <s>Saṃgha</s>. Her preceptress or her instructress, and the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who are in regular standing, should be informed.

children.translated_text: Whose transgressions do not exist?
What person does not err?
Who does not fall into delusion?
Whose understanding remains steadfast?

body.text: evaṃ tayā ajñānatayā kṛtaṃ | na punar evaṃ kariṣyati |
body.translated_text: Thus it was done by her through ignorance. She will not do it again.

body.text: yadā saṃjñaptā bhavanti tadāvalokanā kartavyā | śṛṇotu me āryamiśrikā saṃghaḥ | iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī | tasyāḥ saṃghena amukasmin vastuni utkṣepanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ | sā vartaṃ vartayati | lomaṃ pātayati | niḥsaraṇaṃ pravartayati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgham itthannāmā pratyosāraṇāṃ yāceya | yāciṣyati itthannāmā saṃghaṃ pratyosāraṇāṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīṃ | evam etaṃ dhārayāmi | tāya yācayitavyaṃ | peyālaṃ | atha tatra kācit pṛatihati karmakriyamāṇe prakṛtisthābhir bhikṣuṇībhiḥ saṃjñāpayitavyāḥ | asmākaṃ bhaṇantīnāṃ kṣamasveti |
body.translated_text: When [the relevant parties] have been informed, then the consultation should be made: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so has had the act of suspension performed by the <s>Saṃgha</s> in such-and-such a matter. She is conducting herself properly, is showing humility, is seeking release. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, so-and-so would request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for reinstatement. She will request: so-and-so requests the <s>Saṃgha</s> for reinstatement. If this is acceptable to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, since it is silent, thus I understand it.' She should then make the request. Abbreviated. Now if anyone objects during the performance of the act, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> in regular standing should be informed: 'Please be patient with us as we speak.'

body.text: bhikṣur api jānan bhikṣuṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmato vinayato utkṣiptaṃ svayam eva pratyosārayati sthūlātyayam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> too who, knowing that a <s>bhikṣu</s> has been suspended by the complete <s>Saṃgha</s> in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, reinstates him on his own, incurs a grave transgression (<s>sthūlātyaya</s>). Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānanti bhikṣuṇīṃ samagreṇa saṃghena dharmato vinayato utkṣiptāṃ apratikṛtāṃ akṛtāṃ akṛtvā pūrvakṛtyaṃ anavalokayitvā bhikṣuṇīsaṃghaṃ svayam eva pratyosārayati | ayam api dharmo prathamāpattiko saṃghātiśeṣo ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing that a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has been suspended by the complete <s>Saṃgha</s> in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s>, without her having made amends, without performing the preliminary duties, without consulting the <s>bhikṣuṇī-saṃgha</s>, reinstates her on her own—this too is an offense at the first commission, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>.

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma 11
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> (Formal Meeting) rule 11.

body.text: anavaśrutā avaśrutā
body.translated_text: <s>Anavaśrutā avaśrutā</s> (The unpassionate [nun accepting from] the passionate [man]).

body.text: 165. bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati | tatra jetā nāma bhikṣuṇī | tām aparaḥ puruṣo raktacittaḥ | bhaktenopanimantrayati | pātracīvareṇa bhakṣyabhojyena glānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkāraiḥ | so āha | jānāsi ārye kasya vayam arthāya āryāya dadāmaḥ | sā āha | jānāmi | so āha | kasyārthāya | sā āha | puṇyaṃ te bhaviṣyati so āha | evam etat puṇyaṃ bhaviṣyati | ayaṃ tv aham āryāya arthikaḥ āryāya dadāmi | sā tāvad vigatarāgā | naiva pratikṣipati | nādhivāsayati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇyo mahaprajāpatyā gautamyā ārocayeyuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavataḥ ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha jetāṃ | sā śabdāpitā | etad evaṃ sarvaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te jete | nanu te paścimā nāma janatā avalokayitavyā | naiṣa dharmo naiṣa vinayaḥ |
body.translated_text: 165. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>. There was a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Jetā</s>. A certain man, with a passionate mind toward her, invited her with food, bowl and robes, edibles, comestibles, and medicinal requisites for the sick. He said: 'Do you know, noble one, for whose sake we give to you?' She said: 'I know.' He said: 'For whose sake?' She said: 'It will be merit for you.' He said: 'Indeed it will be merit. But I give to you, noble one, because I desire you.' Now she was free from passion; she neither refused nor accepted. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Jetā</s>.' She was summoned and questioned about all this, up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Jetā</s>. Should you not have considered the future generation? This is not <s>Dharma</s>, this is not <s>Vinaya</s>.'

body.text: atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautamī yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>], <s>Gautamī</s>... up to: so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī anavaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya pratigṛhṇīyāt pātraṃ vā cīvaraṃ vā bhakṣyaṃ vā bhojyaṃ vā glānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkāraṃ vā ayam api dharmaḥ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing herself to be unpassionate, accepts from a passionate man a bowl, or a robe, or edibles, or comestibles, or medicinal requisites for the sick—this too is a rule.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti yāvad upasampannā ubhayataḥ saṃghena | eṣā bhikṣuṇī anavaśrutā ti araktacittā | avaśrutasya puruṣasyeti raktacittasya | pratigṛhṇeyā ti praticcheya | pātram iti jyeṣṭhaṃ madhyamaṃ kanyasam vā | cīvaram iti saṃghāṭiuttarāsaṅgamantarvāsakaṃ kaṇṭhapraticchādanaṃ udakaśāṭikā | khādyam iti khādanīyaṃ | bhojyam iti bhojanīyaṃ | antaśaḥ glānabhaiṣajyam iti saptāhikaṃ vā yāvajjīvikam vā | ayam api dharma | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | eṣo tāvan manuṣyo bhikṣuṇīya dadāti pātram vā cīvaram | bhakṣyabhojyam vā | glānabhaiṣajyam vā | tāṃ puruṣo āha | āryāya vayam arthikā | āryāya vayam dadāma iti | na kṣamati pratīcchituṃ | sa vaktavyaḥ | tavaiva bhavatu dīrghāyuḥ labhiṣyāmaḥ vayam anyato pi | atha pratīcchati saṃghātiśeṣaṃ | atha vācaṃ na bhāṣati hastavikāraṃ vā pādavikāraṃ vā akṣivikāraṃ vā karoti | haṣtam vā prasphoṭayati | aṅgulīṃ vā akṣiṃ vā nipātayati | bhūmim vā vilikhati vinamati vā | jānāti raktacitto ti | na kṣamati pratīcchituṃ | pratīcchati sthūlātyayaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means up to: one ordained by both <s>Saṃghas</s>. 'Unpassionate' (<s>anavaśrutā</s>) means without a passionate mind. 'Of a passionate man' (<s>avaśrutasya puruṣasya</s>) means one with a passionate mind. 'Accepts' means receives. 'Bowl' means large, medium, or small. 'Robe' means the outer robe (<s>saṃghāṭi</s>), upper robe (<s>uttarāsaṅga</s>), inner robe (<s>antarvāsa</s>), neck-covering, or bathing cloth. 'Edibles' means what is to be chewed. 'Comestibles' means what is to be eaten. 'At the very least, medicine for the sick' means for seven days or for one's lifetime. This too is a rule, up to: it is a regulation. Now if a man gives to a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> a bowl, or a robe, or edibles and comestibles, or medicine for the sick, and that man says: 'We desire you, noble one; we give to you'—it is not permissible to accept. He should be told: 'May you live long; we shall receive from others as well.' If she accepts, it is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. If he does not speak words but makes gestures with his hand, foot, or eye, or claps his hands, or drops a finger or an eye[lid], or scratches the ground, or bows—she knows [he is] passionately inclined—it is not permissible to accept. If she accepts, it is a grave transgression (<s>sthūlātyaya</s>).

body.text: atha khalu denaṃ deti prasannair indriyaiḥ | atha khalu tayā bhikṣuṇyā āśayena pratīcchitavyaṃ pratīcchati anāpattiḥ |
body.translated_text: But if he gives with serene faculties, then that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should accept with [pure] intention. If she accepts [in good faith], there is no offense.

body.text: evaṃ bhikṣor api raktacittā strī dadāti | na jānam gṛhṇāti sthūlātyayaṃ | nimittaṃ karoti | jānāti raktacittā iti | naṃ pratīcchati vinayātikraman āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Likewise, if a passionate woman gives to a <s>bhikṣu</s>, and he knowingly accepts, it is a grave transgression. If she makes a sign, and he knows she is passionately inclined and still accepts, he incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression). Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī avaśrutā avaśrutasya puruṣasya pātram cīvaram vā bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā glānabhaiṣajyam vā pratigṛhṇeya ayam api dharmo prathamāpattiko |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being unpassionate, accepts from a passionate man a bowl, or a robe, or edibles, or comestibles, or medicine for the sick—this too is an offense at the first commission.

body.text: kiṃ te vadeti tvaṃ pratigṛhṇa
body.translated_text: 'What does he say to you?' 'Accept this.'

body.text: 166. bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati avaśrutasya puruṣasya pātraṃ vā yāvat pratigṛhṇātuṃ | sā jetā tasya puruṣasya na praticchati | sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī āha | pratigṛhṇa tvam ārye etasya puruṣasya | kiṃ te paro kariṣyati | avaśruto vā anavaśruto vā | yato ca tvam anavaśrutā | dāyakadānapatīnāṃ sakāśāt pratigṛhṇītvā yathāpratyayaṃ karohi | sā bhikṣuṇībhir ucyate | mā ārye etāṃ bhikṣuṇīm evaṃ vada | pratigṛhṇa tvam ārye etasya puruṣasya | kin te paro kariṣyati avaśruto vā anavaśruto vā | yato ca tvam anavaśrutā | dāyakadānapatīnāṃ sakāśāt pratigṛhṇītvā yathāpratyayaṃ karohi | evaṃ sakṛd uktā na pratikramati | dvitīyam tṛtīyam apy uktā na pratikramati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇyo mahāprajāpatyā gautamyā ārocayanti | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavataḥ ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha nandāṃ yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande | naiṣa dharmo naiṣa vinayaḥ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya yāvat paryavadātāni |
body.translated_text: 166. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule: it is not permissible to accept from a passionate man a bowl, and so on. That <s>Jetā</s> [accordingly] did not accept from that man. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s> said: 'Accept, noble one, from this man. What will anyone else do to you? Whether he is passionate or not—since you yourself are unpassionate, accept from donors and benefactors and use it as needed.' She was told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Do not, noble one, say this to that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>: "Accept, noble one, from this man. What will anyone do to you, whether he is passionate or not? Since you are unpassionate, accept from donors and benefactors and use it as needed."' When told once, she did not desist. When told a second and third time, she did not desist. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>,' up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>. This is not <s>Dharma</s>, this is not <s>Vinaya</s>.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>]... up to: so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīṃ evaṃ vadeya | pratigṛhṇa tvam ārye etasya puruṣasya | kiṃ te paraḥ kariṣyati | avaśruto vā anavaśruto vā | yā tvam anavaśrutā | dāyakadānapatīnāṃ sakāśāt pratigṛhṇītvā yathāpratyayaṃ karohi | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhiḥ ucyamānā etad eva vastuṃ pratigṛhya tiṣtheya na pratinissaret | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etat kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareya | ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyakaḥ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> says to another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>: 'Accept from this man, noble one. What will another do for you? Whether he is lustful or not lustful, you who are not lustful—accept the gift from the donors and patrons and do as you see fit.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, takes up and persists in that very matter and does not renounce it—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be admonished and spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> up to a third time for the renunciation of that matter. If when being admonished and spoken to up to a third time she renounces that matter, that is good. If she does not renounce it—this too is an offense [requiring admonishment] up to the third time.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti yathā sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī | tāṃ bhikṣuṇīm iti yathā tāṃ jetāṃ | bhikṣuṇīm evaṃ vadet | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhi evam asya vacanīyā | peyālaṃ | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir ucyamānā tad evaṃ vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheya | ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyakaḥ yathā bhikṣuvinaye | peyālaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—refers to one like the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>. 'That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—refers to one like that <s>Jetā</s>. '<s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> thus says'—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—abbreviation—'if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, takes up and persists in that very matter, this too is an offense up to the third time, as in the <s>bhikṣu-vinaya</s>. Abbreviation. Up to the formal designation.' Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīm evaṃ vadeya | pratigṛhṇa tvam ārye etasya puruṣasya | kiṃ te paro kariṣyati avaśruto vā anavaśruto vā | yā tvam anavaśrutā | dāyakadānapatīnāṃ deyadharmaṃ pratigṛhṇītvā yathāpratyayaṃ karohi | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye etāṃ bhikṣuṇīm evaṃ vade | pratigṛhṇa tvam ārye etasya puruṣasya | kin te paro kariṣyati avaśruto vā anavaśruto vā | yā tvam anavaśrutā | dāyakadānapatīnāṃ deyadharmaṃ paritigṛhṇitvā yathāpratyayaṃ karohi | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir ucyamānā tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheya | na pratiniḥsareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanuśāsitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhyamāṇā samanubhāṣyamāṇā tam vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etat kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareya tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheya | ayan dharmo yāvat tṛtīyakaḥ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> says to another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>: 'Accept from this man, noble one. What will another do for you, whether he is lustful or not? You who are not lustful—accept the gifts of the donors and patrons and do as you see fit.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble one, do not speak thus to this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>: "Accept from this man. What will another do for you, whether he is lustful or not? You who are not lustful—accept the gifts of the donors and patrons and do as you see fit."' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when thus spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, takes up and persists in that very matter and does not renounce it—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be admonished and spoken to up to a third time for the renunciation of that matter. If when being admonished and spoken to up to a third time she renounces that matter, that is good. If she does not renounce it and takes up and persists in that very matter—this offense [requires admonishment] up to the third time.

body.text: saṃghabhedaḥdveya bhedena
body.translated_text: Schism of the <s>saṃgha</s> (<s>saṃghabheda</s>): two [rules] on schism

body.text: 167. bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati | dvau bhedena tathaiva kartavyo yāvat tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 167. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>. The two [rules] on schism should be treated in the same way [as for <s>bhikṣus</s>]. Up to: therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī samagrasya saṃghasya bhedāya parākrameya bhedanasamvartanīyaṃ vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye samagrasya saṃghasya bhedāya parākrameya | bhedanasamvartanīyam vā adhikaraṇaṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭhāhi | sametu āryā saṃghena | samagro hi saṃgho sahito sammodayamāna avivadamāno | ek'uddeśo kṣīrodakībhūto śāstuḥ śāsanaṃ dīpayamānaḥ sukhañ ca phāsuñ ca viharati | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir ucyamānā tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheya | na pratiniḥsareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ na pratiniḥsareya | ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyakaḥ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> strives for the schism of a united <s>saṃgha</s>, or takes up and persists in a matter conducive to schism—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble one, do not strive for the schism of a united <s>saṃgha</s>, nor take up and persist in a matter conducive to schism. Let the noble one join with the <s>saṃgha</s>. For a united <s>saṃgha</s>, harmonious, rejoicing together, not quarreling, of one recitation, blended like milk and water, illuminating the Teacher's teaching, dwells in happiness and comfort.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when thus spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, takes up and persists in that very matter and does not renounce it—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be admonished and spoken to up to a third time for the renunciation of that matter. If when being admonished and spoken to up to a third time she does not renounce that matter—this too is an offense up to the third time.

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma 14(3)
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rule 14(3)

body.text: tad anuvartakāḥ
body.translated_text: Followers [of the schismatic]

body.text: tasyāḥ khalu bhikṣuṇyā bhikṣuṇyo bhavanti sahāyikā | ekā vā dvau vā trayo vā saṃbahulā vā | vargavādinīyo anuvartikāḥ samanujñāḥ saṃghabhedāya | tā bhikṣuṇyaḥ bhikṣuṇyo evam āhuḥ | mā āryamiśrikāḥ etāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ kiñcid avavadittha | kalyāṇaṃ vā pāpakaṃ vā | dharmavādinī caiṣā bhikṣuṇī vinayavādinī caiṣā bhikṣuṇī | asmākaṃ caiṣā bhikṣuṇī chandañ ca ruciṃ ca samādāya pragṛhya vyavaharati | yañ caitasyāḥ bhikṣuṇyāḥ kṣamate ca rocate ca asmākam api taṃ kṣamate ca rocate ca | jānantī caiṣā bhikṣuṇī bhāṣate no ajānanti | tā bhikṣuṇyo bhikṣuṇībhir evam asya vacanīyāḥ | mā āryamiśrikāya evam avocat | naiṣā bhikṣuṇī dharmavādinī | naiṣā bhikṣuṇī vinayavādinī | māryamiśrikāḥ saṃbhedaṃ rocayantu | saṃghasāmagrīm evāryamiśrikā rocayantu | samagro hi saṃgho | sahito sammodayamāno avivadamāno ek'uddeśo kṣīrodakībhūto śāstuḥ śāsanaṃ dīpayamānaḥ | sukhāñ ca phāsuñ ca viharati | evañ ca tā bhikṣuṇyo bhikṣuṇībhiḥ ucyamānā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareṃsuḥ ity etat kuśalaṃ | no ce pratiniḥsareṃsuḥ tā bhikṣuṇyo bhikṣuṇībhiḥ yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareṃsuḥ ity etat kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareṃsuḥ | tad eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheyuḥ | ayam api dharmo yāvattṛtīyakaḥ |
body.translated_text: If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> companions—one, two, three, or many—who are factional, followers, supporters of the schism of the <s>saṃgha</s>, and those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> say: 'Noble sisters, do not admonish this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> in any way, whether good or bad. For this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> speaks the <s>Dharma</s>, this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> speaks the <s>Vinaya</s>. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> acts having taken up and embraced our wishes and inclinations. What is acceptable and pleasing to this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is acceptable and pleasing to us as well. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> speaks knowingly, not unknowingly'—those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are to be told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble sisters, do not speak thus. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> does not speak the <s>Dharma</s>; this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> does not speak the <s>Vinaya</s>. Noble sisters, do not delight in schism. Let the noble sisters delight in the harmony of the <s>saṃgha</s>. For a united <s>saṃgha</s>, harmonious, rejoicing together, not quarreling, of one recitation, blended like milk and water, illuminating the Teacher's teaching, dwells in happiness and comfort.' If those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, when thus spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, renounce that matter, that is good. If they do not renounce it, those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are to be admonished and spoken to up to a third time for the renunciation of that matter. If when being admonished and spoken to up to a third time they renounce that matter, that is good. If they do not renounce it and take up and persist in that very matter—this too is an offense up to the third time.

body.text:
saṃghātiśeṣadharma 15(4)
ākrośo
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rule 15(4): Reviling (<s>ākrośa</s>)

body.text: 168. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tatra sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī adhikaraṇāny utpādayati | tasyā saṃghena utkṣepanīyaṃ karma kṛtaṃ | sā saṃghaṃ ākrośati saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayati | chandagāmī cāryā saṃgho | doṣagāmī cāryā saṃgho | bhayagāmī cāryā saṃgho | mohagāmī cāryā saṃgho | chandan niśrāya | doṣan niśrāya | mohan niśrāya mama ākroṣitavyaṃ | paribhāṣitavyam manyati | bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir ucyate | mā ārye nande saṃgham agatigamanena prāpaya | na saṃgho chandagāmī | peyālaṃ | yāvan na mohan niśrāya yāvad āryā evaṃ chandagāmī | mā ārye chandan niśrāya saṃgham ākroṣitavyam manyasi paribhāṣitavyam manyasi | sā tvam evam ucyamānī na pratikramasi dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyam adhyucyamāni na pratikramasi | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi gacchatha | triṣkṛtvā kuvege | triṣkṛtvā mahājane | tṛṣkṛtvā saṃghamadhye samanugrāhatha samanubhāṣatha etasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | sā kuvege ucyate | satyaṃ tvam ārye nande saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayasi | alam ārye nande saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayituṃ | yāvat khalu te ārye mitrāya karaṇīyaṃ arthakāmāya hitaiṣiṇīya karoti | te tan mitrā ekavācā gacchanti | dve vāce avaśiṣṭe | pratiniḥsara na pratinissarāmīty āha | evam mahājane saṃghamadhye avalokanā kartavyā | satyaṃ tvam ārye nande saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayasi | peyālaṃ | yāva āmo ty āha | sā tāva saṃghamadhye pi vaktavyā peyālaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇyo ārocayeyuḥ | anubhāṣṭā bhagavan āryā nandā triṣkṛtvā kuvege triṣkṛtvā mahājane triṣkṛtvā saṃghamadhye etasya vastunaḥ pratiniḥsargāya | na pratiniḥsarati | bhagavān āha śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad evaṃ caivañ ca pṛṣṭā | peyālaṃ | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande | nanv ahaṃ nande anekaparyāyeṇa daurvacasyaṃ vigarhāmi yāvan naivaṃ kurvato vṛddhir bhavati kūśaleṣu dharmeṣu atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya | peyālaṃ | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 168. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. There the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> was stirring up disputes. The <s>saṃgha</s> performed the act of suspension on her. She reviled the <s>saṃgha</s>, accusing the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct: 'The noble <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of favoritism; the noble <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of malice; the noble <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of fear; the noble <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of delusion. Relying on favoritism, relying on malice, relying on delusion, she thinks I should be reviled and abused.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> told her: 'Noble <s>Nandā</s>, do not accuse the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct. The <s>saṃgha</s> does not act out of favoritism—abbreviation—nor out of delusion. Up to: it is you, noble one, who acts out of favoritism. Noble one, do not think that you should revile and abuse the <s>saṃgha</s> out of favoritism.' When thus spoken to, she did not desist; a second and third time she was spoken to but did not desist. This matter was [reported]—up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Well then, go. Three times in a small assembly, three times in a large assembly, three times in the midst of the <s>saṃgha</s>—admonish and speak to her for the renunciation of this matter.' She was told in a small assembly: 'Is it true, noble <s>Nandā</s>, that you accuse the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct? Enough, noble <s>Nandā</s>, of accusing the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct.' Up to: 'Those who are your friends, who act for your benefit and welfare, they are single-voiced friends—go.' Two statements remain. 'Renounce it.' 'I will not renounce it,' she said. Likewise in the large assembly and in the midst of the <s>saṃgha</s>, the examination should be conducted. 'Is it true, noble <s>Nandā</s>, that you accuse the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct?'—abbreviation—'Yes,' she said. She was then told in the midst of the <s>saṃgha</s> as well—abbreviation. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter. 'Lord, the noble <s>Nandā</s> has been spoken to three times in a small assembly, three times in a large assembly, three times in the midst of the <s>saṃgha</s> for the renunciation of this matter, and she does not renounce it.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>'—abbreviation—and she was thus questioned—abbreviation—'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>. Have I not, <s>Nandā</s>, in many ways censured stubbornness?—up to: acting thus does not lead to growth in wholesome qualities.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>]'—abbreviation—'so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇī khalu punaḥ saṃghākrośikā bhavati | sā evam āha | chandagāmī ca saṃgho | doṣagāmī ca | bhayagāmī ca | mohagāmī ca | saṃgho chandan niśrāya | doṣan niśrāya | bhayan niśrāya | mohan niśrāya | samākrośitavyaṃ paribhāṣitavyaṃ manyati | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye evaṃ vada | na saṃgho chandagāmī | na saṃgho doṣagāmī | na saṃgho bhayagāmī | na saṃgho mohagāmī | na ca saṃgho chandan niśrāya | doṣabhayamohan niśrāya ākrośitavyaṃ | paribhāṣitavyaṃ manyati | ārye ca chandan niśrāya doṣaṃ bhayaṃ mohan niśrāya saṃgham ākrośitavyaṃ manyati | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir ucyamāna tad eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣūṇībhiḥ yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratinissargāya | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamānā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareya ity etat kuślaṃ | no ca pratinissareṃsuḥ | ayam api dharmo yāvattṛtīyakaḥ | peyālaṃ |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who reviles the <s>saṃgha</s> speaks thus: 'The <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of favoritism; the <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of malice; the <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of fear; the <s>saṃgha</s> acts out of delusion. The <s>saṃgha</s>, relying on favoritism, relying on malice, relying on fear, relying on delusion, thinks I should be reviled and abused.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble one, do not speak thus. The <s>saṃgha</s> does not act out of favoritism; the <s>saṃgha</s> does not act out of malice; the <s>saṃgha</s> does not act out of fear; the <s>saṃgha</s> does not act out of delusion. Nor does the <s>saṃgha</s>, relying on favoritism, malice, fear, or delusion, think one should be reviled and abused. Noble one, it is you who, relying on favoritism, malice, fear, or delusion, thinks the <s>saṃgha</s> should be reviled.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when thus spoken to by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, takes up and persists in that very matter—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is to be admonished and spoken to up to a third time for the renunciation of that matter. If when being admonished and spoken to up to a third time she renounces that matter, that is good. If she does not renounce it—this too is an offense up to the third time. Abbreviation.

body.text: yāvad eṣā bhikṣuṇī triṣkṛtvā kuvege samanugrāhiyamānā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā pratiniḥsargārhaṃ vastuṃ na pratiniḥsarati | vācāyām vācāyāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye jñaptim adhivāsayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | prathamāyāṃ vācāyāṃ avyavaropitāyāṃ vinayātikramaḥ | vyavaropitāyāṃ sthūlātyayaḥ | evam dvitīyātṛtīyām vā vācāyāṃ yāvad vyavaropitāyāṃ saṃghātiśeṣaṃ | yadā saṃghātiśeṣām āpattim āpannā |
body.translated_text: If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when being admonished and spoken to three times in a small assembly, does not renounce the matter worthy of renunciation, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression with each statement. Likewise in a large assembly and in the midst of the <s>saṃgha</s>: she accepts the motion and incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. At the first statement, when not concluded, it is a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression; when concluded, it is a grave transgression (<s>sthūlātyaya</s>). Likewise at the second statement. At the third statement—up to: when concluded, it is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. When she has incurred the <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s> offense—

body.text: ye ca kuvege | ye ca mahājane | ye ca saṃghamadhye vinayātikaramāḥ | sthūlātyayāḥ sarve te pratiprasrabhyanti sthāpayitvā aṣṭau sthūlātyayāḥ | na saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayantī | antarā pratiniḥsarati yathāsthitāsu āpattiṣu kārayitavyā | kathaṃ tāvat pratiniḥ sargārhaṃ katham apratiniḥsargārhaṃ | abhūṣi me saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayiṣyan ti prāpayāmi prāpayiṣyāmi ceti evaṃ pratiniḥsargārhaṃ | kathaṃ pratiniḥsargārhaṃ | abhūṣi me saṃgham agatigamanena prāpayiṣyan ti prāpitañ ca | na khalv idānīṃ prāpayāmi na ca prāpayiṣyāmīty apratiniḥsargārhaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: all the <s>Vinaya</s> transgressions in the small assembly, the large assembly, and the midst of the <s>saṃgha</s>, and the grave transgressions—all those are cancelled, except for eight grave transgressions. If she is not accusing the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct and renounces in the interim, she should be dealt with regarding the offenses as they stand. What is worthy of renunciation and what is not worthy of renunciation? [If she says:] 'I was going to accuse the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct; I am accusing; I will accuse'—this is worthy of renunciation. What is worthy of renunciation? [If she says:] 'I was going to accuse the <s>saṃgha</s> of wrongful conduct; I have accused; but I am not now accusing, nor will I accuse'—this is not worthy of renunciation. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: bhikṣuṇī khalu punaḥ saṃghākrośikā bhavati | sā evam āha | chandagāmī | cāryamiśrikāyo | saṃgho doṣagāmī ca bhayagāmī ca saṃgho | mohagāmī ca saṃgho | chandan niśrāya doṣaṃ bhayaṃ mohaṃ niśrāya samākrośitavyām paribhāṣitavyām manyati | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye saṃghaākrośikā bhavāhi | na saṃgho chandagāmī | na saṃgho doṣagāmī | na saṃgho bhayagāmī | na saṃgho mohagāmī | na ca saṃgho chandan niśrāya doṣaṃ bhayaṃ mohaṃ niśrāya āryām ākrośitavyām paribhāṣitavyām manyati | āryā evaṃ chandagāminī doṣagāminī bhayagāminī mohagāminī | āryā eva chandan niśrāya doṣaṃ bhayaṃ mohan niśrāya saṃegham ākrośitavyaṃ roṣitavyaṃ paribhāṣitavyaṃ manyati | viramārya saṃghākrośanāto | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhir ucyamānā tam evi vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭhet | na partiniḥsareya | sā bhikṣuṇ bhikṣunībhir yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhyamānā vā samanubhāṣiyamānā | taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etat kuśalaṃ | no cet pratiniḥsareya | ayam api dharmo yāvattṛtīyako |
body.translated_text: Now, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> reviles the <s>Saṃgha</s>. She says thus: 'The Noble Ladies' <s>Saṃgha</s> acts out of desire! The <s>Saṃgha</s> acts out of hatred! The <s>Saṃgha</s> acts out of fear! The <s>Saṃgha</s> acts out of delusion! Based on desire, hatred, fear, and delusion, [the <s>Saṃgha</s>] thinks one should be reviled and abused.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> thus: 'Do not, Noble One, revile the <s>Saṃgha</s>. The <s>Saṃgha</s> does not act out of desire. The <s>Saṃgha</s> does not act out of hatred. The <s>Saṃgha</s> does not act out of fear. The <s>Saṃgha</s> does not act out of delusion. Nor does the <s>Saṃgha</s>, based on desire, hatred, fear, or delusion, think one should be reviled and abused. It is you, Noble One, who acts out of desire, hatred, fear, and delusion. It is you, Noble One, who, based on desire, hatred, fear, and delusion, thinks the <s>Saṃgha</s> should be reviled, angered, and abused. Desist, Noble One, from reviling the <s>Saṃgha</s>.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when thus admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, should hold fast to that matter and cling to it—and not relinquish it—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be exhorted and admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> up to three times for the relinquishment of that matter. If, being exhorted and admonished up to three times, she relinquishes that matter, it is well. If she does not relinquish it, this too is an offense [requiring action] up to the third [admonition].

body.text:
saṃghātiśeṣadharma 16(5)
daurvacasyaṃdurvacakajātiyo
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rule 16(5): The difficult-to-admonish one (<s>durvacakajātīya</s>).

body.text: 169. bhagavān kauśāmbīyām viharati | chandakamātā nāma bhikṣuṇī | sā uddeśaparyavasānehi śikṣāpadehi bhikṣuṇīhi śikṣāyāṃ saha dharmeṇa saha vinayena vucyamānā | peyālaṃ | yathaiva chandakasya tathaivaṃ vistareṇa kartavyaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 169. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Kauśāmbī</s>. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Chandakamātā</s>—when admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> with training rules contained in the recitation, in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and in accordance with the <s>Vinaya</s>—[abbreviation]. Just as in the case of <s>Chandaka</s> [among the monks], so it should be elaborated in detail. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: bhikṣuṇī khalu punar durvacakajātīya bhavati | sā uddeśaparyāpannehi śikṣāpadehi bhikṣuṇīhi śikṣāyāṃ saha dharmeṇa saha vinayena vucyamānā ātmānam avacanīyaṃ karoti | sā evam āha | mā me āryamiśrikāyo kiñcid vadatha kalyāṇam vā pāpakaṃ vā | aham apy āryamiśrikāṇān na kiñcid vakṣyāmi kalyāṇam vā pāpakam vā | viramantv āryamiśrikāyo mama vacanāya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye uddeśaparyāpannehi śikṣāpadehi bhikṣuṇīhi śikṣāyāṃ saha dharmeṇa saha vinayena vucyamānā ātmānam avacanīyaṃ karohi | vacanīyam evāryātmānaṃ karotu | āryā pi bhikṣuṇīyo vadantu śikṣāyāṃ saha dharmeṇa saha vinayena | āryam api bhikṣuṇīyo vakṣyanti śikṣāyāṃ saha dharmeṇa saha vinayena | evaṃ saṃvṛddhā khalu punar ārye tasya bhagavatas tathāgatasya arhataḥ samyaksambuddhasya parṣā yad idam anyamanyavacanīyā anyamanyāpattivyutthāpanīyā | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇīhi vucyamānā tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheya | na pratiniḥsareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvāttṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇa vā tam vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity evaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareya tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheya | ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyako |
body.translated_text: Now, a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is of a difficult-to-admonish nature. When admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> with training rules contained in the recitation, in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and in accordance with the <s>Vinaya</s>, she makes herself impervious to correction. She says thus: 'Do not, Noble Ladies, say anything to me, whether good or bad! I too shall not say anything to the Noble Ladies, whether good or bad. Let the Noble Ladies desist from admonishing me.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> thus: 'Do not, Noble One, when admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> with training rules contained in the recitation, in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s>, make yourself impervious to correction. Let the Noble One rather make herself open to correction. Let the Noble One also admonish the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> regarding the training, in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s>; and the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> too will admonish the Noble One regarding the training, in accordance with the <s>Dharma</s> and the <s>Vinaya</s>. For thus, Noble One, has the assembly of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>Arhat</s>, the Perfectly Awakened One, grown—namely, through mutual correction and mutual rehabilitation from offenses.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when thus admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, should hold fast to that matter and cling to it—and not relinquish it—that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be exhorted and admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> up to three times for the relinquishment of that matter. If, being exhorted and admonished up to three times, she relinquishes that matter, it is well. If she does not relinquish it but holds fast and clings to that matter—this too is an offense [requiring action] up to the third [admonition].

body.text: dve saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti
body.translated_text: Two [nuns] living in close association.

body.text: 170. bhagavāṃ cchrāvastyāṃ viharati | etā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo nandā ca śākyakanyā uttarā ca māsorakadhītā kāyikena saṃsargeṇa saṃsṛṣṭā hi viharanti | vācikena saṃsargeṇa saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti | kāyikavācikena saṃsargeṇa saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti | anyamanyasyāvadyāni praticchādayanti | kinti dāni kāyikena saṃsargeṇa saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti | peyālaṃ | kin ti dāni anyamanyasyāvadyāni praticchādayanti | ekāye avadyam aparācchādeti | aparāt vadyam aparā cchādeti | tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo bhikṣuṇīhi vuccanti | māryamiśrikāyo kāyikena saṃsargeṇa saṃsṛṣṭā viharatha mā vācikena mā kāyikavācikena | mā anyamanyasyāvadyāni cchādetha | tāyo sakṛd uktāyo na pratikramanti | dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyam apy uktā na pratikramanti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ tā bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayet | vistareṇa | peyālaṃ |
body.translated_text: 170. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, these <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—<s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>—lived in close association through bodily contact; lived in close association through verbal contact; lived in close association through bodily and verbal contact; and concealed each other's offenses. What then is 'living in close association through bodily contact'? [Abbreviation.] What then is 'concealing each other's offenses'? One conceals the offense of the other, and the other conceals the offense of the first. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were told by the [other] <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble Ladies, do not live in close association through bodily contact, or through verbal contact, or through bodily and verbal contact! Do not conceal each other's offenses!' Being told once, they did not desist. Being told a second and third time, they did not desist. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. In detail. [Abbreviation.]

body.text: bhikṣuṇīyo khalu punar dve saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti | anyamanyasyāvadyapraticchādikā | tā bhikṣuṇīyo bhikṣuṇīhi evam asya vacanīyā | mā āryemiśrikāyo saṃsṛṣṭā viharatha anyamanyasyāvadyapraticchādikā | nānā āryamiśrikāyo viharatha | nānā vo viharantīnāṃ vṛddhir eva pratikāṅkṣitavyā kuśalehi dharmehi | na parihāṇiḥ | evaṃ ca tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo bhikṣuṇīhi vucyamānās taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareṃsuḥ | ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratinissareṃsuḥ tā bhikṣuṇīyo bhikṣuṇīhi yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyāḥ samanubhāṣitavyāḥ tasya vastusya pratinissargāya | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratinissareṃsuḥ itya etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratinissareṃsuḥ tam evam vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheṃsuḥ | ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyako |
body.translated_text: Now, two <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> live in close association, concealing each other's offenses. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should be addressed by the [other] <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> thus: 'Do not, Noble Ladies, live in close association concealing each other's offenses. Let the Noble Ladies live apart.
