When you live apart, growth in wholesome qualities is to be expected, not decline.' If those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, when thus addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, relinquish that matter, it is well. If they do not relinquish it, those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should be exhorted and admonished by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> up to three times for the relinquishment of that matter. If, being exhorted and admonished up to three times, they relinquish that matter, it is well. If they do not relinquish it but hold fast and cling to that matter—this too is an offense [requiring action] up to the third [admonition].

body.text: bhikṣuṇīyo khalu puna dve saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti yathā nandā ca śākyakanyā uttarā ca māśorakadhītā | saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti kāyikena vācikena kāyikavācikena | avadyapraticchādikā ti āpattipraticchādikā | tā bhikṣuṇīyo yathā nandā ca śākyakanyā uttarā ca māśorakadhītā | bhikṣuṇīhīti saṃghena mahājanena ekabhikṣuṇīya | evaṃ syur vacanīyā | mā āryamiśrikāyo saṃsṛṣṭā viharatha | anyamanyasyāvadyapraticchādikā | peyālaṃ | yāvat tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheṃsuḥ | yaṃ taṃ vastuṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti anyamanyasyāvadyāni praticchādayanti | tā bhikṣuṇīyo ti yathā nandā ca śākyakanyā uttarā ca māśorakadhitā | bhikṣuṇīhīti saṃghena mahājanena ekapudgalena yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā | trikkhutto kuvege trikkhutto mahājane trikkhutto saṃghamadhye samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareṃsuḥ ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyako saṃghātiśeṣo | peyālaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī trikkhatto kuvege samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā pratiniḥsargārhaṃ vastun na pratiniḥsarati vācāyāṃ vācāyāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye jñaptim adhivāsayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | prathamāyāṃ vācāyām adhyoropitāyāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | vyoropitāyāṃ thūl'-accayaṃ | evaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ vācāyām adhyoropitāyāṃ thūl'-accayaṃ | adhyoropitāyāṃ saṃghātiśeṣaṃ | kin ti dāni pratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | kim apratiniḥsargārhaṃ | abhūṣi khalu mo saṃsṛṣṭā vihariṣyāmo | anyonyasāvadyapraticchādikā ti viharāmo vihariṣyāmo | no ca khalu vihṛtaṃ | evaṃ pratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | kin ti dāni apratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | abhūṣi khalu mo saṃsṛṣṭā vihariṣyāmo anyonyasyāvadyapraticchādikā ti te dānīm viharāmo vihariṣyāmo na vihṛtaṃ | mo ti etaṃ pratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now, two <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> live in close association, like <s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>. 'Living in close association' means through bodily, verbal, or bodily-and-verbal contact. 'Concealing each other's offenses' means concealing offenses. 'Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means like <s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>. 'By the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, by a group, or by a single <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. They should be addressed thus: 'Do not, Noble Ladies, live in close association concealing each other's offenses.' [Abbreviation.] Up to: 'they hold fast and cling to that matter.' The matter whereby they live in close association concealing each other's offenses—'those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means like <s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>. 'By the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, by a group, or by a single person. They should be exhorted and admonished up to three times: three times before a single person, three times before a group, three times in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>—they should be exhorted and admonished for the relinquishment of that matter. If, being exhorted and admonished up to three times, they relinquish that matter, it is well. If they do not relinquish it—this too is an offense [requiring action] up to the third [admonition], a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. [Abbreviation.] Up to the rule-establishment. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being exhorted and admonished three times before a single person, does not relinquish the matter worthy of relinquishment, at each statement she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Similarly before a group: in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, she accepts the motion and incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. When the first statement is completed, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. When [the motion is] taken up, a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Similarly, when the second statement is completed, a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. When [the third] is completed, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. What then should be considered 'worthy of relinquishment'? And what 'not worthy of relinquishment'? 'We have indeed lived in close association, concealing each other's offenses'—'we live [thus], we shall live [thus]'—but [if in fact] they have not lived [thus], this is to be seen as 'worthy of relinquishment.' And what is 'not worthy of relinquishment'? 'We have indeed lived in close association, concealing each other's offenses'—they do live [thus], they will live [thus], they have not [yet] lived [thus]; even this saying 'we have' is to be seen as 'worthy of relinquishment.' Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: bhikṣuṇīyo khalu puna dve saṃsṛṣṭāyo viharanti anyonyasyāvadyapraticchādikā | peyālaṃ | vistareṇa |
body.translated_text: Now, two <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who live in close association, concealing each other's offenses. [Abbreviation.] In detail.

body.text: saṃghātiseṣadharma 18(7)
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rule 18(7):

body.text: tāsāñ cānuvicārikā
body.translated_text: The follower of those [two] (<s>tāsāñ cānuvicārikā</s>).

body.text: 171. bhagavāṃ cchrāvastyāṃ viharati | bhagavān āha | śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīhi saṃsṛṣṭā viharitun ti | nandā ca śākyakanyā uttarā ca māśorakadhītā bhikṣuṇīyo nānā viharanti | sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī tāsām āha | saṃsṛṣṭā eva yūyam āryamiśrikāyo viharatha | anyamanyasyāvadyapraticchādikā | tāsāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ vo viharantīnāṃ vṛddhir eva pratikāṅkṣitavyā kuśalehi dharmehi | na parihāniḥ | kiṃ yūyam eva evaṃrūpā saṃghe | santy anyā apy evaṃrūpā saṃghe | na ca saṃgho tāsāṃ kiñcid āha | yuṣmān eva saṃgho avajñāya paribhavena omarditavyāṃ parimarditavyām manyati | sā bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati | mā ārye nande etāyo bhikṣuṇīyo evaṃ vada saṃsṛṣṭā eva āryamiśrikāyo viharatha | peyālaṃ | yāvat parimarditavyām manyati |
body.translated_text: 171. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'A training rule has been laid down: it is not permissible for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to live in close association.' <s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, were living apart. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s> said to them: 'Noble Ladies, you should indeed live in close association! Concealing each other's offenses! When you live in close association, growth in wholesome qualities is to be expected, not decline. Are only you of this type in the <s>Saṃgha</s>? There are others too of this type in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, and the <s>Saṃgha</s> says nothing to them. It is only you whom the <s>Saṃgha</s>, out of contempt and disrespect, thinks should be crushed and ground down.' She was told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Do not, Noble <s>Nandā</s>, speak thus to those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—"Noble Ladies, you should indeed live in close association"—[abbreviation]—up to: "thinks should be crushed and ground down."'

body.text: sā sakṛd uktā na pratikramati | evaṃ dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyam apy uktā na pratikramati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocenti | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | bhagavān āha | yady eṣā sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī nandāṃ śākyakanyāṃ uttarāṃ ca māśorakadhītām evam āha | saṃsṛṣṭā eva āryamiśrikāyo viharatha | peyālaṃ | yāvat sakṛd uktā na pratikramati | dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi uktā na pratikramati | tena hi gacchatha nantrikkhatto kuvege trikkhatto mahājane trikkhatto saṃghamadhye samanugrāhayatha samanubhāṣatha etasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | sā kuvege vaktavyā | satyaṃ tvam ārye nande etā bhikṣuṇīyo evam vadasi yāvad āmo ty āha | sā tvaṃ kuvege vuccati | mā ārye nande etā bhikṣuṇīyo evaṃ vada | peyālaṃ | yaṃ khalu te ārye nande mitrāya karaṇīyaṃ arthakāmāye hitaiṣiṇīye anukampikāya anukampām upādāya karoti | taṃ mitrā ekā vācā gacchati dve vācā avaśiṣṭā pratiniḥsarāmity āha | evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā | evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye avalokanā kartavyā | evaṃ eva yāvad anubhāṣṭā na pratiniḥsarati | peyālaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavata ārocayet | bhagavān āha śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | etad eva sarvaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande yāvat sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: When told once, she does not desist. When told a second and third time, she does not desist. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> also reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> says to <s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>: "Noble ladies, dwell together in corrupt association!" [abbreviated] up to: when told once she does not desist; when told a second and third time she does not desist; then go and admonish and exhort her three times in private, three times before a large group, and three times in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, for the relinquishment of this matter. She should be told in private: "Is it true, noble <s>Nandā</s>, that you say this to those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?" Up to: she says "Yes." She is told in private: "Noble <s>Nandā</s>, do not tell those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> this." [Abbreviated.] "What a friend should do for you, noble <s>Nandā</s>, one who desires your welfare, who wishes your benefit, who acts out of compassion — your friend is doing. One declaration has been made; two declarations remain. Relinquish this [position]!" She says [that she will]. Likewise the second, the third. Likewise before a large group and in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, a formal examination should be conducted. In the same way, up to: when exhorted she does not relinquish. [Abbreviated.] The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>.' She was summoned. All of this was put to her. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>.' Up to: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>, until [the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīyo nānā viharantīyo evam vadeya | saṃsṛṣṭā eva āryamiśrikāyo viharatha anyamanyasāvadyapraticchādikā | saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ vo viharantīnāṃ vṛddhir eva pratikāṅkṣitavyā kuśalehi dharmehi | na parihāṇiḥ | kiṃ punar yūyam eva evaṃrūpā saṃghe | santy anyā py evaṃrūpā saṃghe | na ca tāsāṃ saṃgho kiñcid āha | yuṣmān eva saṃgho avajñāya paribhāvena omarditavyāṃ parimarditavyām manyati | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye nande itthannāmāṃ ca itthannāmāṃ ca bhikṣuṇīṃ nānā viharantīṃ anuvicārehi | saṃsṛṣṭā eva yūyam āryamiśrikāyo viharatha | anyamanyasyāvadyapraticchādikā | nānāsaṃsṛṣṭānāṃ vo viharantīnāṃ vṛddhir eva pratikāṅkṣitavyā kuśalehi dharmehi | na parihāniḥ | kim punar yūyam eva evaṃrūpā saṃsṛṣṭā saṃghe | santy anyā api evaṃrūpā saṃghe | na ca saṃgho tāsāṃ kiñcid āha | yuṣmākam eva saṃgho avajñāya paribhavena omarditavyāṃ parimarditavyām manyati | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi vucyamānā tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheya na pratinissareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratinissareya | ayaṃ pi dharmo yāvattṛtīyako |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> dwelling separately: 'Noble ladies, dwell together in corrupt association, concealing each other's faults! When you dwell in corrupt association, growth alone is to be expected for you in wholesome <s>dharmas</s>, not decline. Moreover, are you the only ones of such character in the <s>Saṃgha</s>? There are others of such character in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, and the <s>Saṃgha</s> says nothing to them. The <s>Saṃgha</s> thinks only to crush and oppress you through contempt and disdain.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble so-and-so, do not incite so-and-so and so-and-so, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> dwelling separately, [saying:] "Noble ladies, dwell together in corrupt association, concealing each other's faults. When you dwell in corrupt association separately, growth alone is to be expected for you in wholesome <s>dharmas</s>, not decline. Moreover, are you the only ones of such character in corrupt association in the <s>Saṃgha</s>? There are others of such character in the <s>Saṃgha</s>, and the <s>Saṃgha</s> says nothing to them. The <s>Saṃgha</s> thinks only to crush and oppress you through contempt and disdain."' And if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, should hold fast to and cling to that very matter and not relinquish it, that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be admonished and exhorted up to a third time for the relinquishment of that matter. If, when being admonished and exhorted up to a third time, she relinquishes that matter — that is good. If she does not relinquish, this too is an offense up to the third [admonition].

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti yathā sthūlanandā | tā bhikṣuṇīyo ti yathā nandā ca śākyakanyā uttarā ca māsorakadhītā | evaṃ vadeya | saṃsṛṣṭā eva yūyam āryamiśrikāyo viharatha anyamanyasyāvadyapraticchādikā ti kāyikena vācikena kāyikavācikena saṃsargeṇa | mā nānāṃ saṃsṛṣṭānāṃ vo 'dhiviharantīnāṃ vṛddhir eva pratikāṅkṣitavyā kuśalehi dharmehi na parihāṇiḥ | peyālaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means such as <s>Sthūlanandā</s>. 'Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means such as <s>Nandā</s> the <s>Śākya</s> maiden and <s>Uttarā</s> the daughter of <s>Māśoraka</s>. 'Should say: Noble ladies, dwell together in corrupt association, concealing each other's faults' means through bodily, verbal, or bodily-and-verbal association. 'When you dwell apart in corrupt association, growth alone is to be expected for you in wholesome <s>dharmas</s>, not decline.' [Abbreviated.]

body.text: sā bhikṣuṇīti yathā sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī | bhikṣuṇīhīti saṃghena mahājanena ekapudgalena evam asya vacanīyā | āryemiśrān nāme | peyālaṃ | yāvan na pratinissareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi yāvattṛtīyakam ti trikkhatto kuvege trikkhatto mahājane trikkhatto saṃghamadhye | sā kuvege vaktavyā | satyaṃ tvam ārye itthannāme itthannāmāṃ ca itthannāmāṃ ca bhikṣuṇīm yāvad āmo ty āha | sā kuvege vuccati | mā ārye itthannāmāñ ca itthannāmāñ ca bhikṣuṇīṃ nānā viharantīṃ anuvicārehi | peyālaṃ | ayam api dharmo yāvat tṛtīyako | peyālaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī trikkhatto kuvege samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā pratiniḥsargārhaṃ vastuṃ na pratiniḥsarati vācāyāṃ vācāyāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati |
body.translated_text: 'That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means such as the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>. 'By the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, by a large group, or by a single individual — she should be told: 'Noble so-and-so...' [Abbreviated.] Up to: she does not relinquish. 'That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be [admonished] up to a third time by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means three times in private, three times before a large group, three times in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. She is told in private: 'Is it true, noble so-and-so, that you [said this to] so-and-so and so-and-so, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?' Up to: she says 'Yes.' She is told in private: 'Noble so-and-so, do not incite so-and-so and so-and-so, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> dwelling separately.' [Abbreviated.] This too is an offense up to the third [admonition]. [Abbreviated.] If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when admonished and exhorted three times in private, does not relinquish the matter requiring relinquishment, with each declaration she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression).

body.text: evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye jñaptim adhivāsayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | yāvat tṛtīyāyāṃ vācāyāṃ adhyoropitāyāṃ saṃghātiśeṣaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat kin ti dāni pratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ kim apratiniḥsargārhaṃ | abhūṣi khalu ime itthannāmāyo bhikṣuṇīyo vadiṣyaṃ | saṃsṛṣṭā evāryamiśrikāyo viharatha | anyonyasāvadyapraticchādikā vadāmi vadiṣyāmi | na khalu vaditaṃ evaṃ pratiniḥsargārhaṃ | kin ti dāni apratiniḥsargārhaṃ | abhūṣi khalu me itthannāmāyo bhikṣuṇīyo vadiṣyaṃ | saṃsṛṣṭā evāryamiśrikāyo viharatha | anyonyasāvadyapraticchādikā ti | vaditaṃ khalu me idānīm vadāmi na vadiṣyāmi ceti evam apratiniḥsargārham draṣṭavyaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Likewise before a large group and in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>: when she accepts the formal motion (<s>jñapti</s>), she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Up to: at the third declaration, when it has been proclaimed, [it is] a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. [Abbreviated.] Up to: What then is to be regarded as requiring relinquishment, and what as not requiring relinquishment? [If she says:] 'I intended to tell those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> named so-and-so: "Dwell in corrupt association, noble ladies, concealing each other's faults" — I say it, I will say it.' This is not yet spoken, thus it requires relinquishment. What then does not require relinquishment? [If she says:] 'I intended to tell those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> named so-and-so: "Dwell in corrupt association, noble ladies, concealing each other's faults." This has been spoken by me; I do say it now, but I will not say it again.' Thus it is to be regarded as not requiring relinquishment. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīyo nānā viharantīyo evam vadeya | vistareṇa | yāvad ayaṃ pi dharmo yāvat tṛtīyako |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> dwelling separately — in full detail — up to: this too is an offense up to the third [admonition].

body.text: saṃghātiśeṣadharma19(8)
body.translated_text: <s>Saṃghātiśeṣa</s> Rule 19 (8)

body.text: śikṣāpratyākhyāyikā
body.translated_text: Renouncing the Training (<s>śikṣāpratyākhyāyikā</s>)

body.text: 172. bhagavān śākyeṣu viharati | śākyānāṃ kapilavastusmiṃ nyagrodhārāme | tahiṃ dānī dve mātādhītare agārasyānagārikāṃ pravrajite | dhītā śākyehi pravrajitā mātā tīrthikehi | sā dāni mātā dhītaram āha | putriṇi | kiṃ vayaṃ jīvantikā eva anyamanyaṃ na paśyāmaḥ | ihaiva cāgaccha | sā dān āha | āgacchāmī | na mayā yathā vā tathā vā śakyam āgantuṃ | yāvat kiñcid adhikaraṇam utpādayāmi | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi saha vāco vācikaṃ karoti | sā yadā paryādinnā bhavati tadā āha | buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi | evaṃ dharmaṃ saṃghaṃ śikṣām uddeśaṃ samvāsaṃ sambhogaṃ śāstṛpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ pratyākhyāmi | śākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāmi | kiṃ etā eva śramaṇikā śākyaputrīyā | santy anyāny api pṛthutīrthyāyatanāni | tatra brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyaṃ | sā dāni bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati | mā ārye buddhaṃ pratyākhyāhi yāvat mā śākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāhi | asādhu ārye buddhapratyākhyānaṃ yāvad asādhu śākyaputrīya bhāvapratyākhyānaṃ |
body.translated_text: 172. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling among the <s>Śākyas</s>, in <s>Kapilavastu</s>, in the <s>Nyagrodha</s> monastery. Now there, a mother and daughter had both gone forth from the household life to homelessness. The daughter was ordained by the <s>Śākyas</s> [i.e., in the Buddhist order]; the mother by the <s>tīrthikas</s> (non-Buddhist ascetics). The mother said to the daughter: 'Daughter, why should we, while still alive, not see each other? Come here [to me].' She said: 'I will come. But I cannot come just like that. Let me first create some [disciplinary] incident.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> then had a verbal quarrel with the other <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. When she became overwhelmed, she said: 'I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>! Likewise I renounce the <s>Dharma</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the training, the recitation, the communal life, the shared use [of goods], the title of Teacher, the status of a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>! I renounce the status of a follower of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>! Are these the only female renunciants, these followers of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>? There are other broad sectarian establishments. I shall practice the holy life there.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> said to her: 'Noble one, do not renounce the <s>Buddha</s>, up to: do not renounce the status of a follower of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>! It is wrong, noble one, to renounce the <s>Buddha</s>, up to: it is wrong to renounce the status of a follower of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>.'

body.text: sā sakṛd uktā na pratikramati | dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyam pi uktā na pratikramati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato ārocayeti | bhagavān āha | tena hi bhikṣuṇyo | yady eṣā itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī śikhyāpratyākhyāyikā | sā evam āha | buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi | peyālaṃ | yāvat tatra brahmacaryañ cariṣyaṃ | sā sakṛd uktā na pratikramati | dvitīyaṃ tṛtīyam apy uktā na pratikramati | tena hi gacchatha | tāṃ trikkhatto kuvege trikkhatto mahājane trikkhatto saṃghamadhye samanugrāhatha samanubhāṣatha etasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | sā dāni kuvege vaktavyā | satyaṃ tvam ārye itthannāme śikṣāṃ pratyākhyāsi | sā tvam evam vadasi buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi | peyālaṃ | yāvat kiṃ punar etā eva śramaṇikā śākyaputrīyāḥ | santy anyāny api pṛthutīrthyāyatanāni | tatra brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyan ti | āmo ty āha | sā tvaṃ kuvege vuccasi mā tvam ārye itthannāme buddhaṃ pratyākhyāhi yāvac chākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāhi | asādhu ārye buddhapratyākhyānaṃ | yāvad asādhu śākyaputrīya bhāvapratyākhyānaṃ |
body.translated_text: When told once, she does not desist. When told a second and third time, she does not desist. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> also reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: '<s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s>, if this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so is one who renounces the training, and she says thus: "I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>" [abbreviated] up to "I shall practice the holy life there" — when told once she does not desist, when told a second and third time she does not desist — then go and admonish and exhort her three times in private, three times before a large group, and three times in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, for the relinquishment of this matter.' She is to be told in private: 'Is it true, noble so-and-so, that you renounce the training?' 'That you say thus: "I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>"' [abbreviated] up to: '"Are these the only female renunciants, the followers of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>? There are other broad sectarian establishments. I shall practice the holy life there."' She says: 'Yes.' She is told in private: 'Noble so-and-so, do not renounce the <s>Buddha</s>, up to: do not renounce the status of a follower of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>. It is wrong, noble one, to renounce the <s>Buddha</s>. Up to: it is wrong to renounce the status of a follower of the <s>Śākyaputra</s>.'

body.text: yaṃ khalu te ārye itthannāmāya mitrāya karaṇīyaṃ arthakāmāya hitaiṣīṇīye karoti | tena mitrā ekavācā gacchati | dve vācā avaśiṣṭā pratiniḥsara na pratinissarāmīty āha | evam dvitīyam pi tṛtīyam pi | evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye avalokanā kartavyā yāvad etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo bhagavato ārocayeṃsuḥ | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha tāṃ bhikṣuṇīṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | satyan ti | tad evaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha duṣkṛtaṃ te | peyālaṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 'What a friend should do for you, noble so-and-so, one who desires your welfare, who wishes your benefit — your friend is doing. One declaration has been made; two declarations remain. Relinquish [this position]!' She says: 'I will not relinquish.' Likewise the second and third [declarations]. Likewise before a large group and in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, a formal examination should be conducted, up to: the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>.' She was summoned. 'Is it true?' She was questioned about all of this. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong.' [Abbreviated.] Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>], <s>Gautamī</s>, until [the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇī khalu punaḥ śikhyāpratyākhyāyikā bhavati | sā dān āha | buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi | dharmaṃ saṃghaṃ śikṣām uddeśaṃ samvāsaṃ saṃbhogaṃ śāstṛpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ śramaṇībhāvaṃ śākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāmi | kiṃ etā eva śramaṇikā śākyaputrīyā | santy anyāny api pṛthutīrthyāyatānāni | tatra brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyaṃ | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye śikhyāpratyākhyāyikā bhohi | mā buddhaṃ pratyākhyāhi | mā dharmaṃ saṃghaṃ śikṣām uddeśaṃ samvāsaṃ saṃbhogaṃ śāstṛpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ śramaṇibhāvaṃ śākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāhi | asādhu ārye buddhapratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu dharmapratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu saṃghapratyākhyānaṃ | śikṣāuddeśasamvāsasaṃbhogaśāstṛpadabhikṣuṇībhāvaśramaṇībhāvapratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu ārye śākyaputrīya bhāvapratyākhyānaṃ | evañ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi vucyamānā tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pratigṛhya tiṣṭheya na pratiniḥsareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvat tṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareya | ayam api dharmo yāvattṛtīyako saṃghātiśeṣo | saṃgham evādhipatiṃ kṛtvā niḥsaraṇīyo |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, moreover, who is a renouncer of the training. She says thus: 'I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>! I renounce the <s>Dharma</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the training, the recitation, the communal life, the shared use, the teacher's authority, the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, the status of <s>śramaṇī</s> (renunciant woman), the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s> (daughter of the <s>Śākyas</s>). Are these the only renunciant women, these <s>Śākyaputrīyas</s>? There are also other establishments of heretical sects. I shall practice celibacy there.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> thus: 'Do not, Noble One, be a renouncer of the training! Do not renounce the <s>Buddha</s>! Do not renounce the <s>Dharma</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the training, the recitation, the communal life, the shared use, the teacher's authority, the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, the status of <s>śrama��ī</s>, the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>! It is wrong, Noble One, to renounce the <s>Buddha</s>. It is wrong to renounce the <s>Dharma</s>. It is wrong to renounce the <s>Saṃgha</s>. [It is wrong to renounce] the training, recitation, communal life, shared use, teacher's authority, the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, the status of <s>śramaṇī</s>. It is wrong, Noble One, to renounce the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being thus addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, clings to and holds onto that very matter and does not relinquish it, that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be admonished and exhorted by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> up to the third time for the relinquishment of that matter. If, being admonished or exhorted up to the third time, she relinquishes that matter — that is good. If she does not relinquish it, this rule too, requiring up to three [admonitions], is a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. It must be resolved by making the <s>Saṃgha</s> the authority.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti yathā sā bhikṣuṇī | śikṣāpratyākhyāyikā ti sā evam āha buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi | peyālaṃ | yāvac chākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāmi | kim etā eva śramaṇikā śākyaputrīyāḥ | santy anyāny api pṛthutīrthyāyatanāni | tatra brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyaṃ | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye buddhaṃ praytākhyāhi yāvad asādhu ārye śākyaputrīya bhāvapratyākhyānaṃ | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi vucyamānā tam eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheya na pratiniḥsareya | yā sā bhikṣuṇī śikṣāpratyākhyāyikā |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' — as described, that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. 'A renouncer of the training' — she says thus: 'I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>' — abbreviated — 'up to: I renounce the status of <s>Ś��kyaputrīya</s>. Are these the only renunciant women, these <s>Śākyaputrīyas</s>? There are also other establishments of heretical sects. I shall practice celibacy there.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> thus: 'Do not, Noble One, renounce the <s>Buddha</s>' — up to: 'It is wrong, Noble One, to renounce the status of <s>Śākyaputr��ya</s>.' And if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being thus addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, clings to and holds onto that very matter and does not relinquish it — that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is a renouncer of the training.

body.text: sā bhikṣuṇīhīti saṃghena mahājanena ekapudgalena yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā trikkhatto kuvege trikkhatto mahājane trikkhato saṃghamadhye | sā dāni kuvege vaktavyā | satyaṃ tvam itthannāme evaṃ vadasi buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi yāvac chākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāmi | āma ity āha | sā kuvege vuccati | mā ārye itthannāme buddhaṃ pratyākhyāhi | yāvad asādhu ārye śākyaputrīya bhāvapratyākhyānaṃ | yaṃ khalu te ārye itthannāmāya mitrāya karaṇīyaṃ | arthakāmāya hitaiṣiṇīye karoti | te taṃ mitrā ekavācā gacchati | dve vācā avaśiṣṭā pratiniḥsara na pratiniḥsarāmīty āha | evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye avalokanā kartavyā | vistareṇa | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā taṃ vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareya ayam api dharmo yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> by the <s>bhik���uṇīs</s>' — by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, by a large group, or by a single individual — 'should be admonished and exhorted up to the third time' — three times in private, three times in a large group, three times in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. In private, she should be told: 'Is it true, so-and-so, that you say thus: "I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>" — up to — "I renounce the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>"?' She says: 'Yes.' She is told in private: 'Do not, Noble so-and-so, renounce the <s>Buddha</s>!' — up to — 'It is wrong, Noble One, to renounce the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>.' 'Whatever a friend should do for you, Noble so-and-so — one who desires your welfare, who wishes your benefit — does so.' One declaration passes. Two declarations remain. 'Relinquish!' She says: 'I will not relinquish.' Likewise in a large group and in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the formal review should be conducted. In detail: if, being admonished or exhorted up to the third time, she relinquishes that matter — that is good. If she does not relinquish it, this rule too — up to the rule establishment.

body.text: sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī trikkhatto kuvege trikkhatto mahājane trikkhatto saṃghamadhye samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamāṇā vā pratiniḥsargārhaṃ vastuṃ na pratiniḥsarati vācāyāṃ vācāyāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | evaṃ mahājane saṃghamadhye jñaptim adhivāsayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | prathamāyāṃ vācāyāṃ adhyoropitāyāṃ vinayātikramam | adhyoropitāyāṃ thūlaccayam | evaṃ dvitīyāyāṃ tṛtīyāyāṃ vācāyām adhyoropitāyāṃ thūl'-accayam | adhyoropitāyāṃ saṃghātiśeṣaṃ | yadā saṃghātiṣeśam āpattim āpannā bhavati tadā ye ca kuvege ye ca mahājane ye ca saṃghamadhye thūl'-accayā ca vinayātikramā ca sarve te pratiprasrabhyante | ekā gurukā āpattiḥ saṃsthihati yad idaṃ saṃghātiśeṣo | antarā pratiniḥsarati yathāsthitāsu āpattiṣu kārāpayitavyā | kin ti dāni pratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ kim apratiniḥsargārhaṃ | abhūṣi khalu me śikṣāṃ pratyākhyāsyāmi | na khalu me pratyākhyānaṃ prtiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | kin ti dāni apratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | abhūṣi khalu me śikṣāṃ pratyākhyāsyan ti | pratyākhyātam dāni na pratyākhyāsi pratyākhyāmi ceti | evam apratiniḥsargārhaṃ draṣṭavyaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being admonished or exhorted three times in private, three times in a large group, and three times in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, does not relinquish the matter requiring relinquishment: with each declaration, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression). Likewise in a large group and in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>: when she assents to the motion, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. At the first declaration, when it is put forth, [she incurs] a <s>vinayātikrama</s>; when it is completed, a <s>sthūl��tyaya</s> (grave offense). Likewise at the second and third declarations, when put forth, a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>; when completed, a <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. When she has incurred the <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s> offense, then whatever <s>sthūlātyayas</s> and <s>vinayātikramas</s> [were incurred] in private, in a large group, and in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s> — all of those are subsumed. One grave offense remains, namely the <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s>. If she relinquishes in the interim, she should be penalized according to the offenses as they stand. What then should be regarded as requiring relinquishment, and what as not requiring relinquishment? 'I once thought I would renounce the training. But I have not actually renounced.' This is to be regarded as requiring relinquishment. What then is to be regarded as not requiring relinquishment? 'I once thought I would renounce the training. I have renounced, yet I have not renounced, [and now] I say I renounce.' This is to be regarded as not requiring relinquishment. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: bhikṣuṇī khalu punaḥ śikṣāpratyākhyāyikā bhavati | sā evam āha | buddhaṃ pratyākhyāmi dharmaṃ pratyākhyāmi | saṃghaṃ pratyākhyāmi | śikṣāṃ pratyākhyāmi | uddeśaṃ samvāsaṃ saṃbhogaṃ śāstṛpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ śramaṇībhāvaṃ śākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāmi | kim etā eva śramaṇikā śākyaputrīyāḥ | santy anyāny api pṛthutīrthyāyatanāni | tatra brahmacaryaṃ cariṣyaṃ | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evam asya vacanīyā | mā ārye śikṣāpratyākhyāyikā bhohi | mā dharmapratyākhyāyikā bhohi | mā saṃghapratyākhyāyikā bhohi | mā śikṣāṃ pratyākhyāhi | mā uddeśaṃ samvāsaṃ sambhogaṃ śāstṛpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ śramaṇībhāvaṃ śākyaputrīya bhāvaṃ pratyākhyāhi | tat kasya hetoḥ | asādhu ārye buddhapratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu dharmapratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu saṃghapratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu śikṣāpratyākhyānaṃ | uddeśasaṃvāsasaṃbhogaśāstṛpadabhikṣuṇībhāvaśramaṇībhāva pratyākhyānaṃ | asādhu śākyaputrīya bhāvapratyākhyānaṃ | evaṃ ca sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi vuccamānā taṃ eva vastuṃ samādāya pragṛhya tiṣṭheya | na pratiniḥsareya | sā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhitavyā samanubhāṣitavyā tasya vastusya pratiniḥsargāya | yāvattṛtīyakaṃ samanugrāhiyamāṇā vā samanubhāṣiyamānā vā tam vastuṃ pratiniḥsareya | ity etaṃ kuśalaṃ | no ca pratiniḥsareya | ayaṃ pi dharmo yāvattṛtīyako saṃghātiśeṣo | saṃgham evādhipatiṃ kṛtvā niḥsaraṇīyo |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, moreover, who is a renouncer of the training. She says thus: 'I renounce the <s>Buddha</s>. I renounce the <s>Dharma</s>. I renounce the <s>Saṃgha</s>. I renounce the training. I renounce the recitation, the communal life, the shared use, the teacher's authority, the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, the status of <s>śramaṇī</s>, the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>. Are these the only renunciant women, these <s>Śākyaputrīyas</s>? There are also other establishments of heretical sects. I shall practice celibacy there.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> thus: 'Do not, Noble One, be a renouncer of the training! Do not be a renouncer of the <s>Dharma</s>! Do not be a renouncer of the <s>Saṃgha</s>! Do not renounce the training! Do not renounce the recitation, the communal life, the shared use, the teacher's authority, the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, the status of <s>śramaṇī</s>, the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>! For what reason? It is wrong, Noble One, to renounce the <s>Buddha</s>. It is wrong to renounce the <s>Dharma</s>. It is wrong to renounce the <s>Saṃgha</s>. It is wrong to renounce the training. [It is wrong to renounce] the recitation, communal life, shared use, teacher's authority, the status of <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, the status of <s>śramaṇī</s>. It is wrong, Noble One, to renounce the status of <s>Śākyaputrīya</s>.' If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being thus addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, clings to and holds onto that very matter and does not relinquish it, that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should be admonished and exhorted by the <s>bhik��uṇīs</s> up to the third time for the relinquishment of that matter. If, being admonished or exhorted up to the third time, she relinquishes that matter — that is good. If she does not relinquish it, this rule too, requiring up to three [admonitions], is a <s>sa���ghātiśeṣa</s>. It must be resolved by making the <s>Saṃgha</s> the authority.

body.text: uddiṣṭā me āryamiśrikāyo ekūnaviṃśati saṃghātiśeṣā dharmāḥ | tatra ekadaśa prathamāpattikāḥ aṣṭau yāvattṛtīyakāḥ | yeṣāṃ bhikṣuṇī ity anyatarānyatarām āpattim āpadyitvā ardhamāsaṃ ubhayato saṃghe mānatvaṃ caritavyaṃ | cīrṇamānatvā bhikṣuṇī kṛtānudharmā | āhvayanapratibaddhā yatra syād viṃśatigaṇo ubhayato saṃgho tatra sā bhikṣuṇī āhvayitavyā | ekenāpi ced ūnoviṃśatigaṇo ubhayato saṃgho tāṃ bhikṣuṇīm āhveya | sā ca bhikṣuṇī anāhūtā | te ca bhikṣavo tāś ca bhikṣuṇīyo garhyāḥ | iyam atra sāmīcī | tatrāryamiśrikāyo pṛcchāmi | kaccit tha pariśuddhā | dvitīyatṛtīyaṃ pi āryamiśrikāyo pṛcchāmi | kaccic tha pariśuddhā | pariśuddhā atrāryamiśrikāyo yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etan dhārayāmi | uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Recited before you, Noble Sisters of the mixed assembly, are the nineteen <s>saṃghātiśeṣa</s> rules. Among these, eleven are offenses at first commission and eight require up to three [admonitions]. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who incurs any one of these offenses must observe the <s>mānatta</s> (penance) discipline for half a month before both <s>Saṃghas</s>. When the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who has completed the <s>mānatta</s> has acted in accordance with the rule, and is bound by the invitation (<s>āhvayana</s>), she should be invited [back into the community] where there is an assembly of twenty from both <s>Saṃghas</s>. If the assembly from both <s>Sa��ghas</s> is short by even one of twenty and they were to invite that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is not [properly] invited, and those <s>bhikṣus</s> and those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are blameworthy. This is the proper procedure herein. Therein, I ask the Noble Sisters of the mixed assembly: Are you pure in this matter? A second and third time I ask the Noble Sisters of the mixed assembly: Are you pure? The Noble Sisters of the mixed assembly are pure in this; therefore they are silent. Thus do I hold it. body.text: niḥsargikapācattikadharma 11
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 11.

body.text: śayyāsanasyārthāya
body.translated_text: For the sake of bedding and furniture.

body.text: 174. bhagavāṃ cchrāvastyāṃ viharati | sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī aparaṃhi bhikṣuṇīvihāre śayyāsanapratigrāhakā | sā dāni śayyāsanaṃ yāceti | āha | prajāpatī dehi mañcaṃ | dehi saṃghasya pīṭhaṃ | bisi caturaśrakaṃ | kuccaṃ bimbohanaṃ | tā dāni striyo kācin māñcasya mūlyan denti | kācit pīṭhasya yāvat kācid bimbohanasya | sā khādati ca pibati ca | pātraṃ ca jānāpeti | cīvaraṃ ca jānāpeti | bhikṣuṇīyo piṇḍapātam aṇvantīyo kulopagagṛhehi praviśanti | tā dāni striyo pṛcchanti | āryāye nandāye mayā mañcasya mūlyaṃ dattaṃ | kiñcit tāya jānāpitaṃ | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ | kiṃ sā bhadrāyiṇī jānāpayiṣyati | khādati ca pibati ca pātraṃ ca jānāpeti | cīvaraṃ jānāpeti | svake mallake varṣati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | bhagavān āha | satyaṃ tvaṃ nande śayyāsanasyārthāya yācitvā anyaṃ cetāpeti | āha | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande | peyālam | tena hi na kṣamati | śayyāsanasyārthāya yācayitvā anyañ cetāpayitvā | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni |
body.translated_text: 174. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s> was the receiver of bedding and furniture at another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> monastery. She would solicit [donations for] bedding and furniture, saying: 'Mistress, give a bed! Give the <s>Saṃgha</s> a seat! A four-cornered cushion! A stuffed bolster!' Some women would give the price of a bed, some the price of a seat, up to some the price of a bolster. She would eat and drink [with the proceeds], and have bowls procured and robes procured. When <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> going on their alms-round entered the homes of lay families, those women asked: 'I gave Noble <s>Nandā</s> the price of a bed. Has she had anything procured?' They replied: 'What would that good woman procure? She eats and drinks, has bowls procured and robes procured — it rains in her own pot!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> also reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>.' She was then summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Is it true, <s>Nandā</s>, that having solicited [donations] for the sake of bedding and furniture, you have other things procured [for yourself]?' She said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>!' — abbreviated — 'Therefore, it is not proper, having solicited [donations] for the sake of bedding and furniture, to have other things procured.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>' — up to — 'so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī śayyāsanasyārthāya yācayitvā ātmano pātram vā cīvaram vā bhaktam vā bhojyam vā glānabhaiṣajyam vā cetāpayen nissargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having solicited [donations] for the sake of bedding and furniture, should have her own bowl, or robe, or food, or provisions, or medicine for the sick procured [instead] — it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s> (offense requiring forfeiture and confession).

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | śayyāsanasyārthāyeti | śayyāsanaṃ nāma mañcaṃ pīṭhaṃ bisi caturasraṃ kuccaṃ bimbohanaṃ | yācitvā ti vijñāpetvā samādāpetvā | anyaṃ cetāpaye ti jānāpayet | pātram vā cīvaram vā bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā cetāpayen nissargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'For the sake of bedding and furniture' — bedding and furniture means beds, seats, four-cornered cushions, round cushions, and bolsters. 'Having solicited' means having requested and gathered [donations]. 'Should have other things procured' means should have them obtained — bowl, or robe, or edibles, or provisions — it is a <s>ni���sargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: nissargikapācattikaṃ ti saṃghe nissariya pācatikaṃ deśayitavyaṃ | aniḥsariya deśeti vinayātikramam āsādayati |
body.translated_text: '<s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s>' means: having forfeited to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>pācattika</s> (confession offense) must be confessed. If one confesses without forfeiting, one incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression).

body.text: atha dāni śayanāsanaṃ prahīṇamātṛkaṃ bhavati | vastu pradarśayitavyaṃ | imaṃ mayā amukāto mañcamūlyaṃ labdhaṃ | iman tasya mañcaṃ saṃjānatha | yāvad bimboyadhānasya | tam vastuṃ na darśeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | khaṇḍaṃ pralugnaṃ vā vā lepanikām vā kartuṃ kumbhiyo upasthāpayituṃ bhikṣur api śayanāsanasyārthāya yācayitvā anyaṃ cetāpeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | vastun darśetvā labhyaṃ khaṇḍaṃ pralugnādi kartuṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now if the bedding and furniture's donor-lineage has been lost, the origin should be shown: 'This bed-price was obtained by me from so-and-so. Acknowledge this as his bed'—up to the mattress-cushion. If one does not show the origin, one incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression). For repairs—broken, damaged, or needing plaster, or for setting up water-jars—a <s>bhikṣu</s> too, having solicited for the purpose of bedding and furniture and then exchanging for something else, incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Having shown the origin, it is permissible to make repairs for breakage, damage, etc. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī śayyāsanasyārthāya yācitvā ātmano pātram vā cīvaram vā bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā glānabhaiṣajyaṃ vā cetāpaye niḥsargikapācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having solicited for the purpose of bedding and furniture, exchanges it for her own bowl, robe, edibles, comestibles, or medicine for the sick—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s> (forfeiture and expiation).

body.text:
niḥsargikapācattikadharma 12
anyoddeśika
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> (Forfeiture and Expiation) rule 12. <s>Anyoddeśika</s> (Exchanging what was designated for another purpose).

body.text: 174a. bhagavān śrāvastyām viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī omalinamalinehi cīvarehi pāṭitavipāṭitehi khaṇḍena pātreṇa chidravichidreṇa piṇḍapātam aṇvati | striyo āhaṃsuḥ | nāsty āryāye pātraṃ | āha | nāsti | āha | ahan te ārye pātrasya mūlyaṃ demi | pātram ārye jānāpetu | aparā āha | nāsty āryāye cīvaraṃ | āha nāsti | āha | aham āryāye cīvarasya mūlyaṃ demi | cīvaram āryā jānāpayitu | sā khādati ca pibati ca naiva pātraṃ na cīvaraṃ jānāpeti | bhikṣuṇīyo piṇḍapātam aṇvantīyo kulopagagṛhāṇī praviśanti | tā dāni striyo āhaṃsuḥ | mayā āryāye nandāye pātrasya mūlyan dattaṃ | kiñcit tāya pātraṃ jānāpitaṃ | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo āhaṃsuḥ | kiṃ sā bhadrāyaṇī jānāpayiṣyati | sā khādati ca pibati ca | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocenti | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | satyaṃ nande evan nāma tvaṃ nande anyoddeśikenānyaṃ cetāpayasi | āha | āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande yāvad evaṃ nāma tvam anyoddeśikena anyaṃ cetāpayasi | tena hi na kṣamati anyoddeśikenānyaṃ cetāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati |
body.translated_text: 174a. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> went for alms wearing dirty, soiled robes, torn and tattered, with a broken bowl full of holes. Women said: 'Noble one, do you not have a bowl?' She said: 'I do not.' They said: 'I will give you the price for a bowl, noble one. Please obtain a bowl.' Another said: 'Noble one, do you not have a robe?' She said: 'I do not.' They said: 'I will give you the price for a robe. Please obtain a robe, noble one.' She ate and drank but obtained neither bowl nor robe. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, going for alms, entered the houses of the donor families. Those women said: 'I gave the price of a bowl to the noble <s>Nandā</s>—has she obtained a bowl yet?' Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> said: 'How will that <s>Bhadrāyaṇī</s> obtain anything? She just eats and drinks.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>.' She was summoned. 'Is it true, <s>Nand��</s>, that you exchanged what was designated for one purpose for something else?' She said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>—how could you exchange what was designated for one purpose for something else? Therefore it is not permissible to exchange what was designated for one purpose for something else.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anyoddeśikena anyaṃ cetāpayet niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> exchanges what was designated for one purpose for something else—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | anyoddeśikeneti pātramūlyena vā cīvaramūlyena vā | anyaṃ cetāpayed iti bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā niḥsargikapācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | eṣo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo kācit pātram vā cīvaram vā ghṛtam vā tailam vā cetāpayituṃ mūlyan deti |yasyārthāya deti tam eva cetāpayitavyaṃ | pātramūlyena pātraṃ yāvad ghṛtamūlyena ghṛtaṃ | anyaṃ cetāpayati | niḥsargikapācatikaṃ | atha aniyataṃ deti yaṃ icchati taṃ jānāpeti anāpattiḥ | atha dān āha | yam icchasi taṃ gṛhṇāhīti | yam icchati taṃ jānāpeti anāpattiḥ | bhikṣavor apy evam eva āpattis tu vinayātikaramaḥ | avivakṣite anāpattiḥ | yam vā icchasi taṃ gṛhṇāhīti taṃ gṛhṇāti anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained. 'What was designated for another purpose' (<s>anyoddeśikena</s>) means with the price of a bowl or with the price of a robe. 'Exchanges for something else' means [exchanges for] edibles or comestibles—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>, up to: it is a regulation. Now if any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> wishes to exchange the price for obtaining a bowl, robe, ghee, or oil...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anyoddeśakenānyaṃ cetāpayati niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> exchanges what was designated for one purpose for something else—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text:
niḥsargikapācattikadharma 13
anyeṣāṃ
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 13. <s>Anyeṣāṃ</s> (soliciting for others).

body.text: 175. bhagavān śrāvastyām viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī saṃghasya bhaktakāni samādāyeti | sā chandakam aṇvantī āha | prajāpati detha chandakaṃ | āryamiśrikāṇāṃ bhaktaṃ kariṣyāmīti | tā dāni striyo chandakaṃ prajantīntīyo jalpanti | ārye yasmin divase pariveṣaṇaṃ bhavati | vayaṃ pi pariveṣikā gamiṣyāmo ti | atha sā khādati ca pibati ca pātraṃ ca jānāpeti | tāya khāditāvaśeṣeṇa yādṛśaṃ vā bhaktaṃ kṛtaṃ | tā dāni striyo pariveṣikā āgataḥ | āhaṃsuḥ | ārye asmābhir bahuko chandako dinno | iman dāni bhaktaṃ lūhavilūhaṃ | bhikṣuṇīyo āhaṃsuḥ | kim eṣā bhadrāyaṇī taṃ kariṣyati | khādati caiṣā pibati ca | pātraṃ cīvaraṃ caiṣā jānāpeti | svake caiṣā mallake varṣati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayati | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | satyaṃ nande evannāma tvam anyeṣām arthāya yācitvā anyaṃ cetāpayasi | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajapatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 175. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> was in charge of the <s>Saṃgha's</s> food provisions. While going around soliciting contributions, she said: 'Good people, give contributions! I shall prepare a meal for the noble ones.' Those women, while giving contributions, remarked: 'Noble one, wherever...'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anyeṣām arthāya yācayitvā ātmano pātram vā cīvaram vā bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā glānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārān vā cetāpayati | niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having solicited for the sake of others, exchanges it for her own bowl, robe, edibles, comestibles, or medicinal requisites for the sick—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | anyeṣām arthāya yācayitvā saṃghasya bhaktasya vā tarpaṇasya vā yvāgūpānasya vā yācitvā ātmano pātram vā cīvaram vā bhaktam vā bhojyam vā glānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārān vā cetāpayen nissargikapācattikaṃ | atha khalu yasyārthāya yācati tam eva jānāpayitavyaṃ | atha dāni vastraṃ vipraṇāmeti bhaktasya vā tarpaṇasya vā yvāgūpānasya vā arthāya yācayitvā vaibhaṅgikaṃ dadāti | śayyāsanam vā upasthāpeti vārṣikam vā hemantikam vā deti | vinayātikramam āsādayati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī saṃghasya bhaktaṃ dāpeti | tyaktamuktam anavagṛhītaṃ dātavyaṃ | yadi tahiṃ kiñcic cheṣaṃ bhavati odanam vā sūpam vā yāvad bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā upadarśayitavyaṃ | yady ādāya gacchati adhyupekṣitavyaṃ | atha dān āha | āryāya demīti | vaktavyaṃ | na hi | saṃghasya dehi | athāha dinnaṃ mayā saṃghasya | āryāya demītī | pratīcchati | anāpattiḥ | bhikṣor api evam eva āpattis tu vinyātikramaḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained. 'Having solicited for the sake of others' means having solicited for the <s>Saṃgha's</s> meal, or porridge, or rice-gruel drink, and then exchanging for her own bowl, robe, food, comestibles, or medicinal requisites for the sick—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anyeṣām arthāya yācayitvā ātmano pātram vā cīvaram vā bhakṣyam vā bhojyam vā glānapratyayabhaiṣajya pariṣkārān vā cetāpayen niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having solicited for the sake of others, exchanges it for her own bowl, robe, edibles, comestibles, or medicinal requisites for the sick—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: niḥsargikapācattikadharma 14
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 14.

body.text: pātrāṇāṃ sannicayaḥ
body.translated_text: Accumulation of bowls.

body.text: 176. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo āgantukā āgatāḥ | tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo yathāvṛddhikāya utthāpayanti | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ yāva pātrāṇi saṃkrāmayemaḥ | tāyo dāni anastamite sūrye pravṛttāḥ saṃkrāmayituṃ | candraś codgataḥ na cāśeṣataḥ saṃkrāmitāni | āgantukā āhaṃsuḥ | ārye rikto vihārako | āhaṃsuḥ yāvat pātrāṇi saṃkrāmayemaḥ | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ | kiyanty āryamiśrikāṇāṃ pātrāṇi | kim āryamiśrikā pātrāpaṇaṃ prasārayiṣyanti | kā vā jātiḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocenti | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo | tā dāni śabdāpitāḥ | satyaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo ti | bhagavāṃs tad eva sarvaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evañ ca nāma yūyaṃ pātrasannicayaṃ karotha | tena hi na kṣamati pātrasannicayaṃ kartuṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 176. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Visiting <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> arrived. Those <s>bhikṣuṇ��s</s> were assigned places according to seniority. They said: 'Let us transfer the bowls.' They began to transfer them before the sun had set. The moon rose, but the transfer was not completed.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī pātrasannicayaṃ kuryān niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> accumulates bowls—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | pātrasannicayan ti pātran nāma sumbhakaṃ upasambhakaṃ | uktaṭeyakaṃ vaṅkeṭakaṃ tiṅkhinipātraṃ | jyeṣṭhakaṃ madhyamakaṃ kanyasakaṃ | apātraṃ atipātraṃ pariṣkārapātraṃ | sannicayaṃ kuryād iti saṃgrahaṃ kuryān nissargikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained. 'Accumulation of bowls': a 'bowl' means a <s>sumbhaka</s>, an <s>upasambhaka</s>, an <s>uktaṭeyaka</s>, a <s>vaṅkeṭaka</s>, a <s>tiṅkhinī</s>-bowl; the large, the medium, and the small; a non-bowl, an oversized bowl, and an accessory bowl. 'Should accumulate' means should hoard—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīya ṣodaṣa pātrāṇi upasthāpayitavyāni | ekaṃ pātram adhiṣṭhihitavyaṃ | trīṇi pātrāṇi mitrāṇām vikalpayitavyāni | catvāri apātrāṇi | catvāri atipātrāṇī | catvāri pariṣkārapātrāṇi | tad uttariṃ upasthāpayanti niḥsargikapācattikaṃ | etaṃ dāni bhikṣuṇīye parimāṇaṃ baddhaṃ pātradhāraṇaṃ | kiñcāpi bhikṣuḥ bahukāny api pātrāṇi vikalpetvā paribhuñjāti anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should keep sixteen bowls: one bowl should be formally designated; three bowls should be assigned to friends; four non-bowls; four oversized bowls; four accessory bowls. If she keeps more than that—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>. This is the measure fixed for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> regarding bowl-keeping.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī pātrasannicayaṃ kuryān niḥsargikapācattikaṃ
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> accumulates bowls—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: niḥsargikapācattikadharma 15
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 15.

body.text:
cīvarasannicayaḥ
176a. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo āgantukāḥ āgatā | tā bhikṣuṇīyo yathāvṛddhikāya upasthāpayanti | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ yāvac cīvarāṇi saṃkrāmemaḥ | tāyo dāni anastamite sūrye pravṛttāḥ saṃkrāmayituṃ | candrodgataḥ na cāśeṣato saṃkrāmitāni | āgantukāyo āhaṃsuḥ | ārye rikto vihārako | āhaṃsuḥ | yāvac cīvarānī saṃkrāmemaḥ | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ | kiyanty āryamiśrikāṇāṃ cīvarāṇi | kim āryamiśrikāḥ prāvarikāpaṇaṃ prasārayiṣyatha | kā vā jātiḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Accumulation of robes. 176a. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Visiting <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> arrived. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were assigned places according to seniority. They said: 'Let us transfer the robes.' They began to transfer them before the sun had set. The moon rose, but the transfer was not completed.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>—

body.text: yā tāvad ekaṃ pañcacīvaram adhiṣṭhihitavyaṃ | trīṇi pañca cīvarāṇi mitrāṇāṃ vikalpayitavyāni | evam etāni viṃśati cīvarāṇi | ato uttari upasthāpayen nissargikapācattikaṃ | etaṃ dāni bhikṣuṇīye parimāṇaṃ baddhañ cīvaradhāraṇaṃ | kiñcāpi bhikṣu bahukāni cīvarāṇi mitrāṇāṃ vikalpayitvā paribhuñjāti anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: First, one set of five robes should be formally designated; three sets of five robes should be assigned to friends. Thus these are twenty robes. If she keeps more than that—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>. This is the measure fixed for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> regarding robe-keeping. Although a <s>bhikṣu</s> may keep many [robes]...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīcīvarasannicayaṃ kuryāt nissargikapācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> accumulates robes—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: niḥsargikapācattikadharma 16
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 16.

body.text: niḥśṛjāti
body.translated_text: Discarding (<s>niḥśṛjāti</s>).

body.text: 177. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī cīvarāṇi naiva dhovati na sīveti na rañjeti | tāye dāni omalinamalinā saṃghāṭī pāṭitavipāṭitā | upāśraye nikṣiptā yā icchati sā upādīyatū ti | athāparā bhikṣuṇī jetā nāma lūhacīvaradharā | sā bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati | ārye etāṃ saṃghāṭiṃ dhoviya sīviya phoṣiya prāvṛtā | sā dāni sthūlanandā āha | ānehi ārye etāṃ saṃghāṭiṃ mahyaṃ eṣā saṃghāṭī | paśyatha āryamiśrikāyo na kiñcic chakyate upāśraye nikṣipituṃ | labdhotkṣiptikāhi pūro saṃghārāmo tāva | dhṛṣṭā ca mukharā ca pragalbhā ca sā dāni tāya saṃghāṭī ācchinnā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 177. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> neither washed, nor sewed, nor dyed her robes. Her outer robe (<s>saṃghāṭī</s>) was extremely soiled and torn to pieces. She left it in the residence [saying]: 'Whoever wishes may take it.' Then another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Jetā</s>, who wore coarse robes, was told by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble one, wash, sew, and dry this outer robe and wear it.' Then <s>Sthūlanandā</s> said: 'Bring it here, noble one; that outer robe is mine. Look, noble sisters, one cannot leave anything in the residence. The monastery is full of these women who pick up [whatever is] discarded.' Being bold, sharp-tongued, and forward, she took back that outer robe. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> also reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇyupāśraye purāṇasaṃghāṭiṃ nikṣipetvā vā nikṣipāyetvā vā yā icchati sā upādīyatū ti | uktvā paścāt svayam eva upādiyeya nissargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣu��ī</s>, having placed an old outer robe (<s>saṃghāṭī</s>) in the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence, or having had it placed there, [saying:] 'Whoever wishes may take it'—and afterwards takes it up herself—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s> (forfeiture-and-expiation).

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | peyālaṃ | bhikṣuṇy upāśraye ti bhikṣuṇīvihāre | saṃghāṭīti cīvaraṃ | nikṣipetvā ti svayaṃ | nikṣipāyetvā ti pareṇa | yā icchati sā upādīyatū ti paścāt svayam eva upādīyeta niḥsargikapācattikaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīupāśraye cīvaraṃ nikṣipetvā vā nikṣipāyetvā vā yā icchati sā upādīyatū ti yadi kāci upādinnam bhavati na kṣamati ācchindituṃ | ācchindati niḥsargikaṃ bhavati | atha dāni na kāyaci upādinnam bhavati tasyā eva ca tāya artho bhavati kiñcāpi gṛhṇāti anāpattiḥ | atha dāni kṣudrānukṣudrakaṃ pariṣkāraṃ nikṣiptam bhavati yadi kāyaci upādinnam bhavati na kṣamati ācchindituṃ | ācchindati vinayātikramam āsadayati | bhikṣur api bhikṣuvihāre pātram vā cīvaram vā upānaham vā kṣudrānukṣudrakam vā pariṣkāraṃ nikṣipitvā yo icchati so upādīyatū ti | yadi kenacid upādinnam bhavati na kṣamati ācchincituṃ | ācchindati vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha na kenacid gṛhītam bhavati so eva tenārthiko bhavati kiñcāpi gṛhṇāti anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. Abbreviation. 'In the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence'—means in the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> monastery. 'Outer robe' (<s>saṃghāṭī</s>)—means a robe. 'Having placed'—means by oneself. 'Having had placed'—means by another. 'Whoever wishes may take it'—if afterwards she takes it up herself, it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> has placed a robe in the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence or had it placed there [and reclaims it—the forfeiture applies].

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇy upāśraye purāṇasaṃghāṭiṃ nikṣipetvā vā nikṣipāyetvā vā yā icchati sā upādīyatū ti uktvā paścāt svayam eva upādīyeya niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having placed an old outer robe in the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence, or having had it placed there, [saying:] 'Whoever wishes may take it'—and afterwards takes it up herself—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text:
niḥsargikapācattikadharma 17
niḥsīveti
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 17: Unstitching [and not re-sewing]

body.text: 178. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparāya dāni bhikṣuṇīya purāṇasaṃghāṭī omalinamalinā dhovitvā niḥsīvitvā ātape dattvā vāto ca pravāpito | agniś ca utthitaḥ | saṃghāṭī dagdhā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocenti | peyālaṃ yāvad bhagavān āha | evan nāma tvaṃ purāṇasaṃghāṭīṃ niḥsīvitvā na pratisaṃdhaisi na pratisandhāpayasi | tena hi pratisandhetavyaṃ pratisandhāpetavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 178. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s old outer robe was extremely soiled. Having washed it and unstitched it, she placed it in the sun [to dry]. The wind blew, a fire arose, and the outer robe was burnt. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Abbreviation. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How could you unstitich your old outer robe [and leave it thus]?'

body.text: eṣā cārthotpattiḥ | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo śākiyakanyāyo mallakanyāyo lecchavi kanyāyo sukumārāyo bhārikāṃ saṃghāṭiṃ dhovantīyo kilamyanti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi anujānāmi ṣaṭpañcarātraṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīm gautamīm āmantrayati | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: This is the circumstance of the origin: those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—<s>Śākya</s> girls, <s>Malla</s> girls, and <s>Licchavi</s> girls—being delicately raised, became exhausted washing the heavy outer robe. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> also reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore I permit [a period of] five or six nights [to re-sew].'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī purāṇasaṃghāṭiṃ niḥsīvitvā niḥsivāpetvā vā uttari ṣaṭpañcarātram agilānā na pratisandhāye na pratisandhāpayena niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having unstitched an old outer robe by herself or having had it unstitched, does not re-stitch or have it re-stitched within five or six nights, when not ill—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | purāṇasaṃghāṭīti purāṇacīvaraṃ | saṃghāṭīti dvipuṭā | niḥsīvitvā ti svayaṃ | niḥsīvāpetvā ti pareṇa | uttarīti ṣaṭpañcarātram iti na dāni ṣaṭpañca ca | atha khalu paramaṃ ṣaṭrātran na pratisandheyaiti svayaṃ na pratisandhāpeyā ti pareṇa | na pratisandhāpeyan nissargikapācattikaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'Old outer robe'—means an old robe. 'Outer robe' (<s>saṃghāṭī</s>)—means doubled [cloth]. 'Having unstitched'—by oneself. 'Having had unstitched'—by another. 'Beyond'—means five or six nights, which is not actually five, but at most six nights. 'Should not re-stitch'—by oneself. 'Should not have re-stitched'—by another. [If she does not re-stitch or have it re-stitched—it is a] <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: eṣā dāni bhikṣuṇīye saṃghāṭī malinā bhavati | yadi tāva lahukā bhoti tathā yeva dhovitavyā | na kṣamati niḥsīvayituṃ | atha dāni sārikā bhoti niḥsīvetvā niḥsīvitvā dhovitavyā | pratyargalakāni dattvā ātape dātavyā | sāharitvā gopiṭake vā kuṇḍake vā paṭalake vā sthāpayitvā kāṣṭhakhaṇḍena vā upalakhaṇḍena vā ākramitavyā | na kṣamati prakīrṇam osārayituṃ | atha dāni bhājanan na bhavati ekasthāne ākramiya iṣṭakena vā upalakhaṇḍena vā sthāpayitavyā | paścād antevāsiṇīya vā samānopādhyāyinīyā vā bhikṣuṇīya pratisandhāpayitavyā svayam vā pratisandhetavyā | atha dāni jarādurbalā vyādhidurbalā vā bhavati kiñcāpi cireṇa pratisandheti anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now, when this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s outer robe is soiled: if it is light, it should be washed just as it is—it is not permissible to unstitch it. But if it is coarse, it should be unstitched and then washed. Cross-bars should be put in and it should be placed in the sun. Having gathered it, it should be stored in a basket, a pot, or on a shelf, and pressed flat with a piece of wood or a stone.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī purāṇasaṃghāṭīn niḥsīvitvā vā niḥsīvāpetvā vā uttari ṣaṭpañcarātraṃ aglānā na pratisandhe vā na pratisandhāpeya vā niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having unstitched an old outer robe or having had it unstitched, does not re-stitch or have it re-stitched within five or six nights when not ill—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: niḥsargikapācattikadharma 18
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 18

body.text: uktvā śikṣamāṇāṃ
body.translated_text: Having promised a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s> (trainee)

body.text: 179. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparā dāni śikṣamānā upasampādyā | sā dāni sthūlanandāṃ bhikṣuṇīm āha | ārye nande upasampādaya māṃ | sā āha | yadi cīvaram desi tato ham upasampādemi | tāya dāni tasyāś cīvaraṃ dattaṃ | sā dān āha | ārye upasampādaya māṃ | sā vilakṣeti | sā bhikṣuṇīnām āha | evam eva yāva sā vilakṣeti nopasampādeti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 179. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Another <s>śikṣamāṇā</s> was to be fully ordained. She said to the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>: 'Noble <s>Nandā</s>, ordain me.' She replied: 'If you give me a robe, then I will ordain you.' That [trainee] gave her a robe. She said: 'Noble one, ordain me.' [But <s>Sthūlanandā</s>] was embarrassed. She told the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'She said thus [to me]...'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī śikṣamāṇām evam uktvā yadi me cīvaraṃ desi tato ham upasampādayiṣyāmīti tāye cīvaraṃ gṛhya nopasampādayen niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having said to a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s>: 'If you give me a robe, then I will ordain you'—having taken her robe and not ordaining her—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | śikṣamāṇā ti deśitaśikṣā | yadi me cīvaraṃ desi tato ham upasampādayiṣyan ti | cīvaran ti cīvaraṃ nāma kambalaṃ karpāsaṃ yāvat saṃkakṣikā | upasthāpayiṣyan ti upasaṃpādayiṣyaṃ | sā taṃ cīvaraṃ gṛhṇitvā ti yathā sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī na upasampādayed iti svayan na upasampādayet niḥsargikapācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | eṣā tāva bhikṣuṇī śikṣyamāṇāyā cīvaraṃ gṛhṇāti | ahan te upasampādayiṣyāmīti | tāya upasaṃsthāpayitavyā | atha dāni apratibalā bhavati jarādurbalā vyādhidurbalā vā anyā adhyeṣitavyā | vaktavyā etasyā mayā cīvaraṃ gṛhītvā imām upasthāpehi | atha sā necchati taṃ cīvaraṃ pratidātavyaṃ | gaccha yatrecchasi tatra upasaṃpadyāhīti | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī cīvaraṃ gṛhītvā na upasthāpeti na cīvaraṃ pratidadāti niḥsargikapācattikaṃ | bhikṣur api vinayātikramaḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. '<s>Śikṣamāṇā</s>'—means one who has been instructed in the training rules. 'If you give me a robe, then I will ordain you'—a robe (<s>cīvara</s>) means a woolen [cloth], a cotton [cloth]—up to a shoulder-cloth (<s>saṃkakṣikā</s>). 'I will ordain'—means 'I will give full ordination.' 'Having taken that robe'—just as the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>—'does not ordain [her]': neither ordains by oneself nor has another ordain.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī śikṣamānām evaṃ vaditvā yadi me cīvararaṃ desi tato ham upasaṃpādayiṣyan ti tasyāś cīvaraṃ pratigṛhṇītvā na upasaṃpādayen niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having said to a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s>: 'If you give me a robe, then I will ordain you'—having accepted her robe and not ordaining her—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: niḥsargikapācattikadharma 19
body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargikapācattika</s> rule 19

body.text: guruprāvaraṇaṃ
body.translated_text: The heavy outer garment (<s>guruprāvaraṇa</s>)

body.text: 180. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | aparo dāni vāṇijako śatasahasramūlyaṃ kambalaratanam ādāya uttarā pathāto āgato | so dāni aparehi pṛcchito kim asya mūlyaṃ | āha | śatasahasramūlyan ti | naiva rājā krīṇāti na rājaputrāḥ na vaṇijāḥ na sārthavāhāḥ | so dāni vāṇijako vīthīm abhiruhitvā cintāsāgaram anupraviṣṭo āsati | imaṃ mahārghaṃ mūlyaṃ bhāṇḍaṃ bahuśulkaṃ na vikrāyati | aparo dāni pṛcchati | vikrītaṃ te bhāṇḍaṃ | āha | nahi icchasi vikrīṇituṃ | āha | icchāmi | āha | gaccha eṣā bhadrā nāma śramaṇikā sā krīṇīṣyati | so dāni taṃ ceṭakasya skandhe āropayitvā bhikṣuṇī vihāraṃ gatvā pṛcchati | katamaṃ āryāye bhadrāye pariveṇaṃ | aparāhi bhikṣuṇīhi ākhyātaṃ | so dāni praviśya āha | vandāmy ārye āryā bhadrānāma āha | bāḍhaṃ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ | āha | imaṃ kambalaratanaṃ vikreyaṃ vikrīṇāmi | āha | kim etasya mūlyaṃ | āha | śatasahasraṃ | sā dāni na paṇeti na paṇāpeti | antevāsinīye āha | gaccha sālohitaṃ jalpāhi imasya śatasahasraṃ vīthīkāto dāpehīti | so dāni aparehi pṛcchito | vikrītaṃ te bhāṇḍaṃ | āha | vikrītaṃ | āha | kena krītaṃ | āha | eṣā bhadrā nāma śramaṇikā | tāya krītaṃ | te dāni ojjhāyanti | adyāpy eṣā pravrajitā pi mahacchandā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato āroceti | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha bhadrāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ yāvad ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | nanu bhadre paścimā pi nāma janatā avalokayitavyā | tena hi na kṣamati uttari catuṣkarṣeṇa guruprāvaraṇaṃ cetāpayituṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 180. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. A certain merchant, carrying a jewel-blanket (<s>kambalaratna</s>) worth a hundred thousand [coins], came from the northern region. When others asked: 'What is its price?'—he said: 'A hundred thousand.' Neither the king, nor princes, nor merchants, nor caravan-leaders purchased it. Then that merchant, ascending to the street, [plunged] into an ocean of worry.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī uttari catuṣkarṣeṇa guruprāvaraṇaṃ cetāpayati ṅissargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> procures a heavy outer garment (<s>guruprāvaraṇa</s>) exceeding four <s>karṣas</s> in value—it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>.

body.text: uttari catuṣkarṣeṇeti karṣo nāma catvāraḥ purāṇāḥ | catvāraḥ kārṣāḥ ṣoḍaṣakārṣāpaṇāḥ | guruprāvaraṇam iti kambalaratnaṃ | cetāpayed iti jānāpayet | tad uttariṃ paraṃ ṣoḍaṣehi purāṇehi cetāpayati niḥsargikapācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī guruprāvaraṇaṃ cetāpayitukāmā bhavati catuṣkarṣamūlyaṃ jānāpayitavyaṃ | pratyavaro vā tad uttariṃ na kṣamati |
body.translated_text: 'Exceeding four <s>karṣas</s>'—a <s>karṣa</s> is four <s>purāṇas</s>; four <s>karṣas</s> are sixteen <s>kārṣāpaṇas</s>. 'Heavy outer garment'—means a jewel-blanket (<s>kambalaratna</s>). 'Procures'—means has made. If she procures one exceeding sixteen <s>purāṇas</s>, it is a <s>niḥsargikapācattika</s>. Up to the formal designation. When that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> wishes to procure a heavy outer garment, she should procure one worth four <s>karṣas</s> [or less].

body.text: atha dāni kocid ayācito avijñapto mahārghamūlyaṃ pi dadāti pratigṛhṇāty anāpattiḥ | tad evaṃ bhikṣuṇīye parimāṇabaddhaṃ | kiñcāpi bhikṣur mahārghamūlyaṃ pi jānāpayitvā paribhuñjāty anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now, if someone gives unsolicited, uninvited, even something of great value—she may accept it without offense. Thus the limit is fixed for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. But even though a <s>bhikṣu</s> may have something of great value procured and use it, there is no offense. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī uttari catuṣkarṣamūlyāto guruprāvaraṇaṃ cetāpayen niḥsargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should have a heavy outer garment (<s>guruprāvaraṇa</s>) made exceeding four <s>karṣas</s> in value—it is a <s>niḥsargika-pācattika</s> (forfeiture with expiation) offense.

body.translated_text: <s>Niḥsargika-pācattika</s> rule 20:

body.translated_text: Fine [cloth] (<s>sukhuma</s>).

body.text: 181. bhagavān vaiśālīyaṃ viharati | aparo dāni vāṇijako dakṣiṇapathāto āgato | daśasahasramūlyaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇapaṭam ādāya | so dāni aparehi pṛcchito | kiṃ mūlyaṃ | āha | daśapurāṇasahasrāṇi | naiva rājā krīṇāti | peyālaṃ | yāvad atra bhadrā nāma śramaṇikā | sā krīṇiṣyati | so dāni tam ādāya bhikṣuṇīvihāraṃ gato | pṛcchati | katamaṃ āryāye bhadrāye pariveṇaṃ | aparāhi ākhyātaṃ | so dāni praviśya āha | vandāmy ārye āryā bhadrā nāma | āha | bāḍhaṃ | kiṃ kartavyaṃ | āha | ayaṃ haṃsalakṣaṇo paṭo vikrāyati | āha | kim etasya mūlyam | āha daśapurāṇa sahasrāṇi | sā na svayaṃ paṇeti na paṇāpeti | antevāsinīm āha | gaccha sālohitaṃ jalpāhi imasya pīṭhikāto daśapurāṇasahasrāṇi dehīti | so dāni aparehi pṛcchito vikrītaṃ te bhāṇḍaṃ | āha | vikrītaṃ | āha | kena krītaṃ | eṣā tu bhadrā nāma śramaṇikā | tāya krītaṃ | te dāni ojjhāyanti | adyāpy eṣā pravrajitā pi mahacchandā |
body.translated_text: 181. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. Now a merchant had come from the southern country (<s>Dakṣiṇāpatha</s>), bringing a cloth marked with swan-designs worth ten thousand [coins]. He was asked by others: 'What is the price?' He said: 'Ten thousand <s>purāṇas</s>.' Even the king did not buy it. [Abbreviation.] Until: 'There is a female ascetic named <s>Bhadrā</s>. She will buy it.' He took it to the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> monastery and asked: 'Which is the dwelling of the Noble <s>Bhadrā</s>?' Others showed him. He entered and said: 'I bow to the Noble One. Are you the noble <s>Bhadrā</s>?' She said: 'Indeed. What is to be done?' He said: 'This swan-design cloth is for sale.' She said: 'What is its price?' He said: 'Ten thousand <s>purāṇas</s>.' She neither bargained herself nor had anyone bargain, [but] said to her pupil: 'Go, tell the relative: give ten thousand <s>purāṇas</s> from this account.' He was then asked by others: 'Has your merchandise been sold?' He said: 'Sold.' They asked: 'By whom was it bought?' 'That female ascetic named <s>Bhadrā</s>. She bought it.' They were displeased: 'Even as a renunciant she remains greatly desirous!'

body.text: etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī pi gautamī bhagavato ārocayati | yāvad bhagavān āha | nanu bhadre paścimā pi nāma janatā avalokayitavyā | tena hi na kṣamati uttari aḍḍhātiya karṣamūlyāto sukhumaṃ cīvaraṃ cetāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> too reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: '<s>Bhadrā</s>, should not future generations also be considered? Therefore, it is not permissible to have a fine robe made exceeding two-and-a-half <s>karṣas</s> in value.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>... until they will be made utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī uttari aḍḍhātiyakarṣamūlyāto sūkṣmaṃ cīvaraṃ cetāpayen nissargikapācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should have a fine robe made exceeding two-and-a-half <s>karṣas</s> in value—it is a <s>niḥsargika-pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | uttarin ti atireka | aḍḍhātiyakarṣan ti | karṣo nāma catvāraḥ purāṇāḥ | catāpayed iti jānāpayen | niḥsargika pācattikaṃ yāvat yā puna bhikṣuṇī sukhumaṃ cīvaraṃ jānāpayati daśapurāṇamūlyaṃ jānāpayitavyaṃ | praty avaraṃ vā | etaṃ bhikṣuṇīye parimāṇabaddhaṃ | atha dānī kocid ayācito avijñapto mahārghamūlyaṃ pi dadāti śatikam vā sāhasrikam vā yadi kiñcāpi paribhuñjāti anāpattiḥ | kiñcāpi bhikṣu śatasahasramūlyaṃ pi jānāpayaty anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Exceeding' means in excess. 'Two-and-a-half <s>karṣas</s>': a <s>karṣa</s> is four <s>purāṇas</s>. 'Should have made' means should have it procured. '<s>Niḥsargika-pācattika</s>':...
