'Family' means a <s>brāhmaṇa</s> family and the like—where there are a woman and a man, pots and pans, mortar and pestle, sauce and grain measure—such a household. 'At an intimate time' (<s>saṃbhojanīya</s>) means when a woman is food [i.e., enjoyment] for a man, and a man is food for a woman. 'If past midday, during the day, without having previously announced herself' means without having made a sound. 'Should visit uninvited' means should enter—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. Up to the rule establishment. When it is known that 'this is a family at an intimate time,' it is not permissible to visit there during the day without having announced oneself and without being invited. If there is a doorkeeper, one should say: 'I wish to enter.' If he says: 'Do not enter,' one should not enter. If he says: 'Wait a moment until I inform [them]'—if, having entered, he does not come out, it is not permissible to enter. If there is a whispering sound, one should snap one's fingers or cough. If they remain silent, it is not permissible to enter. But if they come out to greet [her saying] 'Welcome, Noble One! Please enter,' then one should enter. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, if he visits [such a family] without being informed, incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī saṃbhojanīye kule divā upasaṃkrameya pūrve apratisaṃviditā anāhūtā pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowingly, should visit a family at an intimate time, during the day, without having previously announced herself and uninvited—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: pācattikadharma 86
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 86:

body.text: saṃsargo
body.translated_text: Close association (<s>saṃsarga</s>).

body.text: 200. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | yā dāni sā kālīyan triyantarā licchavidhītā pravrājitā | sā dāni āgārikehi ca prāvrājakehi ca sārdhaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te kāli | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo | peyālaṃ |
body.translated_text: 200. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. Now, that <s>Licchavi</s> girl with three abnormal [features], whom <s>Kālī</s> had ordained—she lived in close association with laymen and wandering ascetics. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Kālī</s>.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.' [Abbreviation.]

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ārāmikair vā parivrājikair vā saṃsṛṣṭā vihareya divasaṃ vā muhūrtaṃ vā antamasato ārāmikaśramaṇoddeśehi pācattikam ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should live in close association with park-attendants or wandering ascetics, for a day or for a moment, or even with park-attendant novices at the least—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | peyālaṃ | yāvat | āgārikehīt | gṛhībhiḥ | parivrājikehīti gautamajaṭilakaparyantehi tīrthikehi | saṃsṛṣṭā vihared iti kāyikena saṃsargeṇa vācikena saṃsargeṇa | kāyikavācikena saṃsargeṇa | divasam vā muhūrtam vā antamasato tatkṣaṇantallavaṃ tanmuhūrtam vā antamasato | ārāmikaśramaṇoddeśehīti | ārāmikāḥ saṃghopasthāyakāḥ | śramaṇ'uddeśā iti pañcadaśavarṣān upādāya yāvat saptatikāḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ārāmikehi vā parivrājakehi vā saṃsṛṣṭā viharati pācattikaṃ | atha dāni bhikṣuṇīyo anyamanyaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharanti viharanty abhiratā vivecayitavyāḥ | vīcīkārāpayitavyāḥ | trir api bhikṣuṇā sārdhaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. [Abbreviation.] 'With laymen' means with householders. 'With wandering ascetics' means with heretics, including up to <s>Gautama</s> ascetics and matted-hair ascetics. 'Should live in close association' means through bodily contact, through verbal contact, or through bodily-and-verbal contact. 'For a day or a moment'—even for that instant, that second, that moment at the least. 'Park-attendants' means servants of the <s>Saṃgha</s>. 'Novices' (<s>śramaṇoddeśas</s>) means from fifteen years of age up to seventy. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> lives in close association with park-attendants or wandering ascetics—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Now, if <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> live in close association with each other, enjoying each other's company, they should be separated and made to live apart. If she lives in close association with a <s>bhikṣu</s> for three times, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ārāmikair vā parivrājikair vā sārdhaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharet divasam vā muhūrtam vā antamasato ārāmikaśramaṇ'uddeśakaiḥ sārdhaṃ pācattikaṃ || 6 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should live in close association with park-attendants or wandering ascetics, for a day or a moment, or even with park-attendant novices at the least—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. [6]

body.text: pācattikadharma 87
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 87:

body.text: upaśapati
body.translated_text: Taking oaths (<s>upaśapati</s>).

body.text: 201. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi sārdhaṃ kalahaṃ karoti | sā dāni yādā parājītā bhavati tadā upasampati | namo bhagavato bhagavataḥ pādehi śapāmi | kāṣāyehi śapāmi | duḥkhasyāntena śapāmi | yady aham evaṃ bravīmi | mā kāṣāyehi kālaṃ karomi | mā duḥkhasyāntaṃ karomi | mātṛghātikasya gatiṅ gacchāmi | piṭrghātikasya gatiṅ gacchāmi | arhantaghātikasya gatiṅ gacchāmi | yāvad akṛtajñasya gatiṅ gacchāmi | mitradrohasya gatiṅ gacchāmi | āryāpavādakasya gatiṅ gacchāmi | nairayikībhavāmi | tiryagyonigatiṃ gacchāmi | pretī bhavāmi | yā pi bhadrāyaṇī mām evam āha sā py evam bhavatu | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvat śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | etad eva sarvaṃ bhagavāṃ vistareṇācocayati | yāvat āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 201. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> quarreled with the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. When she was defeated [in argument], she would take oaths: 'Homage to the <s>Bhagavān</s>! I swear by the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet! I swear by the saffron robes! I swear by the end of suffering! If I speak thus [falsely]—may I not die in saffron robes! May I not make an end of suffering! May I go to the destiny of a matricide! May I go to the destiny of a patricide! May I go to the destiny of one who kills an <s>Arhat</s>! Up to: may I go to the destiny of an ingrate! May I go to the destiny of one who betrays a friend! May I go to the destiny of one who slanders noble ones! May I become a hell-being! May I go to the animal realm! May I become a hungry ghost! And may <s>Bhadrāyaṇī</s> who speaks to me thus also become the same!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Until: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>.' All of this the <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned in detail. Until: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>.' [Abbreviation.] Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text:
yā puna bhikṣuṇī upaśapantī viharet ātmānaṃ sandhāya parām vā sandhāya pācattikaṃ |
yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | pe | upaśapantī vihareyā ti śapathaṃ kuryāt | nama bhagavato bhagavataḥ pādehi śapāmi | sarvaṃ pūrvavat | yāvat sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ātmānaṃ sandhāya param vā upaśapati pācattikam | bhikṣur api upaśapati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should live making oaths, whether regarding herself or regarding another—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. [Abbreviation.] 'Should live making oaths' means should make sworn statements. 'Homage to the <s>Bhagavān</s>! I swear by the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet!'—all as before. Until: If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> takes oaths regarding herself or another—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, if he takes oaths, incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upaśapantī vihared ātmānaṃ vā sandhāya paraṃ vā pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should live making oaths, whether regarding herself or regarding another—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: pācattikadharma 88
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 88:

body.text: rodati
body.translated_text: Weeping (<s>rodati</s>).

body.text: 202. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi sārdhaṃ kalahaṃ karoti | sā yadā parājitā bhavati tadā ātmānaṃ khaṭacapeṭamustakehi piṭṭāyati | udaram āhanayati | balabalāya rodati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | satyaṃ tvaṃ nande evaṃ nāma bhikṣuṇīhi sārdhaṃ kalahaṃ karoṣi | peyālaṃ | yāvad balabalāya rodasi | āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande naiṣa dharmo yāvat tena hi na kṣamati ātmānaṃ hanitvā rodituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 202. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> quarreled with the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. When she was defeated, she would strike herself with slaps, blows, and fists, beat her stomach, and weep loudly. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Is it true, <s>Nandā</s>, that you quarrel with the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>?' [Abbreviation.] 'Up to: weep loudly?' 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>. This is not the <s>Dharma</s>.' Until: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to weep after striking oneself.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> [addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>]: Until 'they will be utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ātmānaṃ hanitvā rodeya pācattikaṃ || yā puna bhikṣuṇīti | peyālaṃ | ātmānaṃ hanitvā ti khaṭehi vā pāṣāṇehi vā yāvad anyena vā kenacit | rodeyā ti aśruṇi vā pravartayet pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ātmānaṃ hanti na rodayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | rodati na hanati vinayātikramam āsādayati | hanati ca rodati ca pācattikam āsādayati | naiva hanati na rodati anāpattiḥ | bhikṣur api ātmānaṃ hanitvā rodati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should weep after striking herself—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—[abbreviation]. 'After striking herself' means with slaps, or with stones, or with anything else. 'Should weep' means should shed tears—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Up to the rule establishment. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> strikes herself but does not weep, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. If she weeps but does not strike, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. If she both strikes and weeps, she incurs a <s>pācattika</s>. If she neither strikes nor weeps, there is no offense. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, if he strikes himself and weeps, incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ātmānaṃ hanitvā rodeya pācattikaṃ || 8 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should weep after striking herself—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. [8]

body.text: pācattikadharma 89
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 89:

body.text: kṣiyati
body.translated_text: Causing decline (<s>kṣiyati</s>).

body.text: 203. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandāya dāni bhikṣūṇīya jetā bhikṣuṇī kulehi saṃvarṇitā | sā jetā bhikṣuṇī bhadrikā kulāny upasaṃkramati prāsādikenātikrāntena pratikrāntenāvalokitena vyavalokitena saṃmiñjitena prasāritena saṃghāṭīpātracīvaradhāraṇena anuddhatā anunnaḍā acapalā amukharā aprakīrṇā vācā | sā prāsādikā ti prasannā devamanuṣyāḥ | te tehiṃ kārā kurvanti | pratyālapanti pratyutthihinti | nimantrayanti pātreṇa cīvareṇa glānapratyayabhaiṣajyapariṣkārehi | sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī anākalpasampannā anīryāpathasampannā omalinamalinehi cīvarehi pāṭitavipaṭitehi vaḍḍaḍiṅgarapuṣṭālaṃbehi stanehi vaḍḍehi sphicakehi uddhatā unnaḍā capalā mukharā prakīrṇā vācā | te tasyā na gauravaṃ kurvanti na nimantrayanti |
body.translated_text: 203. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Jetā</s> had surpassed <s>Sthūlanandā</s> among the [donor] families. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Jetā</s>, being virtuous, would visit the families with a pleasing manner of going and coming back, of looking and glancing around, of bending and stretching, of wearing her outer robe, bowl, and robes—unagitated, unarrogant, unrestless, ungarrulous, with measured speech. Being pleasing, gods and humans were devoted [to her]. They paid her respects, greeted her, rose to receive her, invited her with bowls, robes, and medicinal requisites for the sick. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>, however, was not accomplished in proper deportment, not accomplished in proper bearing, wearing soiled, dirty, torn, and tattered robes, with large sagging breasts and large buttocks—agitated, arrogant, restless, garrulous, with scattered speech. They paid her no respect and did not invite her.

body.text: sā dāni bhikṣuṇīnām āha | paśyatha āryamiśrikāyo mamaivāryā jetā kulehi saṃvarṇitā mahy'evāvarṇaṃ bravīti | sā dān āha | nāsty etaṃ ārye | nāham āryāye avarṇaṃ bhāṣāmi | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha |duṣkṛtaṃ te nande | peyālaṃ | yāvad eva nāma tvaṃ duḥśrutena duravadhāritena kṣiyādharmam āpadyasi | tena hi na kṣamati duḥśrutena duravadhāritena kṣiyādharmam āpadyasi | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaye gautami yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: She then said to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Look, Noble Ladies—my own [pupil] <s>Jetā</s> is praised by the families, while she disparages me!' <s>Jetā</s> said: 'That is not so, Noble One. I do not disparage you.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>.' [Abbreviation.] 'How is it that you, on the basis of hearsay and misunderstanding, bring about a charge of decline? Therefore, it is not permissible, on the basis of hearsay and misunderstanding, to bring about a charge of decline.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble, <s>Gautamī</s>, [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>]... until they will be utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣūṇīnām evaṃ vadeya | yadāham ārye amukaṃ kulam upasaṃkrāmi | tato itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye bhagavaty āghāto apratyaya iti duḥśrutena duravadhāritena kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'When I, Noble One, visit such-and-such a family, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so expresses displeasure and mistrust in the <s>Bhagavān</s>'—if, on the basis of hearsay and misunderstanding, she brings about a charge of decline—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | bhikṣuṇīnāṃ evam vadeyā ti yathā sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī yāvad āham ārye amukaṃ kulan ti kulan nāma kṣatriyakulaṃ kulan nāma kṣatriyakulaṃ brāhmaṇakulaṃ rājanyakulaṃ yāni ca punar anyāni kulāni | tato itthannāmāye ti yathā jetā pi bhikṣuṇīye | bhagavaty āghāta iti na ca āghātavastūni asthānaprakopadaśamāni | apratyaya iti duḥśrutena duravadhāriteneti na ākāravantena darśanena na ākāravantena śramaṇena kṣiyādharmam āpadyeyā ti avadhyāpeya pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye duḥśrutena duravadhāritena kṣiyādharmam āpadyituṃ | āpadyati pācattikam āsādayati | bhikṣur api duḥśrutena dur avadhāritena kṣiyādharmam āpadyati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Should say this to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means like the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>. Up to: 'Noble ladies, when I visit such-and-such a family' — 'family' means a <s>Kṣatriya</s> family, a <s>Brāhmaṇa</s> family, a <s>Rājanya</s> family, and whatever other families there are. 'From that, [the family feels] offense toward the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> so-and-so' means like toward the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Jetā</s>. 'Offense against the <s>Bhagavān</s>' means — yet the grounds for offense are not among the ten causes for groundless anger. 'Distrust' means through hearsay or misunderstanding — not through well-founded perception, not through well-founded reasoning. 'Should incur the diminishing <s>dharma</s>' means should cause to diminish — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to incur the diminishing <s>dharma</s> through hearsay or misunderstanding. If she incurs it, she commits a <s>pācattika</s>. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> also incurs the diminishing <s>dharma</s> through hearsay or misunderstanding, he incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīnām evam vadeya yadāham ārye amukaṃ kulaṃ upasamkramāmi | tato itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye bhagavaty āghāto 'pratyaya iti duḥśrutena duravadhāritena kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya pācattikaṃ || 9 ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'Noble ladies, when I visit such-and-such a family, from that the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> so-and-so [develops] offense against the <s>Bhagavān</s> and distrust' — and through hearsay or misunderstanding should incur the diminishing <s>dharma</s>, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [9]

body.text: pācattikadharma 90
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 90

body.text: kulamātsaryeṇa
body.translated_text: Jealousy Regarding Families (<s>kulamātsarya</s>)

body.text: 204. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī kālasyaiva nivāsayitvā pātracīvaram ādāya mahātmehi kulehi dvārakoṣṭhakehi tiṣṭhati | bhikṣūṇāṃ praviśantānām āha | praviśantu āryāḥ praviśantu āryamiśrāḥ asmākaṃ kṛtena sidhyati | agrapiṇḍan tāvad dattvā yuṣmākaṃ prathamānām eva paścād ātmanā paribhuñjiṣyan ti | mā anyāni kulāni upasaṃkramatha | nahi anyehi sidhyati | te dāni vrīḍitāḥ pratyosakṣanti | bhikṣuṇīnām apy evaṃ kartavyaṃ | evaṃ carakaparivrājakājīvakanirgranthāḥ yāvad dharmacintakāḥ praviśanti | sā dāni teṣāṃ praviśantānām ākrośati | caṇḍāyū naṣṭāśā bhagnāśāḥ | surābhrastā yānā gardabhāḥ nagnāḥ ahrīkāḥ anotrāpiṇo mithyādṛṣṭikāḥ vinipatitāḥ praviśatha yuṣmākaṃ kṛtena sidhyati | yuṣmākam agrapiṇḍan tāvad dattvā prathamānām eva paścād ātmānaṃ paribhokṣyan ti | mā anyāni kulāny upasaṃkramatha | nahi anyehi kleśehi sidhyati | te dāni vrīḍitāḥ pratyosakṣanti | evaṃ sarvabhikṣācaraṇām āvaraṇaṃ karoti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ | bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtan te nande yāvad evan nāma tvaṃ kulamātsaryaṃ karoṣi | tena hi na kṣamati kulamātsaryaṃ karoṣi | tena hi na kṣamati kulamātsaryaṃ kartuṃ | atha khalu bhagavān māhāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami | peyālaṃ | yāvat |
body.translated_text: 204. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s>, having dressed very early, taking her bowl and robe, would stand at the doorways of prominent families. To <s>bhikṣus</s> entering, she would say: 'Enter, noble ones, enter, noble sirs! By our efforts [the family] is won over. Having first given the best portion of alms-food to you who come first, they will eat afterward. Do not visit other families — others cannot win them over.' Those [<s>bhikṣus</s>], embarrassed, would turn back. She would do the same to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. And when <s>Carakas</s>, <s>Parivrājakas</s>, <s>Ājīvakas</s>, <s>Nirgranthas</s>, up to Dharma contemplators entered, she would abuse them as they entered: 'You whose lives are wretched, whose hopes are ruined, whose hopes are shattered! You drunkards, you asses of vehicles, you naked ones, shameless, immodest, holders of wrong views, destined for ruin! Enter — by your efforts [the family] is won over! Having first given you the best portion of alms-food as you come first, they will eat afterward! Do not visit other families — others cannot win them over through such afflictions!' Those, embarrassed, would turn back. Thus she obstructed all who went for alms. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Nandā</s>.' She was summoned. All the same [was reviewed]. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned in detail. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>, up to: how could you behave with jealousy regarding families? Therefore it is not permissible to act with jealousy regarding families.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>], <s>Gautamī</s>.' [Abbreviated.] Up to:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī kulamātsaryaṃ kuryāt pācattikaṃ | yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | kulamātsaryan ti āvaraṇaṃ kuryāt pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya kulamātsaryaṃ kartuṃ | karoti pācattikam āsādayati | yadi tāvad bhikṣur vā bhikṣuṇī vā pṛcchati bhūto guṇo vaktavyo | atha dāni anyatīrthikā pṛcchanti mā ete mithyādṛṣṭiṃ grāhayiṣyantīti bhṛkuṭiṃ karoti anāpattiḥ | bhikṣur api kulamātsaryaṃ karoti vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should act with jealousy regarding families (<s>kulamātsarya</s>), it is a <s>pācattika</s>. 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Jealousy regarding families' means she should obstruct — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to act with jealousy regarding families. If she does, she incurs a <s>pācattika</s>. However, if a <s>bhikṣu</s> or <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> asks, the genuine virtues [of a family] should be told. But if non-Buddhist ascetics ask, [she may] frown [to discourage them], thinking 'These will lead them into wrong views' — there is no offense. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> also acts with jealousy regarding families, he incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī kulamātsaryaṃ kuryāt pācattikaṃ | ḷṃ || uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should act with jealousy regarding families, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text:
deti [81] | cikitsiti [82] |
vācayati [83] | gṛhivaiyāvṛttaḥ [84] |
sambhojanīyaṃ [85] | saṃsargo [86] |
upaśapati [87] | rodati [88] |
kṣiyati [89] | kulamātsaryeṇa [90] ||
body.translated_text: Gives [81]; Practices medicine [82]; Teaches [83]; Service of householders [84]; Eating together [85]; Association [86]; Curses [87]; Weeps [88]; Diminishes [89]; Jealousy regarding families [90].

body.text: pūryate navamo vargaḥ |
body.translated_text: Thus the ninth section is completed.

body.text: pācattikadharma 91
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 91

body.text: sammukhaṃ
body.translated_text: Face to Face (<s>sammukha</s>)

body.text: 205. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | gartodaro ca gartodaramātā ca gartodarapitā ca āgārasyānagāriyaṃ pravrajitāh | pe | yāvat so mahallako bhuñjāti | sā gartodaramātā pariviṣati | so dāni tāye kānicit pūrvacaritāni jalpati strīutsadadauṣṭhulyāni yāni tasyā amanaāpāni | sā dān āha | caṇḍāyuḥ | akhallamahallaḥ | avyaktaakuśalaaprakrtijña | adyāpi tvam ajalpitavyāni jalpasi | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te gartodaramāte | peyālaṃ | tena hi na kṣamati bhikṣuṃ sammukham ākrośituṃ paribhāṣituṃ | atha bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 205. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Gartodara</s>, <s>Gartodara</s>'s mother, and <s>Gartodara</s>'s father had gone forth from the household life to homelessness. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the old man was eating. <s>Gartodara</s>'s mother was serving him. He then made some remarks to her about former conduct — vulgarities about women — which were displeasing to her. She said: 'You wretch! You doddering old fool! Ignorant, unskilled, one who does not know proper behavior! Even now you still say things that should not be said!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. [Abbreviated.] Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, mother of <s>Gartodara</s>.' [Abbreviated.] Therefore it is not permissible to abuse or revile a <s>bhikṣu</s> to his face. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> [addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>] up to: '[the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇībhikṣuṃ sammukham ākrośayed roṣayed paribhāṣayet pācattikaṃ | yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | sammukhan ti cāturakṣaṃ | ākrośayed iti akāraśakāraekāraiḥ roṣayet paribhāṣayet caṇḍālu | akhallamahallaakuśalaaprakṛtijña ti pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye bhikṣuṇīya bhikṣuṃ sammukham ākrośituṃ roṣituṃ paribhāṣitum | ākrośati roṣati paribhāṣati pācattikaṃ | atha bhikṣuṇyā pitā vā bhrātā jñātiko vā pravrajitako bhavati | so ca bhavati uddhato unnaḍo asamāhito labhyā dāni so vaktuṃ | na dāni kṣamati dharṣiya vaktuṃ | atha khalu prajñayā samjñāpayitavyo | yadi tāvat taruṇako bhavati vaktavyo | sālohita idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣasi kadā tvaṃ śikṣiṣyasi | yadā jīrṇo vṛddho bhaviṣyasi | atha dāni mahallako bhavati vaktavyo | idānīṃ tvaṃ na śikṣasi kadā śikṣiṣyasi yadā maṇḍaladvāram anuprāpto bhaviṣyasi | bhikṣuṇāpi bhikṣuṇīyo na kṣamati sammukham ākrośituṃ muṇḍastrī veśyastrī ti | pe | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṃ samukham ākrośati pācattikaṃ ||1 ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should abuse, anger, or revile a <s>bhikṣu</s> face to face, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Face to face' means within the range of four eyes. 'Should abuse' means with [insults beginning with] the syllables a, śa, e. 'Should anger, should revile' [means saying]: 'You wretch! You doddering old fool, ignorant, unskilled, one who does not know proper behavior!' — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to abuse, anger, or revile a <s>bhikṣu</s> face to face. If she abuses, angers, or reviles — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Now, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s father, or brother, or relative has gone forth, and he is restless, haughty, and undisciplined — it is permissible to speak to him, but it is not permissible to speak disrespectfully. Rather, he should be instructed with wisdom. If he is young, she should say: 'Kinsman, you are not training now — when will you train? When you have become old and aged?' If he is elderly, she should say: 'You are not training now — when will you train? When you have arrived at the door of death?' A <s>bhikṣu</s> also should not abuse <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> face to face [saying]: 'Shaved-headed woman! Prostitute!' [Abbreviated.] If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> abuses a <s>bhikṣu</s> face to face, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [1]

body.text: pācattikadharma 92
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 92

body.text: ūnadvādaśavarṣā
body.translated_text: Under Twelve Years (<s>ūnadvādaśavarṣā</s>)

body.text: 206. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ekavarṣā dvivarṣā yāvat ṣaṭvarṣā upasthāpenti | te naiva ovadanti nānuśāsanti | tā indragavā iva vardhanti śivacchagalā viya vardhanti | anākalpasampannā anīryapathasampannā na jānanti katham upādhyāyinīye pratipattavyaṃ | katham ācāryāye pratipattavyaṃ | kathaṃ vṛddhātarakāṇāṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ pratipattavyaṃ | kathaṃ grāme | katham araṇye | kathaṃ saṃghamadhye | kathaṃ saṃghāṭīpātracīvaradhāraṇe pratipattavyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | pe | yāvad bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo | tā dāni śabdāpitāḥ | etad eva sarvaṃ bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati ūnadvādaśodakavarṣāya upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 206. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> were then ordaining [others when they themselves had been ordained for only] one year, two years, up to six years. They neither instructed nor taught [their students]. Those [students] grew up like glow-worms, grew up like <s>Śiva</s>'s goats — ill-mannered, without proper deportment, not knowing how to behave toward the preceptress, how to behave toward the instructress, how to behave toward senior <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, how [to behave] in the village, how in the forest, how in the midst of the <s>Saṃgha</s>, how to conduct oneself in wearing the outer robe and carrying the bowl. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.' They were summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned all of it in detail. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible for one with fewer than twelve rainy-season years [of ordination] to ordain [others].' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>, until [the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ūnadvādaśavarṣā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> with fewer than twelve years should ordain [another], it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | ūnadvādaśavarṣā ti ūnadvādaśavarṣā nāma ūnadvādaśodakavarṣo ūnadvādaśo samvatsaro ūnadvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Fewer than twelve years' means: fewer than twelve rainy seasons, fewer than twelve calendar years — [such] is a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of fewer than twelve years.

body.text: ūnadvādaśodakavarṣo pūradvādaśo samvatsaro ūnadvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: [If she has] fewer than twelve rainy seasons but has completed twelve calendar years — [she is still] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of fewer than twelve years.

body.text: ūnadvādaśodakavarṣo atireko dvādaśo samvatsaro ūnadvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: [If she has] fewer than twelve rainy seasons but more than twelve calendar years — [she is still] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of fewer than twelve years.

body.text: hemante upasampannā tena dvādaśamena upasampāditi | akṛtāyāṃ pravāraṇāyāṃ ūnadvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī | evaṃ grīṣme varṣāsu upasampannā |
body.translated_text: If ordained in winter, she ordains [another] in the same twelfth [year]; if the <s>Pravāraṇā</s> (invitation ceremony) has not been performed, [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of fewer than twelve years. Likewise if ordained in summer or in the rains.

body.text: evaṃ purimikāyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ upasampannā | akṛtāyāṃ pravāraṇāyāṃ upasampādeti | paścimikāyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ upasampannā | akṛtāhi dvihi pravāraṇāhi upasampādeti ūnadvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: Likewise, if ordained during the first rains-entry period and she ordains [another] before the <s>Pravāraṇā</s> is performed; or if ordained during the second rains-entry period and she ordains without both <s>Pravāraṇās</s> having been performed — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of fewer than twelve years.

body.text: pūradvādaśodakavarṣo ūnadvādaśo samvatsaro pūradvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: [If she has] completed twelve rainy seasons but fewer than twelve calendar years — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of completed twelve years.

body.text: pūradvādaśodakavarṣo pūradvādaśo samvatsaro pūradvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: [If she has] completed twelve rainy seasons and completed twelve calendar years — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of completed twelve years.

body.text: pūradvādaśodakavarṣo atirekadvādaśo samvatsaro pūradvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: [If she has] completed twelve rainy seasons and more than twelve calendar years — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of completed twelve years.

body.text: hemante upasampannā tena dvādaśamena upasampādeti kṛtāyāṃ pravāraṇāyāṃ pūradvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: If ordained in winter, she ordains [another] in the same twelfth [year]; if the <s>Pravāraṇā</s> has been performed — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of completed twelve years.

body.text: evaṃ grīṣme varṣāsu upasampannā |
body.translated_text: Likewise if ordained in summer or in the rains.

body.text: evaṃ purimikāyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ upasampannā kṛtāyāṃ pravāraṇāyām upasampādeti pūradvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī | paścimikāyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ upasampannā tena dvādaśamena upasampādeti kṛtāhi dvihi pravāraṇāhi pūradvādaśavarṣā bhikṣuṇī |
body.translated_text: Likewise, if ordained during the first rains-entry period and she ordains after the <s>Pravāraṇā</s> is performed — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of completed twelve years. If ordained during the second rains-entry period, she ordains in the same twelfth [year] after both <s>Pravāraṇās</s> have been performed — [she is] a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> of completed twelve years.

body.text: ūnadvādaśavarṣā upasampādayet pācattikaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ūnadvādaśavarṣā upasthāpayati pācattikaṃ pravrājayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | bhikṣur api ūnadvādaśavarṣo upasampādayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: If one with fewer than twelve years ordains [another], it is a <s>pācattika</s>. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> with fewer than twelve years gives full ordination, it is a <s>pācattika</s>; if she gives the going-forth [only], she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> also ordains with fewer than twelve years, he incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ūnadvādaśavarṣā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> with fewer than twelve years should ordain [another], it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pācattikadharma 93
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 93

body.text: anaṅgopetā
body.translated_text: Unqualified (<s>anaṅgopetā</s>)

body.text: 207. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati ūnadvādaśavarṣāya upasthāpayituṃ | tena dāni kālena tena samayena ṣaḍvargiṇīyo bhikṣuṇīyo pūradvādaśavarṣā bhavanti | tāyo dāni pravrājenti upasthāpenti | tā naiva t-ovadanti nānuśāsanti | peyālaṃ | yāvat kathaṃ saṃghāṭīpātradhāraṇe pratipattavyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | pe | yāvac chabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati anaṅgopetāya upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 207. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule that it is not permissible for one with fewer than twelve years to ordain [others]. At that time, the group-of-six <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (<s>ṣaḍvargiṇīs</s>) had completed twelve years. They then gave the going-forth and full ordination. But they neither instructed nor taught [their students]. [Abbreviated.] Up to: 'How to conduct oneself in wearing the outer robe and carrying the bowl.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. [Abbreviated.] Up to: they were summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned all of it in detail. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible for one who is unqualified to ordain [others].' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: up to '[the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: pūradvādaśavarṣā pi ca bhavati sā ca anaṅgopetā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Even if she has completed twelve years, if she is unqualified (<s>anaṅgopetā</s>) and should ordain [another], it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pūradvādaśavarṣā ti yathā prathamake śikṣāpade |
body.translated_text: 'Completed twelve years' means as [defined] in the first training rule.

body.text: sā ca anaṅgopetā iti aṅgopetā nāma yasyā daśāṅgāni samvidyante saṃyathaīdaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Not endowed with the [requisite] qualifications' (<s>anaṅgopetā</s>): one who is 'endowed with qualifications' (<s>aṅgopetā</s>) is one who possesses ten qualifications, namely:

body.text: prātimokṣasamvarasaṃvṛtā bhavati || [1] || bahuśrutā bhavaty abhidharme || 2 || bahuśrutā bhavaty abhivinaye || 3 || pratibalā bhavaty adhiśīlaśikṣāyāṃ niveśayituṃ || 4 || pratibalā bhavaty adhicittaśikṣāyān niveśayituṃ || 5 || pratibalā bhavaty adhiprajñaśikṣāyāṃ niveśayituṃ || 6 || pratibalā bhavaty āpattim āpannāṃ vyutthāpayitum vā vyutthāpāyayitum vā || 7 || pratibalā bhavaty āpadāsu vyupakarṣayituṃ vā vyupakarṣāpayitum vā || 8 || pratibalā bhavati gilānam upasthihitum vā upasthāpayitum vā || 0 || dvādaśavarṣā bhavati sātirekadvādaśavarṣā vā || ḷṃ ||
body.translated_text: [1] She is restrained by the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> restraint. [2] She is learned in the <s>Abhidharma</s>. [3] She is learned in the <s>Abhivinaya</s>. [4] She is capable of establishing [others] in the training of higher virtue (<s>adhiśīla</s>). [5] She is capable of establishing [others] in the training of higher mind (<s>adhicitta</s>). [6] She is capable of establishing [others] in the training of higher wisdom (<s>adhiprajñā</s>). [7] She is capable of causing one who has fallen into an offense to rise up or having her caused to rise up. [8] She is capable of helping [others] in times of misfortune or having them helped. [9] She is capable of attending to the sick or having them attended to. [10] She has twelve years [of seniority] or more than twelve years.

body.text: yasyā imāni daśāṅgāni samvidyante iyam ucyate aṅgopetā | viparyayād anaṅgopetā | sā eṣā anaṅgopetā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā anaṅgopetā pravrājayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | upasampādayati pācattikaṃ | bhikṣur api anaṅgopeto pravrājayati upasampādayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: One who possesses these ten qualifications is called 'endowed with qualifications.' The opposite is 'not endowed with qualifications.' If she, not endowed with qualifications, ordains [a candidate]—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Abbreviated, up to: it is a regulation. If she, not endowed with qualifications, gives the going-forth—she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. If she gives full ordination—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, if not endowed with qualifications, who gives the going-forth and full ordination, incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: pūradvādaśavarṣā pi ca bhavati sā ca anaṅgopetā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ || 3 ||
body.translated_text: Even though she has full twelve years, if she is not endowed with qualifications and ordains [a candidate]—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [Rule 3]

body.text: pācattikadharma 94
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> (Expiation) rule 94.

body.text: asaṃmatā
body.translated_text: Without approval (<s>asaṃmatā</s>).

body.text: 208. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | dvādaśavarṣāye aṅgopetāya upasthāpayitavyeti | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo dvādaśavarṣā aṅgopetāyo upasthāpayanti | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | asty eṣā dvādaśavarṣā na punar jñāyate | aṅgopetā vā anaṅgopetā vā ti | etat prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayaṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | upasthāpanāsaṃmutī tāya yācitavyā |
body.translated_text: 208. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule that only one with twelve years [of seniority] and endowed with qualifications should ordain. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who had twelve years and were endowed with qualifications were ordaining. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then objected: 'She may have twelve years, but it is not known whether she is endowed with qualifications or not.' This matter was reported by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'The approval to ordain should be requested by her.'

body.text: karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ iyam itthannāmā bhikṣunī dvādaśavarṣā aṅgopetā | sā saṃghaṃ upasthāpanā saṃmutiṃ yāceyā | yaciṣyati āryamiśrikā itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī dvādaśavarṣā aṅgopetā upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ saṃghaṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etan dhārayāmi |
body.translated_text: The <s>karmakārikā</s> (procedural officer) should perform the act: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so, who has twelve years and is endowed with qualifications, would request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for approval to ordain. She will request...'

body.text: tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryā saṃghaṃ | aham itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī dvādaśavarṣā aṅgopetā | sāhaṃ saṃgham upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yacāmi | sādhu bata me āryā saṃgho upasthāpanāsammutin detu | evam bhikṣutto yācayitavyaṃ ||
body.translated_text: She should then make the request: 'I pay homage to the noble <s>Saṃgha</s>. I, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so, have twelve years and am endowed with qualifications. I request the <s>Saṃgha</s> for approval to ordain. May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> please grant me the approval to ordain...'

body.text: karma | śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī dvādaśavarṣā aṅgopetā | sā saṃgham upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye dvādaśavarṣāye aṅgopetāye upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ dadyāt | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: The formal act: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so has twelve years and is endowed with qualifications. She requests the <s>Saṃgha</s> for approval to ordain. If it is the proper time for the <s>Saṃgha</s>, the <s>Saṃgha</s> would grant the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so, who has twelve years and is endowed with qualifications, the approval to ordain...'

body.text: śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyaṃ itthannāmā bhikṣuṇī dvādaśavarṣā aṅgopetā | sā saṃgham upasthāpanāsaṃmutiṃ yācati | tāye saṃgho itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye dvādaśavarṣāye aṅgopetāye upasthāpanāsaṃmutin deti | yāsām āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye dvādaśavarṣāye aṅgopetāye upasthāpanāsammutin dīyamānāṃ saṃghena | sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣatu | iyam prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācaneti | dinnā aryamiśrikāyo itthannāmāye bhikṣuṇīye dvādaśavarṣāye aṅgopetāye upasthāpanāsammuti saṃghena | kṣamati taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>Saṃgha</s> listen to me. This <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so has twelve years and is endowed with qualifications. She requests the <s>Saṃgha</s> for approval to ordain. The <s>Saṃgha</s> grants the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named so-and-so, who has twelve years and is endowed with qualifications, the approval to ordain...'

body.text: pūradvādaśavarṣā pi ca bhavati aṅgopetā sā ca asammatā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Even though she has full twelve years and is endowed with qualifications, if she is without approval and ordains [a candidate]—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: aṅgopetā iti daśabhir aṅgehi bhikṣuṇī aṅgopetā bhavati | śeṣaṃ pūrvavat | asammatā iti asammatā eva asammatā | anaṅgopetā ca asammatā tam ca se karma kurvanti jñaptivipannaṃ gaṇavipannaṃ anuśrāvaṇāvipannaṃ anyatarānyatareṇa karmopakleśena upakliṣṭaṃ evam eṣā asammatā | upasthāpayed iti upasampādayet pācattikaṃ | sā eṣa bhikṣuṇī asammatā upasthāpayati pācattikaṃ | pravrājayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Endowed with qualifications' means a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> endowed with ten qualifications. The rest is as before. 'Without approval' means simply without approval. If she is both not endowed with qualifications and without approval, and they perform the act—if the motion is defective, the quorum is defective...

body.text: pūra dvādaśavarṣā pi ca bhavati aṅgopetāsā ca asammatā upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||4 ||
body.translated_text: Even though she has full twelve years and is endowed with qualifications, if she is without approval and ordains [a candidate]—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [Rule 4]

body.text: pācattikadharma 95
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 95.

body.text: duḥśilā
body.translated_text: Of bad conduct (<s>duḥśīlā</s>).

body.text: 209. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | yā sā kālīya bhikṣuṇīya triyantarā lecchavidhītā pravrājitā | sā deśitaśikṣā | pratitālakehi pratikuñcikāhi ca paravihārān udghāṭiya āgārikehi parivrājakehi ca saha tiṣthati | sā tāya upasaṃpāditā | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | kim imāya duḥśīlāya pratitālakinīya puruṣasahāyikāya upasthāpitāya | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvat śabdāpayatha kālīṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtan te kāli | naiṣa kāli dharmo yāvad eva nāmā tvaṃ duḥśīlāṃ pratitālakinīṃ puruṣasahāyikām upasthāpayasi | tena hi na kṣamati jānantī duḥśīlāṃ pratitālakinīṃ puruṣasahāyikām upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 209. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. That <s>Licchavi</s> maiden who had been ordained as a two-year trainee by the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Kālī</s>—she had completed her training. [But] with duplicate keys and lock-picks she would break into other [nuns'] residences and engage in misconduct with laymen...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī duḥśīlāṃ pratitālakinīṃ puruṣasahāyikām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing [a woman to be] of bad conduct, a lock-picker, and one who associates with men, ordains her—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | jānantīti svayam vā jāneya parato vā śruṇeya | duḥśīleti śīlavipannā śīlātikrāntā | pratitālakinīti pratitālakehi pratikuñcikāhi ca anyātakān vihārakān udghāṭayati | puruṣasahāyinīti | āgārikehi ca parivrājakehi ca sārdhaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharati | upasthāpayed iti upasampādayet pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ yā dāni eṣā āgārikehi parivrājakehi ca sārdhaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharati sā na kṣamati upasthāpayituṃ | atha dāni śaknoti brahmacaryaṃ saṃpādayituṃ labhyā tato saṃsargāto vivecayitvā upasthāpayituṃ | bhikṣur api jānan duḥśīlaṃ śrāmaṇeraṃ strīsaṃsṛṣṭaṃ apratyosārāyetvā upasampādeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained. 'Knowing' means either knowing by herself or hearing from others. 'Of bad conduct' (<s>duḥśīlā</s>) means one whose conduct is defective, who has transgressed the rules of conduct. 'Lock-picker' (<s>pratitālakinī</s>) means one who, with duplicate keys and lock-picks, breaks into other residences...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī duḥśilāṃ pratitālakinīṃ puruṣasahāyikām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||5 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing [a woman to be] of bad conduct, a lock-picker, and one who associates with men, ordains her—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [Rule 5]

body.text: pācattikadharma 96
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 96.

body.text: ūnaviṃśativarṣā kumāribhūtā
body.translated_text: A maiden under twenty years of age (<s>ūnaviṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā</s>).

body.text: 210. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni daśadvādaśavarṣāṃ kumārībhūtām upasampādayanti | apratisaṃkhyānavartinyo bhavanti anākalpasampannā | na jānanti katham upādhyāyīye pratipadyitavyaṃ yāvat saṃghāṭīpātracīvaradhāraṇe pratipadyitavyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha tā bhikṣuṇīyo | tā dāni śabdāpitāḥ | tad eva sarvaṃ bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati ūnaviṃativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtām upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 210. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were ordaining maidens of ten or twelve years. They were without reflection, not properly trained. They did not know how to [treat] the preceptress...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtāṃ upasthāpayet pācatikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains a maiden under twenty years of age—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: ūnaviṃśativarṣā ti ūnaviṃśodakavarṣo ūnaviṃśo samvatsaro ūnaviṃśativarṣā |
body.translated_text: 'Under twenty years' means: under twenty rainy seasons, under twenty calendar years—she is under twenty years.

body.text: ūnaviṃśodakavarṣo pūraviṃśo samvatsaro ūnaviṃśativarṣā |
body.translated_text: Under twenty rainy seasons but full twenty calendar years—she is still under twenty years.

body.text: ūnaviṃśodakavarṣo atirekaviṃśo samvatsaro ūnaviṃśativarṣā |
body.translated_text: Under twenty rainy seasons but more than twenty calendar years—she is still under twenty years.

body.text: hemante jātā tena viṃśena upasaṃpādeti akṛtāyāṃ pravāraṇāyāṃ ūnaviṃśativarṣā | evaṃ grīṣme jātā |
body.translated_text: If born in winter and ordained in that same twentieth [year] before the <s>pravāraṇā</s> has been performed—she is under twenty years. Likewise if born in summer.

body.text: evaṃ purimikāyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ jātā tena viṃśena upasaṃpādeti ūnaviṃśativarṣā |
body.translated_text: Likewise if born at the first rains-entry (<s>varṣopanāyikā</s>) and ordained in that twentieth [year]—she is under twenty years.

body.text: paścimikāyāṃ varṣopanāyikāyāṃ jātā tena viṃśena upasaṃpādeti | akṛtāhi dvihi pravāraṇāhi | ūnaviṃśativarṣā |
body.translated_text: If born at the last rains-entry and ordained in that twentieth [year], with two <s>pravāraṇās</s> not yet performed—she is under twenty years.

body.text: kumārībhūtām etām ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ sarvā ūnaviṃśativarṣasamjñinīyo upasampādenti sarvāyo pācattikam āsādayanti |
body.translated_text: If this maiden under twenty years is ordained by all [nuns] who perceive her as under twenty—all incur a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: sā ca anupasampannā | tām etām ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtāṃ eka ūnaviṃśativarṣasamjñinīyo upasampādenti ekā pūrasamjñinīyo | yā ūnasaṃjñinīyo upasampādenti tāyo pācattikam āsādayanti | pūrasaṃjñinām anāpattiḥ | sā cānupasampannā | ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ sarvāyo ūnaviṃśativarṣasamjñinīyo upasampādenti sarvāsām anāpattiḥ | sā ca sūpasampannā |
body.translated_text: And she is not [validly] ordained. If this maiden under twenty years is ordained by some who perceive her as under twenty and some who perceive her as of full [age]—those who perceive her as under [age] and ordain her incur a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pūraviṃśativarṣāṃ sarvāyo ūnaviṃśativarṣasaṃjñinīyo upasampādenti sarvā vinayātikramam āsādayanti | sā ca sūpasampannā |
body.translated_text: If she is of full twenty years and all [nuns] perceiving her as under twenty ordain her—all incur a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. And she is well-ordained.

body.text: pūraviṃśativarṣām ekā ūnaviṃśativarṣasaṃjñinīyo ekā pūraviṃśativarṣasaṃjñinīyo upasampādenti | yā ūnaviṃśativarṣasaṃjñinīyo tā vinayātikramam āsādayanti | yā pūraviṃśativarṣasaṃjñinīyo tāsām anāpattiḥ | sā ca sūpasampannā |
body.translated_text: If she is of full twenty years and some perceive her as under twenty while others perceive her as of full twenty years and they ordain her—those who perceive her as under twenty incur a <s>vinayātikrama</s>; those who perceive her as of full twenty years incur no offense.

body.text: pūraviṃśativarṣāṃ sarvā pūrasaṃjñinīyo upasampādenti sarvāsām anāpattiḥ | sā ca sūpasampannā |
body.translated_text: If she is of full twenty years and all perceive her as of full [age] and ordain her—for all there is no offense. And she is well-ordained.

body.text: kumārībhūtā ti kumārībhūtā avikopitabrahmacaryā | upasthāpayed iti upasampādayet pācattikaṃ | pe | yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Maiden' (<s>kumārībhūtā</s>) means a maiden whose celibacy has not been violated. 'Should ordain' means should give full ordination—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Abbreviated, up to: it is a regulation.

body.text: yā eṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasampadaṃ sā dāni samanugrahitavyā | kadā tvaṃ jātā | atha na jānāti janmapaddhikā niśāmayitavyā | janmapaddhikā na bhavanti mātāpitarau pṛcchitavyau | atha dāni te pi na jānanti pṛcchitavyā | katarasmiṃ rājye jātā | kettikā vā tadā tvaṃ abhūṣi | sudṛṣṭir durdṛṣṭir vā | pṛcchitavyā | na uddhikasya vā citrikasya vā vaśena gantavyaṃ | atha khu hastapādā niśāmetavyāḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: If this maiden wishes for full ordination in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, she should be assisted. [Ask her:] 'When were you born?' If she does not know, the birth-record should be examined. If no birth-record is available...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtāṃ upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||6 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains a maiden under twenty years of age—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [Rule 6]

body.text: pācattikadharma 97
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 97.

body.text: adeśitaśikṣā
body.translated_text: Without the training having been taught (<s>adeśitaśikṣā</s>).

body.text: 211. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā dāni śikṣāpadam prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtām upasthāpayitun ti | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo pūraviṃśativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtām adeśitaśikṣām upasthāpayanti | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | ko jānāti pūraviṃśativarṣā vā eṣā na vā ti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | yā eṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati | tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadāṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | tāya saṃgho dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ yācitavyo | karmakārikāya karma kartavyaṃ | śṛṇotu āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ iyam itthannāmā saṃghaṃ dvevarṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ yāceyyā | yāciṣyati āryamiśrikā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā dvevarṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ saṃghaṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etaṃ dhārayāmi | tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryā saṃghaṃ | aham itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣāmi tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sāhaṃ dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ yācāmi | sādhu vata me āryā saṃgho dve varṣāṇi śikṣāpadāni sammutiṃ detu | evaṃ trikhhatto yācitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 211. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had established the training rule: 'It is not permissible to ordain a maiden under twenty years of age.' Now the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were ordaining maidens who were a full twenty years old but who had not received training instructions. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were displeased: 'Who knows whether she is a full twenty years old or not?' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Abbreviation. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'For this maiden who desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, the <s>saṃgha</s> should be requested for two years of training instruction permission. The <s>karmakārikā</s> should perform the formal act: "May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, she should request two years of training instruction permission from the <s>saṃgha</s>. She will request: Noble sisters, two years of training instruction permission from the <s>saṃgha</s>, for this eighteen-year-old maiden. If this is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, let it be silent. Thus I understand it." Now she should make this request: 'I bow to the noble <s>saṃgha</s>. I, named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desire full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. I request two years of training instruction permission. May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> grant me two years of training rules permission.' Thus it should be requested three times.

body.text: karma | śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannamā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sā saṃghaṃ dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ yācati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ saṃgho itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ dadyāt | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: The formal act: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. She requests two years of training instruction permission from the <s>saṃgha</s>. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, the <s>saṃgha</s> should grant this one named so-and-so, the eighteen-year-old maiden, two years of training instruction permission. This is the motion (<s>jñapti</s>).'

body.text: śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā aṣṭādaśavarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sā saṃghaṃ dve varṣāṇī śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ yācati | tasyāḥ saṃgho itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varsāṇī śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ deti | yasyā āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiṃ dīyamānāṃ saṃghena | sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣitu | iyaṃ prathamā karmavācanā | evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācaneti | dinnā āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmāye aṣṭādaśavarṣāye kumārībhūtāye dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutiḥ samghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmāntrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, an eighteen-year-old maiden, desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. She requests two years of training instruction permission from the <s>saṃgha</s>. The <s>saṃgha</s> grants this one named so-and-so, the eighteen-year-old maiden, two years of training instruction permission. If this is acceptable to the noble sisters—the granting of two years of training instruction permission to this one named so-and-so by the <s>saṃgha</s>—let them be silent. If not acceptable, let them speak. A second and a third time. The noble sisters have granted this one two years of training instruction permission by the <s>saṃgha</s>. It is acceptable to the <s>saṃgha</s>, since it is silent. Thus I understand it.'

body.text: pūraviṃśativarṣā pi ca bhavati kumārībhūtā | tāṃ cādeśitaśikṣām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Even if she is a full twenty years old and a maiden, if she ordains her without [having completed] the training instructions—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pūraviṃśativarṣā ti pūraviṃśodakavarṣā | pūraviṃśo samvatsaro | pūraviṃśo samvatsaro | pūraviṃśativarṣā | kumārībhūtā ti aviropitabrahmacaryā | adeśitaśikṣā ti adeśitaśikṣaiva adeśitaśikṣā | taṃ ca se karma kurvanti jñaptivipannaṃ gaṇavipannaṃ anuśrāvaṇāvipannaṃ anyatarānyatareṇa karmopakleśena upakliṣṭaṃ | evam apy eṣā adeśitaśikṣā | upasthāpayed iti upasaṃpādayet pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'A full twenty years'—means a full twenty years of age, a full twenty rainy seasons, a full twenty years. 'Maiden'—means one whose celibacy has not been violated. 'Without training instructions'—means precisely one without training instructions. And the formal act for her [is to be performed].

body.text: pūraviṃśativarṣā pi ca bhavati kumārībhūtā | tañ cādeśitaśikṣām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||7 ||
body.translated_text: Even if she is a full twenty years old and a maiden, if she ordains her without [having completed] the training instructions—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [7]

body.text: pācattikadharma 98
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 98

body.text: aparipūraśikṣā
body.translated_text: Incomplete training (<s>aparipūraśikṣā</s>)

body.text: 212. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni deśita śikṣām upasthāpayanti | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | asty eṣā deśitaśikṣā na jñāyate paripūraśikṣā vā na veti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati deśitaśikṣām api aparipūraśikṣām upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 212. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were ordaining those who had received training instructions. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were displeased: 'She has received training instructions, but it is not known whether her training is complete or not.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>.

body.text: deśitaśikṣā pi ca bhavati kumārībhūtā tāṃ cāparipūraśikṣām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Even if she has received training instructions and is a maiden, if she ordains her with incomplete training—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: deśitaśikṣā ti deśitaśikṣaiva deśitaśikṣā anaṅgopetāye | deśitaśikṣā tañ ca se karma kurvanti | jñaptisampannaṃ gaṇasampannaṃ anuśrāvaṇāsampannaṃ anyatarānyatareṇa karmopakleśena anupakliṣṭaṃ | evam eṣā deśitaśikṣā |
body.translated_text: 'Training instructions received'—means precisely one who has received training instructions but whose training requirements are not complete. 'Training instructions received'—the formal act for her is performed. The formal act is complete in its motion, complete in its assembly, complete in its announcements, and not vitiated by any defect in the procedure. Thus the formal act is properly performed.

body.text: aparipūraśikṣā ti aṣṭādaśahi varttehi dve varṣāṇi aśikṣitaśikṣā | katamehi aṣṭādaśahi sarvabhikṣuṇīnāṃ navikety ādi pūrvavat yathā gurudharmeṣu | na ca tāye kṣamati ekākinīya grāmaṃ piṇḍāya praviśituṃ | atha khu bhikṣuṇīya vā śramaṇerīya vā saha piṇḍāya praviśitavyaṃ | na kṣamati ekākinīya adhvānaṃ gantuṃ | yadi sā aṣṭānām anyatarānyarāpattim āpadyati punaḥ śikṣā deśitavyā | ekānnaviṃśatim ārabhya sarvaṃ duṣkṛtena kārāpayitavyā yāni ūnakāni dve varṣāṇi śikṣati sāparipūraśikṣā | upasthāpayed iti upasaṃpādayet pācattikaṃ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Incomplete training'—means one who has not trained for two years in the eighteen observances. Which eighteen? [The rule about] being junior to all <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, et cetera, as stated previously in the <s>gurudharmā</s>s. And it is not permissible for her to enter a village alone for alms.

body.text: deśitaśikṣā pi ca bhavati kumārībhūtā | tāṃ cāparipūraśikṣām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||8 ||
body.translated_text: Even if she has received training instructions and is a maiden, if she ordains her with incomplete training—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [8]

body.text: pācattikadharma 99
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 99

body.text: asaṃmatā
body.translated_text: Without formal permission (<s>asaṃmatā</s>)

body.text: 213. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā dāni śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati aparipūraśikṣām upasthāpayituṃ | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo viṃśativarṣāṃ kumārībhūtāṃ deṣitaśikṣāṃ paripūraśikṣām upasthāpayanti | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | asty eṣā deśitaśikṣā | no tu jānāma paripūraśikṣā vā na vā ti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi yā eṣā viṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ tāya saṃgho upathāpanāsammutiṃ yācitavyo |
body.translated_text: 213. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had established the training rule: 'It is not permissible to ordain one with incomplete training.' Now the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were ordaining twenty-year-old maidens who had received training instructions and whose training was complete [but without formal permission from the <s>saṃgha</s>].

body.text: śṛṇotu me ārya saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā viṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā deśitaśikṣā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ iyam itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasthāpanāsammutiṃ yāceyyā | yāciṣyati āryā saṃgho iyam itthannāmā saṃghaṃ upasthāpanāsammutiṃ | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi | tāya dāni yācitavyaṃ | vandāmy āryā saṃghaṃ | aham itthannāmā viṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā desitaśikṣā paripūraśikṣā ākāṅkṣāmi tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sāhaṃ saṃgham upasthāpanāsammutiṃ yācāmi | sādhu vata me āryā saṃgho upasthāpanāsammutiṃ detu | evaṃ dvir api trir api yācitavyaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, a twenty-year-old maiden, who has received training instructions, desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, this one named so-and-so should request the <s>saṃgha</s> for ordination permission.'

body.text: karma | śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā viṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā deśitaśikṣā paripūraśikṣā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sā saṃgham upasthāpanāsammutiṃ yācati | yadi saṃghasya prāptakālaṃ samgho itthannāmāye upasthāpanāsammutiṃ dadyāt | ovayikā eṣā jñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: The formal act: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, a twenty-year-old maiden, who has received training instructions and whose training is complete, desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. She requests the <s>saṃgha</s> for ordination permission. If the time is right for the <s>saṃgha</s>, the <s>saṃgha</s> should grant ordination permission to this one named so-and-so. This is the motion.'

body.text: śṛṇotu me āryā saṃgho | iyam itthannāmā viṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā deśitaśikṣā paripūraśikṣā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ | sā saṃgham upasthāpanāsammutiṃ yācati | tasyā samgho itthannāmāye upasthāpanāsammutiṃ deti | yasyā āryamiśrikāṇāṃ kṣamati itthannāmāye viṃśativarṣāye upasthāpanāsammutiṃ dīyamānāṃ saṃghena | sā tūṣṇīm asya | yasyā na kṣamati sā bhāṣatu | evaṃ dvitīyā tṛtīyā karmavācanā | dinnā āryamiśrikāyo itthannāmāye viṃśativarṣāye kumārībhūtāye deśitaśikṣāye paripūrṇaśikṣāya upasthāpanāsammutiḥ saṃghena | kṣamate taṃ saṃghasya yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti | [1] paripūraśikṣā pi ca bhavati tāṃ cāsaṃmatām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'May the noble <s>saṃgha</s> hear me. This one named so-and-so, a twenty-year-old maiden, who has received training instructions and whose training is complete, desires full ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> proclaimed by the <s>Tathāgata</s>. She requests the <s>saṃgha</s> for ordination permission. The <s>saṃgha</s> grants ordination permission to this one named so-and-so. If this is acceptable to the noble sisters, let them be silent; if not, let them speak. A second and a third time.'

body.text: paripūraśikṣā pi ca bhavatīti aṣṭādaśavarttehi dve varṣāṇi deśitaśikṣā | tāṃ cāsaṃmatām iti asaṃmatā evam asaṃmatā aparipūraśikṣā pi asaṃmatā tam ca se karma karonti prajñaptivipannaṃ gaṇavipannaṃ anuśrāvaṇāvipannaṃ anyatarānyatareṇa karmopakleśena upakliṣṭaṃ | evaṃ pi eṣā asaṃmatā | upasthāpayed iti upasampādayet pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whose training is complete'—means one who has trained for two years in the eighteen observances and has received training instructions. 'Without formal permission'—means precisely one without permission; [also] one whose training is incomplete is without permission; and the formal act for her is defective in its formal designation, defective in its assembly, defective in its announcements [i.e., improperly performed].

body.text: | [2] pūraviṃśativarṣā pi ca bhavati kumārībhūtā deśitaśikṣā ca paripūraśikṣā ca | tāṃ cāsaṃmatām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||9 ||
body.translated_text: Even if she is a full twenty years old, a maiden, who has received training instructions and whose training is complete—if she ordains her without formal permission, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [9]

body.text: pācattikadharma 100
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 100

body.text: ūnadvādaśavarṣā gṛhicaritā
body.translated_text: A formerly-married woman under twelve years (<s>ūnadvādaśavarṣā gṛhicaritā</s>)

body.text: 214. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni śākiyakanyāyo mallakanyāyo kolīyakanyāyo gṛhicaritāyo pravrajitāyo paṭu kāyo uccakṣukāyo kṣipraniśāntikāyo | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavantaṃ pṛcchati | labhyā dāni bhagavan ūnaviṃśativarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayituṃ | bhagavān āha | labhyā | tāyo aṣṭavarṣām navavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayanti | tā apratisaṃkhyānavartinyo bhavanti | yathā ūnaviṃśativarṣāḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | na kṣamati ūnadvādaśavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 214. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Śākya</s> girls, <s>Malla</s> girls, and <s>Koliya</s> girls who had been married and then went forth were bright-bodied, keen-sighted, and quickly tranquil. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> asked the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Is it permissible [to ordain them earlier]?'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ūnadvādaśavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains a formerly-married woman under twelve years [of ordination]—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: gṛhicaritā ti vikopitabrahmacaryā | upasthāpayed iti upasaṃpādayet pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | yā eṣā gṛhicaritā ākāṅkṣati tathāgatapravedite dharmavinaye upasaṃpadaṃ bhikṣuṇībhāvaṃ sā tāya anugrāhitavyā | peyālaṃ | yāvat hastapādā nivāsayitavyāḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'One who has lived as a householder' means one whose celibacy has been violated. 'Should ordain' means should grant full ordination — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. If that woman who has lived as a householder desires ordination and <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> status in the <s>Dharma</s> and <s>Vinaya</s> taught by the <s>Tathāgata</s>, she should be taken in hand — abbreviated — up to: the hands and feet should be instructed. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ūnadvādaśavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||10 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should ordain a woman who has lived as a householder and is less than twelve years [since going forth] — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [10]

body.text:
uddānaṃ |
sammukham [91] | ūnadvādaśavarṣā [92] |
anaṅgopetā [93] | asammatā [94] | duḥśīlā [95] |
ūnaviṃśativarṣā kumārībhūtā [96] |
adeśitaśikṣā [97] | aparipūraśikṣā [98] |
asammatā [99] | ūnadvādaśavarṣā gṛhicaritāya [100]
pūryate daśamo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Mnemonic verse: In person [91]; less than twelve years [92]; not endowed with the requisite qualities [93]; unapproved [94]; of bad conduct [95]; less than twenty years as an unmarried woman [96]; untaught in the training [97]; with incomplete training [98]; unapproved [99]; less than twelve years for one who has lived as a householder [100] — thus the tenth section is completed.

body.text: pācattikadharma 101
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 101.

body.text: adeśitaśikṣā
body.translated_text: Untaught in the training (<s>adeśitaśikṣā</s>).

body.text: 215. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati ūnadvādaśavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayitun ti | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo pūradvādaśavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritām upasthāpayanti | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | ko jānāti pūradvādaśavarṣā vā na veti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | pe | yathā kumāribhūtāya aṣṭādaśavarṣāya dve varṣāṇi śikṣādeśanāsammutir yācitavyā | vistareṇa | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 215. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule: 'It is not proper to ordain a woman who has lived as a householder and is less than twelve years [since going forth].' Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then ordained women who had lived as householders and were twelve full years [since going forth]. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> complained: 'Who knows whether she is truly twelve full years or not?' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> — abbreviated — just as for an unmarried woman of eighteen years, the approval for two years of training instruction should be sought. In detail. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: pūradvādaśavarṣā pi ca bhavati gṛhicaritā tāṃ cādeśitaśikṣām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||1 ||
body.translated_text: Even if she is twelve full years [since going forth] and has lived as a householder, if one should ordain her without [her] training having been taught — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [1]

body.text: pācattikadharma 102
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 102.

body.text: aparipūraśikṣā
body.translated_text: Incomplete training (<s>aparipūraśikṣā</s>).

body.text: 216. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sudinnā nāma abhaṭagaṇakabhāryā pravrajitā | tāya kalyāye śikṣā deśitā | tāya dāni gṛhibhūtāya kukṣi pratilabdho | so pi vṛddho | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | iyan tāva deśitaśikṣā | iyaṃ ca kukṣivatī | sa nirveṭheti | āryamiśrikāyo yato haṃ pravrajitā nāmabhijānāmy ahaṃ etad dharmam pratiṣevituṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ yāvad bhagavān āha | yato dāni eṣā pravrajitā | na eṣā jānāty etaṃ dharma pratiṣevituṃ | gṛhibhūtāya etāya kukṣiḥ pratilabdho | yā dāni eṣā īdṛśī bhavati na kṣamati upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu yadi tāvad dārikāṃ janayati yadā stanikā gṛhān nirgatā bhavati tato upasthāpayitavyā | atha dārakaṃ janayati yadā ayaṃ stanībhūto bhavati tato upasthāpayitavyā | atha dāni tāye sālohito bhavati jñātiko vā āhaṃsuḥ | vayaṃ etan dārakam upasthāsyāma iti upasaṃpādayitavyā | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | tathaiva kartavyaṃ yathā kumārībhūtāye | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 216. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. A woman named <s>Sudinnā</s>, the wife of a tax-collector, had gone forth. Her training had been taught early. But while still a householder, she had become pregnant. [The child] had grown. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then complained: 'She was indeed taught the training, yet she is pregnant!' She cleared herself: 'Noble Sisters of the mixed assembly, since the time I went forth, I do not recall engaging in that practice.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> — abbreviated — up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Since the time she went forth, she does not know engaging in that practice. She became pregnant while still a householder. One who is in such a condition should not be ordained. However, if she gives birth to a girl, when the girl has left the breast and gone from the household, then she may be ordained. If she gives birth to a boy, when the boy is weaned from the breast, then she may be ordained. If a blood-relative or kinsman of hers says "we shall take care of this child," then she may be ordained.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'It should be done just as for an unmarried woman.' Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: deśitaśikṣā pi ca bhavati gṛhicaritā nāṃ aparipūraśikṣām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||2 ||
body.translated_text: Even if she is one who has lived as a householder and whose training has been taught, if one should ordain her with the training incomplete — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [2]

body.text: pācattikadharma 103
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 103.

body.text: asammatā
body.translated_text: Unapproved (<s>asammatā</s>).

body.text: 217. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati ūnadvādaśavarṣām gṛhicaritām upasthāpayitun ti | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo pūradvādaśavarṣāṃ gṛhicaritāṃ deśitaśikṣām upasthāpayanti | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo ojjhāyanti | asty eṣā deśitaśikṣā na tu jānāma paripūraśikṣa vā na veti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yathā kumārībhūtāye yāvat tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 217. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule: 'It is not proper to ordain a woman who has lived as a householder and is less than twelve years [since going forth].' Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then ordained women who had lived as householders, were twelve full years [since going forth], and whose training had been taught. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then complained: 'She may have been taught the training, but we do not know whether the training is complete or not.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> — abbreviated — just as for an unmarried woman — up to: therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: paripūraśikṣā pi ca bhavati gṛhicaritā | tāṃ cāsammatām upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||3 ||
body.translated_text: Even if she is one who has lived as a householder and whose training is complete, if one should ordain her without [<s>Saṃgha</s>] approval — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [3]

body.text: pācattikadharma 104
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 104.

body.text: nānuśāset
body.translated_text: Not instructing (<s>nānuśāset</s>).

body.text: 218. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo upasthāpiya upasthāpiya nāvavadanti nānuśāsanti | tāyo dāni indragavā iva vardhanti yāvat kathaṃ saṃghāṭīpātracīvaradhāraṇe pratipattavyaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ vo bhikṣuṇīyo evañ ca nāmā yūyaṃ upasthāpayitvā nāvavadatha nānuśāsatha | tena hi dve varṣāṇi ovaditavyā anuśāsitavyā |
body.translated_text: 218. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, after ordaining [disciples], would not admonish or instruct them. They then grew like wild oxen — up to: not knowing how to conduct themselves in wearing the patchwork robe, bowl, and robes. Abbreviated — up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>! How can you ordain [disciples] and then not admonish or instruct them? Therefore, they should be admonished and instructed for two years.'
