body.text: atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble [the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>], <s>Gautamī</s>' — up to: 'so that [the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasthāyikā upasthāpitāṃ dve varṣāṇi nāvavadeya nānuśāsayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being the preceptress, does not admonish or instruct an ordained [disciple] for two years — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | peyālaṃ | upasthāyikā ti upādhyāyinī | upasthāpitān ti sārdhaṃ vihāriṇī | dve varṣāṇīti dve dakavarṣāṇi | nāvavaded iti abhidharme vā abhivinaye vā | abhidharmo nāma navavidhaḥ sūtrāntaḥ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained — abbreviated. 'The preceptress' (<s>upasthāyikā</s>) means the <s>upādhyāyinī</s>. 'The ordained one' (<s>upasthāpitā</s>) means the co-resident disciple. 'Two years' means two rainy-season years. 'Does not admonish' means in the higher <s>Dharma</s> (<s>Abhidharma</s>) or in the higher discipline (<s>Abhivinaya</s>). '<s>Abhidharma</s>' means the ninefold <s>sūtrānta</s> (scripture).

body.text: abhivinayo nāma prātimokṣaḥ vistaraprabhedena | nānuśāsed iti ācāram akurvantīm anācāraṃ kurvantīṃ na nirddhameyā na daṇḍakarma dadyāt pācattikaṃ | atha dāni sā upasthāpitā durvacā bhavati śaithilikā vā bāhulikā vā aśikṣākāmā nirddhamitavyā | bhikṣur api sārdhaṃ vihārinaṃ nāvāvadati nānuśāsati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: '<s>Abhivinaya</s>' means the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> (code of discipline) in detail with its analysis. 'Does not instruct' means does not reprove one who fails to act properly or who acts improperly, does not impose disciplinary measures — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. However, if that ordained disciple is difficult to admonish, or is lax, or self-indulgent, or unwilling to train, she should be reproved. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, who does not admonish or instruct his co-resident disciple, incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasthāyikā upasthāpitāṃ dve varṣāṇi nāvavaden nānuśāset pācattikaṃ ||4 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, being the preceptress, does not admonish or instruct an ordained [disciple] for two years — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [4]

body.text: pācattikadharma 105
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 105.

body.text: nopasthihet
body.translated_text: Not attending upon (<s>nopasthihet</s>).

body.text: 219. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo upasthāpitāḥ anyena gacchanti | tā dāni upādhyāyinīyo ojjhāyanti | asmākaṃ bhagavatā daṇḍakarma prajñaptaṃ | imā sāmoktikā | yā dāni upasthāpitā anyena gacchanti | katham imāḥ asmābhir avavaditavyāyo anuśāsitavyāyo | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvac chabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ pṛcchīyanti | āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ vo bhikṣuṇīyo evaṃ nāma yūyam upasthāpitāḥ anyena gacchatha | tena hi upasthāpitāya upasthāyikā dve varṣāṇi anubandhitavyā | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 219. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who had been ordained would go elsewhere. Their preceptresses then complained: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> has laid down a disciplinary measure for us. These [disciples] are willful. Now that they have been ordained, they go elsewhere. How are we to admonish and instruct them?' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> — abbreviated — up to: they were summoned and questioned about all of it. 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>! How can you, having been ordained, go elsewhere? Therefore, an ordained disciple should follow her preceptress for two years.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'Assemble the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, <s>Gautamī</s>' — up to: 'so that [the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasthāpitā upasthāyikāṃ dve varṣāṇi nopasthihen nānubandhet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having been ordained, does not attend upon or follow her preceptress for two years — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | upasthāpiteti sārdhavihāriṇī | upasthāyikām iti upādhyāyinī | dve varṣāṇīti dve varṣāṇī | nopasthihed iti kāyaparicaryāṃ kuryāt | nānubandhed iti yena gacchati tena na gacchati pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | atha dāni sā upasthāyikā aśikṣākāmā bhavati śaithilikā vā bāhulikā vā | bhikṣuṇī paśyati | sā me brahmacaryāntarāyo bhaveya dṛṣṭvānukṛtim āpadyantīyeti anyena gacchati anāpattiḥ | bhikṣuṇī upasthāyikāṃ nopasthihati nānubandhati pācattikaṃ | bhikṣur api upādhyāyaṃ dve varṣān nopasthihati nānubandhati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Having been ordained' means the co-resident disciple. 'The preceptress' means the <s>upādhyāyinī</s>. 'Two years' means two years. 'Does not attend upon' means does not perform bodily service. 'Does not follow' means does not go where she goes — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. However, if that preceptress is unwilling to train, or is lax, or self-indulgent — and the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sees: 'She would be an obstacle to my celibacy; seeing [her conduct], [others] would imitate [it]' — and she goes elsewhere, there is no offense. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who does not attend upon or follow her preceptress — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too who does not attend upon or follow his preceptor for two years incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasthāpitā upasthāyikāṃ dve varṣāṇī nopasthihen nānubandhet pācattikaṃ ||5 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, having been ordained, does not attend upon or follow her preceptress for two years — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [5]

body.text: pācattikadharma 106
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 106.

body.text: anuvarṣam
body.translated_text: Every year (<s>anuvarṣam</s>).

body.text: 220. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo anuvarṣam upasthāpayanti | tāsāṃ dāni kaukṛtyaṃ | kin nu khalv etaṃ labhyaṃ kartuṃ | utāho na labhyaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati anuvarṣam upasthāpayituṃ | atha khalu vīciḥ kartavyā |
body.translated_text: 220. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were ordaining [disciples] every year. They then had doubt: 'Is this indeed permissible to do, or is it not?' Abbreviated — up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not proper to ordain every year. Rather, a turn should be taken.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anuvarṣam upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should ordain [a disciple] every year — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | anuvarṣan ti anusamvatsaraṃ | upasthāpayed iti upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī anuvarṣam upasthāpayeti pācattikaṃ | ekaṃ varṣam upasthāpayitavyaṃ | aparavarṣe vīciḥ kartavyā | atha dāni bhikṣuṇī kṛtapuṇyā bhavati ekaṃ varṣaṃ śikṣā deśayitavyā | aparaṃ varṣam upasthāpayitavyā | kiñcāpi bhikṣuḥ anuvarṣam upasthāpayed anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Every year' means annually. 'Should ordain' means should grant ordination — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who ordains every year — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. One should ordain in one year; in the following year, a turn should be taken. However, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> is one of great merit, the training should be taught in one year and ordination granted in the following year. Although a <s>bhikṣu</s> may ordain every year — there is no offense. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī anuvarṣam upasthāpayet pācattikam ||6 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should ordain [a disciple] every year — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [6]

body.text: pācattikadharma 107
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 107.

body.text: ekato viśuddhāṃ
body.translated_text: Purified from one side only (<s>ekato viśuddhā</s>).

body.text: 221. bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati | tahiṃ dāni jetā nāma bhikṣuṇī | sā antevāsinīṃ bhikṣuṇīhi upasaṃpādīyāna sthūlanandāṃ bhikṣuṇīm āha | ārye mama antevāsinī upasampādyā sādhu ārye āryamiśrikānāṃ gaṇaṃ paryeṣehi | tāya gatvā ṣadvargikā bhikṣū ānītā | sā dān āha | nāham etehi upasaṃpādayeyaṃ | tāya dāni aparaṃ divasaṃ bhadrakāṇāṃ bhikṣuṇāṃ gaṇaṃ samudānayitvā upasaṃpādayitvā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo majāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te jete evan nāma tvaṃ ekato viśuddhāṃ parivāsikinīm upasthāpayasi | evan nāma tvaṃ gaṇam avajānāsi | tena hi na kṣamati gaṇam avajānituṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 221. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>. There was a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Jetā</s>. She, wishing to ordain her pupil, addressed the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>: 'Noble One, my pupil is to be ordained. Please, Noble One, arrange a quorum of the mixed assembly.' <s>Sthūlanandā</s> went and brought the six-group <s>bhikṣus</s> (<s>ṣaḍvargika</s>). <s>Jetā</s> then said: 'I will not ordain [her] with these [monks].' On another day, having assembled a quorum of virtuous <s>bhikṣus</s>, she ordained [her pupil]. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> — up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Jetā</s>! How can you ordain a <s>pārivāsikā</s> (probationer) purified from one side only? How can you show contempt for the quorum? Therefore, it is not proper to show contempt for the quorum.' Abbreviated — up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ekato viśuddhāṃ parivāsikinīm upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should ordain a probationer (<s>pārivāsikinī</s>) purified from one side only — it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | ekato viśuddhām iti bhikṣuṇīgaṇenopasampannāṃ | pārivāsikinīm iti parivasitarātriṃ | upasthāpayed iti upasampādayen na bhikṣugaṇena pārājikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati ekato pārivāsikinīm upasthāpayituṃ | nāpi kṣamati apariśuddhena upasaṃpādayituṃ | atha khalu pratikṛty eva tāva bhadrakāṇāṃ bhikṣūṇāṃ gaṇo samudānayitavyo | atha dāni anye bhadrakāḥ anye abhadrakāḥ tathā kartavyaṃ yathā bhadrottarāṇi karmāṇi bhavanti | bhikṣuṇā pi bhadrottarāṇi karmāṇi kartavyāni | atha dāni gaṇam avajānāti vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha dāni senābhayaṃ vā bhavati paracakrabhayaṃ vā nagaroparodho vā kiñcāpi pārivāsikinīm upasthāpayety anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Purified from one side only' means ordained by the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> quorum [alone]. 'A probationer' (<s>pārivāsikinī</s>) means one who has completed her probationary nights. 'Should ordain' means should grant full ordination — not [completing] the <s>bhikṣu</s> quorum [portion] is a <s>pārājika</s>, up to the rule establishment. It is not proper to ordain a probationer from one side only. Nor is it proper to ordain with an impure [quorum]. Rather, one should first arrange a quorum of virtuous <s>bhikṣus</s>. If some are virtuous and some are not, it should be done in such a way that the formal acts have a virtuous majority. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too should perform formal acts with a virtuous majority. If one shows contempt for the quorum, one incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. However, if there is fear of an army, fear of a foreign invasion, or a city under siege — even if one ordains a probationer [from one side], there is no offense. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ekato viśuddhāṃ pārivāsikīnīm upasthāpayet pācattikaṃ ||7 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should ordain a probationer (<s>pārivāsikinī</s>) purified from one side only — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [7]

body.text: pācattikadharma 108
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 108.

body.text: ṣaṭpañca yojanā
body.translated_text: Six or five <s>yojanas</s>.

body.text: 222. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | yā sā kālīya triyantarā lecchavidhītā upasthāpitā | sā dāni āgārikehi ca sārdhaṃ saṃsṛṣṭā viharati | sā bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati | ārye kāli yā dāni upasthāpitā tvaṃ jānāsi āgārikehi ca parivrājakehi ca saṃṣṛṣṭāṃ | kim arthaṃ na vyapakarṣasi na vyapakarṣāpayasi | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te kāli yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti
body.translated_text: 222. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. The <s>Licchavi</s> girl with three abnormal [features] whom <s>Kālī</s> had ordained—she was living in close association with laymen. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> said to her: 'Noble <s>Kālī</s>, the one you ordained—you know she lives in close association with laymen and wandering ascetics. Why do you not remove her, or have her removed?' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Kālī</s>... until they will be utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasthāyikā upasthāpitāṃ tathārūpāsu āpadāsu na vyapakarṣen na vyapakarṣāpayed antaśaḥ ṣaṭpañca yojanā ti pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is a preceptress, when one whom she has ordained is in such difficulties, should neither remove [her] nor have [her] removed—at least five or six <s>yojanas</s> away—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | upasthāyikā ti upādhyāyinī | upasthāpitā ti sārdhevihāriṇī | tathārūpāsu āpadāsū ti svayam vā pratyodhāvitukāmā jñātikā vā pratyodhāvayitukāmā anyehi vā saṃsṛṣṭā bhavati | na vyupakarṣatīti svayaṃ na vyupakarṣāpayatīti parehi | antamasato ṣaṭpañca yojanā ti na dāni ṣaṭpañca ca paramaṃ | ṣaḍ eva pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | eṣā dāni bhikṣuṇīye sārdham vihāriṇī vā antevāsinī vā saṃsṛṣṭā bhavati vyapakarṣitavyā vā vyapakarṣāpayitavyā vā cārikāya varṇo bhāṣitavyaḥ | atha dāni jarādurbalāvā vyādhidurbalā vā bhoti anyāhi bhikṣuṇīhi vyakpakarṣayitavyā | vaktavyā | cetīya vandanā bhaviṣyati | bhikṣudarśanam bhaviṣyati | yadā vayaṃ taruṇīyo āsi evam asmābhir aṭitaṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Preceptress' (<s>upasthāyikā</s>) means the <s>upādhyāyinī</s>. 'One whom she has ordained' (<s>upasthāpitā</s>) means her co-resident. 'In such difficulties' means: she herself wishes to return [to lay life], or her relatives wish to take her back, or she lives in close association with others. 'Should not remove' means she herself does not [do so]. 'Should not have removed' means [does not have it done] by others. 'At least five or six <s>yojanas</s>' — not just five or six as the maximum, but exactly six — it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Up to the rule establishment. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s co-resident or pupil lives in close association, she should either remove or have her removed; the virtues of traveling should be praised. But if she is weakened by old age or weakened by illness, other <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should have her removed. One should say: 'There will be a <s>caitya</s> veneration. There will be an opportunity to see <s>bhikṣus</s>. When we were young, we traveled thus.'

body.text: bhikṣur api sārdhaṃ vihāriṃ utkaṇṭhitan na vyapakarṣayati na vyapakarṣāpayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, if he does not remove or have removed a co-resident who is distressed, incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasthāyikā upasthāpitāṃ tathārūpāsv āpadāsu na vyapakarṣayet na vyapakarṣāpayet antamasato ṣaṭpañca yojanā ti pācattikaṃ ||81 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who is a preceptress, when one whom she has ordained is in such difficulties, should neither remove [her] nor have [her] removed—at least five or six <s>yojanas</s> away—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. [81]

body.text: pācattikadharma 109
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 109:

body.text: kiṃ punaḥ
body.translated_text: 'What use' (<s>kiṃ punaḥ</s>).

body.text: 223. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī anaṅgopetā upasthāpayati | sā nāvavadati nānuśāsati | tā indragavā viya vardhanti śivacchagalā viya vardhanti | peyālaṃ | yāvat kathaṃ saṃghāṭīpātracīvaradhāraṇe pratipadyitavyaṃ | sā dāni bhikṣuṇīhi vuccati kim punar āryāye anaṅgopetāye upasthāpitena yaṃ āryāmevaṃ vaktavyā anuśāsitavyā | sā dān āha | kiṃ bhadrāyiṇīyo irṣyāpathā mama parṣām upasthāpayantīyo | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande evan nāma tvaṃ kṣiyādharmam āpadyesi | tena hi na kṣamati kṣiyādharmam āpadyituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati | sannipātaya gautami | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 223. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s> ordained those who were not endowed with the requisite qualities. She neither instructed them nor guided them. They grew like <s>indragava</s> insects; they grew like wild goats. [Abbreviation.] Until: 'How is it that she...'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evam ucyamānā | him punar āryāye anaṅgopetāye upasthāpitena | yaṃ āryā evam vaktavyā anuśāsitavyety uktā samānā kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'What use [is one ordained] by one not endowed with the requisite qualities? The Noble One should be told and instructed'—being thus told, should bring about a charge of decline—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | bhikṣuṇīhīti saṃghena mahājanena ekapudgalena | kim punar āryāye anaṅgopetāye ti daśahi aṅgehi samanvāgatā aṅgopetā | prātimokṣasamvarasamvṛtā bhavati [1] | bahuśrutā bhavaty abhidharme [2] | bahuśrutā bhavaty abhivinaye [3] | yāvat | dvādaśa varṣā ca bhavati [10] | yasyā imāni daśāṅgāni na samvidyante sā bhavati anaṅgopetā | kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya ti vivācayet pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi yucyamānā kim punar āryāye anaṅgopetāye upasthāpiteneti kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya pācattikaṃ | bhikṣur api bhikṣūhi vucyamāno kim punar āyuṣmato anaṅgopetasya upasthāpiteneti kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'By the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' means by the <s>Saṃgha</s>, by a group, or by a single person. 'What use of one not endowed with the qualities' — 'endowed with the qualities' (<s>aṅgopetā</s>) means endowed with ten qualities: [1] she is restrained by the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> discipline; [2] she is learned...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīhi evaṃ vucyamānā kim punar āryāye anaṅgopetāye upasthāpiteneti uktā kṣiyādharmam āpadyeya pācattikaṃ ||9 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when addressed by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>: 'What use [is one ordained] by one not endowed with the requisite qualities?'—being thus told, should bring about a charge of decline—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. [9]

body.text: pācattikadharma 110
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 110:

body.text: na visarjayet
body.translated_text: 'Should not dismiss' (<s>na visarjayet</s>).

body.text: 224. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | aparā dāni śikṣamāṇā sthūlanandām āha | sādhu me ārye nande upasaṃpādaya māṃ | sā dān āha | bāḍhaṃ ahaṃ te upasaṃpādayiṣyan ti | sā vilakṣeti | naivopasaṃpādeti na visarjayati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvat śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande |
body.translated_text: 224. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. Now a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s> (trainee nun) said to <s>Sthūlanandā</s>: 'It would be good, Noble <s>Nandā</s>, if you would ordain me.' She said: 'Very well, I shall ordain you.' But she procrastinated and neither ordained her nor dismissed her...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī śikṣamāṇām evaṃ vādet | yadā pūraśikṣā bhaviṣyasi tato ham upasthāpayiṣyan ti vaditvā naivopasaṃpādayen na visarjayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should say to a <s>śikṣamāṇā</s>: 'When your training is complete, then I shall ordain you'—having said this, should neither ordain [her] nor dismiss [her]—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | peyālaṃ | śikṣamāṇeti aṣṭādaśehi varttehi dve varṣāṇi deśtitaśikṣā | evam vadeyā ti yathā sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī | ahan te upasthāpayiṣyan ti upasthāpayitavyā | atha dāni na pratibalā bhavati anyā adhyeṣitavyā | atha dāni naivātmanā upasthāpayati nāpy anyāṃ adhyeṣayati na visarjayati | gaccha yatrecchasi tahiṃ upasampadyāhīti | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī śikṣamāṇām uktvā ahan te upasthāpayiṣyan ti paścān nopasampādayen na visarjayet pācattikaṃ ||10 ||
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. [Abbreviation.] '<s>Śikṣamāṇā</s>' means one who has been trained for two years in the eighteen observances, with training taught. 'Should say thus' means like the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s>. 'I shall ordain you' means she should be ordained. But if then...

body.text: pācattikadharma 111
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 111:

body.text: yānam
body.translated_text: Riding a vehicle (<s>yāna</s>).

body.text: 225. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | atha bhadrā kāpileyī caturyuktaṃ yānam abhiruhitvā jñātikulaṃ gacchati | jano dāni ojjhāyati | paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇikā mahacchandā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 225. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. Then <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s>, mounting a chariot drawn by four [horses], went to her relatives' house. People were displeased: 'Look, friends, the female renunciant is still greatly desirous!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī yānam abhiruhyet pācattikaṃ | eṣaivārthotpattiḥ | bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni śākīyakanyāḥ kolīyakanyāḥ lecchavikanyāś ca prakṛtisukumārāḥ pravrajitāḥ | pādehi gacchantīyo kilamyanti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi anujānāmi gilānāye | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantrayati yāvat |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should mount a vehicle—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense. This is the same origin story. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, those <s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Koliya</s> maidens, and <s>Licchavi</s> maidens, being naturally delicate, had gone forth. Going on foot...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī agilānā yānam abhiruhet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, not being ill, should mount a vehicle—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | agilānā ti pratyuddhṛtaṃ bhagavatā padaṃ anāpattiḥ gilānāye | glānyaṃ nāma jarādurbalā vā vyādhidurbalā vā prakṛtisukumārā vā na śaknoti pada āgacchantu idam atra gailānyam abhipretaṃ | yānan nāma hastiyānaṃ aśvayānam uṣṭrayānaṃ goyānaṃ gardabhayānaṃ nāvāyānaṃ śivikāyānaṃ yānayānam eva aṣṭamaṃ | abhiruhyet pācattikaṃ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇyā yānam abhiruhituṃ | yatra uṣṭrā vā goṇā vā yuktā bhavanti | atha khalu strīyānam abhiruhitavyaṃ | yahiṃ uṣṭrīyo vā goṇīyo vā yuktā bhavanti tahiṃ āruhitavyaṃ | atha dāni asaṃjñikā bhavati na strīṃ na puruṣaṃ jānāti anāpattiḥ | atha dāni nāvāya aparāt param uttaraty anāpattiḥ | ūrdhvaṅgāminīyam vā adhogāminīyam vā pratyayo adhiṣṭhihitavyo mā mariṣyāmīti | bhikṣur api agilāno yānamabhiruhati vinayātikramam āsādayati | pratyayam adhiṣṭhihati anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Not being ill' — this word was removed by the <s>Bhagavān</s>: there is no offense for one who is ill. 'Illness' means weakened by old age, weakened by disease, or naturally delicate—unable to go on foot. 'Here, this is what is meant by illness...'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī agilānā yānam abhiruhet pācattikaṃ |rā ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, not being ill, should mount a vehicle—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: pācattikadharma 112
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 112:

body.text: chatra
body.translated_text: Umbrella (<s>chatra</s>).

body.text: 226. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | bhadrā kāpileyī chatreṇa gṛhītena upānahābhyām ābaddhābhyāṃ jñātikulaṃ gacchati | jano dāni ojjhāyati | paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇikā adyāpīyaṃ pravrajitā pi mahacchandā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati chatropānahaṃ |
body.translated_text: 226. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s>, holding an umbrella and wearing sandals, went to her relatives' house. People were displeased: 'Look, friends, even after going forth, this female renunciant is still greatly desirous...'

body.text: eṣaivārthotpattiḥ | bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni śākīyakanyāḥ lecchavikumārāḥ pravrajitā gacchantīyo ātapena dahyante | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi anujānāmi gilānāye | yāvāt |
body.translated_text: This is the same origin story. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>Śākya</s> maidens and <s>Licchavi</s> maidens who had gone forth, going [on their rounds], were being scorched by the sun. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. [Abbreviation.]

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī agilānā chatropānahaṃ dhārayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, not being ill, should wear an umbrella and sandals—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ti upasampannā | agilānā ti pratyuddhṛtaṃ bhagavatā padaṃ anāpattir gilānāye | kin tāvad atra gailānyam abhipretaṃ | jarādurbalā vā vyādhidurbalā va prakṛtisukumārā vā | śaknoti gantuṃ ātapena dahyate | chatropānaha iti chatran nāma bhūrjachatraṃ tālachatraṃ veṇuchatraṃ parṇachatraṃ cailachatram | upānahā nāma ekapalāsikā saṃpuṭā vā | dhārayed iti paribhuñjet pācattikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī agilānā chatran dhāreti na upānahāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | upānahān dhāreya na chatraṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | ubhayan dhāreti pācattikaṃ | nobhayaṃ anāpattiḥ | bhikṣur api picumastakādi chatraṃ dhāreti saṃpuṭām vā anirmokāṃ vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Not being ill' — this word was removed by the <s>Bhagavān</s>: there is no offense for one who is ill. 'What then is meant by illness here?' — weakened by old age, weakened by disease, or naturally delicate—she is able to go [without them]...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī agilānā chatropānahaṃ dhārayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, not being ill, should wear an umbrella and sandals—it is a <s>pācattika</s> offense.

body.text: pācattikadharma 113
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 113:

body.text: mañca
body.translated_text: Bed (<s>mañca</s>).

body.text: 227. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | bhadrā dāni kāpileyī jñātikulaṃ gacchati | teṣāṃ śayyā āstṛtapratyāstṛtā dvikaḍevara trikaḍevarehi niśreṇīya āruhyati | carakaparivrājakā bhikṣuṇīyo ca bhikṣārthaṃ praviśanti | te tāṃ dṛṣṭvā ojjhāyanti | paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇikā adyāpīyaṃ mahacchandā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvac chabdāpayatha bhadrāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evaṃ nāma tvaṃ atirekaprāmāṇike mañce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdasi abhinipadyasi | tena hi na kṣamati atirekaprāmāṇike mañce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdituṃ vā abhinipadyitum vā | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 227. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s> went to her relatives' house. Their bed, covered with spreads and coverings, was two or three [corpse-lengths] high, reached by a ladder. <s>Caraka</s> wanderers and <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> entered for alms. They, seeing her [on the high bed], criticized: 'Look, friends, the female renunciant still has such extravagant desires!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Up to: 'Summon <s>Bhadrā</s>.' She was summoned. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned all of it in detail. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How could you sit on or lie down on a bed or seat that exceeds the proper measurement? Therefore it is not permissible to sit on or lie down on a bed or seat that exceeds the proper measurement.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> [spoke] up to: '[the rules] will be made clear.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī atirekaprāmāṇike mañce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdeya vā abhinipadyeya vā pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should sit on or lie down on a bed or seat that exceeds the proper measurement, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | atirekaprāmāṇike iti sugatāṣṭāṅgulapramāṇato uttari | mañce vā pīṭhe vā ti caturdaśa mañcāḥ caturdaśa pīṭhāḥ | abhiniṣīdeya vā ti āseya | abhinipadyeya vā ti śayyāṃ kalpayet pācatikaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī sakṛn niṣaṇṇā divasaṃ pi niṣīdati ekaṃ pācattikam āsādayati | atha puno puno niṣīdati tāvatyaḥ pācattikāḥ | atirekapramāṇaṃ bhūmau nikhanitvā upaviśati vā nipadyati vā anāpattiḥ | bhikṣur api atirekaprāmāṇike mañce vā pīṭhe vā niṣīdati vā abhinipadyati vā vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Exceeding the proper measurement' means exceeding the measurement of eight <s>Sugata</s> finger-breadths [in leg height]. 'Bed or seat' means the fourteen types of beds and the fourteen types of seats. 'Should sit on' means should sit. 'Should lie down on' means should arrange as a sleeping place — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, once seated, sits for the whole day, she incurs one <s>pācattika</s>. But if she sits down again and again, she incurs that many <s>pācattikas</s>. If the excess measurement [of the legs] is sunk into the ground and she sits on it or lies down, there is no offense. If a <s>bhikṣu</s> also sits on or lies down on a bed or seat exceeding the proper measurement, he incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī atirekaprāmāṇike mañce vā pīṭhe vā abhiniṣīdeya vā abhinipadyeya vā pācattikaṃ ||2 ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should sit on or lie down on a bed or seat that exceeds the proper measurement, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [2]

body.text: pācattikadharma 114
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 114

body.text: ekāstaraṇā
body.translated_text: Sharing a Single Covering (<s>ekāstaraṇā</s>)

body.text: 228. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni ṣaḍvargiṇīyo bhikṣuṇīyo ekāstaraṇaprāvaraṇāṃ śayyāṃ kalpayanti | tāyo mañcāṃ bhañjanti biśikāṃ pāṭenti caturasrakāṃ pāṭenti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvat tā dāni śabdāpitāḥ pṛcchīyanti | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ vo bhikṣuṇīyo yāvat |
body.translated_text: 228. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The group-of-six <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> (<s>ṣaḍvargiṇīs</s>) would arrange sleeping places with a single covering and wrap. They would break the beds, tear the mattresses, and tear the rectangular [cushions]. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Up to: they were summoned...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī ekāstaraṇaprāvaraṇāṃ sahaśayyāṃ kalpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should arrange a sleeping place [with another] with a single covering and wrap, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | ekāstaraṇā ti ekamañcāstaraṇā | ekaprāvaraṇā ti ekacelā | śeyyā ti paṅgulamañco paṅgulapīṭho yāvat kaṭakilañjādayo | kalpayed iti kuryāt | pācattikam yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye sahaśayyāṃ kalpayituṃ | atha khalu mañce ekākinīya śayitavyaṃ | trihi pīṭhehi dvihi janāhīti pādāṃ prāsārayantīhi tathā prasārayitavyāḥ yathā anyamanyasya jānukā nākrameyuḥ | bisyām ekākinyā śayitavyā | tiryak prajñaptāyā tṛhi janehi śayitavyaṃ pāṭiyakapāṭiyakehi pratyāstaraṇehi yathā caturasrake yathā pīṭhe | atha dāni tṛṇādi saṃstaro bhavati na kṣamati atibahuṃ ākramituṃ | atha khu nirmuṣṭikaṃ samaṃ prajñāpayitavyaṃ pāṭiyakapāṭiyakehi pratyāstaraṇehi | atha dāni śītam bhavati svakasvakāny antarīkaraṇāni kṛtvā ekaṃ saṃcelī kartavyā | bhikṣur api sahaśayyāṃ kalpayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Single covering' means a single bed-cover. 'Single wrap' means a single cloth. 'Sleeping place' means a board-bed, a board-seat, or mats and reed [mattresses] and the like. 'Should arrange' means should do — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to arrange a shared sleeping place. However...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī sahaśayyāṃ kalpayet pācattikaṃ ||3 ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should arrange a shared sleeping place, it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [3]

body.text: pācattikadharma 115
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 115

body.text: prakramati
body.translated_text: Departing [Without Returning Saṃgha Property] (<s>prakramati</s>)

body.text: 229. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī sāṃghike vihāre śayyāsanaṃ rundhitvā cārikāṃ prakrāntā | bhikṣuṇīyo āgantukāyo āgatāyo | tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo yathāvṛddhikāya utthāpīyanti tasmin vihāre sāṃghikaṃ śayyāsanaṃ | tā bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | kim asya dāni sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanaṃ nirundhiya cārikāṃ prakramīyati | na śayanāsanam aniḥsaritvā gantavyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvac chabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | etad eva pṛcchiyati yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande evaṃ ca nāma tvaṃ sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanaṃ aniḥsaritvā cārikāṃ prakaramasi | tena hi na kṣamati sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanam aniḥsarivtā cārikāṃ prakramituṃ | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 229. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s>, having occupied a sleeping place in a <s>Saṃgha</s> dwelling, departed on a wandering tour. Visiting <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> arrived. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were assigned, by seniority, the <s>Saṃgha</s> sleeping places in that dwelling. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanam aniḥsaritvā cārikāṃ prakrāmeya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should depart on a wandering tour without returning the <s>Saṃgha</s> sleeping place, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanan ti mañcam vā pīṭham vā bisikām vā caturasrakām vā kuccam vā bimbohanam vā | aniḥsaritvā ti aniryātayitvā | cārikāṃ prakrameyā ti anyatra gacchet pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanam aniḥsaritvā cārikāṃ prakramituṃ | prakramantīya vaktavyaṃ yathā paliguddhaṃ śayanāsanaṃ niḥsarāmīti | aniḥsaritvā prakrāmati pācattikam āsādayati | atha dāni ekavastuko saṃghārāmo bhavati aniḥsaritvā cārikāṃ prakramati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. '<s>Saṃgha</s> sleeping place' means a bed, a seat, a mattress, a rectangular [cushion], a pillow, or a bolster. 'Without returning' means without bringing back [to the stores]. 'Should depart on a wandering tour' means should go elsewhere — it is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to the rule establishment. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī sāṃghikaṃ śayanāsanam aniḥsaritvā cārikāṃ prakrameya pācattikaṃ |ṇàüka ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should depart on a wandering tour without returning the <s>Saṃgha</s> sleeping place, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pācattikadharma 116
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 116

body.text: praviśati
body.translated_text: Entering [a Bhikṣu Monastery Unannounced] (<s>praviśati</s>)

body.text: 230. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | so dāni gartodarapitā svavihāre snāpayati | gartodaramātā apratisamviditā vihāraṃ gacchati | praviśitvā pṛṣṭhim asya mardati | tenāvalokitā | so dān āha | aye hi strī ti | sā dān āha | apāpā gartodarapitā | kas tāvad atra doṣo 'yaṃ dāni ahaṃ anyadāpi anyadāpi snāpayāmi | so dān āha | anyadāham gṛhī āsi idānīṃ pravrajito | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvac chabdāpayatha gartodaramātāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā tad eva sarvaṃ | bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | anyadāpi snāpayāmi | so dān āha | duṣkṛtan te gartodaramāte yāvad evan nāma tvaṃ jānantī pūrve apratisamviditā anāhūtā upasamkramasi | tena hi na kṣamati yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 230. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Gartodara</s>'s father was bathing in his own dwelling. <s>Gartodara</s>'s mother, without informing [anyone], went to the dwelling. Having entered, she rubbed his back. He turned around. He said: 'Oh, a woman!' She said: 'It is nothing improper, father of <s>Gartodara</s>. Who is [more harmless] than...'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī sabhikṣukaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ pūrve apratisamviditā anāhūtā upasamkrameya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowingly, without prior notification and without being invited, should approach a <s>Saṃgha</s> monastery where [even one] <s>bhikṣu</s> is present, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | sabhikṣukan ti antamasato yahiṃ ekabhikṣur api bhavati | saṃghārāman ti āraṇyakam vā grām'antikam vā | pūrve apratisamviditā ti aniveditā | anāhūtā ti aśabdāpitā | upasamkrameyā ti praviśeya | yathā gartodaramātā bhikṣuṇī | pācattikaṃ peyālaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ |
body.translated_text: 'If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is fully ordained. 'Where a <s>bhikṣu</s> is present' means where at least one <s>bhikṣu</s> is. '<s>Saṃgha</s> monastery' means whether in a forest or near a village. 'Without prior notification' means without having informed. 'Without being invited' means without having been summoned. 'Should approach' means should enter. As [in the case of] <s>Gartodara</s>'s mother, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>...

body.text: etā dāni yo bhikṣuṇīyo pariveṇaṃ gacchanti dvārakoṣṭhake sthitvā nivedayitavyaṃ | vandāmy ārya praviśāmaḥ | tenāpi dāni bhikṣuṇā bhikṣavo jānāpayitavyā mā dāni bhikṣū viprakaṭā bhaveṃsū ti | yadi viprakaṭā bhonti mṛttikākarmeṇa vā iṣṭakākarmeṇa vā | apaliguddhā bhavanti vaktavyaṃ | āgametha tāvad bhaginīyo | tena te bhikṣū upasaṃkrāmitvā vaktavyāḥ | āyuṣmanto nivāsetha prāvaratha bhikṣuṇīyo praviśanti | na ca akuśalena aprakṛtijñena vaktavyaṃ | sahasā mā praviśatheti | atha khalu vaktavyaṃ | viprakaṭā bhikṣavo mā praviśatha | atha dāni apratisaṃviditā praviśanti pācattikaṃ | ekaṃ pādaṃ praveśayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | dvitīyapādaṃ praveśayati pācattikaṃ | tata eva pratyośakkati vinayātikramam āsādayati | bhikṣur api apratisaṃvidito bhikṣunīupāśrayaṃ praviśati vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha khu dvārakoṣṭhake sthitvā acchaṭikā kartavyā | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now, those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who go to the residential quarters should stand at the entrance and announce: 'I bow, noble one; may we enter?' That <s>bhikṣu</s> should also inform the [other] <s>bhikṣus</s> so that the <s>bhikṣus</s> are not [found] in an indecent state. If they are in an indecent state, [they should cover themselves] by plastering work or by brickwork...

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī sabhikṣukaṃ saṃghārāmaṃ pūrve apratisaṃviditā anāhūtā upasaṃkrameya pācattikaṃ ||tṛ ||
body.translated_text: If any <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowingly, without prior notification and without being invited, should approach a <s>Saṃgha</s> monastery where a <s>bhikṣu</s> is present, it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pācattikadharma 117
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> Rule 117

body.text: samanuṣya
body.translated_text: With a Man (<s>samanuṣya</s>)

body.text: 231. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni kośalehi janapadehi cārikāṃ carantīyo grāmavāsake vāsam upagatāḥ | tehi dāni aparā strī vipravastapatikā uktā | prajāpati dehi asmākaṃ pratiśrayaṃ | sā dān āha | ārye kuṭumbiko mama vipravusto | mā sahasā āgamiṣyati | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ | kaḥ punar evaṃ jñāsyati āgamiṣyati vā na veti | tāya dinno pratiśrayo tāsān dāni bhikṣuṇīnāṃ pratikrāntānāṃ | so puruṣo vikāle āgato | so dāni khāditvā pibitvā kleśe pīḍito bhāryāya sārdhaṃ mśrībhūto | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo tena śabdena pratibuddhāḥ | yā dāni avigatarāgāḥ tāsām asparśasaṃjñā utpannā |
body.translated_text: 231. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s>, wandering through the <s>Kośala</s> countryside on tour, took lodging in a village-dwelling. Now, a certain woman whose husband was away was asked by them: 'Good lady, give us lodging.' She said: 'Noble ladies, my husband is away. Do not...'

body.text: etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | pe | yāvad bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo | tāyo śabdāpitāyo tad eva sarvaṃ | bhagavān vistareṇa pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evaṃ ca nāma yūyaṃ jānantīyo saṃbhojanīye kule anupakhajjāsanaṃ śayyāṃ kalpayatha | tena hi na kṣamati |
body.translated_text: The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.' They were summoned. All the same [was reviewed]. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned in detail. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How could you, knowingly...'

body.text: eṣaivārthotpattiḥ | bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni kośalehi janapadehi cārikāṃ carantīyo anyatarasmiṃ grāmavāsake vāsam upagatāḥ | tāyo dāni sarvagrāmam aṇvitāḥ na kahiñcid apuruṣaṃ gṛhaṃ labhanti | tā dāni rathyāyāṃ pratikrāntāḥ rātrau vātavṛṣṭir utthitāḥ | viheṭhitā duḥkhitāḥ saṃvṛttāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi anujānāmi vātasamaye vṛṣṭisamaye |
body.translated_text: This is the same origin story. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s>, wandering through the <s>Kośala</s> countryside on tour, took lodging in a certain village-dwelling. They searched the entire village and could not find any house without a man. They then withdrew to the street at night...

body.text: eṣaivārthotpattiḥ | bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | yāvat rathyāyām vā sopagatā bhikṣuṇīyo | striyo ārocayeṃsuḥ | imaṃ gṛhaṃsuḥ imaṃ gṛhaṃ praviśatha dhūrtakānām iha bhayaṃ | bhikṣuṇīyo āhaṃsuḥ | nahi | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati sapuruṣake gṛhe śayyāṃ kārayituṃ | tāyo tahiṃ rātrau dhūrtakehi viheṭhitāḥ tatrānyatarā brahmacaryāto cyāvitāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi anujānāmi puruṣāśaṅkitasamayaṃ yāvat |
body.translated_text: This is the same origin-story. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> were on the street without lodging. Women told them: 'Enter this house! There is danger from rogues here.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> said: 'No. The <s>Bhagavān</s> has laid down a training rule: it is not permissible to arrange bedding in a house where men are present.' They were then harassed by rogues during the night, and one of them was made to fall from her celibacy. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore I permit the exception when there is apprehension of [danger from] men.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣunī jānantī saṃbhojanīye kule anupakhajjeśayyāṃ kalpayed anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing that a household is one of intimacy [between men and women], intrudes and arranges bedding there, except on a [permissible] occasion—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: tatrāyaṃ samayo vātasamayo vṛṣṭisamayo puruṣāśaṅkitasamayo ayam atra samayo ||
body.translated_text: The occasion here is: a time of strong wind, a time of rain, a time of apprehension regarding men. This is the occasion here.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | jānantīti svayam vā jāneya parato vā śruṇeya | saṃbhojanīyan ti strīyā puruṣo bhojanaṃ puruṣasyāpi strī bhojanaṃ | kulan ti brāhmakulaṃ yāvad rājakulaṃ yāni vā punar anyāny api kāñcit kulāni | anupakhajja nāma vāsavastu yahiṃ bhāryāpatikā pratikramanti | śayyāṃ kalpayan ti pārśvan dadyāt | anyatra samaya iti pratyuddhṛtaṃ bhagavatā padam anāpattiḥ | samayo vātasamayo vṛṣṭisamayo puruṣāśaṅkitasamayo | tatra vātasamayo nātīto nānāgato | atha khu vartamāno yeva | evaṃ vṛṣṭisamayo | puruṣāśaṅkitasamayo nāma mā brahmacaryāntarāyo bhaviṣyatīti | so eṣo puruṣāśaṅkitasamayo nātīto nānāgato | atha khu vartamāno yeva | pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye jānantīye saṃbhojanīye kule anupakhajje śayyāṃ kalpayituṃ |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained. 'Knowing' means either knowing by herself or hearing from others. 'Household of intimacy' (<s>saṃbhojanīya kula</s>) means a woman's enjoyment is a man, and a man's enjoyment is a woman. 'Household' means a brahmin household, up to a royal household, and whatever other households there may be. 'Intruding' (<s>anupakhajja</s>) means the sleeping quarters where husband and wife retire. 'Arranging bedding' means lying on one's side. 'Except on an occasion' means the <s>Bhagavān</s> has exempted this situation—no offense. The occasions are: time of strong wind, time of rain, time of apprehension regarding men. Therein, the time of strong wind is not past, not future, but only the present. Likewise the time of rain. 'Time of apprehension regarding men' means [fear that] there may be an obstacle to celibacy. This time of apprehension regarding men is not past, not future, but only the present. It is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to: it is a regulation. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who knows [the household] to be one of intimacy to intrude and arrange bedding.

body.text: atha dāni jñāyate ayaṃ manuṣyaḥ śrāddho ālaptako vā kiñcāpi anupakhajjo śayyāṃ kalpayanti anāpakhajjo śayyāṃ kalpayati anāpattiḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Now if it is known that the man is faithful or a conversation partner, even if she intrudes and arranges bedding—there is no offense. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī saṃbhojanīye kule anupakhajje śayyāṃ kalpayed anyatra samaye pācattikaṃ | tatrāyaṃ samayo vātasamayo vṛṣtisamayo puruṣāśaṅkitasamayo | ayam atra samayo |rā ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing that a household is one of intimacy, intrudes and arranges bedding there, except on a [permissible] occasion—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. The occasion here is: a time of strong wind, a time of rain, a time of apprehension regarding men. This is the occasion here.

body.text: pācattikadharma 118
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> (Expiation) rule 118.

body.text: adhvānaṃ
body.translated_text: Traveling (<s>adhvāna</s>).

body.text: 232. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhikṣū dāni vaiśālīyaṃ varṣoṣitāḥ śrāvastīṃ prasthitāḥ bhagavato pādāvandāḥ | bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ bhikṣū kila bhagavato pādavandā gamiṣyantīti | tāyo pariveṇaṃ gatvā āhaṃsuḥ | vandāmy ārya śruṇomaḥ āryamiśrāḥ śrāvastīyaṃ gamiṣyanti bhagavataḥ pādavandā | āhaṃsuḥ | āma kiṅ kartavyaṃ | āhaṃsuḥ | vayam api gamiṣyāmaḥ | āhaṃsuḥ | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye saha adhvānamārgaṃ pratipadyitum | tāyo dāni āhaṃsuḥ | kadā punar āryamiśrā gamiṣyanti | āhaṃsuḥ | amukaṃ divasaṃ | tāyo ekadvikāya divasāni gaṇayanti tadaho gamiṣyantīti | tāyo dāni prakṛtyeva kṛtabhaktakṛtyāḥ nivāsayitvā prāvaritvā pātracīvaram ādāya mārge sthitāḥ | te ca bhikṣavo tāṃ velāṃ prasthitāḥ | te tāṃ dṛṣṭvā āhaṃsuḥ | āyuṣmanto imāyo tāyo bhaginīyo śīghraśīghraṃ gacchanti | tā api bhikṣuṇīyo śīghraśīghraṃ gacchanti | te dāni bhikṣū pradhāvitāḥ | tā api bhikṣuṇīyo pradhāvitāyo | tahiṃ dāni yā bhikṣuṇīyo taruṇīyo balavantīyo tāhi te bhikṣū anujavitāḥ | yā taṃhi jarādurbalāyo vyādhidurbalāyo prakṛtisukumārāyo tāyo ce ehi muṣitāḥ paripiṭṭitāś ca | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | evaṃ ca nāma tave tirorājyan tirojanapadaṃ asārthikā prakramatha | tena hi na kṣamati tirorājyāṃ tirojanapadam asārthikā cārikāṃ prakramituṃ | yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 232. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣus</s> who had completed the rains at <s>Vaiśālī</s> set out for <s>Śrāvastī</s> to pay respects to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard: 'The <s>bhikṣus</s> are going to <s>Śrāvastī</s> to pay respects to the <s>Bhagavān</s>.' They went to the residence and said: 'We pay respects, noble ones. We hear the noble ones are going to <s>Śrāvastī</s> to pay respects to the <s>Bhagavān</s>.' They said: 'Yes. What should we do?' They said: 'We too will go.' They said: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> has laid down a training rule: it is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to travel on the road together [with monks].' They then asked: 'When will the noble ones go?' They said: 'On such-and-such a day.' They counted the days one by one, two by two: 'On that day they will go.' Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, having prepared their meal, dressed, put on their outer robes, and taken their bowls and robes, stood on the road. Those <s>bhikṣus</s> set out at that time. Seeing them, they said: 'Sirs, those sisters are going very quickly!' Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> too went very quickly. Then those <s>bhikṣus</s> ran. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> too ran. Among those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, the young and strong ones kept up with the <s>bhikṣus</s>. But those who were weak from age, weak from illness, or naturally delicate—they were robbed and assaulted. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How could you set out without a caravan across kingdoms and across countries? Therefore it is not permissible to set out on a journey across kingdoms and countries without a caravan... up to: so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī tirorājyaṃ tirojanapadaṃ asārthikā cārikāṃ prakrameya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sets out on a journey across kingdoms and countries without a caravan—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | tirorājyan ti pararājyaṃ | tirojanapadan ti parajanapadaṃ | asārthikā ti sālo nāma gṛhi sārtho vā pravrajitasārtho vā śakaṭasārtho vā paryeṣitavyo | cārikā ti anyatra prakramati | pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī asārthikā cārikāṃ prakramati | yadā mārgo nistīrṇo bhavati pācattikaṃ | atha dāni sārtheṇa sārdhaṃ gacchanti | samaṃ prasthitāḥ viṣamaṃ praviśanti vinayātikramam āsādayanti | viṣamaṃ prasthitāḥ samaṃ praviśanti vinayātikramam āsādayanti | samaṃ prasthitāḥ samaṃ praviśanti anāpattiḥ | viṣamaṃ prasthitāḥ viṣamaṃ praviśanti pācattikam āsādayanti |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>' means one who is ordained. 'Across kingdoms' means to another kingdom. 'Across countries' means to another country. 'Without a caravan' means: a caravan is a lay caravan, or a monastic caravan, or a cart caravan—one should be sought. 'Sets out on a journey' means goes elsewhere. It is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to: it is a regulation. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sets out on a journey without a caravan: when the road has been crossed—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Now if they travel with a caravan: if they set out on an even [road] and enter an uneven one—they incur a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. If they set out on an uneven [road] and enter an even one—they incur a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. If they set out on an even [road] and enter an even one—no offense. If they set out on an uneven [road] and enter an uneven one—they incur a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: bhikṣur api asārthiko sabhayaṃ sapratibhayaṃ sāśaṅkasammataṃ mārga pratipadyati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagāvan āha |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, without a caravan, who takes a road that is dangerous, frightening, and known to be perilous, incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī tirorājyan tirojanapadam asārthikā cārikāṃ prakrameya pācattikaṃ || grā ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sets out on a journey across kingdoms and countries without a caravan—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pācattikadharma 119
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 119.

body.text: udyānaṃ
body.translated_text: Pleasure gardens (<s>udyāna</s>).

body.text: 233. bhagavān śrāvastīyaṃ viharati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni strībhiḥ saha udyānabhūmiṃ nirgatāḥ | striyo khādanti ca pibanti ca | tatra bhikṣuṇyaḥ strīveṣeṇa caṅkramanti ārāmagṛhakāni vanagṛhakāni citragṛhakāni nīrīkṣantīyo | tāyo dāni gūḍhe pradeśe puruṣehi viheṭhitāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 233. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s> went out to a pleasure-garden area together with laywomen. The women ate and drank. There the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, dressed in women's attire, walked about, looking at garden-houses, forest-houses, and painted houses. In a secluded spot, they were harassed by men. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: antorājyaṃ kaṃ pi ca bhavati antorāṣṭraṃ | tatra ca bhikṣuṇī ārāmagṛhakāni vā vanagṛhakāni vā citragṛhakāni vā darśanāya gacchet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Even within the kingdom, even within the realm, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> goes to see garden-houses, forest-houses, or painted houses—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: antorājyaṃ kaṃpi bhavatīti svarājyaṃ | antorāṣṭrakam apīti svarāṣṭraṃ | tatra ca bhikṣuṇī ārāmagṛhakānīti ete dāni bhavanti | caṃpakārāmā vā panasārāmā vā atimuktakārāmā vā | vanagṛhakānīti ete bhavanti | nyagrodhavanā vā drākṣāvanā vā kadalīvanā vā dāḍimavanā vā mātuluṅgavanā vā | citragṛhakānīti ete bhavanti sabhā vā kūṭāgārā vā | darśanāya gacched iti prekṣaṇāya | pācattikaṃ | yāvat prājñaptiḥ | na kṣamati ārāmagṛhaṃ vā vanagṛhaṃ vā citragṛhaṃ vā darśanāya gantuṃ | gacchati vinayātikramam āsādayati | yadāgatā bhavati tadā pācattikam āsādayati | atha dāni tatraiva strībhiḥ saha cañcūryate anāpattiḥ | bhikṣur api ārāmagṛhaṃ vā vanagṛhaṃ vā citragṛhaṃ vā darśanāya gacchati yatra kāmopabhoginaḥ krīḍanti vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Even within the kingdom' means one's own kingdom. 'Even within the realm' means one's own realm. 'Garden-houses' means such as: <s>campaka</s>-groves, jackfruit-groves, <s>atimuktaka</s>-groves. 'Forest-houses' means such as: banyan groves, grape groves, banana groves, pomegranate groves, citron groves. 'Painted houses' means such as: assembly halls or gabled mansions. 'Goes to see' means for the purpose of viewing. It is a <s>pācattika</s>, up to: it is a regulation. It is not permissible to go to see a garden-house, forest-house, or painted house. If she goes—she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. When she has arrived—she incurs a <s>pācattika</s>. Now if she walks about there together with women [i.e., not to view the places but accompanying them]—no offense. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, who goes to see a garden-house, forest-house, or painted house where pleasure-seekers are sporting, incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: antorājyaṃ kaṃpi ca bhavati antorāṣṭraṃ pi | tatra ca bhikṣuṇī ārāmagṛhakāni vā vanagṛhakāni vā citragṛhakāni vā darśanāya gacchet pācattikaṃ ||8 ||
body.translated_text: Even within the kingdom, even within the realm, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> goes to see garden-houses, forest-houses, or painted houses—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [Rule 8]

body.text: pācattikadharma 120
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 120.

body.text: raho
body.translated_text: In private (<s>raho</s>).

body.text: 234. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | sujātā nāma bhikṣuṇī āyuṣmato udāyiṣya purāṇadvitīyā | tāya dāni tasya dūtena preṣito | ehi tvaṃ mama oheyyakavāro bhaviṣyati | sahitakā āsiṣyāmaḥ | yadā tāyo bhikṣuṇīyo gocaraṃ praviṣṭāḥ tadāyuṣmān udāyī kālasyaiva nivāsayitvā prāvaritvā pātracīvaram ādāya tahiṃ praviṣṭo | te dāni vihārasya paścāt vastuke ambarīyakeṇa niṣaṇṇā raktacittā karmaṇyenāṅgajātena anyamanyasya aṅgajātāni nidhyāyattā āsanti | aparā dāni bhikṣuṇī mahallikā uccārakarmāya vā prasrāvakarmāya vā paścād vastukaṃ gatā | tāya dṛṣṭo | sā dāni vrīḍitā pratyosakkitā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtan te sujātike yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 234. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sujātā</s> was the Venerable <s>Udāyin's</s> former wife. She was sent a message by his messenger: 'Come, it will be your turn to serve me. We shall sit together.' When those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> had gone for alms, the Venerable <s>Udāyin</s>, having dressed early in the morning, put on his outer robe, and taken his bowl and robe, entered there. They sat behind the dwelling on a couch-screen, with passionate minds and aroused organs, gazing at each other's private parts. Then another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, an elder, went behind the dwelling for the purpose of defecation or urination. She saw them. She was embarrassed and drew back. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Abbreviated. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Sujātikā</s>... up to: so that they may become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇā sārdhaṃ ekā ekena raho niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> arranges a private sitting, alone with a single <s>bhikṣu</s>, one-to-one—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | ekā ekeneti sā ca bhavati anyo ca tatra bhoti | supto matto unmattotkṣiptacitto vedanābhinno uttānaśayyāko amānuṣo tiryagyonigato | evam apy eṣā ekā ekena | raho ti mitho | niṣadyāṃ kalpayati | sahitakā āseyuḥ | pācattikaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat prajñaptiḥ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇā sārdhaṃ sakṛn nisaṇṇā divasam pi niṣīdati ekaṃ pācattikam āsādayati | atha dāni puno puno ucchati ca niṣīdati ca tattikā pācattikam āsādayati | atha dāni dve janā bhavanti eko vihāraṃ praviśati kasyacid arthāya bhikṣuṇīya śīghram utthihitavyaṃ | nāpi dāni sahasrām ājāneya māṃ eṣā viheṭhayitukāmā ti | atha khu pratisaṃveditavyaṃ | utthāsyāmy ahaṃ | āha | kasyārthāya | vaktavyaṃ | ekāye ekena sthātuṃ | so eṣo ūnasaptavarṣo cellako bhavati | so āsādanāya na mocanāya kettāvatā antareṇāpattir bhavati | yenāntareṇānabhisaṃskṛtā bhikṣā dīyate | atha dāni ākīrṇajanamanuṣyo bhikṣuṇī upāśrayo bhavati niṣkramanti ca praviśanti ca sthapativardhakicitrakarāḥ kiñcāpi tehi kalpiyakārehi āsati anāpattiḥ | atha dāni rathyāmukhaṃ dvāraṃ bhavati avīciḥ striyo ca puruṣā ca gacchanti akiñcāpi tehi kalpiyakārehi āsati anāpattiḥ | atha dāni antarāvīciḥ chinnā bhavati pācattikaṃ | kalpiyakāro pravalāyati acchaṭikāya bodhayitavyo | atha dāni dve bhūmake kalpiyakāro tiṣṭhati trayāṇām anyatamānyataraṃ paśyaty anāpattiḥ | tatra vāyo vā vemāntareṇa trayāṇām anyatamānyataraṃ paśyaty anāpattiḥ | asti darśanopavicāro na śramaṇopavicāro | asti śramaṇopavicāro na darśanopivicāro | asti darśanopavicāro ca śramaṇopavicāro ca | asti naiva darśanopavicāro na śramaṇopavicāraḥ | kin ti dāni asti darśanopavicāro na śramaṇopavicāraḥ | prākṛtena cakṣuṣā paśyati bhikṣur eṣo āsati bhikṣuṇī veti no tu prākṛtena śrotreṇa tayor āyaṃ śṛṇoti | evaṃ catuṣko yojayitavyaḥ | yāvad eṣā āpattiḥ | grāme vāraṇye vā rātrau vā divā vā channe vā abhyavakaśe vā ekasya na mahājane santike na dūre | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'Alone with one'—means she is there and another is there: asleep, intoxicated, insane, with mind upset, overcome by pain, lying supine, a non-human, or an animal—even so, she is alone with one. 'In private'—means secretly. 'Should arrange a sitting'—means they would sit together. It is a <s>pācattika</s>. Abbreviation. Up to the formal designation. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sits once with a <s>bhikṣu</s>, even for the whole day, she incurs one <s>pācattika</s>. But if she repeatedly stands up and sits down, she incurs a <s>pācattika</s> each time. Now, if two persons are present and one enters the dwelling for some purpose, the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> should quickly stand up. She should not think 'She wishes to harass me suddenly'; rather she should be aware: 'I shall stand up.' If asked 'For what purpose?'—she should say: 'It is not [permissible] for one [woman] to remain alone with one [man].' A boy under seven years old [counts for the offense] but not for release. How close does an offense arise? Within the distance at which uncooked almsfood can be given. Now, if the <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> residence is crowded with people coming and going—builders, painters—even if she sits with those who make [things] allowable, there is no offense. If the door opens onto a highway and women and men pass without a gap, even if she sits without those who make [things] allowable, there is no offense. But if there is a break in the stream [of passersby]—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. If the one who makes [things] allowable falls asleep, she should be awakened by snapping one's fingers. If there are two floors and the one who makes allowable stands [on a different floor], if she sees one of the three [that counts]—there is no offense. Through a lattice or a partition, if she sees one of the three—there is no offense. There is visual monitoring without auditory monitoring; there is auditory monitoring without visual monitoring; there is both; there is neither. What is visual monitoring without auditory? She sees with her natural eye that a <s>bhikṣu</s> is sitting, or a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, but does not hear their conversation with her natural ear. Thus the fourfold set should be applied. Up to: this offense [applies] in a village, in the forest, at night, by day, in a covered [place], in an open [place], alone with one, not in a large gathering, near and not far. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇā sārdhaṃ ekā ekena raho niṣadyāṃ kalpayet pācattikaṃ ||0 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> arranges a private sitting alone with one <s>bhikṣu</s>—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [0]

body.text: pācattikadharma 121
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 121

body.text: puruṣa
body.translated_text: With a man (<s>puruṣa</s>)

body.text: 235. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhadrā dāni kāpileyī jñātikulaṃ gatā bhrātṛkehi bhrātṛputrakehi mātulehi mātulaputrakehi sārdhaṃ ekā ekena saha tiṣṭhati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni piṇḍapātaṃ aṇvantīyo dṛṣṭvā ojjhāyanti | kin tāvad imāye pravrajitāye puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ ekāya ekena raho niṣīdituṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye āhaṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha bhadrāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | tad eva sarvaṃ pṛcchīyati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati | ekāye ekena puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ raho niṣīdituṃ yāvad bhagavān aha |
body.translated_text: 235. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s> had gone to her relatives' house and was standing alone with her brothers, nephews, maternal uncles, and cousins—alone with one. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, going for alms, saw this and were displeased: 'Why does this woman who has gone forth sit alone in private with a man?' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Summon <s>Bhadrā</s>.' She was summoned. Everything was inquired about. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible for one [woman] alone to sit in private with one man.' Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ ekā ekena raho niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> arranges a private sitting alone with one man—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī upasampannā | puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ ekā ekeneti sā ca bhavati yāvad evam apy eṣā ekā ekena | raho ti mithyā | niṣadyāṃ kalpeyā ti sahitakā āseyuḥ | pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ sanniṣaṇṇā divasan niṣīdati ekaṃ pācattikam āsādayati | evaṃ vistareṇa yathaiva bhikṣuṇā | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'With a man, alone with one'—means she is there, and so on, even so she is alone with one. 'In private'—means secretly. 'Should arrange a sitting'—means they would sit together. It is a <s>pācattika</s>. Up to the formal designation. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sits with a man, even for the whole day, she incurs one <s>pācattika</s>. Thus, in detail, just as with a <s>bhikṣu</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ ekā ekena raho niṣadyāṃ kalpeya pācattikaṃ ||lṛṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> arranges a private sitting alone with one man—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pācattikadharma 122
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 122

body.text: upakarṇakena
body.translated_text: Whispering in the ear (<s>upakarṇaka</s>)

body.text: 236. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | atha bhadrā dāni kāpileyī jñātikulaṃ gatā | bhrātṛduhitṛputrehi mātulaputrehi saha anto hastapāśasya tiṣṭhati saṃlapati upakarṇakaṃ jalpati | bhikṣuṇīyo dāni ojjhāyanti | kin tāvad imāye pravrajitāye upakarṇakaṃ jalpitena |
body.translated_text: 236. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s> had gone to her relatives' house. She stood within arm's reach of her nephews and cousins, conversed with them, and whispered in their ears. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were displeased: 'Why does this woman who has gone forth whisper in the ears [of men]?'

body.text: avaśyam eṣā asmākam arthāya jalpati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye āhaṃsuḥ yāvat |
body.translated_text: 'She must be speaking for our [detriment].' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Up to:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī puruṣena sārdhaṃ anto hastapāśasya saṃtiṣṭheya vā saṃlapeya vā upakarṇam vā jalpeya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> stands within arm's reach of a man, or converses with him, or whispers in his ear—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | puruṣeṇa sārdham iti gṛhasthena vā pravrājitena vā | anto hastapāśaṃ ti vyāyāmābhyantare tiṣṭheya | saṃlapatīti kiñci jalpeya | upakarṇakaṃ jalpeyā ti karṇakalpikam jalpeya | pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya puruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ anto hastapāśasya tiṣṭhatum vā samlapitum vā upakarṇakam vā jalpitum vā | atha dāni kiṃ jalpitavyaṃ bhavati | paraṃ hastapādā sthitāya jalpayitavyaṃ | atha dāni guhyaṃ jalpitavyaṃ bhavati bhittim vā kuḍyam vā stambham vā vṛkṣam vā yamanikām vā antarīkṛtvā jalpayitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī puruṣeṇa sārdham anto hastapāśasya tiṣṭhati vā saṃlapati vā upakarṇakam vā jalpati pācattikaṃ | bhikṣur api striyā sārdhaṃ anto hastapāśasya tiṣṭhati vā saṃlapati vā upakarṇam vā jalpati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'With a man'—means with a householder or a wandering ascetic. 'Within arm's reach'—means she stands within striking distance. 'Converses'—means she says something. 'Whispers in the ear'—means she speaks secretly into the ear. It is a <s>pācattika</s>. Up to the formal designation. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to stand within arm's reach of a man, or to converse, or to whisper in his ear. Now, if something needs to be said, it should be said while standing beyond arm's reach. If something secret needs to be said, it should be said with a wall, a fence, a pillar, a tree, or a curtain between them. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> stands within arm's reach of a man, or converses, or whispers in his ear—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression if he stands within arm's reach of a woman, converses, or whispers in her ear. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīpuruṣeṇa sārdhaṃ anto hastapāśasya santiṣṭheya vā saṃlapeya vā upakarṇaṃ vā jalpeya pācattikaṃ ||1 || uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> stands within arm's reach of a man, or converses with him, or whispers in his ear—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. [1] Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: chatra [1(112)], mañca [2(113)], ekāstaraṇā [3(114)] | prakramati [4(115)], praviśati [5(116)] | samanuṣya [6(117)], adhvānaṃ [7(118)], udyānam [8(119)] | raho [9(120)], puruṣa [10(121)], upakarṇakena [11(122)] || dvādaśamo mā (va)rgaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Umbrella [1(112)], bed [2(113)], single bedding [3(114)]; setting out [4(115)], entering [5(116)]; inhabited [6(117)], road [7(118)], park [8(119)]; in private [9(120)], with a man [10(121)], whispering in ear [11(122)]. Twelfth section.

body.text: pācattikadharma 123
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 123

body.text: upasaṃkramati
body.translated_text: Approaching (<s>upasaṃkramati</s>)

body.text: 237. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | atha bhadrā dāni kāpileyī jñātikulaṃ gatvā putrabhrātṛbhāgineyānāṃ raho gatānāṃ andhakāre apratisamviditā sahasā chatti praviśati | te dāni tahiṃ veḍā bhavanti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye guatamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | peyālaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evaṃ nāma tvaṃ jānantī sapuruṣam āvāsaṃ andhakāre apradīpikā upasaṃkramasi | tena hi na kṣamati etad eva yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti
body.translated_text: 237. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s>, having gone to her relatives' house, suddenly entered the room where her sons, brothers, and nephews had retired in the dark, unannounced. They were frightened there. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Abbreviation. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How is it that you, knowingly, approach a dwelling where a man is present, in the dark, without a lamp? Therefore it is not permissible to do so.' Up to: 'they will become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī sapuruṣam āvāsam andhakāre apradīpikā upasaṃkrameya pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowingly, approaches a dwelling where a man is present, in the dark, without a lamp—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | jānantīti svayam vā jāneya parato vā śruṇeya | sapuruṣo ti yahiṃ puruso ti yahiṃ puruṣo bhaveya andhakāre apradīpiketi yahin na syāt tailapradīpo vā kaṇḍolkā vā | upasaṃkrameya ti praviśeta pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya sapuruṣam āvāsam andhakāre apradīpikāya upasaṃkramituṃ | atha dāni kiñcit kāryaṃ bhavati yadi tahiṃ uccaśabdo bhavati praviśaty anāpattiḥ | atha dāni agnir na bhavati pratisaṃvedayitavyo | acchaṭikā vā kartavyā ukkāsitavyam vā | yady āha praviśeti praviśitavyaṃ | sa eṣā bhikṣuṇī naiva pratisaṃvedayati nācchaṭikāṃ karoti upasaṃkramati pācattikam āsādayati |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'Knowingly'—she knows herself or hears from another. 'Where a man is'—means where a man is present. 'In the dark, without a lamp'—means where there is neither an oil lamp nor a torch. 'Approaches'—means enters. It is a <s>pācattika</s>. Up to the formal designation. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to approach a dwelling where a man is present, in the dark, without a lamp. Now, if there is some business: if there is a loud sound there, she may enter without offense. But if there is no fire, she should make her presence known—she should snap her fingers or clear her throat. If he says 'Enter,' she should enter. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> neither makes her presence known nor snaps her fingers [but] approaches—she incurs a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: bhikṣur api sastrīkam āvāsam andhakāre apratisaṃvidito upasaṃkramati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: A <s>bhikṣu</s> too incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression if he approaches a dwelling where a woman is present, in the dark, without announcing himself. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī sapuruṣam āvāsam andhakāre apradīpikā upasaṃkrameya pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowingly, approaches a dwelling where a man is present, in the dark, without a lamp—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text:
pācattikadharma 124
viśoko
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 124: Entertainment (<s>viśoka</s>)

body.text: 238. bhagavān rājagṛhe viharati | tāyo dāni ṣaḍvargiṇo bhikṣuṇīyo giryagrasamājaṃ gacchanti | tā dāni tahiṃ gatvā pṛthag mañca gṛhṇanti naṭo nāṭayati saprahāsaṃ vastupadā nāṭitam bhavati | sarvo jano hasati | tāyo dāni tūṣṇīkās tiṣṭhanti yogācarā iva | yadā praśāntam bhavati nāṭakam avatāritaṃ bhavati | tato tāyo aṭṭahāsaṃ muñcanti | sarvo jano tato sukho bhoti | jano dāni ojjhāyati | atihāsyaṃ imāsāṃ śramaṇikānāṃ | te dāni vicakṣu kṛtā nelāṭikaṃ na prayacchanti | ojjhāyanti | imāsām śramaṇikānāṃ bāhanelāṭikaṃ na labhāmaḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad āma bhagavan bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati viśokadarśanāya gantuṃ | atha khalu bhagavān yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti |
body.translated_text: 238. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Rājagṛha</s>. The group-of-six <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> went to the mountain-top festival. Having gone there, they each took a separate seat. The actor performed a play, and the performance was humorous. Everyone laughed. But they sat in silence, as if practicing meditation. When the performance had become calm and the theatrical show was brought down, they then burst out in loud laughter. Everyone was happy because of them. But people were displeased: 'These female ascetics laugh too much.' And those who were discerning, being displeased, did not give them the eye-ointment [reward]. They said: 'We don't even get eye-ointment because of these female ascetics.' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible to go to see entertainment.' Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> [established the rule]. Up to: 'they will become utterly purified.'

body.text: yā punar bhikṣuṇī viśokadarśanāya gacchet pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> goes to see entertainment—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇīti upasampannā | viśokam iti naṭanartanakasallamallapāṇisvarikāḥ kumbhabhūmīrāḥ antamasato yahiṃ catvāro pi janāḥ sannipatanti krīḍyārthaṃ tahiṃ darśanāya gacchanti | pācattikaṃ yāvat prajñaptiḥ | na dāni kṣamati viśokadarśanāya gantuṃ | atha dāni bhikṣuṇī piṇḍacāram aṇvati paśyati devayānaṃ niṣkramantaṃ rājño 'ntaḥpuraṃ niṣkrāntaṃ dāni śakyam akṣīṇi nimīlayituṃ kiñcāpi paśyati anāpattiḥ | atha dāni ābhogaṃ karoti ime paśyāmi ito paśyāmīti pācattikaṃ | atha dāni bhagavato mālyāropaṇaṃ bhavati upāsakopāsikā āhaṃsuḥ | āryamiśrikāhi śobhā bhāvayitavyaṃ | sāmagrī dātavyeti labhyā sāmagrī dātuṃ | atha dāni tahiṃ kocic cittasya vikāro bhavati na kṣamati sthātuṃ | bhikṣur api viśokadarśanāya gacchati vinayātikramam āsādayati | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 'Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'—means one who is fully ordained. 'Entertainment' (<s>viśoka</s>)—means dancers, actors, acrobats, wrestlers, hand-musicians, and pot-jugglers; wherever even four people gather for the purpose of amusement—going to see that is a <s>pācattika</s>. Up to the formal designation. It is not permissible to go to see entertainment. Now, if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, going for alms, sees a divine procession coming out, or the king's inner palace going forth—it is not possible to close one's eyes; even if she sees it, there is no offense. But if she deliberately thinks 'I shall watch this, I shall look at this'—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Now, if there is a garland-offering ceremony for the <s>Bhagavān</s>, and the laymen and laywomen say: 'The noble sisters should beautify it; [their] participation should be given'—it is permissible to give participation. But if there arises any mental disturbance, it is not permissible to stay. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression if he goes to see entertainment. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī viśokadarśanāya gacchet pācattikaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> goes to see entertainment—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

body.text: pācattikadharma 125
body.translated_text: <s>Pācattika</s> rule 125

body.text: kalaho
body.translated_text: Quarreling (<s>kalaha</s>)

body.text: 239. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhikṣuṇīnāṃ kalahajātānāṃ bhaṇḍanajātānāṃ vigrahavivādam āpannānāṃ viharantīnāṃ vṛṣabhī samānā adhikaraṇāni na vyupaśamayati na vyupaśamāpayati na vyupaśamanāyautsukyaṃ karoti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo bhagavato ārocayemsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān sarvaṃ pṛcchati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evaṃ nāma tvaṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ kalahajātānāṃ bhaṇḍanajātānāṃ vigrahavivādam āpannānāṃ vṛṣabhī samānā adhikaraṇāni na vyupasamayasi na vyupasamāpayasi na vyupasamanāyautsukyaṃ karosi | tena hi na kṣamati | atha khalu yāvat paryavadātāni bhaviṣyanti | yā puna bhikṣuṇī bhikṣuṇīnāṃ kalahajātānāṃ bhaṇḍanajātānāṃ vigrahavivādam āpannānāṃ viharantīnāṃ vṛṣabhī samanā adhikaraṇāni na vyupaśamayen na vyupasamāpayen na vyupasamanāyautsukhyaṃ kuryāt pācattikaṃ |
body.translated_text: 239. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>, being a leader among the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who had fallen into quarrel, dispute, and controversy, did not settle the disputes, did not have them settled, and did not make an effort toward their settlement. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> questioned all in detail. Until: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.'
