body.text: yāni kho punar imāni praṇītasammatāni bhojanāni bhavanti sayyath' īdaṃ māṃsaṃ evaṃrūpaṃ bhikṣuṇī agilānā kulehi vijñapetvā vā vijñapāyetvā vā khādeya vā bhuñjeya vā pratideśayitavyaṃ tāya bhikṣuṇīya | asaṃpreyam me ārye gārhyaṃ prātideśanikaṃ dharmaparyāyaṃ vā tan dharmaṃ pratideśayāmi | ayaṃ pi dharmo prātideśaniko ||
body.translated_text: Now, these foods are reckoned as exquisite, namely: meat and such foods. If a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, not being ill, having requested or having had [someone] request from families, eats or consumes [these]—it must be confessed by that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>: 'Noble one, I have incurred a blameworthy <s>prātideśanika</s> offense or a related rule. I confess that offense.' This too is a <s>prātideśanika</s> rule.

body.text: uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: saripis [1] | tailaṃ [2] | madhu [3] | phāṇitaṃ [4] | dugdham [5] dadhi [6] | matsya [7] | māṃsaṃ [8] | idam aṣṭamaṃ | bhikṣuṇīnāṃ prātideśanikāṃ ||
body.translated_text: Ghee [1]; oil [2]; honey [3]; molasses [4]; milk [5]; yogurt [6]; fish [7]; meat [8]—these are the eight <s>prātideśanika</s> (confession) rules for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.

body.text: śaikṣā dharmā 166
body.translated_text: <s>Śaikṣā</s> (training) rules: 166

body.text: 253. śaikṣā vistareṇa kartavyā yathā bhikṣuṇāṃ sarve ṣaḍvargāh sthāpayitvā haritodake |
body.translated_text: 253. The <s>śaikṣā</s> rules should be done in detail as for <s>bhikṣus</s>. All the group-of-six [stories apply], except [the rule about] green-water [grass].

body.text: uddānam |
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: nivāsanaṃ [1] | prāvaraṇaṃ [2] | susaṃvṛtaṃ [3] | cakṣuḥ [4] | śabdaṃ [5] | noccagghikā [6] | noguṇṭhikā [7] | notkṣiptikā [8] | na utkuṭuke [9] | na khambha [10] | na kāya [11] | na śīrṣa [12] | na bāhukena [13] || prathamo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Under-robe [1]; outer robe [2]; well-covered [3]; eyes [4]; sound [5]; not with loud laughter [6]; not with head covered [7]; not with arms raised [8]; not squatting [9]; not with arms akimbo [10]; not [swaying] the body [11]; not [shaking] the head [12]; not with arms [swinging] [13]. First section.

body.text: uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: susaṃvṛtā [14] | cakṣuḥ [15] | na śabda [16] | uccagghayikā [17] | na oguṇṭhikā [18] | notkṣiptikā [19] | na osaktikā [20] | na pallatthikā [21] | na khambha [22] | na hastapādakaukṛtyena [23] | dvitīyo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Well-covered [14]; eyes [15]; not with sound [16]; not with loud laughter [17]; not with head covered [18]; not with arms raised [19]; not hanging down [20]; not cross-legged [21]; not with arms akimbo [22]; not with restless hands and feet [23]. Second section.

body.text: uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: dve satkṛtya [24, 25] | samasūpa [26] | na stūpa [27] | nāvakīrṇa [28] | nāvagaṇḍa [29] | na jihvā [30] | nātimahanta [31] | nānāgata [32] | na kavaḍotkṣepaka [33] | na kavaḍacchedaka [34] | na sakavaḍena [35] | tṛtīyo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Two [rules about] eating respectfully [24, 25]; even curry [26]; not heaped up [27]; not overflowing [28]; not stuffing the cheek [29]; not [with] tongue [licking] [30]; not too large [morsels] [31]; not [eating] before [the morsel arrives] [32]; not throwing the morsel [33]; not breaking the morsel [34]; not with morsel [in hand, speaking] [35]. Third section.

body.text: uddānaṃ ||
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: trayo nirlehā [36, 37, 38] | cuccu [39] | surusuru [40] | gulugulu [41] | na hasta [42] | na sittha [43] | nodhyāyana [44] | pātrasaṃjñī [45] | vijñapti [46] | chādayati [47] | na pātrodake [48] | na sasitthena [49] | caturtho vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Three [rules about] licking [36, 37, 38]; sipping [39]; slurping [40]; gulping [41]; not with the hand [42]; not with rice [grains scattered] [43]; not [teaching] <s>Dharma</s> [while eating] [44]; mindful of the bowl [45]; requesting [46]; covering [47]; not with bowl-water [48]; not with rice-water [49]. Fourth section.

body.text: uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.text: na sthitā [50] | na niṣaṇṇā [51] | na uccāsanā [52] | upanaha [53] | na pādukā [54] | na oguṇṭhikā [55] | na saṃmukha [56] | na osaktikā [57] | na pallatthikā [58] | pūryate pañcamo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Not standing [to teach] [50]; not to one who is seated [while standing] [51]; not on a high seat [52]; wearing sandals [53]; not in wooden shoes [54]; not with head covered [55]; not facing away [56]; not hanging down [57]; not cross-legged [58]. The fifth section is complete.

body.text: uddānaṃ |
body.translated_text: Summary verse (<s>uddāna</s>):

body.translated_text: Not with weapons [59, 60]; a staff [61]; an umbrella [62]; on a side-path [63]; behind [64]; a vehicle [65]; while standing [66]. Sixth section.

body.text:
sapta adhikaraṇasamathā dharmā
dharmā anudharmā
body.translated_text: Seven rules for the settlement of disputes (<s>adhikaraṇaśamatha dharmā</s>). <s>Dharma</s> and subsidiary <s>Dharma</s>.

body.text:
254. saptādhikaraṇasamathā dharmā yathā bhikṣūṇāṃ |
sammukha [1] | smṛti [2] | amūḍha [3] | pratijñā [4] | tasya pāpeyaśika [5] | yo bhuyasika [6] | tṛṇaprastārako [7] ca saptamaḥ ||
body.translated_text: 254. The seven rules for the settlement of disputes are as for <s>bhikṣus</s>: face-to-face [1]; recollection [2]; non-confusion [3]; acknowledgment [4]; majority decision [5]; voting by majority [6]; and grass-covering [7] as the seventh.

children.translated_text: The <s>Dharma</s> and subsidiary <s>Dharma</s> are as for <s>bhikṣus</s>.
The analysis of the <s>Prātimokṣa</s> (<s>prātimokṣavibhaṅga</s>) for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is concluded.

body.text: bhikṣuṇī prakīrṇaka 1
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> miscellaneous rule (<s>prakīrṇaka</s>) 1

body.text: niṣadyāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Relating to sitting posture (<s>niṣadyāpratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 255. āryamahāsāṃghikānāṃ lokottaravādināṃ bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇakasyādiḥ |
body.translated_text: 255. Beginning of the miscellaneous rules for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> of the <s>Āryamahāsāṃghika Lokottaravādins</s>.

body.text: bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo paścimaṃ prahāṇaṃ svastikaparyaṅkena niṣīdanti | athāparāye dāni bhikṣuṇīye vraṇamukhena dīrghako 'nusrotena praviṣṭo | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato ārocayet | bhagavān āha | gacchatha tāye amukaṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ detha tato so dīrghako niṣkramiṣyati | tāye dāni taṃ bhaiṣajyaṃ dinnaṃ pibanāye | so dīrghako anusrotam āgato na ca mṛto | bhagavān āha | evaṃ ca nāmā yūyaṃ svastikaparyaṅkena niṣīdatha | tena hi na kṣamati svastikaparyaṅkena niṣīdituṃ | niṣadyāpratisaṃyuktaṃ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye paryaṅkena niṣīdituṃ | atha khalv ekinā padena paryaṅko baddhavyaḥ | aparāya pārṣṇikāya vraṇamukhaṃ pithayitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī svastikaparyaṅkena niṣīdati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate niṣadyāpratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were sitting for the last meditation session in the cross-legged posture (<s>svastika-paryaṅka</s>). A long worm entered through the wound-opening of another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, going with the current. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported it to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Go, give her such-and-such medicine; then that worm will come out.' That medicine was given to her to drink. The worm came out with the current but did not die. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How is it that you sit in the cross-legged posture? Therefore, it is not permissible to sit in the cross-legged posture.' Relating to sitting posture: It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to sit in the full cross-legged posture. Rather, one leg should be placed in the cross-legged position, and the opening should be covered with the other heel. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sits in the cross-legged posture, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'relating to sitting posture.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakirṇaka 2
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> miscellaneous rule 2

body.text: kaṭhinapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Relating to the <s>kaṭhina</s> cloth (<s>kaṭhinapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 256. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo kaṭhine cīvaraṃ nikṣipiya sīvanti | aparāye bhikṣuṇīye vaṃsavidalikāya vraṇamukhena kṛtaṃ rudhiram utpāditaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ | peyālaṃ | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati kaṭhine niṣīdituṃ | kaṭhinapratisaṃyuktaṃ | etā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo cīvara niṣīditukāmā bhavanti | na kṣamati kaṭhine niṣīdituṃ | atha khu upasthānaśālāyām vā prāsāde vā prahāṇaśālāyām vā ākārṣān dattvā cīvarakaṃ prajñapiya sīvitavyaṃ | atha evaṃ pi na bhavati | pīṭhasya vā mañcasya vā upari prajñapayitvā sīvitavyaṃ | athaivaṃ pi na bhavati jānukānām upari sthāpayyitvā sīvitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī kaṭhine niṣīdati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate kaṭhinapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||2 ||
body.translated_text: 256. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were sewing robes while sitting on the <s>kaṭhina</s> [cloth]. A bamboo splinter caused a wound and produced blood in another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. This matter—abbreviation—the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to sit on the <s>kaṭhina</s> cloth.' Relating to the <s>kaṭhina</s>: when those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> wish to sit and sew robes, it is not permissible to sit on the <s>kaṭhina</s>. Rather, in the assembly hall, upper room, or meditation hall, markers should be placed, the cloth should be laid out, and sewing done. If that too is not possible, it should be placed on a stool or a bed and sewn. If even that is not possible, it should be placed on the knees and sewn. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> sits on the <s>kaṭhina</s>, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'relating to the <s>kaṭhina</s> cloth.' [2]

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 3
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> miscellaneous rule 3

body.text: veṭhakapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Relating to the body-wrap (<s>veṭhakapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 257. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā dāni bhikṣuṇī saṃbahulāni strīhi sārdhaṃ nadīm ajirāvatīṅ gatvā ekānte cīvarakāṇī nikṣipiya snānāyāvatīrṇā | sā dāni pratikṛtyevottaritvā veṭhakena kāyaṃ veṭhayitvā strīṇām āha | prajāpati nidhyāpayatha māṃ | kim ahaṃ śobhāmi na śobhāmīti | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ | kim punar āryāya muṇḍāya piṇḍilikāya etena kāryaṃ | vayaṃ kāmopabhoganīyā mānārthāya evaṃ karomaḥ | kuṭumbikānāṃ priyatarikā bhaviṣyāmo ti | ārye kim etena | yaṃ tāhi strīhi avadhyāpitaṃ taṃ dāni bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ | pe | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtaṃ te nande yāvat tena hi na kṣamati veṭhakena kāyaṃ veṭhayituṃ | veṭhakapratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī veṭhakena paṭṭakena vā kāyaṃ veṭhayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha dāni paṭṭikāya vā lohakena vā kāyaṃ veṭhayati | na kṣamati dvir api vellakaṃ trir api vellakaṃ veṭhayituṃ | atha khu eka parivellakaṃ veṭhayitavyaṃ | atha dāni vātena pārśvaṃ gṛhītaṃ bhavati | gaṇḍam vā piṭakam vā kṣatam vā upahatam vā bhavati kiñcāpi paṭṭakena kāyaṃ veṭhayaty anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate veṭhakapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||3 ||
body.translated_text: 257. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Sthūlanandā</s>, having gone with many women to the river <s>Aciravatī</s>, went aside, put down her robes, and descended for bathing. Having come out, she wrapped her body with a wrap-cloth and said to the women: 'Look at me! Am I beautiful or not?' They said: 'What use is this for a noble one who is shaven-headed and begging? We, who are meant for the enjoyment of pleasures, do this for the sake of [our] dignity, so that we may be more dear to [our] husbands. Noble one, what is the use of this?' What was spoken in reproof by those women was heard by the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. This matter—abbreviation—up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'You have done wrong, <s>Nandā</s>. Up to: therefore, it is not permissible to wrap the body with a wrap-cloth.' Relating to the body-wrap: if this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> wraps her body with a wrap-cloth or a band, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. Now, it is not permissible to wrap [the body] twice or three times with a band. Rather, one should wrap [it] once around. But if she has a wind condition affecting the side, or a boil, abscess, wound, or injury—even if she wraps the body with a band, there is no offense. This is called 'relating to the body-wrap.' [3]

body.text: bhikṣuṇī prakīrṇaka 4
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> miscellaneous rule 4

body.text: śroṇibhaṇḍakapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Relating to hip ornaments (<s>śroṇibhaṇḍakapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 258. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | yathaiva veṭhakasya evam evārthotpattiḥ kartavyā | sā pratikṛty' eva uttaritvā śroṇībhaṇḍakam ābandhitvā āha | prajāpatī prajāpati nidhyāyatha māṃ kim aham śobhāmi na śobhāmīti | tā dān āhaṃsuḥ | kim āryāya | peyālam | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha tena hi na kṣamati śroṇībhaṇḍaṃ | śroṇībhaṇḍakapratisaṃyuktaṃ | śroṇībhaṇḍakan nāma ete bhavanti | śaṅkhāvarttakā vā śirikā vā pīlukā vā vidrumā vā akṣarakṣā vā suvarṇarūpyamayā vā maṇimayā vā prakālakā vā antamasato sūtramaṇikā vā bandhati | tena ca śroṇībhaṇḍakachandaṃ vinodayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate śroṇībhaṇḍakapratisaṃyuktaṃ || ṇka ||
body.translated_text: 258. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The origin-story should be constructed just as for the body-wrap. Having come out [of the water], she tied on hip-ornaments and said: 'Look at me! Am I beautiful or not?' They said: 'What use for the noble one?'—abbreviation—up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible [to wear] hip-ornaments.' Relating to hip-ornaments: hip-ornaments are these: conch-shell spirals, shell-bead strings, <s>pīluka</s> beads, coral, rosary beads, gold or silver [ornaments], gem [ornaments], mother-of-pearl, or even bead-thread necklaces worn [at the hip]. If she satisfies a desire for hip-ornaments, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'relating to hip-ornaments.'

body.text:
bhikṣuṇīprakirṇaka 5
gṛhiṇibhaṇḍakapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> miscellaneous rule 5: Relating to housewife-ornaments (<s>gṛhiṇībhaṇḍakapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 259. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | eṣaivārthotpattiḥ yāvad gṛhiṇībhaṇḍakam ābandhitvā yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati gṛhiṇībhaṇḍakaṃ | gṛhiṇībhāṇḍakan nāma ete bhavanti | mūrdhāpidhānakā vā | valayā vā | karṇikā vā | ṭikkā vā | veṭhakā vā | harṣakā vā | hārā vā | ardhahārā vā aparañjaga vā | kaṭakā vā | śaṅkhakā vā | nūpurā vā | aṅgulīyakā vā | yad vā punar anyad api kiñcid gṛhiṇībhāṇḍaṃ sarvan na kṣamati | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī gṛhiṇībhaṇḍakam ābandhayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha dāni bhaiṣajyabhaṇḍakam ābandhati jvarasūtrakam vā anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate gṛhiṇībhāṇḍakapratisaṃyuktaṃ || tṛ ||
body.translated_text: 259. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The same origin-story [applies]. Up to: she tied on housewife-ornaments. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible [to wear] housewife-ornaments.' Housewife-ornaments are these: head-coverings, bracelets, earrings, forehead-marks, wrap-cloths, necklaces, garlands, half-garlands, <s>aparañjaga</s> ornaments, armlets, conch-shell [bangles], anklets, finger-rings, or whatever else is any kind of housewife-ornament—all are not permissible. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> wears housewife-ornaments, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. But if she wears a medicinal ornament or a fever-thread—there is no offense. This is called 'relating to housewife-ornaments.'

body.text: bhikṣūṇīprakirṇaka 6
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> miscellaneous rule 6

body.text: gṛhiṇīalaṅkārapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Relating to housewife-adornment (<s>gṛhiṇīalaṅkārapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 260. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni śākiyakanyāyo kolitakanyāyo mallakanyāyo mahāntehi kulehi pravrajitā alaṅkārikāny ādāya | kumārikānāṃ vuhyantīnāṃ utsavasamaye tithi parvaṇyā devayātrādiṣu kṛtakāni bhāṇḍakāni dadantī | jano dāni ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā vāṇijeyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ | peyālaṃ yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati gṛhiṇīalaṅkāraṃ dhārayituṃ | yadi kācid gṛhiṇī pravrajati yadi tāya kiñcid alaṅkāraṃ bhavati vaktavyā visarjehi | atha dāni paśyati durbhikṣa vā bhaveya piṇḍapāto vā na labhyeta jarādurbalā vā bhavati vyādhidurbalā vā gailānyam vā kiñcid bhaviṣyati alpalābho mātṛgrāmo mā vihanyeyā ti | piṇḍaṃ kārayitvā parvrājayitavyā | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī alaṅkāram aparityājayitvā pravrajeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | bhikṣor apy eṣa evaṃ vidhir | idam ucyate gṛhiṇīalaṅkārapratisaṃyuktaṃ || phu ||
body.translated_text: 260. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now those <s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Koliya</s> maidens, and <s>Malla</s> maidens, having gone forth from great families, brought ornaments [with them]. At the festival-time when maidens were being married, on special days and holy days, at divine processions and the like, they would give away their prepared ornamental items. People were displeased: 'This is not renunciation—this is trade!' [Abbreviation.] Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to keep housewives' ornaments. If any housewife goes forth, and she has any ornaments, she should be told: "Give them up." But if she sees that there might be famine, or alms might not be obtained, or she is weakened by old age, or weakened by disease, or some illness might arise—since women have small gains—[thinking:] "Lest she be distressed"—having made a lump [of gold from the ornaments], she should be ordained. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains [a woman] without having her give up the ornaments, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. For a <s>bhikṣu</s> too, this same procedure [applies]. This is called "connected with housewives' ornaments."

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakirṇaka 7
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> (Miscellaneous Rule for Nuns) 7:

body.text: veśyāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with courtesans (<s>veśyāpratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 261. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo śākīyakanyāyo koliyakanyāyo mallakanyāyo mahākulehi pravrajitā ceṭikām ādāya pravrajanti | tāyo ceṭikāyo prāsādikāyo darśanīyāyo veśyaṃ (!) vāhayanti | jano dani ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā gaṇikā imā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evaṃ ca nāma yūyaṃ veśyām upasthāpayatha | tena hi na kṣamati veśyām (!) upasthāpayituṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī veśyām upasthāpayati tena jīvikāṃ kalpayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate veśyāpratisaṃyuktaṃ || grā ||
body.translated_text: 261. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>—<s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Koliya</s> maidens, and <s>Malla</s> maidens, having gone forth from great families—took servant-girls along and ordained them. Those servant-girls, being graceful and beautiful, served as courtesans. People were displeased: 'This is not renunciation—these are courtesans!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. Until: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How is it that you ordain [women as] courtesans? Therefore, it is not permissible to ordain [women as] courtesans.' If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ordains [a woman as] a courtesan and makes a livelihood thereby, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with courtesans.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 8
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 8:

body.text: ārāmikinipratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with park-attendants (<s>ārāmikinīpratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 262.bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā dāni śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati veśyām upasthāpayituṃ ti | tāyo dāni śākiyakanyāyo mallakanyāyo kolitakanyāyo mahākulehi pravrajanti | tāyo dāni paudgalikām ārāmikinīm upasthāpenti | tāyo dāni ārāmikinīyo prāsādikāyo jano dāni ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā gaṇikā iyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati paudagalikām ārāmikinīm upasthāpayituṃ | na kṣamati ārāmikinī | nā kṣamati ceṭī | na kṣamati kalpiyakārī | sā eṣā bhikṣūṇī yā paudgalikām ārāmikinīm upasthāpayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate ārāmikinīpratisaṃyuktam || hrā ||
body.translated_text: 262. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule: 'It is not permissible to ordain [women as] courtesans.' Now those <s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Malla</s> maidens, and <s>Koliya</s> maidens, having gone forth from great families, appointed personal female park-attendants. Those park-attendants, being graceful, drew people's displeasure: 'This is not renunciation—these are courtesans!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. Until: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to appoint a personal female park-attendant. A park-attendant is not permissible. A female servant is not permissible. A female worker is not permissible.' If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> appoints a personal female park-attendant, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with park-attendants.'

body.text: bhikṣūṇīprakīrṇaka 9
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 9:

body.text: saṃkakṣikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the shoulder cloth (<s>saṃkakṣikāpratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 263. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparā dāni bhikṣuṇī prāsādikā darśanīyā | tāye dāni pīnehi stanehi gacchantīya cīvaram utkṣipīyati | sā dāni janena uccagghīyati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha tena saṃkakṣikā nāma kartavyā | samkakṣikāṃ prāvarantīya tathā prāvaritavyaṃ yathā dāni stanāpīḍitā bhavanti | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī saṃkakṣikān nopasthāpayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | santī na prāvarayati vinayātikramaḥ idam ucyate saṃkakṣikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ || 0 ||
body.translated_text: 263. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, a certain <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> was graceful and beautiful. When she walked, her robe was lifted up by her full breasts. People laughed at her. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. [Abbreviation.] Until: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, a shoulder cloth (<s>saṃkakṣikā</s>) should be made. When wrapping the shoulder cloth, it should be wrapped in such a way that the breasts are compressed.' If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> does not procure a shoulder cloth, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. If she has one but does not wrap it, [she incurs] a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with the shoulder cloth.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 10
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 10:

body.text: dakaśāṭikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the bathing cloth (<s>dakaśāṭikāpratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 264. bhagavān vaiśālīyam viharati | bhadrāya dāni kāpileyyā arthotpattiḥ kartavyā | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati nagnikāyā snātuṃ | dakaśāṭikāya snāpitavyaṃ | dakaśāṭikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ | na kṣamati nadīyam vā oghe vā puṣkiriṇīyam vā taḍāge vā nagnikāya snāpituṃ | dakaśāṭikāya snāpitavyaṃ | nagnikā snāyati vinayātikramaḥ | atha dāni vihāre gupte pradeśe nagnikā snāyaty anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate dakaśāṭikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ || ḷ ||
body.translated_text: 264. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Vaiśālī</s>. The origin story of <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s> should be given. Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to bathe naked. One should bathe with a bathing cloth.' Connected with the bathing cloth: it is not permissible to bathe naked in a river, a torrent, a lotus pool, or a tank. One should bathe with a bathing cloth. If she bathes naked, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. But if she bathes naked in a secluded place within the monastery, there is no offense. This is called 'connected with the bathing cloth.'

body.text: || prathamo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: First section.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 11
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 11:

body.text: talaghātapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with striking with the palm (<s>talaghātapratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 265. bhagavān śrāvastīyaṃ viharati | bhikṣuṇīvihāro ca gṛhikulaṃ ca kacchāntaritā | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo kāmarāgeṇa khajjanti | tāyo dāni hastatalenāṅgajātaṃ prasphoṭayanti | so manuṣyo puno puno śabdaṃ śṛṇoti | so dān āha | kim etan ti | sā dāni strī āha | bhavatu āryaputra aham etaṃ jānāmi kin tavānena jñānena | āha | nahi ācikṣāhi | āha | etā āryamiśrikāyo brahmacāriṇīyo kāmarāgena khajjantīyo hastatalena āsphoṭayanti āṅgajātaṃ | tena dāni manuṣyeṇa ojjhāpitaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣūṇīhi śrutaṃ | yāvad bhagavān aha | tena hi na kṣamati talaghātakaṃ | talaghātapratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī hastatalenāṅgajātam āsphoṭayati pātreṇa vā kupātreṇa vā kaṃsikāya vā viḍallāya vā anyena vā puna kenacit tena ca kāmarāgaṃ vinodayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate talaghātakapratisaṃyuktaṃ || [1] ||
body.translated_text: 265. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> monastery and a householder's dwelling were separated [only] by a thicket. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, tormented by sensual desire, would strike their private parts with the palm of their hand. That man heard the sound again and again. He said: 'What is this?' His wife said: 'Let it be, noble husband. I know what it is—what use is this knowledge for you?' He said: 'No, tell me.' She said: 'Those noble ladies, the celibate ones, tormented by sensual desire, are striking their private parts with their palms.' That man was displeased. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, palm-striking is not permissible.' Connected with palm-striking: if this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> strikes her private parts with her palm, or with a bowl, or with a broken bowl, or with a metal cup, or with a brazier, or with anything else, and thereby dispels sensual desire—she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with palm-striking.' [1]

body.text: bhikṣūṇī prakīrṇaka 12
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 12:

body.text: jatumaṭṭhakapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with a wax device (<s>jatumaṭṭhakapratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 266. bhagavān śrāvastīyaṃ viharati | aparāya dāni bhikṣuṇīya kāmarāgeṇa khajjantīya jatumaṭṭhakaṃ mañcakaṃ yantritaṃ | atra vipratipadyiṣyan ti | tad anantaram agnir utthito | tāya dāni saṃbhrāntāya asamanvāharitvā sa mañcako bahin niṣkāsito | manuṣyo dāni pratyavekṣamāṇā aṇvanti | kahiṃ agnir utthito kasya gṛhād utthito | tehi dāni so dṛṣṭo | te dāni ojjhāyanti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | pe | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati jatumaṭṭhakaṃ | jatumaṭṭhakapratisaṃyuktaṃ | jatumaṭṭhakaṃ nāma jatusya vā lohasya vā trapusya vā nāgrasya vā hārakūṭasya vā dantasya vā coḍakasya vā mṛttikāya vā aṅgajātakākāraṃ kṛtvā sve aṅgajāte praveśeti tena ca kāma rāgaṃ vinodeti thul'-accayam āsādayati | idam ucyate jatumaṭṭhakapratisaṃyuktaṃ || 2 ||
body.translated_text: 266. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, another <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, tormented by sensual desire, had a wax-coated bed that was mechanically operated. She was about to use it improperly when immediately a fire broke out. In her panic, without thinking clearly, she threw the bed outside. People, looking around, went [to investigate]: 'Where did the fire break out? From whose house did it start?' They saw it. They were displeased. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. [Abbreviation.] Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, a wax device is not permissible.' Connected with the wax device: a 'wax device' means one made of wax, copper, tin, lead, alloy, ivory, horn, or clay, fashioned in the shape of the private parts, which is inserted into one's own private parts—and thereby dispels sensual desire—she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s> (grave offense). This is called 'connected with the wax device.' [2]

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 13, 14
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 13, 14:

body.text:
dhovanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
praveśanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with washing (<s>dhovanāpratisaṃyukta</s>) and connected with insertion (<s>praveśanāpratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 267. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | atha khalu mahāprajāpatī gautamī yena bhagavāṃs tenopasaṃkramitvā bhagavataḥ pādau śirasā vanditvā ekānte asthāsi | ekāntasthitā mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavantaṃ yācati | bhagavantaṃ vanditvā āha | mātṛgrāmasya bhagavan aṅgajātaṃ durgandhaṃ upavāyati | labhyaṃ | bhagavan dhovituṃ | bhagavān āha | labhyā | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo bāhirabāhireṇa dhovanti tathaiva durgandhaṃ vāyati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavantaṃ pṛcchati | labhyā bhagavan praveśiya dhovituṃ | bhagavān āha | labhyā dhovanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ praveśanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ | bhikṣuṇīya dhovantīya ekam aṅguliveṭhakaṃ praveśayitvā dhovitavyaṃ | na kṣamati atidūraṃ praveśayituṃ | atidūraṃ praveśeti tena ca kāmarāgaṃ vinodeti thūl'-accayam āsādayati | idam ucyate dhovanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ praveśanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ || ṇka ||
body.translated_text: 267. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> approached the <s>Bhagavān</s>, bowed her head at the <s>Bhagavān's</s> feet, and stood to one side. Standing to one side, <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> made a request to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. Having bowed to the <s>Bhagavān</s>, she said: '<s>Bhagavān</s>, women's private parts emit a foul smell. Is it permissible, <s>Bhagavān</s>, to wash [them]?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'It is permissible.' But those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, washing only the outside, still had the foul smell. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> asked the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Is it permissible, <s>Bhagavān</s>, to wash by insertion?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'It is permissible.' Connected with washing and insertion: a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, when washing, may insert one finger-wrap and wash. It is not permissible to insert too deeply. If she inserts too deeply and thereby dispels sensual desire, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. This is called 'connected with washing' and 'connected with insertion.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇiprakīrṇaka 15, 16, 17
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 15, 16, 17:

body.text: ānicolakapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the menstrual cloth (<s>ānīcolakapratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 268. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāsān dāni bhikṣuṇīnām anumāsaṃ anumāsaṃ ṛtur āgacchati | lohitaṃ śayyāsanaṃ nāśīyati | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato āroceti | labhyā bhagavan śayanāsanaguptyarthaṃ ānīcolaṃ dhārayituṃ | bhagavān āha | labhyaṃ ānīcolakapratisaṃyuktaṃ | yasyā eṣa ṛtur āgacchati śoṇitaṃ sravati tayā ānīcolakaṃ dhārayitavyaṃ | leṇṭakakhaṇḍāni | nāpi kṣamati gāḍhaṃ nāpi kṣamati atidūraṃ praveśayituṃ yathā tenaiva kāmarāgam vinodayet | atha khalu praśithilaṃ vraṇamukhasya praveśayitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī atidūram vā praveśeti gāḍham vā praveśeti yathā tenaiva kāmarāgam vindodeti sthūl'-accayam āsādayati | idam ucyate ānīcolakapratisaṃyuktaṃ || tṛ ||
body.translated_text: 268. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' menses came every month. Blood was ruining the bedding. <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported this matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>: 'Is it permissible, <s>Bhagavān</s>, to wear a menstrual cloth to protect the bedding?' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'It is permissible.' Connected with the menstrual cloth: she whose menses come, from whom blood flows, should wear a menstrual cloth—pieces of rags. It is not permissible to insert [them] tightly, nor is it permissible to insert too deeply, such that she would thereby dispel sensual desire. Rather, it should be inserted loosely at the opening. If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> inserts too deeply or tightly, and thereby dispels sensual desire, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. This is called 'connected with the menstrual cloth.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 16
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 16:

body.text: strītīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the women's bathing-spot (<s>strītīrthapratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 269. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo strītīrthe ānīcolaṃ dhovanti | striyo dāni ojjhāyanti | sarvam idam tīrthaṃ rudhireṇa viṭṭālitaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati stritīrthe ānīcolakaṃ dhovituṃ | strītīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ānīcolakaṃ strītīrthe dhovati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate strītīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ || phu ||
body.translated_text: 269. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were washing their menstrual cloths at the women's bathing-spot. The women were displeased: 'The whole bathing-spot has been defiled with blood!' [Abbreviation.] Until the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to wash the menstrual cloth at the women's bathing-spot.' Connected with the women's bathing-spot: if this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> washes the menstrual cloth at the women's bathing-spot, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with the women's bathing-spot.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 17
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 17:

body.text: puruṣatīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the men's bathing-spot (<s>puruṣatīrthapratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 270.bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati strītīrthe ānīcolakaṃ dhovituṃ | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo puruṣatīrthe ānīcolakaṃ dhovanti | peyālaṃ | yāvat sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ānīcolakaṃ puruṣatīrthe dhovati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate puruṣatīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ || grā ||
body.translated_text: 270. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule: 'It is not permissible to wash the menstrual cloth at the women's bathing-spot.' Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> then washed the menstrual cloth at the men's bathing-spot. [Abbreviation.] Until: if this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> washes the menstrual cloth at the men's bathing-spot, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with the men's bathing-spot.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 18
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 18:

body.text: rajakatīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the washerman's bathing-spot (<s>rajakatīrthapratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 271. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | evam eva rajakatīrthe kartavyaṃ | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati rajakatīrthe dhovituṃ | atha khu kuṇḍālake vā kaṭāhake vā mallake vā dakānake vā udakaṃ gṛhya ekānte dhovitavyaṃ | yahiṃ paryādānaṃ gaccheya | atha dāni bāhirodakaṃ bhavati yahiṃ nirvāho tahin dhovitavyaṃ | tāni leṇṭakāni śoṣayitavyāni yadā puno ṛtu nāgacchati tadā puno dātavyāni | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī rajakatīrthe ānīcolaṃ dhovati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate rajakatīrthapratisaṃyuktaṃ || hrā ||
body.translated_text: 271. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The same [should be done] regarding the washerman's bathing-spot. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, it is not permissible to wash [the menstrual cloth] at the washerman's bathing-spot. Rather, having taken water in a basin, or a cauldron, or a pot, or a water-vessel, one should wash in a secluded place where [the water] can be disposed of. If there is outdoor water where there is drainage, one should wash there. Those rags should be dried. When the menses no longer come, they should be given back.' If this <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> washes the menstrual cloth at the washerman's bathing-spot, she incurs a <s>Vinaya</s> transgression. This is called 'connected with the washerman's bathing-spot.'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 19
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 19:

body.text: udakadhārāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with water-pouring (<s>udakadhārāpratisaṃyukta</s>).

body.text: 272. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparāya dāni bhikṣuṇīya raktacittāya aṅgajātaṃ udake dhāritaṃ | tasyāśucir muktaṃ | tāye dāni kaukṛtyaṃ | kaukṛtyena bhikṣuṇīnām ārocayati | yāvad bhagavān āha | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī udakadhārāyām vā kuṇḍikadhārāyām vā udakacoḍena vā ālukaveṇṭikāyām vā praṇālyām vā aṅgajātaṃ dhāreti tena ca kāmarāgaṃ vinodeti thūl'-accayam āsādayati | atha dāni snāyati taḍāge vā prasravaṇe vā praṇāliyam vā na dāni agrato udakadhārāṃ kṛtvā snāyitavyaṃ yathā pṛṣṭhīya vā śīrṣeṇa vā udakadhārāṃ praticcheya tathā snāyitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī agrato mukhāṃ udakadhārāṃ kṛtvā snāyati tāya ca kāmarāgaṃ vinodeti thūl'-accayam āsādayati | idaṃ ucyate udakadhārāpratisaṃyuktaṃ ||0 ||
body.translated_text: 272. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, a certain <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, with a lustful mind, held her private parts in water. She had a discharge. She then felt remorse. Out of remorse she reported to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> holds her private parts in a water stream, or in a water-pitcher stream, or in a water jet, or in a gourd-pipe, or in a drainage channel, and thereby dispels her lustful desire, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s> (grave offense). Now, when bathing in a pond, a spring, or a drainage channel, she should not bathe facing the water stream; she should bathe so that the water stream hits her from behind or on the head. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> bathes facing the water stream and thereby dispels her lustful desire, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. This is called the section connected with water streams.' [0]

body.text: bhikṣuṇiparikīrṇaka 20
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 20

body.text: udakasrotapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Water Currents (<s>udakasrotapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 273. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparāya dāni bhikṣuṇīya raktacittāya udakasrote aṅgajātaṃ dhāritaṃ | tāye aśucir āgato yathā udakadhārāya yāvat | tena hi na kṣamati udakasrote aṅgajātaṃ dhārayituṃ | udakasrotapratisaṃyuktaṃ | yā dāni tāyo bhavanti girinadīyo śīghrasrotāyo tahiṃ aṅgajātaṃ dhāreti tena ca kāmarāgaṃ vinodeti thūl'-accyam āsādayati | atha dāni snāyati na kṣamati agratomukhaṃ srotaṃ kṛtvā snāyituṃ pṛṣṭhatomukhaṃ srotaṃ kṛtvā snāyitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī agratomukhaṃ srotaṃ kṛtvā snāyati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate udakasrotapratisaṃyuktaṃ || ḷ ||
body.translated_text: 273. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, a certain <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, with a lustful mind, held her private parts in a water current. She had a discharge, as [described] regarding the water stream, up to [the same details]. Therefore, it is not permissible to hold the private parts in a water current. Connected with water currents: those mountain rivers with swift currents — if she holds her private parts there and thereby dispels her lustful desire, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. Now, when bathing, it is not permissible to bathe facing the current; she should bathe with her back to the current. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> bathes facing the current, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s> (disciplinary transgression). This is called the section connected with water currents.

body.text: || dvitīyo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Second section.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 21
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 21

body.text: vikṛtipratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Substitutes (<s>vikṛtipratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 274. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo nānāprakārehi mocayanti mūlakena palāṇḍūkebukāye sobhañjanakena latikāya | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ yāvad bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati vikṛtīhi mocayituṃ | vikṛtipratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī mūlakena vā palāṇḍūya vā kebukāya vā sobhañjanakena vā latikāya vā illādukāya vā trapusena vā allābūya vā kakṣārukena vā anyena vā puna kenacin mocayati tena ca kāmarāgaṃ vinodeti thūl'-accayam āsādayati | idam ucyate vikṛtipratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 274. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were gratifying themselves in various ways — with a radish, an onion, a <s>kebuka</s> [fruit], a <s>śobhañjanaka</s> [drumstick tree pod], a vine. This matter was reported, up to: '<s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible to gratify oneself with substitutes.' Connected with substitutes: if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> gratifies herself with a radish, onion, <s>kebuka</s>, <s>śobhañjanaka</s>, vine, <s>illāduka</s>, cucumber, gourd, <s>kakṣāruka</s>, or anything else, and thereby dispels her lustful desire, she incurs a <s>sthūlātyaya</s>. This is called the section connected with substitutes.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 22
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 22

body.text: karmapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Formal Acts (<s>karmapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 275. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparasya dāni bhikṣusya utkṣepanīyaṃ karma kriyate | tahiṃ nāsti koci parikuśalo karmakārako | bhikṣuṇīya karma kṛtaṃ | tāye dāni kaukṛtyaṃ | kin nu khalu labhyā etaṃ kartuṃ utāho na labhyaṃ | kaukṛtyena bhikṣuṇīnām ārocayati | bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad bhagavān āha | agrapariṣā eṣā | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya bhikṣusya karma kartuṃ | karmapratisaṃyuktaṃ na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya bhikṣusya karma kartuṃ (!) | atha dāni na kocit parikuśalo karmakārako bhavati labhyaṃ bhikṣuṇīye bhikṣusya uddeśituṃ | atha dāni karmakarentasya vismarati labhyā bhikṣuṇīya anupradātuṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī bhikṣusya karma karoti vinayātikramaḥ | kiñcāpi bhikṣuḥ bhikṣuṇīye karma karoti anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate karmapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 275. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, a formal act of suspension (<s>utkṣepanīya karma</s>) was being performed against a certain <s>bhikṣu</s>. There was no skilled procedure-officiant there. A <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> performed the formal act. She then felt remorse: 'Is it permissible for me to do this, or is it not?' Out of remorse, she reported to the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>. Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'This [the <s>bhikṣu</s> assembly] is the foremost assembly. It is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to perform a formal act for a <s>bhikṣu</s>.' Connected with formal acts: it is not permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to perform a formal act for a <s>bhikṣu</s>. However, if there is no skilled procedure-officiant, it is permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to teach the text to a <s>bhikṣu</s>. And if the one performing the procedure forgets, it is permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to prompt him. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> performs a formal act for a <s>bhikṣu</s>, it is a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. However, a <s>bhikṣu</s> performing a formal act for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> incurs no offense. This is called the section connected with formal acts.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 23
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 23

body.text: kauśeyapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Silk (<s>kauśeyapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 276. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhadrā dāni kāpileyī kauśeyacīvareṇa prāvṛtā jñātikulaṃ gacchati sthūlavṛṣito devo ovṛṣṭo kauśeyacīvaramovṛṣṭaṃ kāyeśliṣṭaṃ sphaṭikapratyuṣṭo viya kāyodṛśyati jano sannipātito bhadrāye aṅgayaṣṭiṃ paśyitukāmo | sā dāni utkuṭukā upaviṣṭā antevāsinīhi parivṛtā | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati kauśeyaṃ | kauśeyapratisaṃyuktaṃ | kauśeyan nāma jātimaṃ karttimaṃ ca | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī jātimaṃ prāvarati | deśanāgāmīvinayātikramaḥ | karttimaṃ prāvarati samvaragāmīvinayātikramaḥ kiñcāpi bhikṣur ubhayaṃ prāvarati anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate kauśeyapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||3 ||
body.translated_text: 276. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. <s>Bhadrā Kāpileyī</s>, wrapped in a silk robe, went to her relatives' house. A heavy rain fell. The silk robe, soaked by rain, clung to her body, and her body appeared as if reflected in crystal. A crowd gathered, wanting to see <s>Bhadrā</s>'s bodily form. She then sat squatting, surrounded by her pupils. This matter [was reported]. Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, silk is not permissible.' Connected with silk: silk is of two kinds — natural (<s>jātima</s>) and manufactured (<s>karttima</s>). If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> wraps herself in natural [silk], it is a <s>deśanāgāmi</s> (confession) <s>vinayātikrama</s>. If she wraps herself in manufactured [silk], it is a <s>saṃvaragāmi</s> (restraint-related) <s>vinayātikrama</s>. However, a <s>bhikṣu</s> may wrap himself in both without offense. This is called the section connected with silk.

body.text: bhikṣuṇiprakīrṇaka 24
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 24

body.text: gaṇḍapraticchādanapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Breast Covering (<s>gaṇḍapraticchādanapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 277. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī vihārasyākāśatalake ekasaṃkakṣikāya caṅkramati | tāye dāni | stanāvaḍḍāś caṅkramantīya utpatanti | janena uccagghāyati paśyatha bhaṇe śramaṇikā alābutumbakena viya nadīṃ taratīti | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi gaṇḍapraticchādanan nāma kartavyaṃ | gaṇḍapraticchādanapratisaṃyuktaṃ | saṃkakṣikāye upariṭo osārayitavyo yathā gaṇḍā praticchannā bhaveṃsuḥ sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī gaṇḍapraticchādanaṃ paṭaṃ na prāvarati vinayātikramam āsādayati | na dāni kṣamati prākaṭe pradeśe ekasaṃkakṣikāya āsādayati | na dāni kṣamati prākate pradeśe ekasaṃkakṣikāya caṅkramituṃ | atha dāni vihārasya gupte pradeśe caṅkramati ekasaṃkakṣikāya anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate gaṇḍapraticchādanapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 277. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s> was walking back and forth on the open terrace of the monastery with only a shoulder cloth. Her exposed breasts bounced as she walked. People laughed: 'Look, friends, the female renunciant is crossing the river like a gourd-vessel!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, a breast covering should be made.' Connected with breast covering: the [covering] should be placed over the shoulder cloth so that the breasts are covered. If that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> does not wear the breast-covering cloth, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. It is not permissible to walk with only a shoulder cloth in a public area. But if she walks in a private area of the monastery with only a shoulder cloth, there is no offense. This is called the section connected with breast covering.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 25
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 25

body.text: strīalaṅkārapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Women's Ornaments (<s>strīalaṅkārapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 278. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni śākiyakanyāyo mahākulehi pravrajitāḥ | abhijñāyo alaṃkarituṃ |
body.translated_text: 278. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>Śākya</s> maidens who had gone forth from great families were skilled in adorning.

body.text: yā dāni kumāriyo vuhyanti navavadhukāyo vā ānīyanti tāyo alaṅkarenti gṛheṇa gṛhan nīyanti | alaṅkarituṃ khajjabhojjaṃ labhanti tena vṛttiṃ kalpenti | jano dāni ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā alaṅkārikā etāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati alaṅkartuṃ | strīalaṅkārapratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī śīrṣam vā prasādheti akṣiṇī vā añjeti cūrṇakena vā mukhaṃ ocūrṇeti tena ca jīvikāṃ kalpeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha dāni akṣiṇīduḥkham ti śirovedanā vā bhavati | ardhāvabhedakā vā labhyā akṣiṇī añjayituṃ śīrṣam vā mārjayituṃ | idam ucyate strīalaṅkārapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||tṛ ||
body.translated_text: When maidens were being married or new brides were being brought [to their husband's house], those [ordained women] would adorn them, taking them from house to house. In exchange for adorning, they would receive food and sweets, and thereby made their living. People criticized: 'This is not the going-forth; these are adornment-makers!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible to adorn [others].' Connected with women's ornaments: if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> arranges hair, or applies eye-liner, or powders the face with cosmetic powder, and thereby makes her living, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. But if she has an eye ailment or a headache, or a splitting headache, it is permissible to apply eye-liner or to cleanse the head. This is called the section connected with women's ornaments.

body.text: bhikṣuṇī prakīrṇaka 26
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 26

body.text: utpalavāpakapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Planting Lotuses (<s>utpalavāpakapratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 279. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni śākiyakanyāyo kolitakanyāyo mallakanyāyo mahākula pravrajitāyo utpalāni vāpenti vikrīṇanti ca | tena ca jīvikāṃ kalpayanti | jano dāni ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā utpalavāpikā iyaṃ | etam prakaraṇaṃ yāvat peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati utpalāni vāpayituṃ utpalavāpakapratisamyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī vāpeti vikrīṇāti ca tena ca jīvikāṃ kalpeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha dāni caityārthāya vāpeti bhagavataḥ pūjākarmāya vāpeti anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate utpalavāpakapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 279. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Koliya</s> maidens, and <s>Malla</s> maidens who had gone forth from great families would plant lotuses and sell them, and thereby made their living. People criticized: 'This is not the going-forth; these are lotus-planters!' This matter [was reported], [abbreviated], up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible to plant lotuses.' Connected with planting lotuses: if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> plants and sells [lotuses] and thereby makes her living, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. But if she plants them for the sake of a shrine or for the worship of the <s>Bhagavān</s>, there is no offense. This is called the section connected with planting lotuses.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 27
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 27

body.text: sumanāvāpanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Planting Jasmine (<s>sumanāvāpanāpratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 280. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | evam eva sumanāvāpanāya kartavyaṃ yāvat idam ucyate sumanāvāpanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ ||grā ||
body.translated_text: 280. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The same [rule] should be applied regarding planting jasmine, up to: this is called the section connected with planting jasmine.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 28
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 28

body.text: utpalagranthikā pratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Tying Lotus Garlands (<s>utpalagranthikāpratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 281. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | bhagavatā dāni śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ | na kṣamati sumanāṃ vāpayitum ti | tāyo dāni śākiyakanyāyo kolitakanyāyo mallakanyāyo licchavikanyāyo utpalāni granthayitvā vikrīṇanti | jano dāni ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā kārikā iyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati utpalāni granthayituṃ | utpalagranthikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī utpaladāmām vāmallikādāmām vā āraṅgaṇadāmām vā kṛtvā vikrīṇanti | tena ca jīvikāṃ kalpayanti vinayātikramaḥ | atha dāni mālyopahāro bhavati jātimahā vā bodhimahā vā dharmacakramahā vā ānandamahā vā rāhulamahā vā pañcavārṣikā vā | mahāpañcavārṣikā | jano dāni āha | āryamiśrikāhi śobhāpayitavyaṃ | kiñcāpi bhikṣuṇī mutpalamālām vā mallikāmālām vā āraṅgaṇamālām vā granthayaty anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate utpalagranthikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ || hra ||
body.translated_text: 281. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> had laid down the training rule that it is not permissible to plant jasmine. Those <s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Koliya</s> maidens, <s>Malla</s> maidens, and <s>Licchavi</s> maidens would then tie lotuses [into garlands] and sell them. People criticized: 'This is not the going-forth; these are [garland-]makers!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. [Abbreviated.] Up to: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavan</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible to tie lotuses [into garlands].' Connected with tying lotus garlands: if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> makes lotus garlands, or jasmine garlands, or <s>āraṅgaṇa</s> garlands, and sells them, and thereby makes her living — it is a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. But if there is a garland-offering for a festival — a birth-festival, an enlightenment-festival, a <s>Dharmacakra</s>-festival, an <s>Ānanda</s>-festival, a <s>Rāhula</s>-festival, a quinquennial festival, or a great quinquennial festival — and people say: 'The noble ladies should beautify [the place]' — then even if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> ties lotus garlands, jasmine garlands, or <s>āraṅgaṇa</s> garlands, there is no offense. This is called the section connected with tying lotus garlands.

body.text: bhikṣuṇī prakīrṇaka 29
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 29

body.text: sumanāgranthikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Tying Jasmine Garlands (<s>sumanāgranthikāpratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: evam eva sumanāgranthikāya nānākaraṇaṃ granthiguṇaṃ vā mālāguṇam vā puṣpakañcukam vā kṛtvā vikrīṇāti | tena jīvikāṃ kalpayati vinayātikramaḥ | idam ucyate sumanāgranthikāpratisaṃyuktaṃ || 0 ||
body.translated_text: The same [rule] applies for tying jasmine garlands. The difference is: if she makes a tied string, or a garland string, or a flower-jacket, and sells them, and thereby makes her living — it is a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. This is called the section connected with tying jasmine garlands.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 30
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 30

body.text: kartanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Spinning (<s>kartanāpratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 282. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāyo dāni bhikṣuṇīyo śākiyakanyāyo yāvan mahākulapravrajitāyo saṃjñikāḥ sūtraṃ kartayitvā vikrīṇanti | jano dāni ojjhāyati | neyaṃ pravrajyā picukārikā iyaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvad bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati kartituṃ | kartanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī kambalam vā karpāsam vā kṣaumam vā kauśeyam vā śāṇam vā bhaṅgam vā anyam vā kartayitvā vikrīṇāti tena jīvikāṃ kalpayati vinayātikramam āsādayati | atha dāni bhikṣuṇīye cīvaraṃ pariśrāmaṇaṃ vā kṣīnaṃ vā bhavati labhyaṃ sī
body.translated_text: 282. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> — <s>Śākya</s> maidens and others who had gone forth from great families — being skilled, would spin thread and sell it. People criticized: 'This is not the going-forth; these are cotton-spinners!' The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard of this matter. [Abbreviated.] Up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not permissible to spin.' Connected with spinning: if that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> spins wool, cotton, linen, silk, hemp, or <s>bhaṅga</s> (cannabis), or anything else, and sells it, and thereby makes her living, she incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. But if a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>'s robe or cloth is worn out or deteriorated, it is permissible to sew...

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 31
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī</s> Miscellaneous Rule 31

body.text: ācāravikopanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with Violating Proper Conduct (<s>ācāravikopanāpratisaṃyukta</s>)

body.text: 283. manāsmi | brahmacaryāto cyāvitā | āha | kena | āha | so me devaro paripāteti | so me nayitukāmo | āha | upaviśa mātā yāhi | vayaṃ te rakṣiṣyāmaḥ sā dān āha gamiṣyāmi āryāye mūlaṃ āryā me rakṣiṣyati | tāhi tāye nūpurāṇi ābaddhāni karṇikā ābaddhā valayāni āviddhāni alaṅkṛtā rakṣoparaktehi vastrehi parihitā vāvāguṇṭhitā ca | catuhi pañcahi ceṭikāhi parivṛtā | so dāni manuṣyo tān dvāre sthitvā avaloketi | yāṃ velāṃ niṣkramiṣyati tato haṃ gṛhṇīṣyāmīti | tena sā dṛṣṭā niṣkramantī | tasya bhavati arhati kuṭumbikabhāryā eṣā | na eṣāsā sā dāni bhikṣuṇī | sā dāni bhikṣuṇī upāśrayaṃ gatā bhikṣuṇīhi dṛṣṭā | āhaṃsuḥ | ārye iyaṃ sudinnā pratyodhāvita | āha | nāhaṃ pratyodhāvitā api tu mama devaro pratyodhāvayitukāmo | tasya bhayād ārakṣābhiprāyā evaṃ kṛtaṃ | peyālaṃ yāvat etad eva | bhagavān sarvaṃ pṛcchati | ām bhagavan | bhagavān āha | evañ ca nāma tvaṃ ācāraṃ vikopayasi | tena hi na kṣamati ācāraṃ vikopayituṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī tyaktamuktena cittena ācāraṃ vikopayati abhikṣuṇī bhavati | atha rakṣābhiprāyā ācāram vikopayati vinayātikramaḥ | na ca abhikṣuṇī bhavati | bhikṣur api atyaktamuktena cittena rakṣārthaṃ ācāraṃ vikopayati anāpattiḥ | idam ucyate ācāravikopanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ ||1 ||
body.translated_text: 283. 'I have been made to fall from my celibacy.' She said: 'By whom?' She said: 'My brother-in-law is pursuing me. He wants to take me [as wife].' [The nuns] said: 'Sit down, mother. Go! We shall protect you.' She then said: 'I shall go to my noble preceptress. She will protect me.' They then bound anklets on her, fastened earrings, put on bracelets, adorned her, dressed her in garments dyed with protective [colors], and veiled her. Surrounded by four or five maidservants, [she left]. That man stood at the door watching: 'The moment she comes out, I shall seize her.' He saw her coming out. He thought: 'This is worthy of being a householder's wife. This is not that <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> went to the dwelling. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> saw her and said: 'Noble one, this <s>Sudinnā</s> has returned [to lay life]!' She said: 'I have not returned. But my brother-in-law wished to take me back. Out of fear of him, for the sake of protection, this was done.' Abbreviated, up to: the <s>Bhagavān</s> asked all about it. 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'How could you violate proper conduct? Therefore, it is not permissible to violate proper conduct.' That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who, with a willing and freed mind, violates proper conduct—she ceases to be a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. But if she violates conduct for the sake of protection—it is a <s>vinayātikrama</s>, and she does not cease to be a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, if without a willing and freed mind, violates conduct for the sake of protection—there is no offense. This is called 'connected with violation of proper conduct.' [1]

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 32
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> (Miscellaneous Rules for Nuns) 32.

body.text: pātrapraticchādanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with covering the bowl (<s>pātrapraticchādana</s>).

body.text: 284. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | sthūlanandā bhikṣuṇī piṇḍacāram aṇvantī | sā dāni aparaṃ mahāntaṃ kulaṃ piṇḍāya praviṣṭā | taṃhi striyāya lolagarbho dārako | sā dān āha | ārye imaṃ dārakaṃ ujjhehi | āha | ujjhetu āryā | ahaṃ āryāye kiñcid dāsyāmi | āha | nāham enam ujjhāmi | āha | āryāya ahaṃ ettakaṃ caittakaṃ ca dāsye | tāya lubdhāya uktaṃ | iha pātre dehi | sā taṃ praticchādayitvā niṣkramati | thero dāni mahākāśyapo piṇḍacāraṃ praviṣṭo | therasyāpi samadānaṃ | yā prathamā bhikṣā lakṣati tāṃ bhikṣusya vā bhikṣuṇīye vā pratiṣṭhāye ti | thereṇa dāni sā dṛṣṭā | āha | āhara pātraṃ | sā saṃkusāyati praticchādeti na darśayeti | thero āha | āhara pātraṃ | sā maheśākhyena śāstṛkalpena thereṇābhigarjitā | tāya dāni bhītāya tharatharāpantīya pātraṃ praṇāmitaṃ | thereṇa dṛṣṭaṃ | āha | hi hīyāya dharmo | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ āyuṣmān mahākaśyapo bhikṣuṇām ārocayati | bhikṣū bhagavato ārocayeṃsuḥ | bhagavān āha | śabdāpayatha nandāṃ | sā dāni śabdāpitā | etad eva pṛcchīyati | yāvad āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | duṣkṛtan te nande naiṣa dharmo naiṣa vinayo yāvat | evañ ca nāma tvaṃ pātraṃ praticchādesi | tena hi na kṣamati pātraṃ praticchādayituṃ | pātrapraticchādanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya prākaṭena pātreṇa piṇḍāya aṭituṃ praticchādayitvā aṭitavyaṃ | yadā bhikṣāṃ praticchati tadā ugghāṭiya praticchitavyaṃ | yadi bhikṣuṃ rathyāyāṃ paśyati ugghāṭiya upadarśayitavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī prākaṭena pātreṇa aṭati vinayātikramam āsādayati | bhikṣuṃ dṛṣṭvā na ugghāṭiya darśeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate pātrapraticchādanāpratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 284. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Sthūlanandā</s> was going on her alms-round. She entered a great household for alms. There a woman had an unwanted fetus. She said: 'Noble one, abort this child...'

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 33
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 33.

body.text: varcakuṭipratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the latrine (<s>varcakuṭi</s>).

body.text: 285. bhagavān śrāvastīyaṃ viharati | tā dāni bhikṣuṇīyo onaddhavarce varcakuṭīye upaviśanti | varcakuṭīye striyāya lolagarbho pratikṣipto | caṇḍālāś citraghaṭakehi uccāraṃ chorayanti | tehi so dārako dṛṣṭo | te taṃ dārakaṃ ekāyāṃ bāhāyāṃ gṛhītvā ojjhāyanti | śramaṇikā varcakuṭīyaṃ prasūtā hi | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat tena hi na kṣamati onaddhavarce upaviśituṃ | varcakuṭīpratisaṃyuktaṃ | na dāni kṣamati bhikṣuṇīya onaddhavarcakuṭiṃ kārāpayituṃ | atha khu vivṛtapādakā kārāpayitavyā | na kṣamati āgatodakaṃ kārāpayituṃ | niḥsīmā kārāpayitavayā | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī onaddhavarcakuṭīyaṃ āgatodakāyam vā upaviśati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate varcakuṭīpratisaṃyuktaṃ ||
body.translated_text: 285. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> sat in the enclosed latrine. A woman's unwanted fetus was discarded in the latrine. <s>Caṇḍālas</s> (outcaste workers) were disposing of excrement with decorated pots. They [found] that child...

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 34
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 34.

body.text: jentākapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with the bath-house (<s>jentāka</s>).

body.text: 286. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tāya dāni bhikṣuṇīya śākiyakanyāyo licchavikanyāyo mallakanyāyo jentāke snāyanti | kulaputrakehi anupraviśya brahmacaryāto cyāvitāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat tena hi na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīye jentāke snāyituṃ | atha dāni gilānā bhavati labhyā vihāre svedayitvā tailena aṅgāni mrakṣayitvā snāyituṃ | sā esā bhikṣuṇī jentāke snāyati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate jentākapratisaṃyuktaṃ ||3 ||
body.translated_text: 286. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Those <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> <s>Śākya</s> maidens, <s>Licchavi</s> maidens, and <s>Malla</s> maidens were bathing in the bath-house. Young men entered [after them] and they were made to fall from their celibacy. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> reported this matter...

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 35
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 35.

body.text: āraṇyakaśayanāsanapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with forest dwellings (<s>āraṇyaka-śayanāsana</s>).

body.text: 287. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | tena kālena tena samayena bhikṣuṇīnām āraṅyakāni śayanāsanāni na pratikṣiptāni grāmāntikāni ca akṛtāni | tena khalu punaḥ samayena pañcamātrāṇi bhikṣuṇīśatāni mahāprajāpatīpramukhāni rājakārāme viharanti | tāyo dāni śākiyakanyāyo licchavikanyāyo kolitakanyāyo prāsādikāyo darśanīyāyo | tāyo dāni kulaputrakehi ocaritāyo | tāyo purimaṃ yāmaṃ prahāṇam upaviṣṭā | kulaputrakāś ca allīnā graheṣyāmo ti | tāḥ sratti vaihāyasam abhyudgatāḥ | te kulaputrāḥ pratyosakkitāḥ | tāyo puno madhyamayāmaṃ evam paścimaṃ yāmaṃ prahāṇam upaviṣṭāḥ | kulaputrakāś ca allīnā graheṣyāmo ti | taṃhi tadā nīyāḥ kṣiprasamāpattikāḥ | yāhi ca middham anokrāntaṃ tāḥ sratti vaihāyasam abhyudgatāḥ | yāvanta samāpattikā yāhi ca middham avakrāntaṃ tāyo kulaputrakehi gṛhya viheṭhitāḥ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ | peyālaṃ | yāvat tena hi na kṣamati āraṇyake śayanāsane vastuṃ | atha dāni cātuṣpathikā sarvarātrikā bhavati upāsakopāsikā gacchanti labhyaṃ vastuṃ | tahiṃ pi na kṣamati pratigupte pradeśe vastuṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī āraṇyake śayanāsane vāsaṃ upagacchati varṣam vā vasati vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate āraṇyakaśayanāsanapratisaṃyuktaṃ || tṛ ||
body.translated_text: 287. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. At that time, forest dwellings for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> had not been prohibited and village-adjacent ones had not been established. At that time, five hundred <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> [were dwelling in the forest]...

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 3641
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 36-41.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 36, 37
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 36, 37.

body.text: 288. yo bhikṣūṇām āstāro anāstāro so bhikṣuṇīnāṃ | yo bhikṣuṇīnāṃ āstāro anāstāro so bhikṣūṇāṃ || grā ||
body.translated_text: 288. What is a proper seat-covering for <s>bhikṣus</s> is an improper one for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. What is a proper seat-covering for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is an improper one for <s>bhikṣus</s>.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 38, 39
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 38, 39.

body.text: yo bhikṣūṇām uddhāro anuddhāro so bhikṣuṇīnāṃ | grā | yo bhikṣuṇīnām uddhāro anuddhāro so bhikṣūṇāṃ || 0 ||
body.translated_text: What is a proper recitation selection for <s>bhikṣus</s> is an improper one for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>. What is a proper recitation selection for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is an improper one for <s>bhikṣus</s>.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 40, 41
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 40, 41.

body.text: yo bhikṣūṇām abhihāro anabhihāro so bhikṣuṇīnāṃ || ḷ ||
body.translated_text: What is a proper offering for <s>bhikṣus</s> is an improper one for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.

body.text: yo bhikṣuṇīnām abhihāro anabhihāro so bhikṣūnāṃ || ḷ ||
body.translated_text: What is a proper offering for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is an improper one for <s>bhikṣus</s>.

body.text: || caturtho vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: End of the fourth section.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 4248
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 42-48.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 42, 43
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 42, 43.

body.text: 289. yaṃ bhikṣūṇām āmiṣaṃ akalpiyaṃ | akalpiyaṃ taṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ ||
body.translated_text: 289. Whatever material is improper for <s>bhikṣus</s> is also improper for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>.

body.text: yaṃ bhikṣuṇīnām āmiṣaṃ akalpiyaṃ kalpiyaṃ tam bhikṣūṇāṃ || 2 ||
body.translated_text: Whatever material is improper for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> is proper for <s>bhikṣus</s>. [2]

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 44, 45
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 44, 45.

body.text: labhyaṃ bhikṣusya bhikṣuṇīya pratigrahayituṃ sthāpayitvā jatarūparajataṃ agnikalpiyañ ca || 3 ||
body.translated_text: It is permissible for a <s>bhikṣu</s> to have a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> receive [offerings on his behalf], except for gold, silver, and what is proper for fire [i.e., cooked food]. [3]

body.text: labhyaṃ bhikṣuṇīye bhikṣūṇā pratigrāhāpayituṃ sthāpayitvā jātarūpaṃ rajataṃ agnikalpiyañ ca || ṇka ||
body.translated_text: It is permissible for a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to have a <s>bhikṣu</s> receive [offerings on her behalf], except for gold, silver, and what is proper for fire. [4]

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 46
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 46.

body.text: 290. trīṇi bhikṣusya abhikṣukaraṇāni | katamāni trīṇi | tyaktamuktena cittena śikṣāṃ pratyākhyāti [1] | saṃgho vāsati vastusmin nāśeti [2] | strīliṅgam vā sā prādurbhavati [3] | imāni trīṇi bhikṣuṣya abhikṣukaraṇāni | tena bhikṣuṇā bhikṣuṇīvihāraṃ gantavyaṃ | na kṣamati bhikṣuṇīnām ekapiṭake eke pi vicāre vastuṃ | atha khu cchinnopavicāre vastavyaṃ | yadāsya bhūyo bhikṣu liṅgaṃ prādurbhavati tadā bhikṣuvihāram āgantavyaṃ | sā evāsyopasampadā tad eva varṣāgraṃ || tṛ ||
body.translated_text: 290. There are three things that cause a <s>bhikṣu</s> to cease being a <s>bhikṣu</s>. What are the three? [1] With a willing and freed mind, he renounces the training. [2] The <s>Saṃgha</s> dwells [i.e., performs the act] and destroys [his status] in the matter. [3] The female sex-characteristic manifests in him. These are the three things that cause a <s>bhikṣu</s> to cease being a <s>bhikṣu</s>.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṃaka 47
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 47.

body.text: trīṇi bhikṣuṇīye abhikṣuṇīkaraṇāni | katamāni trīṇi | tyaktamuktena cittena ācāraṃ vikopayati | [1] | saṃgho vāsati vastusmin nāśeti | [2] | puruṣaliṅgaṃ vāsya prādurbhavati [3] | imāni trīṇi bhikṣuṇīye abhikṣuṇīkaraṇāni | tathaiva yathā bhikṣoḥ || phu ||
body.translated_text: There are three things that cause a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to cease being a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>. What are the three? [1] With a willing and freed mind, she violates proper conduct. [2] The <s>Saṃgha</s> dwells [i.e., performs the act] and destroys [her status] in the matter. [3] The male sex-characteristic manifests in her. These are the three things that cause a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to cease being a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>.

body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇī-prakīrṇaka</s> 49.

body.text: ratanapratisaṃyuktaṃ
body.translated_text: Connected with valuables (<s>ratana</s>).

body.text: 291. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | aparaṃ dāni kulaṃ rājakulena upahataṃ | rājabhaṭāḥ parivāri vāriya rakṣanti | sthūlanandā nāma bhikṣuṇī piṇḍacāram anvaṇṭī taṃhi praviṣṭā | sā strī tām āha || ārye idaṃ kulaṃ rājakulenopahataṃ utkacaprakaco | imam ārye niṣkrāmetu yadi jīvantīyo mucciṣyāmo asmākaṃ bhaviṣyati āryāye vṛttiṃ dāsyāmo āryāye etaṃ bhaviṣyati | tāya tasyāḥ pātraṃ upanāmitaṃ imaṃhi dehīti | nānākārāṇāṃ ratnānāṃ pātraṃ pūrayitvā dinnaṃ muktāyāḥ maṇīnāṃ sphoṭikasya musāragalvasya lohikāyāḥ | sā dāni praticchādayitvā niṣkramati | bhaṭehi ca dṛṣṭā te dān āhaṃsuḥ | āhara kim idaṃ | sā saṃkusāyati na darśeti | tharatharāpantīya bhītabhītāya darśitaṃ | bhikṣuṇīhi śrutaṃ | etaṃ prakaraṇaṃ bhikṣuṇīyo mahāprajāpatīye gautamīye ārocayeṃsuḥ | yāvad chabdāpitā | tad eva pṛcchīyati | āha | āma bhagavan | bhagavān āha | tena hi na kṣamati ratanaṃ praticchādayituṃ | ratanapratisaṃyuktaṃ | etaṃ dāni mahāntaṃ kulaṃ rājakule nophatam bhavati yāvan na lekhyaṃ kṛtam bhavati | na sārajyaṃ kṛtam bhavati | yadi kiñcid dadanti labhyaṃ niṣkāsayituṃ | atha dāni lekhyaṃ kṛtam bhavati rakṣā vā kṛtā bhavati bhaṭehi parivāritam bhavati | āha | imaṃ gṛhaṃ rājakulenopahataṃ yadi tāvaj jīvantīyo mucyāmaḥ asmākaṃ bhaviṣyati āryāyā eva bhaviṣyatīti na kṣamati niṣkāsayituṃ | vaktavyaṃ | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptaṃ na kṣamati niṣkāsayituṃ | atha dān āha | caityasya demaḥ saṃghasya vā demaḥ āryāye eva demo ti gṛhṇītavyaṃ | gṛhṇītvā na kṣamati praticchādayitvā niṣkāsayituṃ | prākaṭaṃ kṛtvā niṣkāsyitavyaṃ | atha pṛcchīyati kasyedan ti caityasya saṃghasya mameti | yadi mucyate nandaṃ bhadraṃ | athāchidyati dātavyaṃ | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī ratanapūrṇapātraṃ praticchādeti vinayātikramam āsādayati | idam ucyate ratanapratisaṃyuktaṃ || hrā ||
body.translated_text: 291. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Now, a certain family had been seized by the royal household. Royal guards had surrounded, blockaded, and were guarding [the house]. The <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> named <s>Sthūlanandā</s>, while going on her alms-round, entered there. The woman said to her: 'Noble One, this household has been seized by the royal authority — [everything is] in utter disarray. Noble One, please leave! If we survive and are released, what is ours will be [yours]; we shall provide a livelihood for the Noble One; it will be the Noble One's.' She offered her bowl [saying]: 'Put [something] in this.' Having filled the bowl with various kinds of jewels — pearls, gems, crystal, coral, and rubies — she gave [it to her]. She then concealed [them] and left. The guards saw her and said: 'Hand [it] over! What is this?' She hesitated and would not show [them]. Trembling with fear, she showed [them]. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> heard [about this]. They reported this matter to <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> — up to: she was summoned. That very [matter] was questioned. She said: 'Yes, <s>Bhagavān</s>.' The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore it is not proper to conceal jewels.' Relating to jewels: Now, if a great family has not been seized by the royal household — meaning no document [of seizure] has been made, no confiscation has been executed — if they give something, it is permissible to take [it] out. But if a document has been made, or a guard has been posted, or [the house] has been surrounded by soldiers — if she says: 'This house has been seized by the royal authority; if we survive and are released, it will be ours and will be the Noble One's' — it is not permissible to take [anything] out. One should say: 'The <s>Bhagavān</s> has laid down a training rule; it is not permissible to take [anything] out.' If she then says: 'We give to the shrine, or we give to the <s>Saṃgha</s>, or we give to the Noble One herself' — it should be accepted. Having accepted, it is not permissible to conceal [it] and take [it] out. Rather, one should make [it] visible and take [it] out openly. If asked: 'Whose is this?' — [one should answer:] 'It is the shrine's, the <s>Saṃgha</s>'s, mine.' If [one] is released — well and good. But if [it] is confiscated, it must be given up. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who conceals a bowl full of jewels incurs a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. This is called 'relating to jewels.' Abbreviated.

body.text: bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka 50
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka</s> (Miscellaneous Rules for <s>Bhikṣuṇīs</s>), [section] 50.

body.text: yathāvṛddhikāya
body.translated_text: By seniority (<s>yathāvṛddhikā</s>).

body.text: 292. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | nadīye ajirāvatīye pāre ubhayato sāṃghikaṃ bhaktaṃ | tahiṃ bhikṣavo gacchanti nāvāya | bhikṣuṇīyo na labhanti abhiruhituṃ | bhikṣū āhaṃsuḥ | mā bhaginīyo abhiruhatha | bhagavatā śikṣāpadaṃ prajñaptam | na kṣamati bhikṣusya bhikṣuṇīya saha ekanāvām abhiruhituṃ ti | te dāni bhikṣū osarantikāya uttaranti | ekabhikṣuṇāpi nāvā paliguddhā bhavati dvihi trihi evaṃ paliguddhā bhavati | yadā te bhikṣū uttaritāḥ tadā bhikṣuṇīyo ekanāvāparipūrakena tāritāḥ | tāsāṃ varṣāgraṃ parigrāhantīnāṃ akālibhūtaṃ | atha kho mahāprajāpatī gautamī sāyāhnasamaye parikilantehi mahābhūtehi bhagavato pādavandīkāṃ upasaṃkrāntā | bhagavān jānanto yeva pṛcchati | kena bhe gautami parikilantāni mahābhūtāni | atha mahāprajāpatī gautamī bhagavato tad eva sarvam āroceti | bhagavān āha | tena hi aṣṭāhi bhikṣuṇīhi yathāvṛddhikāya upaveṣṭavyaṃ | śiṣṭāhi yathāgatikāya | ete dāni bhavanti bhaktā vā tarpaṇā vā yavāgupānā vā paraṃ vārṣikā vā mahāpañcavārṣikā vā aṣṭānāṃ bhikṣuṇīnāṃ āsanāni sthāpayitavyāni yathāvṛddhikāya | aṣṭa vā nirmuṣṭikā hastāḥ pratikṛty' eva gantavyaṃ | tā etā bhikṣuṇīyo aṣṭānām āsanāni sthāpayitvā niṣīdanti vinayātikramam āsādayanti | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: 292. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. On both banks of the river <s>Ajirāvatī</s> there was a <s>Saṃgha</s> meal. The <s>bhikṣus</s> went there by boat. The <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> could not board. The <s>bhikṣus</s> said: 'Do not board, sisters! The <s>Bhagavān</s> has laid down a training rule: it is not proper for a <s>bhikṣu</s> and a <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> to board the same boat together.' Those <s>bhikṣus</s> then crossed one at a time. Even with one <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, a boat was weighed down; with two or three, it was likewise weighed down. When those <s>bhikṣus</s> had crossed, then the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> were all ferried [together] filling one boat. While they were receiving the rains-retreat [offerings], it became untimely [too late]. Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>, in the late afternoon, with exhausted limbs, approached the <s>Bhagavān</s> to pay respects at his feet. The <s>Bhagavān</s>, though knowing, asked: 'Why, <s>Gautamī</s>, are your limbs so exhausted?' Then <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s> reported that entire matter to the <s>Bhagavān</s>. The <s>Bhagavān</s> said: 'Therefore, eight <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should be seated by seniority; the rest by order of arrival.' Now, for meals, or offerings of food, or rice-gruel, or the rains-retreat [ceremony], or the great five-yearly [ceremony], seats for eight <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should be arranged by seniority. [A distance of] eight arm-spans without fists should also [be measured], and one should go only after making preparations. Those <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> who, having set up seats for the eight [senior nuns], sit down [in them themselves], incur a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: aṣṭābhir bhikṣuṇībhir yathāvṛddhikāya upaveṣṭavyam u śiṣṭābhi yathāgatikāya || 0 ||
body.translated_text: Eight <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> should be seated by seniority; the rest by order of arrival.

body.text: |pañcamo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Fifth section.
