body.text: 293. parivāso [1] | laśunaṃ [2] | chattraṃ [3] | yānaṃ [4] | tathaiva śastrakarmāṇi [5] | upānaho [6] | śayyā [7] | niṣadyā [8] | navamaṃ prekṣaṇaṃ [9] | ime nava padā prakīrṇakāto samuddhṛtāḥ |
body.translated_text: 293. <s>Uddāna</s> (summary verse) of the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s>: probationary period (<s>parivāsa</s>) [1]; garlic (<s>laśuna</s>) [2]; umbrella (<s>chatra</s>) [3]; vehicle (<s>yāna</s>) [4]; likewise surgical procedures (<s>śastrakarma</s>) [5]; sandals (<s>upānaha</s>) [6]; bed (<s>śayyā</s>) [7]; seat (<s>niṣadyā</s>) [8]; ninth is entertainment (<s>prekṣaṇa</s>) [9]. These nine topics are extracted from the <s>prakīrṇaka</s>.

body.text: sarve anye nava padā anūnā pratiṣitavyā puna tahiṃ | yatrāsi parivāso sattvavikṛtin tahim samodahe | yatrāsi upānaho vṛkṣavikṛtim tahiṃ samodahet | yatrāsi laśunaṃ kāṣṭhavikṛtiṃ tahiṃ samodahe | yatrāsi śayyā nirdiśet tahiṃ puṣpavikṛtiṃ | yatrāsi yānaṃ phalavikṛtiṃ nirdiśet tahiṃ vijñaḥ | yatrāsi sahaniṣadyā ekorttakaṃ tahiṃ samādiśet chatraṃ | yatrāsi āpattiṃ tatra nirdeśed vijñaḥ | yatrāsi śastrakarma nirdiśet tahiṃ and āpattiḥ | yatrāsi viśokadarśanaṃ āpattipratikarma tatra nirdiśed vijñaḥ | etāvatā uddhārāḥ prakīrṇake ye ca ovṛṣāḥ vargaṃ samuddhariya dvādaśamaṃ | nava padāni punar eva bhikṣuṇīnāṃ prakīrṇake sarvaṃ pratikṣiptaṃ bhikṣuprakīrṇakato vargās trayodaśa kāryāḥ | anye ca pañca vargāyutakā yathā bhikṣuṇīsūtre | āraṇyakaṃ | jentākaṃ varca kaṭhinaṃ uddharitvā avaśeṣā tathaiva kāryāḥ | abhisamācārikā dharmāḥ | taṃ sarvaṃ saṅkale puna vargā aṣṭādaśa prakīrṇake svayaṃbhunā nirdiṣṭā | bhikṣuṇīsūtre ubhesūtre saṃkaletvāna śikṣāpadasaṃgraho yathābhūtaṃ | pañcaśatāni anūnāni apare ca padā catustriṃśat |
body.translated_text: All these other nine topics should be reinserted back in their proper places. Where there is 'probationary period,' one should combine 'creature-variant' (<s>sattvavikṛti</s>) there; where there is 'sandals,' one should combine 'tree-variant' (<s>vṛkṣavikṛti</s>) there; where there is 'garlic,' one should combine 'wood-variant' (<s>kāṣṭhavikṛti</s>) there; where there is 'bed,' one should indicate 'flower-variant' (<s>puṣpavikṛti</s>) there; where there is 'vehicle,' the wise one should indicate 'fruit-variant' (<s>phalavikṛti</s>) there; where there is 'co-sitting' (<s>sahaniṣadyā</s>), one should assign the single-unit (<s>ekorttaka</s>) there to 'umbrella'; where there is 'offense,' the wise one should indicate there; where there is 'surgical procedure,' one should indicate 'offense' there; where there is 'sorrow-free viewing' (<s>viśokadarśana</s>), the wise one should indicate 'remedy for offense' (<s>āpattipratikarma</s>) there. These are the extractions in the <s>prakīrṇaka</s>, and those omitted — having extracted the twelfth section — the nine topics for the <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>' <s>prakīrṇaka</s> are all incorporated from the <s>bhikṣu-prakīrṇaka</s>. Thirteen sections should be made. And five other sections with sub-groups, as in the <s>Bhikṣuṇī-sūtra</s>: the forest-dweller rules (<s>āraṇyaka</s>), the bath-house (<s>jentāka</s>), the latrine (<s>varca</s>), and the <s>kaṭhina</s> — having extracted [these], the remainder should be done likewise. [These are] the rules of proper conduct (<s>abhisamācārikā dharmāḥ</s>). Collecting all of these again, eighteen sections in the <s>prakīrṇaka</s> were taught by the Self-Arisen One (<s>Svayaṃbhū</s>). Combining the <s>Bhikṣuṇī-sūtra</s> and both <s>sūtras</s> together, the collection of training rules as they truly are: five hundred complete and thirty-four additional rules.

body.text: samāptaṃ bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇakaṃ āryamahāsāṃghikānāṃ lokottaravādināṃ ||
body.translated_text: The <s>Bhikṣuṇīprakīrṇaka</s> of the <s>Āryamahāsāṃghika-Lokottaravādins</s> is completed.

body.text: bhikṣuprakīrṇaka 1-23
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuprakīrṇaka</s> (Miscellaneous Rules for <s>Bhikṣus</s>), [sections] 1-23.

body.text: 294. prakīrṇakoddānaṃ | tatra upasaṃpadā [1] | anupasampadā [2] | upasampādyo [3] | anupasampādyo [4] | karma [5] | karmavastu [6] | tarjanīyaṃ [7] | nigharṣaṇīyaṃ [8] pravrājanīyaṃ [9] | pratisāraṇīyaṃ [10] ||
body.translated_text: 294. <s>Uddāna</s> (summary verse) of the <s>Prakīrṇaka</s>: therein — ordination (<s>upasaṃpadā</s>) [1]; non-ordination (<s>anupasampadā</s>) [2]; one who should be ordained (<s>upasampādya</s>) [3]; one who should not be ordained (<s>anupasampādya</s>) [4]; formal act (<s>karma</s>) [5]; matter for a formal act (<s>karmavastu</s>) [6]; censure (<s>tarjanīya</s>) [7]; rebuke (<s>nigharṣaṇīya</s>) [8]; banishment (<s>pravrājanīya</s>) [9]; reconciliation (<s>pratisāraṇīya</s>) [10].

body.text: || prathamo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: First section.

body.text: uddānaṃ | utkṣepanīyaṃ karma [11] | parivāsadānaṃ [12] | mānatvadānaṃ [12] | āhvayanaṃ [14] | sthānārhaṃ karma [15] | asthānārhaṃ karma [16] | niṣṛtavartaṃ [17] | sthalasthavartaṃ [18] | nānāsamvāsavartaṃ [19] | pārājikāya āpattīye [20] | śikṣāye [12] | dinnavartaṃ [22] | tasya pāpeyasika śamatha [23] | dinnavartaṃ ||
body.translated_text: <s>Uddāna</s>: suspension (<s>utkṣepanīya</s>) formal act [11]; granting probation (<s>parivāsadāna</s>) [12]; granting penance (<s>mānatvadāna</s>) [13]; summoning (<s>āhvayana</s>) [14]; case deserving formal act (<s>sthānārha karma</s>) [15]; case not deserving formal act (<s>asthānārha karma</s>) [16]; procedure for one who has emerged (<s>niṣṛtavarta</s>) [17]; procedure for one on land (<s>sthalasthavarta</s>) [18]; procedure for those of different communion (<s>nānāsaṃvāsavarta</s>) [19]; offense of <s>pārājika</s> [20]; training (<s>śikṣā</s>) [21]; granted procedure (<s>dinnavarta</s>) [22]; the <s>pāpīyasika</s> (majority-decision) reconciliation procedure (<s>śamatha</s>) for that [23]; granted procedure.

body.text: || dvitīyo vargaḥ ||
body.translated_text: Second section.

body.text: bhikṣuprakirṇaka 24-54
body.translated_text: <s>Bhikṣuprakīrṇaka</s> (Miscellaneous Rules for <s>Bhikṣus</s>), [sections] 24-54.

body.text: uddānaṃ | codanāvastu [24] | kāraṇāvastu [25] | nāśanāvastu [26] | nānāsamvāsavastu [27] | arthasāmīcī [28] | sammutipratisaṃyuktaṃ [29] | vastupratisaṃyuktaṃ [30] | vihāravastupratisaṃyuktaṃ [31] | navakarmikapratisaṃyuktaṃ [32] | śayyāsanapratisaṃyuktaṃ [33] | sāmīcīkarmapratisaṃyuktaṃ [34] ||
body.translated_text: <s>Uddāna</s>: matter of accusation (<s>codanāvastu</s>) [24]; matter of cause (<s>kāraṇāvastu</s>) [25]; matter of destruction (<s>nāśanāvastu</s>) [26]; matter of different communion (<s>nānāsaṃvāsavastu</s>) [27]; proper procedure (<s>arthasāmīcī</s>) [28]; relating to authorization (<s>sammutipratisaṃyukta</s>) [29]; relating to matters (<s>vastupratisaṃyukta</s>) [30]; relating to dwelling-matters (<s>vihāravastupratisaṃyukta</s>) [31]; relating to construction overseers (<s>navakarmikapratisaṃyukta</s>) [32]; relating to beds and seats (<s>śayyāsanapratisaṃyukta</s>) [33]; relating to proper procedures (<s>sāmīcīkarmapratisaṃyukta</s>) [34].

body.text: || tṛtīyo vargaḥ ||

body.text:
Fol. 71b
athāha ārye kahiṃ dānan dātavyaṃ | yahiṃcit taṃ prasīdati | athāha | kahiṃ dānaṃ dinnaṃ mahāphalaṃ bhavati | vaktavyaṃ saṃghe dinnam mahāphalaṃ | athāha | kahiṃ dāni saṃgho śīlavān guṇavān bhadrako śikṣākāmo vaktavyaṃ | nāsti saṃgho duḥśīlo nāma | atha dān āha | kahiṃ dāni abhiyuktā bhikṣubhikṣuṇīyo vā kriyāyāṃ vā | khaṇḍapralugge vā uddeśe svādhyāye yoge manasikāre kahiṃ vā śīghraṃ parisamāpyet | ciraṃ ca dṛśyeta sampakvo paribhuṃjyeta | labhyaṃ samyagmatī karma dātuṃ | amukaṃhi bhikṣū vā bhikṣuṇīyo vā abhiyuktā ity ādi | sā eṣā bhikṣuṇī sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ ātmano pariṇāmayen niḥsargika | sāṃghikaṃ lābhaṃ pudgalasya pariṇāmayet pācattikaṃ || gaṇalābhaṃ gaṇasya pariṇāmayet pācattikaṃ | parṣalābhaṃ parilābhaṃ pariṣāya pariṇāmayet pācattikaṃ | paudgalikaṃ pudgalasya pariṇāmayati vinayātikramaḥ | bhikṣur api gaṇalābhaṃ gaṇasya pariṇāmayati vinayātikramaḥ | tena bhagavān āha |
body.translated_text: Folio 71b. Then she asked: 'Noble one, where should a gift be given?' 'Wherever one has faith.' Then she asked: 'Where does a gift given bear great fruit?' It should be said: 'A gift given to the <s>Saṃgha</s> bears great fruit.' Then she asked: 'Where is the <s>Saṃgha</s> virtuous, endowed with good qualities, worthy, and desirous of training?' It should be said: 'There is no <s>Saṃgha</s> that is of bad conduct.' Then she asked: 'Where are <s>bhikṣus</s> or <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> devoted to practice, or to repair of broken and damaged [items], to recitation, self-study, meditation, and mental cultivation? Where does one quickly attain completion, and where is one seen for a long time as mature and fit to be honored?' It is permissible to direct a gift properly. [Say:] 'In such-and-such [place] the <s>bhikṣus</s> or <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are devoted,' etc. That <s>bhikṣuṇī</s> who diverts a <s>Saṃgha</s> gain for herself—it is a <s>niḥsargika</s> (forfeiture). Who diverts a <s>Saṃgha</s> gain for an individual—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Who diverts a group gain for a group—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Who diverts an assembly gain for the assembly—it is a <s>pācattika</s>. Who diverts an individual gain for an individual—it is a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. A <s>bhikṣu</s> too, who diverts a group gain for a group—it is a <s>vinayātikrama</s>. Therefore the <s>Bhagavān</s> said:

body.text: yā puna bhikṣuṇī jānantī gaṇalābhaṃ pariṇataṃ gaṇasya pariṇāmayet pācattikaṃ || lṛ ||
body.translated_text: Whatever <s>bhikṣuṇī</s>, knowing it to be a group gain that has been prepared, diverts it for a group—it is a <s>pācattika</s>.

Addenda 1 (p. iv)
vargāvaśeṣāḥ deśanā ca vihāro ca bhikṣuṇīnāñ ca ye daśa praṇītasammatam mātraṃ | yāvat vāsādanā iha chadanā sahaśayyā ca | samvidhānañ ca vuccati | niṣadyā ūnaviṃśo ca | araṇyāyāṃ ca śāṭikā dvāviṃśati śuddhekehi uddhārā bhikṣuṇīnāṃ pravuccati | deśanām uddharitvāna saṃcintyaṃ samodahe puno cātra ||
body.translated_text: Addendum 1 (p. iv). The remaining sections: teaching and dwelling and [rules] for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s>, which are ten; the refined-food measure; up to: offending here; covering; sharing a bed; and arrangement is said; sitting; under-twenty; and forest; and bathing cloth—twenty-two pure [rules]; the extractions for <s>bhikṣuṇīs</s> are declared. Having extracted the teaching, one should recombine harmoniously and again here.

body.text: atha puno vihāraṃ uddhariya bhaṇeya ko kuccaṃ | āsādanaṃ | apanetvā samodahe cīvaraṃ puno tatra vijñaptim uddharitvāna aparihatā catu nirdiṣṭā | apakarṣiya snānaṃ | bhīṣaṇāṃ samodahe | tatra chādanā uddharitvāna udakahāsyaṃ ca nirdiṣṭaṃ | utkṣipya ūnaviṃśati nirdiṣṭaṃ | aṅgulipratodo uddhariya araṇyavāsaṃ | samoho puno bhavati tatra eva tāvatā ca |
body.translated_text: Then again, having extracted the dwelling [rules], one should recite the comb; offending; having set aside, one should recombine the robe; again there, having extracted the request, four are specified without being removed; having withdrawn, bathing; frightening; one should recombine. There, having extracted the coverings, the water-jest is specified; having lifted up, under-twenty is specified; having extracted, the finger-pricking and forest-dwelling; the combination again comes to be with just that much.

body.text:
Addenda 1 (p. v)
uddhārā te bhūṣāḥ | paṇḍitena vijñeyāḥ | vargaṃ samuddharitvā saptamakaṃ | yate te bhūṣāḥ purimā ca sapta vargāḥ | saptati śiksāpadā samākhyātāḥ | anye ca sapta vargāh | yutaṃ yan bhikṣuṇīsūtre taṃ sarvam saṃkaletvāna śataṃ bhavati | piṇḍenaikacattālaṃ pācattikā nirdiṣṭāḥ bhikṣuṇīsūtre || uddiṣṭā āryamiśrikāyo ekacattālaṃ śataṃ śuddhapācattikā dharmāḥ |
body.translated_text: Addendum 1 (p. v). Those extractions are embellishments. They should be known by the wise. Having extracted the seventh section: where those embellishments are and the first seven sections—seventy training rules are declared. And seven more sections. What is combined in the <s>bhikṣuṇī-sūtra</s>—having combined all of that, it becomes one hundred. In total, one hundred and forty-one <s>pācattika</s> rules are specified in the <s>bhikṣuṇī-sūtra</s>. Recited [before] the noble assembly: one hundred and forty-one pure <s>pācattika</s> rules.

body.text: tatrāryamiśrikāyo pṛcchāmi kaccit tha pariśuddhāḥ | dvitīyaṃ pi tṛtīyaṃ pi pṛcchāmi | kaccit tha pariśuddhāḥ | pariśuddhā atrāryamiśrikāyo | yasmāt tūṣṇīm evam etad dhārayāmi || ḥ ||
body.translated_text: Therein, I ask the noble assembly: 'Are you pure?' A second and a third time I ask: 'Are you pure?' The noble assembly is pure. Since they are silent, thus I understand it.

body.text: 252. bhagavān śrāvastīyam viharati | atha khalu bhagavān mahāprajāpatīṃ gautamīm āmantreti | ekam idaṃ gautami samayaṃ tathāgato ihaiva śrāvastīyaṃ viharati |
body.translated_text: 252. The <s>Bhagavān</s> was dwelling at <s>Śrāvastī</s>. Then the <s>Bhagavān</s> addressed <s>Mahāprajāpatī Gautamī</s>: 'At one time, <s>Gautamī</s>, the <s>Tathāgata</s> was dwelling here in this very <s>Śrāvastī</s>.'
